desc: Our nation is founded on the strong backs of the brave Christian men who have joined our order as knights. Their martial prowess will compensate for our low numbers, compared to those of the Pagans surrounding us, as will the light and strength of our faith.
entities.name: Knights of the Livonian Order

desc: The knights of our order have proven their valor and skill in battle time and time again. By promoting the most capable among them to bannerets, we ensure that our armies will always be led by the best.
entities.name: Bannerets of the Livonian Order

desc: The many fortifications in our territories owe their construction and funding to our numerous Crusader bands. Flanked by sturdy walls, these fortifications will serve and protect our people for years to come!
entities.name: Baltic Crusader Forts

desc: The Ç̌äwa adapt a line formation, marching side by side and firing in order. When the first line in combat reloads their firearms, the second takes their position to fire, just to be replaced by the next one in a continuous motion.
entities.name: Ç̌äwa Line Infantry

desc: The Janissaries are the elite corps only loyal to the Sultan himself. Their ranks are made up through the Devşirme System of child levy and go through strict military training. As such, the Janissaries are the most disciplined forces of the Empire.
entities.name: Janissary Line Infantry

desc: The Bedouin are a wandering people who travel through the desert regions of the Arabian Peninsula, North Africa, the Levant and Mesopotamia. Through their nomadic lifestyle, they have mastered their riding skills, and the usage of the Arabian horses makes them a formidable cavalry force.
entities.name: Bedouin Cavalry

desc: The world evolves, and those who fail to adapt are forgotten by history. Our Order has endured for over half a millennium, and we will not fade away now! Our mortal bodies will eventually join the Creator, but our Order must first become immortal. We will transform ourselves into the most modern nation of our age, strengthening ourselves from the very core.
entities.name: A Brand New World

desc: Our advantageous central position in the Mediterranean enables effortless access to any shore. We should capitalize on this asset to seek alliances, forge new friendships, and expand our borders. With the sea as our gateway, opportunities abound for growth and prosperity in our quest for greater influence and security.
entities.name: A Central Mediterranean Power

desc: The introduction of gunpowder makes the traditional bows and javelins obsolete, but gives a new edge to the Ç̌äwa.
entities.name: Ç̌äwa Arquebusiers

desc: The Janissaries are the elite corps only loyal to the Sultan himself. Their ranks are made up through the Devşirme System of child levy and go through strict military training. As such, the Janissaries are the most disciplined forces of the Empire.
entities.name: Janissary Arquebusiers

desc: Our lands are a haven for the bold. Those looking to better their lives will find opportunity here, and we will in turn capitalize on the talents of these ambitious individuals to strengthen our nation.
entities.name: A Dynamic Society

desc: Our borders are not well-defended by natural features, as is the case in some other nations. However, we have wit and wisdom in abundance, enough to construct the mightiest fortifications possible to deter our enemies and protect our families.
entities.name: A Fortified Border

desc: Tuscany is the center of banking in Europe, with many powerful financial institutions headquartered in its major cities. From these bases, their influence extends across Italy and into northern Europe through extensive trade networks and lucrative partnerships.
entities.name: A Land of Banks

desc: The Great Khān was not only known for his fearsome sword, but also for the exceptional generosity towards those who wisely bent the knee to him. Those who welcome the rule of our tolerant empire shall be treated as part of it.
entities.name: A Magnanimous Empire

desc: For centuries, mining has shaped our landscape, economy, and culture. Significant Silver discoveries in the region have attracted miners and traders from diverse regions, fostering the Ore Mountains' growth and expanding our realm's significance and development.
entities.name: A Mining Heritage

desc: Despite our apparent isolation, we are well aware of the innovations happening around the world, and we waste no time in implementing these modernizations in order to maintain a competitive advantage over our rivals.
entities.name: A Modern Nation

desc: As long as any faithful Catholic is in danger of religious persecution, our mission is not over! Be it during a pilgrimage to the Tomb of our Lord and Savior, or while crossing the seas and fending off corsairs, we will never stop training and never rest, ready to leap into combat at a moment's notice.
entities.name: A Never-Ending Crusade

desc: Our nation has been reborn. The old ways of living are gone, like dreams melting into the morning light. It is time for us to face the world as a fully modernized nation.
entities.name: A New Dawn

desc: For centuries, our nation has lacked a permanent capital, with the court following the rulers wherever they desired. While this approach has its advantages, in order to effectively govern our vast nation we need to establish a strong central authority in a proper permanent location.
entities.name: A Permanent Capital

desc: The discipline of the Ç̌äwa Regiments gets further improved, making them fight more coordinated, inflicting deadly volleys to their enemies.
entities.name: Ç̌äwa Musketeers

desc: The Janissaries are the elite corps only loyal to the Sultan himself. Their ranks are made up through the Devşirme System of child levy and go through strict military training. As such, the Janissaries are the most disciplined forces of the Empire.
entities.name: Janissary Musketeers

desc: A better structure system allows the Ç̌äwa to be better trained and become a mighty force for Ethiopia.
entities.name: Ç̌äwa Regiments

desc: The Janissaries are the elite corps only loyal to the Sultan himself. Their ranks are made up through the Devşirme System of child levy and go through strict military training. As such, the Janissaries are the most disciplined forces of the Empire.
entities.name: Janissary Guards

desc: Our people are truly resilient, embodying unwavering determination in the face of challenges. They weather adversity with unwavering spirit, finding strength in unity and a steadfast commitment to their shared values. Their indomitable resilience propels us forward, enabling us to overcome any obstacle that comes our way. We will always emerge stronger and more determined than ever before.
entities.name: A Resilient Soul

desc: The most modern version of the Ç̌äwa. These fighters have reached the highest point in discipline and effectivity, becoming the terror of their enemies.
entities.name: Ç̌äwa Columns

desc: The Janissaries are the elite corps only loyal to the Sultan himself. Their ranks are made up through the Devşirme System of child levy and go through strict military training. As such, the Janissaries are the most disciplined forces of the Empire.
entities.name: Janissary Columns

desc: Religious infighting and intolerance plagues other lands, but we stand firm against allowing such strife to fester in our realm. Regardless of the diverse faiths our subjects hold, this nation shall be built on the strong pillars of tolerance and brotherhood, fostering a harmonious coexistence among all communities. United by a common vision, we will be forging a nation where respect and understanding flourish, paving the way for a prosperous future.
entities.name: A Tolerant Society

desc: Our nation is blessed with a well-established hub of cities focused on trade, and adventurous sailors willing to bring riches from all over the world back home. These seafarers will be an excellent way for us to trade with other nations and make significant profits.
entities.name: A Trading Hub

desc: External influences have their uses, but exposure to them can alter the nature of our beliefs. In order to maintain our identity, we must secure the domestic primacy of our own Tewahedo Church.
entities.name: A True Ethiopian Church

desc: Abaci may be ancient technology, but it is precisely thanks to proper accounting tools and ledgers that we are able to keep accurate accounts of our wealth. Without these tools and the talented experts who know how to use them, we would be blind to the actual richness of our country.
entities.name: Abacus

desc: We know from reading ancient Roman accounts that a citizen army of free men is far more willing to fight than those who are forced. We should give our peasants a relative amount of freedom; they will then fight more fervently to defend their homeland — and those privileges.
entities.name: Abolished Serfdom

desc: Many people demand to be given a role in the government, but mostly because they want to be rewarded without expending much effort. The idea of absolutism has recently piqued our interest, as adopting it would empower us to dispose of those self-serving parasites and rule alone...
entities.name: Absolute Rulership

desc: As various regions of the world are formally consolidated and resources become more limited, it is the right of the state to exercise an aggressive policy to satisfy the material needs of its people and expand its power. And while war should be seen as the last act of diplomacy, it is still a diplomatic play, as the state is above human restrictions such as morality and law.
entities.name: State Above All

desc: Absolutist rulers not only demonstrate their power in court, but also through an administrative apparatus that may spread throughout the country.
entities.name: Absolutist Administration

desc: Authority has become increasingly centralized in the person of the ruler. Courtiers and officials now serve as extensions of royal will rather than autonomous actors. This concentration of authority allows rulers to enact their wishes more quickly and efficiently.
entities.name: Absolutist Court

desc: For a long time, Naples has striven to be a center of modern learning, attracting the great minds of the age and spreading the light of the Renaissance. Under the leadership of Giovanni Pontano, these discussion circles have been given structure and organization. It is only fitting that we name the academy after its industrious leader.
entities.name: Accademia Pontaniana

desc: Our Grand Duke has established the ''Accademia del Cimento'' — the Academy of Experiment — gathering the finest scientific minds of the age under a single roof devoted to empirical inquiry, its members bound by the motto ''Provando e Riprovando'' — testing and retesting — that sets a new standard for the pursuit of knowledge. At the same time, the Grand Duchy is reshaping the municipalities of Tuscany, replacing the patchwork of local privileges with uniform administrative procedures that make the state's authority felt in every town and valley. This combination of scientific ambition and administrative rigor defines our duchy as a state where both ideas and governance are held to the same exacting standard of proof.
entities.name: Accademia del Cimento

desc: Some Christian denominations have decided to reduce the importance of the Old Testament, claiming that the arrival of Jesus completely supersedes it. We, however, maintain that it is still relevant, and that some instructions in it are as valid as they were when they were written.
entities.name: Acceptance of the Old Testament

desc: According to the legendary Mansa Mūsā, his predecessor started a journey across the Atlantic Ocean in hopes of discovering the furthest limits of the ocean. While some among the ruling class consider this endeavor a shameful abdication of duty, others see this as inspiration to explore corners of the world previously unknown to man.
entities.name: Accounts of the Atlantic Voyage

desc: Our coastal defenses are unmatched, utilizing Italian ''Trace Italienne'' design to repel enemy naval raids and incursions into our sovereign territory. We have transformed the old Crusader castles into modern artillery forts, capable of withstanding months of siege while projecting power over the Ionian and Aegean seas. No invader shall take the Morea by sea so long as our stone sentinels stand watch over the rocky capes and fertile valleys.
entities.name: A System of Forts

desc: As scholars flee the crumbling peripheries of the East, many find refuge in our courts, leading to a unique synthesis of Latin philosophy and Greek classical knowledge. Under the enlightened patronage of the Princes, we have established academies where the works of the great sages of both East and West are studied side-by-side, sparking a cultural rebirth. This intellectual flowering attracts the best minds of Europe, ensuring our state remains at the cutting edge of administrative and scientific progress.
entities.name: Achaean Enlightenment

desc: The feudal laws of the Frankish East are the most refined in the Catholic world, having been codified to manage a complex web of Greek serfs and French lords. These ''Assizes'' provide a clear legal framework for land disputes, inheritance, and military obligations, ensuring that even in times of war, the social order remains unbreakable. Rigorous adherence to these laws prevents the internal fractures that destroyed the first Crusader states, providing a rock-solid foundation for governance.
entities.name: Assizes of Romania

desc: Our nobility has spent centuries in constant border skirmishes against our enemies, creating a unique tradition of highly mobile cavalry. These knights have discarded the cumbersome barding of their French ancestors in favor of lighter armor and tactics adapted for the steep, treacherous Greek mountains. This allows our forces to outmaneuver traditional heavy cavalry and strike at the enemy's flanks with devastating speed and precision.
entities.name: Knights of the Peloponnese

desc: The Peloponnese remains the heart of European silk production, a legacy of the Byzantine era that the Frankish Princes have expanded through state-sponsored mulberry groves. By controlling strategic ports, we can undercut the high prices of Persian and Chinese imports, making Achaea the primary supplier for the garment makers of Florence and Lyon. This monopoly provides a steady stream of ''Soft Gold'' that funds our mercenaries and the fortification of our mountain passes.
entities.name: Morean Silk

desc: Geoffrey of Villehardouin, marshal of Champagne and eyewitness chronicler of the Fourth Crusade, composed one of the earliest vernacular histories in Old French, immortalizing the deeds of his companions and the astonishing capture of Constantinople in vivid, heroic prose that circulated widely among the nobility of Western Europe. His chronicle served not only as a record but as propaganda and inspiration, rallying fresh knights and pilgrims to reinforce the beleaguered Latin states, while fostering a shared sense of chivalric brotherhood among the scattered Frankish lords who continued to view themselves as crusaders holding God's frontier against schismatic and infidel alike long after the original host had dispersed. It is time to recover that spirit for the challenges of our army.
entities.name: Villehardouin's Valor

desc: It has long been the custom to gift parts of the Royal Domain to our nobility as a reward for their services, but this system cannot be sustained if we want to ensure the integrity of our domain. From now on, we will insist on renting these lands instead of outright giving them away.
entities.name: Act of Revocation

desc: There is what is ours, and what is part of our ancestral domain that will never be surrendered. A bit of flexibility in defining these 'ancestral' borders will lead to more land being accepted as our rightful territory, and should the worst happen, the whole world will know our crusade to recover it will be just.
entities.name: Adaptability

desc: Invaders from strange lands have set foot in our territory, and threaten our very existence. But our armies are adaptive; they adjust to new enemy tactics, learn to wield their very own weapons against them, and fight with an unbreakable resolve inspired by their foes.
entities.name: Adaptable Incan Army

desc: The New World is many things, but the most important thing of all is that it is empty. Well, no one important lives there, at any rate. By letting people know of the boundless opportunities that await them in the New World, we will encourage more people to go forth and settle there.
entities.name: Additional Colonists

desc: The drive to expand our country means we must also expand our diplomatic reach. We must ensure that our diplomatic service is properly staffed.
entities.name: Additional Diplomats

desc: Naturally, there are those within our subject nations who recognize our divine right to rule. By recruiting and aiding these enlightened individuals, we can strengthen our grasp on these territories.
entities.name: Additional Loyalist Recruitment

desc: Colonies are no good to us unless we can bring their riches home to the mother country. We must expand our merchant class to ensure that this happens.
entities.name: Additional Merchants

desc: A military leader must not only know about military matters. Logistics, supply administration and allocation, monetary expenses, and similar topics are all also critical concerns for any successful military campaign.
entities.name: Administrative Leadership

desc: The Admiralty is tasked with the protection of our maritime interests. With military and civil administration both represented in one, the balance of interest will be fairly represented.
entities.name: Admiralty

desc: Rejecting the dualism between consciousness and matter, Advaita Vedānta claims that the Ātman, or the innermost self or consciousness, is one and the same as the supreme reality or consciousness of the universe, Brahman. In this sense, the physical material world is just an illusion hiding the ultimate reality of the Brahman.
entities.name: Advaita Vedānta

desc: In our age of discovery and humanism, there is no longer a place for the thievery and violence that pirates inflict on the high seas. More and more nations are banding together to face this common threat to the well-being and prosperity of all, and have sworn to put an end to this scourge.
entities.name: Renunciation of Privateering

desc: Allows us to increase our tax revenues by adopting a more bureaucratic administrative system governed by state officials.
entities.name: Advanced Bureaucracy

desc: The development of more advanced and durable tools has made possible to further expand mining operations for new minerals and metals.
entities.name: Advanced Mining

desc: Paiks are foot soldiers of India who are renowned for their offensive and defensive versatility and their skill in archery. As the weapons develop, so does their portfolio of skills. Thus, the bows of the early eras have been replaced by the modern musket, yet their versatility still prevails.
entities.name: Advanced Paiks

desc: A stronger focus on agricultural production will help our people thrive. Thankfully, we have the ample space and fertile soil necessary to grow a number of crops.
entities.name: Sturdy Grains Agriculture

desc: The canal network that threads through the Lombard plain started as a simple irrigation system but has grown into the arteries of our entire regional economy, connecting Milan to the Po and carrying grain, timber, and finished goods at a fraction of the cost of road transport. We have invested in widening and deepening these waterways, building new locks that allow heavier barges to move year-round without depending on seasonal water levels. This network cuts the cost of supplying our cities and moving troops, making Lombardy one of the most efficiently administered territories in Italy.
entities.name: The Navigli

desc: We have many covert operations planned, but lack sufficient agents to carry them out. Establishing a training method for our spies will help bolster the ranks of operatives available for dangerous missions.
entities.name: Agent Training

desc: The Sama and other sea-wandering peoples have long lived upon the water itself, drifting between islands with unmatched skill. Through knowledge-sharing or agreements of mutual respect and shared opportunity, we shall ensure safe passage and swift repairs.
entities.name: Agreements with the Sea Nomads

desc: The land is generous, and provides us with abundant crops and resources. But in order to advance our society and become a prosperous nation, we must learn how to shape and tame the land, and to extract the best possible treasures from it.
entities.name: Agriculture

desc: Also called capitulations, the Ahidnâme are contractual agreements with other nations, drawing upon both Muslim and secular law. Ahidnâme are most often used for guaranteeing the protection and rights of foreign merchants and clergy within our lands, ensuring that justice is upheld and trade can flow unhampered.
entities.name: Ahidnâme

desc: The concept of Ahiṃsā, or nonviolence, is a key virtue among all religions following the Dharma. Any conflict is encouraged to be resolved peacefully through dialogue, rather than the use of force. Unfortunately, that is not always possible, but violence should always be the last resort, and its use must be just.
entities.name: Ahiṃsā

desc: Our light cavalry regiments often raid and sometimes even settle in neighboring territories. Known for their courage in battle, they lived and operated as raiders on the frontier, often the first line of response against incursions from our rivals and perfectly positioned to attack and rout enemy trade routes.
entities.name: Akıncılar

desc: Originally based on ancient Khmer script, Thai writing has evolved to be quite distinct from its original form to accommodate the complex phonology of our language. Having a unique written language has certainly contributed to the development of our unique culture.
entities.name: Akson Thai

desc: We are among the first Japanese to have established permanent trade with the Ainu. Our ships go back and forth between their lands and ours, greatly benefiting both communities.
entities.name: Ainu Trade

desc: The position of the Ezo ''Kanrei'', or administrator of Ezo, has been assigned to our clan since the time of the Kamakura Shogunate. We are in charge of managing the island as a place of exile for criminals, necessitating constant communication across the strait.
entities.name: Ezo Kanrei

desc: Akita, our fief in northern Dewa Province, was an ancient zone of conflict against northern 'barbarians'. The border of Japan has expanded far into the North, but the spirit of our ancestors still lives in our blood — let any who dare stand in our way!
entities.name: March of Akita

desc: By appointing a loyal ''Qā'id'' to oversee provinces and regulate trade on behalf of the state, we empower urban merchants while ensuring provincial governance. Ensuring fair dealings and regulated markets will greatly strengthen our economic base.
entities.name: Al-Qā'id

desc: Our latest crowned heads can be traced directly to the lineage of the Capetian House of Anjou, specifically established by Charles I of Naples to serve as his gateway into the Byzantine heartlands. This connection grants us a unique Western prestige among the fragmented Balkan lords, allowing us to claim a seat at the table of the great Catholic monarchs of Europe. By upholding the honors and heraldry of the Lily, we distinguish our sovereignty from that of mere tribal chieftains.
entities.name: Angevin Legitimacy

desc: Our position allows us to act as the essential bridge between the Italian city-states and the rugged Balkan interior. Our diplomats are trained to navigate both the Venetian Senate and tribal councils, making our mediation indispensable for trade and war.
entities.name: Diplomacy of the Two Shores

desc: Our urban centers continue to operate under both the sophisticated principles of Byzantine Law and the modern bureaucracies of the West. This legal continuity provides a stable framework for contracts, property rights, and inheritance that attracts foreign merchants and scholars to our courts. A predictable legal system is the foundation of our growing administrative strength.
entities.name: Eastern and Western Heritage

desc: Following the European trend, our monarchs have centralized power, stripping the old clans of their feudal privileges in favor of a modern state. This move has allowed us to implement universal taxation and a national judicial system, turning the kingdom into a streamlined machine of war.
entities.name: Enlightened Albanian Absolutism

desc: The merchants of our coast have become the primary carriers of trade between the Balkans and the West. By utilizing the Greek language for commerce and Albanian for loyalty, they dominate the markets from Venice to Constantinople. These merchant marines are the lifeblood of our modernizing economy.
entities.name: The Albanian Merchant Class

desc: Over time, a good number of our people have emigrated abroad and formed ''Arbëreshë'' communities. These 'Albanians across the sea' maintain our language and traditions while gaining influence in their new homes. They serve as permanent diplomatic envoys there, constantly lobbying for support for the homeland.
entities.name: The Arbëreshë Diaspora

desc: As the power of our foes wanes, our great houses have united to ensure the survival of our nation. By leveraging our position between the Catholic West and the Orthodox East, we have become masters of maritime diplomacy and coastal trade. This strategic autonomy allows us to navigate the rivalries of neighbors to our own benefit.
entities.name: The Arbërian Principality

desc: Positioned as the easternmost outpost of the Roman Church, we have become the primary shield against both Orthodox schismatics and Turkish heathens. This sacred duty gives us an inner peace that infuses the entire realm, transforming our struggle into a crusade for our soul.
entities.name: The Catholic Bulwark

desc: Despite our communities being divided by faith, our nation is devoted to Christ, earning us the title of ''Athleta Christi''. Our relentless faith has drawn the eyes of the Papacy and the Patriarchs, securing us financial subsidies and military volunteers. We fight not just for our land, but for the very survival of the 'Word of Christ'.

mods.label: Damage Done versus Heathens in Battle

entities.name: The Champion of Christ

desc: We will not rest until the borders of the ancient Kingdom are restored to their greatest extent and beyond, reclaiming our place as masters of the Balkans. This centralizing mission allows us to integrate newly conquered territories with minimal friction as we restore 'rightful' rule.
entities.name: The Expansion of the Regnum

desc: As the primary port for Western intervention, we have modernized the shipyards of Durrës to maintain a permanent fleet of galleys. This infrastructure allows us to project power across the Adriatic, ensuring that the sea lanes between Naples and Albania remain open for reinforcements and trade. Our control of the harbor makes us the undisputed masters of the western Balkan coastline.
entities.name: The National Arsenal

desc: Our 'National Rebirth' or ''Rilindja'' has ignited a fire in the hearts of Albanians everywhere, from the mountains of the north to the diaspora in Italy and Egypt. This cultural and political movement has unified all Albanians under the common banner of 'Albanianism'. We are a nation reborn, ready to take our place among the sovereign states of Europe.
entities.name: The Spirit of the Rilindja

desc: The Accursed Mountains that rise in the heart of our lands are as much a part of our people as the ''Kanun'' itself. Even the humblest villager knows which passes are passable in winter, which ridges offer shelter from ambush, and which valleys lead nowhere. Invaders who march into these mountains find themselves trapped in a maze by the terrain long before they meet our warriors.
entities.name: Bjeshkët e Namuna

desc: Scholars and patriots are working tirelessly to standardize the Albanian language using a unified Latin alphabet. By establishing national schools and printing newspapers in the vernacular, we are breaking the cultural hegemony of foreign tongues. Literacy in Albanian is the first step toward true independence.
entities.name: The Albanian Alphabet Commission

desc: Throughout the countryside, the nobility and wealthy farmers have constructed ''Kulla'' — fortified stone tower houses. These structures serve as miniature citadels, protecting families from both blood feuds and enemy raids. They represent a society that is permanently mobilized for defense.
entities.name: The Fortified Kulla Houses

desc: In the absence of a central crown, our social order is maintained by the ''Kanun'', a sophisticated code of customary law. This legal framework governs everything from property rights to the sacred duty of ''Besa'' (the sworn oath). The ''Kanun'' provides a bedrock of stability and honor that foreign administrators can never fully dismantle.
entities.name: The Kanun

desc: The concept of ''Besa'' has evolved into a national institution of trust and hospitality. An Albanian's word is his bond, and this reputation for unwavering loyalty makes us the most trusted guards and mercenaries in the Mediterranean. In a world of shifting alliances, our word is our most valuable currency.
entities.name: The Sacred Oath

desc: The poverty of our mountains has turned our men into the finest light cavalry in Christendom. These Stratioti are sought after by every major power from Venice to France for their unparalleled skills in skirmishing and reconnaissance. By exporting our martial prowess, we bring wealth back to our hills and ensure our soldiers are the most experienced in Europe.
entities.name: The Stradioti Tradition

desc: The seasonal movement of livestock — Transhumance — allows our people to utilize the high summer pastures and the warm winter plains of the coast. This mobile lifestyle makes our population difficult to pin down and provides a resilient food supply that cannot be easily burned by a scorched-earth campaign. Our wealth walks on four legs, always ready to move to safer ground.
entities.name: The Transhumance Networks

desc: The art of alchemy involves the creation of potions and elixirs using a combination of herbs, minerals, and other natural ingredients. While not always reliable, the use of alchemy can sometimes produce remarkable results in treating various ailments.
entities.name: Alchemy

desc: No country benefits from its neighbors being constantly vigilant of its movements. We must employ active diplomacy to immediately deflate any tensions that may arise, so that our neighbors have no reason to be concerned about us.
entities.name: Deflating Tensions

desc: Our faith is the beginning and end of all things. The voice of our god shall be the only sound that our enemies hear above the screams of the battle; the words of our faith shall lead them to the truth.
entities.name: Alpha and Omega

desc: The Swiss landscape is dominated by rough terrain, mountains, and valleys. We must find a way to overcome the challenges our environment presents, and to find a way to use it as a weapon against any potential invaders.
entities.name: Alpine Defense

desc: Our coastal raiders provide our nation with a constant influx of captives from Europe through maritime raids and coastal incursions. This steady supply of enslaved labor is key to expanding our workforce and increasing our economic success.
entities.name: Amazigh Slave Raids

desc: The Low Countries have traditionally had a high rate of urbanization, which has allowed us to achieve power beyond what most might expect. We should accelerate this trend by creating a robust network of prosperous settlements that can help us create a wealthier future.
entities.name: Early Urbanization

desc: Our region is diverse in cultures and religions, and the only thing that keeps it united is not compassion, but a powerful ruler, capable of dealing swiftly and decisively with any attempt at revolt.
entities.name: An Iron Fist

desc: While some nations are often described as an ''Army with a State'', we, on the other hand, have always been an Order with a nation, ever since our acquisition of Rhodes from the Greeks. Nevertheless, we cannot help but admire how efficiently they have harnessed their resources to become a formidable nation. Inspired by their success, we will implement reforms to ensure our military can confront any adversary with confidence.
entities.name: An Order with a State

desc: Our Bible contains all books worthy of veneration and study, even though some may have less importance than others. The Anagignoskomena are not present in the Hebrew Bible, so they receive less attention than other texts, but they are nonetheless worthy of being read and should not be disregarded.
entities.name: Anagignoskomena

desc: Physicians are developing a more advanced understanding of the human body, which is leading to more effective treatments for injuries and diseases. This knowledge, largely gleaned from practical dissections of human cadavers, is also helping to improve surgical techniques and reduce the risks of medical procedures.
entities.name: Anatomy

desc: The golden lilies and double-headed eagles of our banners speak to ancient rights and royal ambitions. Claims that stretch across Italy, reaching as far as Albania and Jerusalem, still echo in our hearts. Let the House of Valois-Anjou rise higher than ever before!
entities.name: Angevin Heraldry

desc: Following the heroic example of our leaders, our house is known as the first to rise and the last to surrender against our foes. This legacy of unyielding resistance has forged our people into a nation of warriors who see struggle as a sacred duty rather than a burden.
entities.name: Arianiti's Defiance

desc: Our ancestral home in the highlands of our nation is a natural citadel of jagged peaks and narrow ravines that is nearly impossible for a conventional army to navigate. We have further fortified every strategic pass and mountain peak, ensuring that any enemy invader must pay a staggering price in blood for every inch of our territory they attempt to occupy.
entities.name: Born in the Highlands

desc: By providing significant land grants and funds to our monasteries, we maintain the spiritual loyalty of the nobility and the peasantry. These sacred sites serve as the cultural heart of our principality, where our victories are celebrated.
entities.name: Patronage of the Faith

desc: We have sworn an eternal oath that so long as we breathe, the heart of the rebellion will continue to beat. Our troops are drilled with a fanatical devotion to our ruling house, ensuring they maintain discipline even in the face of overwhelming imperial numbers.
entities.name: The Eternal Resistance

desc: The rugged mountains of central Albania under our control are rich in high-quality iron ore essential for the tools of war. We have established state-sponsored smelters to provide our clans with a constant supply of superior steel blades and armor plates, ensuring we are never dependent on foreign imports to equip our growing armies.
entities.name: The Iron Mines of the Interior

desc: We have evolved our traditional skirmishers into elite mountain grenadier units, specialized in heavy assault and siege warfare. These troops combine their ancestral mountain agility with the devastating firepower of modern explosives, making them the terror of any fortress garrison.
entities.name: The Professional Highland Grenadiers

desc: The rise of cutthroat, lawless buccaneers in the New World — and along the maritime routes leading to it — had made a great impact on our merchants and our trade. From now on, our merchant ships will form convoys with an accompanying warship to protect them, and will have on board a small military contingent to further ensure their survival on the high seas.
entities.name: Merchant Convoys

desc: An apothecary is a place where medicines can be found and dispensed. These come from a variety of sources, including herbs and other natural remedies, but also from more exotic materials, such as animal horns or mercury.
entities.name: Apothecary

desc: Having talented military experts leading our men into battle, rather than entrusting that duty to inept nobles who only were put in leadership roles because of their blue blood, make our armies work more efficiently. The result of that is that we can more easily command larger forces.
entities.name: Appointed Chain of Command

desc: Our territory sits at the junction of the Julian Alps and the Karst plateau, a landscape that provides natural defensive advantages to those who know how to use it and proves lethal to armies that do not. We invest in the fortification of the key passes and valley approaches, training our garrison forces to hold terrain rather than meet the enemy in open ground, and establishing a network of signal stations that ensures no advance can reach us without warning. This system of ''Difesa Alpina'' makes our territory one of the most costly to invade in the region, converting the rugged landscape into an ally that inflicts losses on any hostile force before our own soldiers need to engage.
entities.name: Alpine Defense

desc: Long before the Roman legions formalized it, the route that carried Baltic amber from the northern seas down to the Adriatic ran through our territory, making Aquileia one of the great entrepôts of the ancient world and establishing trade habits that outlasted the empire which later paved the road. We revive and invest in this corridor, improving the roads and staging posts that connect our city to the Alpine passes and the trading networks beyond them, ensuring that our merchants can reach markets to the north with greater efficiency than any rival route. This control over the ''Amber Road'' multiplies our diplomatic reach and makes our trading lanes the preferred route for goods moving between the Adriatic and central Europe.
entities.name: The Amber Road

desc: The memory of Aquileia as a crossroads between west and east, between the Roman and the Slavic worlds, and between the Latin and the Germanic, has given our institutions an instinctive openness to ideas from outside that more homogeneous states can struggle to achieve. We build on this tradition by welcoming the scholars and administrators produced by the Enlightenment into our governing institutions, reforming our laws by the same principles of reason and evidence that the patriarchate once applied to canon law in a different era. This spirit of the ''Patriarcato illuminato'' earns our state a reputation as a place where ideas are taken seriously and institutions are genuinely open to improvement, drawing scholars and skilled administrators whose presence accelerates every reform we attempt.
entities.name: The Enlightened Patriarchate

desc: The Friulian countryside has always been a frontier, and the men raised on its farmsteads and in its market towns carry a soldier's habits from youth — accustomed to bearing arms, experienced in the local terrain, and under no illusions about what happens to those who cannot defend themselves on a border that hostile powers have crossed many times. We formalize this martial tradition by organizing, equipping, and training the ''Milizia Friulana'' on a professional footing, giving these experienced men the discipline and the leadership that converts their individual hardiness into a reliable military force. This soldiery gives our armies a core of steady infantry who fight for their own soil and hold their ground with a tenacity that mercenary formations rarely match.
entities.name: Friulian Soldiery

desc: For centuries, the patriarchs of Aquileia administered a territory that stretched from the Adriatic coast to the Alpine passes, managing ecclesiastical law, civil disputes, and diplomatic relations with secular powers simultaneously — an administrative experience that accumulated in our institutions long after the patriarchate's temporal power was absorbed by Venice. We draw on this heritage to rationalize and improve our own machinery of government, applying the procedural knowledge of an institution that once governed a far larger and more complex territory to the more manageable scale of our current state. This ''Patriarchal Legacy'' of administrative sophistication makes our cabinet more effective and our legislation more coherent, giving us a governmental capacity that belies the modest size of our domain.
entities.name: The Patriarchal Legacy

desc: Aquileia was once the fourth city of the Roman Empire and later the seat of a patriarchate that claimed authority over the whole of northeastern Italy and the eastern Alps, a tradition of ecclesiastical prestige that lingered in our institutions long after the political power that created it had passed. We draw on this heritage to build institutions of learning that reflect the city's ancient role as a center of transmission between the Latin west and the Slavic and Germanic east. This tradition of the ''Patriarchate of Aquileia'' as a crossroads of cultures and books gives our state an unusual depth of literacy and a tolerance rooted in centuries of managing Christians of different rites under a single ecclesiastical roof.
entities.name: The Patriarchate of Aquileia

desc: Through carefully laid stone channels and gravity-fed conduits, this construct secures a steady supply of fresh water. While simple in construction, these works mark the first step toward organized urban water management.
entities.name: Aqueduct System

desc: Our realm is firmly fixated on the vast expanse of the sea, its attention directed towards maritime pursuits. With a strategic outlook, it harnesses naval power and maritime trade to strengthen its position and expand its influence. Our maritime focus shapes our policies, fostering a seafaring culture that propels the nation's prosperity.
entities.name: A Maritime Realm

desc: The Mediterranean Sea's gentle embrace caresses our shores, beckoning our people to engage trade endeavors from generation to generation. Our bustling commercial centers and strategic trade posts scattered throughout the Mediterranean will play a crucial role in realizing our ambition to become a dominant force in trade.
entities.name: A Mediterranean Trade Power

desc: Almogavars are a class of light infantry soldiers originating from the Crown of Aragon. These quick-moving warriors serve as frontier defenders and foot soldiers. In addition to their role in the Reconquista, they have also found employment as mercenaries in Italy, the Frankokratia, and the Levant.
entities.name: Almogavars

desc: Some of the fiercest and deadliest crossbowmen in the Western Mediterranean, the Catalan Crossbowmen competed against the Genoese Crossbowmen for supremacy in this field.
entities.name: Catalan Crossbowmen

desc: Our traders are wasting resources competing with each other. This is silly; we should focus all our efforts on taking trade from others instead! Let us charter companies who will be given temporary monopolies on trade from certain regions and whose renewal will be dependent on giving the Crown its rightful due.
entities.name: Chartered Merchant Companies

desc: Since its inception, our nation has consisted of diverse realms brought together under a single ruler. However, each realm retains its unique traditions and laws. Consequently, numerous major cities have emerged as regional metropolises, representing and governing their respective regions.

mods.label: Possible Burghers in Towns and Cities

entities.name: Constellation of Cities

desc: ''Desperta Ferro!'' — Awake Iron! — is the fearsome battle cry of the Almogavars, invoking the presence of iron in combat. It is accompanied by striking lances and darts against flints to create sparks. Among other war cries like ''Aragó!'' and ''Sant Jordi!'', ''Desperta Ferro!'' stands out as the most renowned and unique.
entities.name: Desperta Ferro!

desc: In the bustling Mediterranean, fleets gather from around the world, prompting the need for a legal system to address crimes in the crowded land and sea. ''Ordinacions sobre lo fet de la mar'', or ''Ordinances on What Happens in the Sea'', is one of the earliest military codes of justice, created to govern fleets. This unique response to the post-Black Death era recruits crew members, including criminals, from outside Aragon, resulting in a harmonized code formed from diverse traditions rather than a mere codification of existing naval customs.
entities.name: Fleet Ordinances

desc: The ''Fallas'' celebration has acted as a catalyst within the Crown of Aragon, spurring advancements in artillery techniques through the practical expertise gained from handling gunpowder for firecrackers and fireworks. This festive tradition has fueled a spirit of innovation, resulting in the development of new strategies and knowledge about artillery.
entities.name: Gunpowder Souls

desc: The Almogavars, embracing new innovations, have undergone remarkable adaptations to enhance their efficiency on the battlefield. Integrating cutting-edge weaponry and strategic advancements into their traditional tactics, these formidable warriors have become even more formidable. With a blend of ancient expertise and modern tools, they stand as a prime example of the seamless fusion between tradition and innovation in warfare.
entities.name: Reformed Almogavars

desc: The ''Escuadras de Paisanos'', known as ''Esquadres de Catalunya'' or ''Mossos d'Esquadra'', are a local militia dedicated to safeguarding trade routes and fairs, making the most of their intimate familiarity with the terrain. Inspired by their success, we aim to establish similar militias in our other territories, composed of local inhabitants. This should foster a harmonious coexistence and ensure peace in these regions.
entities.name: Mossos d'Esquadra

desc: Our soldiers would want their loved ones to be looked after in the event they perish in battle. Aragon will do its duty and ensure that this is done through establishing a system of workhouses for orphans of the fallen.
entities.name: Protect the Smallfolk

desc: The ''Remença'' system, particular to Catalonia, has close equivalents in other territories of the Crown, fostering a collective drive towards greater raw goods production. Through this framework, our lands experience a surge in wealth, igniting the potential for substantial progress towards fulfilling our objectives. By harmonizing these systems, we will cultivate an environment where our endeavors are fortified by the abundance of resources, fueling a path of growth and prosperity for our realm.
entities.name: Remença

desc: Since the merger of between us and the County of Barcelona in 1164, Aragon has functioned as a Confederation, comprising distinct realms under a central ruler. These differences have fostered prosperity and maintained individual identities, yet have also given rise to an illusion of disunity. This has led to the need for administrative reforms to strengthen our union while honoring the unique characteristics of each territory.
entities.name: Stronger United

desc: The realm we inhabit has ascended to literary heights as yet unattained by many neighboring nations, thanks to the remarkable contributions of esteemed authors such as Joanot Martorell, Ausiàs March, and Isabel de Villena. Their profound literary works have elevated our culture to unparalleled levels, instilling a sense of pride within our people. Undeniably, our nation stands as a radiant beacon of culture, shining brightly for all to behold.
entities.name: Valencian Golden Age

desc: Our lands are host to some of the most holy sites in our faith. This divine proximity makes our people connect deeply with their beliefs, inspiring them to further and further greatness.
entities.name: Cradle of Islam

desc: Ever since antiquity, Yemen has been known as 'Arabia Felix', the Fortunate Arabia. Blessed with a temperate highland climate and fertile soil in a sea of desert, it remains one of the most naturally prosperous regions of the peninsula. Let us nurture that prosperity and use it as the foundation of a thriving realm.
entities.name: Arabia Felix

desc: There are many trade outposts along our coastline, dealing in precious goods both from our own lands and foreign shores. It is time that we claim our fair share of this wealth.
entities.name: Red Sea Trade

desc: The inhospitable deserts of Arabia have made our warriors stronger, able to wear down the enemy before moving in for the killing blow.
entities.name: Strength of the Desert

desc: The Horses we raise are desired in many foreign lands for their beauty and strength. With our focus set on raising and exporting them, we will benefit greatly from their renown.
entities.name: Arabian Horsemanship

desc: Asia is home to some very inhospitable lands, from the high peaks of the Himalaya, to the arid span of the Gobi Desert, to the dense jungles of India and South East Asia. And that does not even include the monsoon and typhoon seasons, and the almost constant present of earthquakes! Its people have learned to live in such an unwelcoming environment, but invaders will not find it so easy.
entities.name: Arduous Terrain

desc: Capitalizing on our position as a safe harbor, the merchant houses of Nauplia have developed a sophisticated system of maritime insurance and risk-sharing for Aegean trade. By guaranteeing the safety of Latin cargoes against piracy and storms, we have turned our port into the financial safe haven of the Peloponnese. This early form of financial capitalism draws capital away from the larger Italian republics and concentrates it in our own local banks.
entities.name: Argive Maritime Insurance

desc: Recognizing that the future of warfare is determined by the cannon, we have turned our high-altitude forts into laboratories for ballistics and gunnery. Our officers are trained to calculate firing arcs from extreme heights, allowing our batteries to hit enemy ships with pinpoint accuracy. The ''Argos School of Gunnery'' is respected across Europe for its mathematical precision and tactical innovation.
entities.name: The Artillery School of Argos

desc: In a daring move toward social stability, the Lordship has reformed the high court of Nauplia into the Curia of the Two Benches. This judicial body requires that every civil case involving land or inheritance be heard by a panel consisting of one Frankish judge and one Greek Demogeron (Elder). By institutionalizing this 'Shared Justice', we have effectively ended the centuries-old legal friction between the Latin and Orthodox populations. This governance model has created a unique 'Argive Identity' that is fiercely loyal to the Lordship, protecting the state from the revolutionary fervors sweeping through the rest of Europe.
entities.name: The Curia of the Two Benches

desc: The Palamidi fortress, perched high above the Gulf of Argos, has been expanded into a complex system of seven interlocking forts that command the entire Argolid. By controlling this 'Gibraltar', we dictate the movement of any fleet attempting to supply an army in the Morea, effectively making the lordship unconquerable by land or sea. This strategic dominance allows us to play the role of kingmaker between our neighbours.
entities.name: The Gibraltar of the Levant

desc: As the House of Brienne maintains claims to Jerusalem and Cyprus, Argos has become a center for 'Chivalric Genealogy'. Knights from across the West come here to prove their lineage or seek titles in the 'crusader fringe'. This constant influx of high-born adventurers provides a rotating pool of talented officers for our local levies.
entities.name: The Heraldry of the Brienne

desc: Because Argos is the most neutral and secure port in the Peloponnese, it has become the preferred meeting ground for the ambassadors of the Latin states. We have established a permanent 'Diplomatic Quarter' where treaties are negotiated and alliances are forged between the Frankish lords and the Great Powers. This role as a regional mediator grants us an international influence that protects us from being annexed by our larger neighbors.
entities.name: The Peloponnesian Diplomatic Hub

desc: Aristocracy is a key part of any monarchy, as the nobles surrounding the royal dynasty are precisely what gives justification to the monarch. In the end, the concept of royal blood cannot exist without the corresponding concept of noble blood. As such, the aristocracy supports the monarch, but they expect to have some privileges in exchange for their loyalty, as they must never be confused with the common rabble.
entities.name: Aristocracy

desc: Armenia was the first nation to declare Christianity as its state religion. As such, our religious traditions, especially those of our clergy, are a major component of our identity.
entities.name: Armenian Apostolic Church

desc: Since ancient times, Armenia has been the reluctant battleground between larger nations. Even after regaining our sovereignty, remaining neutral is extremely difficult — it is not impossible to appease everyone, but it is not easy, either.
entities.name: Border Nation

desc: In our long and illustrious history, Armenian kingdoms spread over a large territory, and so did our Armenian people. By emulating these bygone realms, we become a beacon of all Armenian people, who will happily unite under our leadership.
entities.name: Greater Armenia

desc: Our fortresses are a brilliant emblem of our resilience and fortitude, built to endure not only the difficult local climate, but also any foreign invader foolish enough to mount an attack into our unforgiving territory.
entities.name: Highland Fortresses

desc: Armenia has been ravaged by war for centuries. By reclaiming the lands lost in these struggles, making them suitable for inhabitation, and restoring ruined churches and fortresses, we can improve the lives of our people and take firmer control over our territory.
entities.name: Reclaimed Territory

desc: Hayk, descendant of Noah, founded our kingdom at the base of Mount Ararat after defeating the Babylonians, and thus became the patriarch of our nation. All our people know this story, and all are proud to belong to such an ancient lineage.
entities.name: Legacy of Hayk

desc: As one of the few bastions of an independent Armenian state, Armenia is governed by feudal suzerains called ''meliks'', as the old system of Nakharar Titles collapsed after the Mongol invasions. The relationship between meliks and their subordinates is that of a military commanding officer and junior officer, and not of feudal lord and a serf.
entities.name: Melikdom Organization

desc: Mount Ararat, where Noah's Ark came to rest after the Great Flood, is where our nation first formed. As a result, our people resist with a particularly holy fervor when the sanctity of our territory is threatened.
entities.name: Mount Ararat

desc: Armenia is a mountainous land. Our people have adapted to this terrain over the centuries, and we have developed many ways to use those mountains to our advantage. Our armies will gather readily when called, confident in the additional protection our unique environment provides.
entities.name: Mountain Armies

desc: The ''Nakharar'' system of titles was in continuous use in Armenia from its inception until the times of the Mongol invasions, when it collapsed. Although the titles themselves are no longer in use, certain characteristics of that system persist, enhancing the abilities of both our nobles and armies.
entities.name: Nakharar Titles

desc: After decades of warfare on every border, we learned to fight with weapons of both east and west. Blending Muscovite grit with western precision, our armories now produce elite artillery and tactics unmatched by our rivals. From our forges comes firepower — and from firepower, domination and perseverance.
entities.name: The Armories of Smolensk

desc: The development of Professional Armies has created the need of getting new sources of [
]. The Armory can be built in [Urban Locations] to increase it.
entities.name: Armory

desc: Our professional diplomats and spies excel at fabricating credible pretexts to justify almost any action we might take on the international stage.
entities.name: Pretexts

desc: Our army is feared far and wide. Despite our reputation, we should still establish diplomatic relations with nations that have the same goal as ourselves: the destruction of our common enemies. By sending well-armed and escorted envoys to foreign courts, we can ensure our diplomatic reach will not suffer under outbreaks of violence.
entities.name: Armed Envoys

desc: Our people are fearsome warlords who wish to spread their legacy to every corner of the world. As a means of integrating and managing our ever-growing domain, we have decided to mostly respect the way conquered locals conduct themselves, and not to interfere excessively.
entities.name: Respect Local Government

desc: Raiding and looting is fundamentally how our army sustains itself. Everywhere our troops go, they pillage as much as they can.
entities.name: Raider Troops

desc: Through the use of mounted scouts, we can check the terrain lying ahead of armies, and plan how to maneuver around any difficulties. This allows us to travel at a faster rate than other armies could in that same location.
entities.name: Scouting Parties

desc: Army doctrines represent skillsets in which our [

] can specialize. The longer we work under these doctrines, the more entrenched they become in our military culture, and the more skilled we become at them. Over time, this can lead to powerful benefits for our glorious forces.
entities.name: Army Doctrine

desc: The element of surprise, combined with landing the first strike, often determines the ultimate victor in an armed conflict. Boosting our military initiative is an excellent way to maintain a competitive advantage.
entities.name: First Strike

desc: Field magazines are not new technology, but their use has been greatly popularized by the unparalleled growth of modern armies. The steady supply of ammunition they provide facilitates ease of army movement, and extends their operational range.
entities.name: Magazines

desc: Paying fair prices for the food and supplies our army needs while moving through a region instead of raiding accelerates our movement through the area, as the peasants themselves will bring their goods to the collection points we establish.
entities.name: Supply Contracts

desc: As we learned from the Persian invasion of Greece so long ago, a small army can defeat a larger one — as long as they have iron discipline and the proper training. We must elevate our own army to meet these extraordinary standards.
entities.name: Army Professionalism

desc: Dedication to the aesthetic crafts, and the refinement of our artists, must be properly cultivated by the establishment of art schools. Each shall be an incubator for gifted individuals to commence their artistic careers and bring glory and splendor to our nation!
entities.name: Art Schools

desc: The invention of gunpowder in Sòng China has led to the development of a new device that employs its firepower in warfare: the artillery. These weapons pose a serious threat to stone-built castles and other fortifications.
entities.name: Siege Artillery

desc: Gunpowder has made way for the creation of multiple different types of weapons. Cutting through lines of infantry does not require the same power as breaking down castle walls, and so a specialized type of cannon has to be deployed in sieges.
entities.name: Siege Cannons

requires.label: March to the Sound of Guns

desc: The need for a weapon that fills the niche between the direct fire of siege cannon and the indirect one of the mortars has led our military to develop new howitzers.
entities.name: Advanced Howitzers

gate: is capital in south america or carribean

desc: It is not fitting that territories we have conquered should have better artisans and wiser advisors than in our capital. The greatest hands and minds of the empire must be brought to the capital to serve us directly.
entities.name: Relocating Artisans

desc: Art has always been created in a number of different ways, but recent advances have allowed it to develop even further into a myriad of manifestations, as artists explore new media and techniques.
entities.name: Artistic Currents

desc: Widespread usage of the printing press has created new opportunities for our people to share their artistic skills, and to distribute this art faster and more widely than ever before.
entities.name: Artistic Prints

desc: In the wake of the Reformation, new forms of art flourish like blossoms on a vine. It has become easier for artists to gain recognition in their field, and also to find employment in the courts of the world.
entities.name: Development of Secular Art

desc: With the rise of the Enlightenment, the arts are flourishing in all forms and at all levels of society. New publications of music and literature are in particular leading to a broad developing interest in these arts.
entities.name: Enlightened Art

desc: Art is the life-breath of humanity, and what turns the world from a bland existence into a vibrant canvas full of wonders and possibilities. We must foster greater artistic curiosity among our people.
entities.name: Arts Academy

desc: Echizen is home to many important temples representing different sects, such as the Eiheiji of the Sōtō tradition and the Heisenji of the Tendai tradition, among others. If we could bring all of them under our control and establish religious peace throughout the province, it would be the foundation of an ideal religious policy for our entire nation.
entities.name: Control of Buddhist Sects

desc: Many centuries ago, emperor Keitai launched his campaign to take the imperial throne from Echizen. Like him, we must not hesitate to project power beyond our borders and to launch invasions into neighboring realms when the situation calls for it.
entities.name: Legacy of Emperor Keitai

desc: Although the Buddha warned us about the dangers of extreme asceticism, some among the monastic community still perform these strict practices. Limiting the type of cloth they can wear, the food they can eat, or where they can live are some of the restrictions adopted by those who wish to walk this path. Although such abstemious behavior is not a requirement for obtaining merit, it has its own benefits for the practitioner.
entities.name: Ascetic Practices

desc: We must strengthen the authority of our administrative officials, such as the Bugyōshū magistrates and the Hōkōshū commanders. A strong bureaucracy can sometimes be the only thing that stands between us and an open civil war.
entities.name: Bugyōshū and Hōkōshū

desc: When the Kamakura Shogunate fell, we were the ones who protected the Emperor and the Imperial Court. This has afforded us a position at the forefront of all clans in Japan, as the true protector of the Empire and its courtly traditions.
entities.name: Defenders of the Imperial Court

desc: Built around the ascetics of Zen buddhism, Higashiyama culture sees beauty in simplicity. It has promoted development of the formal tea ceremony, ''ikebana'' flower arrangements, theater, and art. This blossoming of culture has brought great prestige to those who practice the arts, and will reflect well upon our realm.
entities.name: Higashiyama Culture

desc: ''Shugo'' are important vassals for the Shogunate, administrating the lands in name of the Shōgun. Thanks to them, we can administer our lands better and more efficiently.
entities.name: Shugo System

desc: By delegating the responsibility of assaulting breaches to our finest and most disciplined troops, we will penetrate even the most formidable fortifications that our foes may hide behind.
entities.name: Reformed Breach Sorties

desc: Our armies willingly march into the mayhem of cannon fire and dust, carving a path for our troops to take the enemy's forts. Despite advances in artillery and new fortification techniques, our skill in assaulting enemy walls remains unrivaled.
entities.name: March Against Fire

desc: Our Order is named the Knights Hospitaller for a reason: we were originally the protective force of a pilgrims' hospital in Jerusalem. Though Jerusalem is lost to the Saracens, we still provide medical aid to those in need, including our brave knights, who heartily return to the battlefield much faster than most armies.
entities.name: Assistance to the Suffering

desc: There are those who feel that we should not associate with unbelievers at all. We have done much to quash this, as only through association with heathen nations will we be able to trade with them.
entities.name: Association With Unbelievers

desc: Called the orthodox schools of Hinduism, they accept the authority of the Vēdaḥ and the existence of Ātman. Although consisting of many different branches, this commonality of acceptance gives the Āstika Schools a lot of common ground.
entities.name: Āstika Schools

desc: As our rulers transitioned toward absolute rule, they replaced the fractious feudal lords with a meritocratic civil service drawn from the urban bourgeoisie. This centralized administration ensures that taxes are collected efficiently and the ruler's law is enforced uniformly from Marathon to Megara. By breaking the power of the old baronial families, our nation has become a streamlined, modern state capable of rapid mobilization.
entities.name: The Athenian Bureaucracy

desc: Our artillery is now the finest in the world, benefiting from the metallurgical secrets of the world's renowned master-smiths and the chemical innovations of our local alchemists. The 'Thunder of Athens' is heard across the Balkans, as our cannons are prized for their range and reliability.
entities.name: The Attican Gunpowder Mills

desc: After being hired and then betrayed by the Byzantine emperor, the ferocious Catalan Grand Company turned against their former paymasters and, in 1311, annihilated the Frankish duke Walter V of Brienne at the Battle of the Cephissus, seizing control of the Duchy of Athens and establishing a period of Catalan rule. These battle-hardened Almogàvers introduced a more ruthless mercenary ethos to Greek affairs, fortifying key strongholds, extracting tribute from the countryside, and maintaining their grip through a combination of terror and disciplined infantry tactics until internal strife and Aragonese intervention eventually shifted power back toward a more conventional feudal regime.
entities.name: The Catalan Company

desc: Otto de la Roche, first Duke of Athens, established his court amid the ruins of the Acropolis, converting the ancient Parthenon into a Catholic cathedral dedicated to Our Lady while ruling over a duchy that stretched from Attica to Boeotia. Under his successors, the duchy became a surprising center of cultural exchange where Frankish knights patronized Greek scribes, Italian merchants traded in Piraeus, and scholars debated philosophy in sight of marble temples. All this produced a distinctive aristocratic society that prized both the martial virtues of chivalry and an appreciation for the Hellenic past that had so long been ignored by Western conquerors. We must reinstate this court to its past glory.
entities.name: The Parthenon Dukes

desc: Modeled after the Venetian Arsenal but utilizing modern assembly-line techniques, our new dockyards at Piraeus can produce a fully equipped war galley in a matter of weeks. This industrialization of naval warfare allows the small Duchy to punch far above its weight class, maintaining a professional navy that dominates the Saronic Gulf. The Piraeus is no longer a ruin, but the most modern naval base in the Eastern Mediterranean.
entities.name: The Piraeus Arsenal

desc: The workshops of Thebes, already renowned in Byzantine times for their silk-weaving, have flourished anew under Frankish rule as the dukes of Athens encourage Italian merchants to invest in looms, dyeworks, and export networks that carry Theban samites and velvets to markets from Bruges to Alexandria. This revival of luxury textile production, combined with the fertile plains of Boeotia that supply raw materials, generate substantial wealth that funds castle-building, knightly retinues, and the lavish lifestyle of the Athenian court, ensuring that the duchy remains one of the richest and most economically sophisticated territories of the entire Frankokratia.
entities.name: Thebes' Textiles

desc: Successfully navigated by sailors starting from Europe, these new maritime routes have opened the floodgates to goods and coin from both the New World and the Far East.
entities.name: Atlantic Trade Routes

desc: Referred to the true and eternal unchanging Self, it is the essence of each individual's consciousness. According to the astika schools, this Ātman is distinct from the mind and body, and it is also different from the Jivātman that persists across multiple lifetimes. In contrast, the nastika schools interpret the concept differently, or reject it entirely.
entities.name: Ātman

desc: Our ports have long been a haven for those who seek fortune on the high seas. By welcoming these skilled seamen regardless of their faith or origins, we may further strengthen our corsair fleets and expand our maritime manpower.
entities.name: Attract Foreign Pirates

desc: While we work to infiltrate other nations, we must be vigilant of poisonous ideas spreading around our own courts. Assembling an audit team to ensure our ministers are acting in the state's interest should help root out any rotten elements.
entities.name: Audit Checks

desc: ''Auftragstaktik'', or 'Mission Tactics'. is a system by which our subordinate leaders are informed about the objectives of the battle or the war by their commanders, and then are allowed to act on their personal initiative. This system allows our battalions to develop a tighter relationship with their leaders, yielding better results.
entities.name: Auftragstaktik

desc: Our rulers must receive the best education possible to live up to the ideal of the enlightened monarch.
entities.name: Enlightenment Through Education

desc: Maintaining our diplomatic relations requires time and effort, and committing too many people to diplomatic missions could negatively affect our efficiency and damage our reputation. The Austrian Court's streamlined approach ensures we deploy the right envoys at the right times and still gather the information we need without overextending our diplomatic resources.
entities.name: Austrian Court

desc: Recruited from our Carpathian and Balkan lands, these light troops are well equipped to guard the peace in our border regions. Their knowledge of their homeland will make them a formidable opponent for any invader.
entities.name: Grenzer Infantry

desc: Stationed in border garrisons, these regiments of hussars will be able to patrol and secure the far reaches of our country, while keeping the strain on our treasury light.
entities.name: Grenzhussar

desc: The victory of Rudolf I over his rivals secured our place among the great houses of the Holy Roman Empire and is the subject of many tales and songs. The fervor displayed by him and his knights in the Battle on the Marchfeld will inspire our troops for centuries to come.
entities.name: Legacy of Rudolf I

desc: 'Let others wage war; you, happy Austria, marry! For what Mars gives to others, Venus gives to you — kingdoms.'
entities.name: 'Tu Felix Austria Nube'

desc: Only well-rounded tactics of artillery shock, cavalry charges, and unyielding infantry recruited from the landknechte can lead us to victory.
entities.name: Landsknecht Tactics

desc: Industrial modernization must always be a priority for our administration. Only through modern manufacturing can we compete with our rivals on a global stage.
entities.name: State Industrialization

desc: Our rise to power has made us the target of much envy, and the rival houses of the Holy Roman Empire vie for our position as the protectors of the south-eastern border. Despite these circumstances, we pride ourselves on executing diplomatic maneuvers unrivaled by any others.
entities.name: A House of Glory

desc: Balancing local needs versus national interests is one of the most difficult aspects of government. Given the slow pace of communications, it can take a long time for the most basic directives to reach even relatively close provinces. We must encourage local governors towards more autonomy to ensure that local interests are served in a timely manner.
entities.name: Autonomous Pashas

desc: Also known as Guānyīn or Kannon, Avalokiteśvara is one of the most revered Bodhisattvas. Represented as a male or female depending on the school, and even in some considered to be the origin of all Hindu deities, Avalokiteśvara is the Bodhisattva of compassion, and is associated with the mantra ''Oṃ maṇi padme hūm̐''.
entities.name: Avalokiteśvara

desc: Âyan are provincial magnates of diverse backgrounds that wield significant local autonomy, but still provide a ready source of tax farming income and military forces for the state.
entities.name: Âyan

desc: Our country has a rich and complex literary tradition, from the epic ''Lilit'' poems narrating famous military conflicts, to the ''Nirat'' poetry of travels and lost lovers; from folk legend of local heroes to panegyrics praising the feats of our most glorious rulers.
entities.name: Ayutthaya Literature

desc: Our country is home to many people from afar, who came here hoping to profit from the richness of our land. Having so many people and goods flowing through our borders is something we derive numerous benefits from.
entities.name: Cosmopolitan Trade

desc: Rice has been grown in our country for centuries, but the constant flooding of our rivers has always been an issue for its proper cultivation. This new variety of rice, used to growing in flooded conditions, will provide us with a stable source of food even when the rivers overflow.
entities.name: Floating Rice

desc: All freemen subject to ''phrai'' service not only serve in war — the ''Phrai Thaan'' — but also assist in the construction of public works, at the discretion of local governors.
entities.name: Phrai Luang

desc: All males at the age of eighteen are to be registered with the military, and their information passed on to the government bureaucracy. Every male citizen is eligible to be conscripted and made to serve in the army in war, and we will make sure that they do so if needed.
entities.name: Phrai Thaan

desc: Whether on horseback or atop an elephant, we can boast of an impressive cavalry, usually made up of descendants from the most prestigious families. Their contributions through supporting our infantry are invaluable.
entities.name: Prestigious Cavalry

desc: Our society is strictly organized along the Sakdina system. Each person knows their proper place in society and how much wealth and property they are entitled to have. This organization makes it much more efficient to extract taxes from them.
entities.name: Sakdina

desc: The white elephant symbolizes sacred kingship in Buddhism tradition, and is also the emblem of our ruler. Possessing a white elephant legitimizes our authority, proving to our subjects that we rule with the blessing of the divine.
entities.name: White Elephant

desc: Unmarried youths drafted from the poorest segments of society, the Azebs will not only function as soldiers and sailors, but also builders, sappers and armorers. Through a system of fortress garrisons, we will ensure that they always get paid.
entities.name: Azeb Irregulars

desc: The aggressive nature of our warriors is known — and feared — beyond our borders. When battle starts, our enemies shiver in fear at the sight of our combatants charging at them with frenzy, as if they were about to be run down by the heralds of Death itself.
entities.name: Aztec Chargers

desc: The Baghlah is a large deep-sea sailing vessel which is used as a merchant ship. It has its origins in the Arabian Peninsula, but spread as far as the Spice Islands as a used ship type.
entities.name: Baghlah

desc: Our state was born from the rebellion of Amir Hasan Gangu against the pathetic rule of Delhi. The victory against the Dehlavi Sultanate still lives on in the minds of our own nobility and military to this day.
entities.name: Amir Rebellion

desc: The climate of India is suboptimal at best for breeding and raising horses. The horses of Arabia, however, are superb mounts that outclass our local breeds. We will use our trade connections to ensure that we have a steady supply of these horses for our troops.
entities.name: Arabian Horses

desc: Our unusual practice of always passing the throne to the eldest son of the current ruler has at times created some instability in our realm, as power-hungry regents and opportunistic nobles initially showed little hesitation in trying to take advantage of a child ruler or in supporting an envious relative's claim to the throne. By now, however, the practice has become firmly institutionalized, and when the time for succession comes there are very few who would oppose the true heir of our dynasty.
entities.name: Bahmani Primogeniture

desc:
Cutting ties with Delhi to found our own kingdom has loosened our connection with the Muslim-dominated northern parts of India. As our state lacks any form of entrenched Muslim aristocracy, we are in a precarious situation, and we could end up entirely at the mercy of local Hindu nobles.
Fortunately, our reputation precedes us. Tales of the riches of the Deccan are told and retold all over the Muslim world, and many ambitious fortune-seekers make the sea voyage to our ports. By using the vast riches of India to attract talented westerners, or ''Gharbians'', to our court, we can ensure that our country shall never lack able minds to lead our armies, collect our taxes, and rule our subjects.
entities.name: Gharbians

desc:
For centuries, the Indo-Egyptian trade has been dominated by Egypt-based groups of traders and captains known as the Kārimī. Instrumental in the day-to-day business of Indian Ocean trade, this merchant organization is now both wealthy and powerful. From the Tamil coasts and the ports of the Swahili trading cities to the Lower Egyptian port cities past the Gulf of Aden, sultans, nobles, and commoners alike come to buy exotic goods or borrow money for their projects from the Kārimī.
This organization has lately taken a very active interest in our state, and we only stand to gain from cultivating our relationship with them further.
entities.name: Kārimī

desc:
India in general, and our state in particular, has a history as a center of Sufi teachings. The efforts of our rulers to attract and patronize Sufi sheiks from all over the world are a testament to the piety and the great spiritual strength of our monarchs and our court.
