The state adopting the Sufi concepts of spiritual sovereignty and the inclusive nature of the Sufi teachings themselves will help create an environment where the diverse religious faiths of Gharbians and the natives of Deccan alike can mix and thrive without clashes or unproductive quarrels.
entities.name: Legacy of Gisu Daraz

desc: For many years now, our state has drained able men from the greater Muslim world, while also incorporating the best of the states that came before us. This has created a rich cosmopolitan culture that is not entirely Farsi, Arabian, Marathi, Telugu, nor Kannadiga in nature. Creating a major madrasa in our capital would serve to further the development of learning this multitude of cultures and also allow the world to see the greatness of our state.
entities.name: Great Madrasa of the Deccan

desc: Deccan is a region of many languages and cultures; the great influx of people of Iranian, Turkic, Afghan, and Arabian descent into these lands has accentuated the cosmopolitan nature of our state. While historically the Persian language fulfilled the needs of our predecessors, a new mix of local languages — as well as Persian and Arabic — has grown increasingly common. This mixture of languages has even become a source of cultural inspiration for emerging artists.
entities.name: Linguistic Melting Pot

desc: Although at times a challenge to the sovereignty of the ruler, the noble class is nonetheless useful to our government, as they are crucial in administrating our vast properties. With winning our independence from Delhi, we gained rulership over almost exclusively Hindu subjects, while our Muslim nobles are a small minority, unable to manage the masses. We must expand and stabilize our aristocracy by promoting promising Hindu candidates into their ranks.
entities.name: Hindu Elite Integration

desc: The first thing any guest in our royal audience chamber notices is the Turquoise Throne of our dynasty. This unique piece of royal furniture was originally donated to us by the defeated Telugu Raja Kapaya, and it is in many ways the ultimate symbol of our dynasty. Exquisite and splendidly unique, it embodies the riches of the Deccan and the unusual combination of styles that is the hallmark of our cosmopolitan state.
entities.name: Takht-e-Fīrozā

desc: Our domain stretches well beyond the horizon. The emergence of a common written language among our subjects will surely bridge the gaps between us, elevate our culture, and reduce conflict based on misunderstanding and linguistic differences.
entities.name: Báihuàwén

desc: As the central authority of medieval kingdoms fractures under the weight of imperial expansion, the social vacuum is filled by the Hajduks. Originally simple cattle drovers (''hajtó'') and seasonal laborers, these men have transitioned into a semi-mythical class of guerrilla fighters and highwaymen. They operate in small, disciplined bands (''cheta'') led by a ''Harambaša'', governed by strict internal codes of conduct that emphasize loyalty and the protection of the local peasantry (the ''raja''). In our eyes, they are nothing more than brigands; to the commoners, they are the only shield against the depredations of foreign tax collectors and unruly invaders. By codifying their presence within our military structure, we empower a force that thrives on the very lawlessness of the frontier.
entities.name: Hajduks

desc: The heart of social life in our society is the ball game, where players strive to keep the ball inside the playing court by striking it with their hips. It is both a ritual alternative to warfare and a large part of religious life.
entities.name: Tlachtli

desc: We shall build a grand shipyard on the eastern coast of the Baltic Sea, and dominate overseas trade!
entities.name: Baltic Shipyard

requires_state: text: unlocked advance bank of saint george tt
has variable: unlocked advance bank of saint george

desc: Founded to consolidate the mounting debts of the republic, the ''Casa di San Giorgio'' has become one of the most sophisticated financial institutions in Christendom. Private creditors and the state share in its governance, channeling Genoese wealth into ventures abroad while keeping the cost of borrowing low. This union of public and private capital gives us unmatched capacity to finance our ambitions.
entities.name: Bank of Saint George

desc: Moneylending is old as time, but it is not without risks. We can minimize said dangers if we institutionalize those practices and see that money is loaned under controlled and fair stipulations.
entities.name: Banking

desc: While many seek wealth in the opportunities of trade and commerce, our state fills its coffers by offering entirely fair and highly affordable loans.
entities.name: Banking Traditions

desc: Ever since our descent from Arabia and Persia, we have established communities across the Swahili Coast that integrate the local Bantu in an effort to maintain social order and make way for the rise of new architectural and cultural advances.
entities.name: Bantu and Perso-Arabian

desc: We must confirm baptism as an important cornerstone of our faith by keeping meticulous records of who in our population has or has not yet been baptized.
entities.name: Baptism Records

desc: A postal service that extends even to the farthest corners of our Empire, this institution is responsible for all communication between our capital and centers of local authority across the land.
entities.name: Barīd

desc: The Barracks are a more efficient way of increasing the [
] by replacing the Armory in [Urban Locations].
entities.name: Barracks

desc: Unruly irregulars recruited from disenfranchised segments of the population, and sometimes outright vagabonds, the ''bashi-bazouks'' provide an affordable way of garrisoning forts and outposts. With their proclivity for brigandage and wanton killing, they can always be relied upon to disturb the enemy's frontier.
entities.name: Bashi-bazouks

desc: Overseas trade is very risky, but also highly profitable. The development of financial instruments like letters of credit will help reduce that risk and increase our profits.
entities.name: Basic Financial Instruments

desc: Due to the advances of Artillery, the Castle is no longer sufficient to withstand the power of gunpowder. The Bastion negates the advantage of the cannon thanks to its superior design, offering them a greater passive resistance and more space for ranged defenses.
entities.name: Bastion

desc: An army is only as good as its leadership. An incompetent general can be the bane of their nation, while a military leader of great prowess will be known and feared on every battlefield.
entities.name: Battle Leadership Law

desc: Allows us to focus heavily on military advancements and thereby increase our Army Tradition.
entities.name: Battlefield Commissions

desc: Our lands are rich in the crops and fresh water required to brew beer, and our people readily enjoy this abundance. Many small breweries could grow into successful businesses, with the right support.
entities.name: Skilled Brewers

desc: Our realm needs a new standardized coin to serve as our national unified currency. Establishing a state-owned mint in our capital would ensure our total control over this new coinage.
entities.name: Bavaria Coin

desc: With our homeland at the feet of the beautiful Alps, we are a destination for artists from all over Europe, who seek inspiration in our incredible landscape. If we were to construct and support the appropriate cultural institutions, we could refine our court into a center of refinement and elegance, one that could rival even the most prestigious powers of Europe.
entities.name: Bavarian Cultural Institutions

desc: No matter if we are answering to an Imperial overlord or cozying up to a potential foreign ally, our diplomats must be prepared for everything. But only if they keep Bavarian interests first and foremost in their efforts will we be able to claim true success in our diplomatic maneuverings.
entities.name: Practical Diplomacy

desc: Establishing a council with the sole duty of advising our ruler during times of conflict will help us develop a more capable fighting force.
entities.name: Bavarian Hofkriegsrat

desc: Our nobles have distinguished themselves as formidable knights in the service of the Holy Roman Empire. We should nurture and scrupulously maintain these troops to ensure the survival of our ducal integrity.
entities.name: Bavarian Imperial Knights

desc: Regiments of seasoned hunters and foresters. These units will be unmatched in forested terrain, able to hinder and harass our enemies if they dare to enter our forests.
entities.name: Bavarian Jäger

desc: We have been granted the rulership of Bavaria directly by the Emperor! By embellishing ourselves as the divinely-appointed protectors of Bavaria, we will ensure our legitimacy cannot be questioned.
entities.name: Bavarian Dukedom

desc: The excellent quality of our beer has been celebrated for centuries, but for our brews to achieve legendary status, we must ensure their continued prestige and superiority for all time. Several rulers in the past have created regulations and standards for the brewing of this wonderful substance; and we could use this fact as a stamp of our breweries' quality.
entities.name: Bavarian Purity Law

desc: We once were ruled by Bavaria, unified in culture and allied under a single banner. We must ensure that the new Bavarian state is equally mighty, a home worthy of its strong and proud people.
entities.name: Dreams of Unification

desc: We must ensure our people remain united in their faith, and that they will not be divided by heretical thoughts.
entities.name: One Faith for Bavaria

desc: Men who are well-led will follow, so we must ensure that our officers lead from the front.
entities.name: Bayonet Leaders

desc: Tlemcen lies at the crossroads of Saharan caravans, Mediterranean commerce, and Andalusian eminence. As trade flourishes through its markets and ports, we must strive to continue expanding our merchant networks, asserting our influence over regional commerce.
entities.name: Beacon of Maghrebi Trade

desc: Lateen-rigged caravels are highly maneuverable, allowing them to easily tack against the wind. This makes sailing through unfavorable weather and hostile seas much quicker.
entities.name: Beat to Windward!

desc: Brewed in larger workshops with ample storage for the process of fermentation, we will be able to produce larger quantities of alcoholic drinks than before.
entities.name: Beer Workshop

desc: Many of the faithful have devoted themselves to a life of prayer and good works, which usually comes with taking the veil or becoming a monk. However, they have not taken formal vows, and act without official Roman approval. Nevertheless, we should support these popular efforts to do good deeds and help our people.
entities.name: Lay Religious Orders

desc: Mercenaries will always look out for themselves first, so we need to ensure that any we hire remain with us. By properly looking after our mercenary companies, they will stay loyal for longer and require less direct monetary compensation.
entities.name: Benefits for Mercenaries

desc: Our nation is a bastion of tolerance and enlightenment. By ensuring that all other nations know this, we can foster better relations abroad.
entities.name: Benevolence

desc: The art of diplomacy is an intricate one. Being good with words is not enough, as one's overall presence and demeanor are crucial to how the words themselves are interpreted. By having our diplomats focus on making a good impression, we will be seen more favorably by other countries.
entities.name: Benign Diplomats

desc: New ideas spread fast in our cities, and the minds of Brandenburg have never been idle. We will cultivate this spirit of inquiry, drawing scholars and thinkers to our court. A nation that thinks clearly governs itself well.
entities.name: Berliner Aufklärung

desc: Christianity undoubtedly originated inside the cradle of the Roman Empire, and many of its branches have been content to stay in that region. Miaphysitism, however, was on the edges of the Empire after being denounced by the Chalcedonians, and has spread far beyond its birthplace, bringing the light of God to the most remote places.
entities.name: Beyond the Borders

desc: The age of the Great Hordes is not over yet. We have learned from the mistakes of our enemies and will now rise wiser, and stronger. All the land where the sun lives and dies must be ours.
entities.name: Beyond the Sun

desc: Having emerged in the 6th century, this movement promotes love and devotion to one's personal god or towards an enlightened individual. It appeals to the lay population by speaking to them directly on their own terms. A highly influential movement, it is changing how religion and belief themselves are understood by our people.
entities.name: Bhakti Movement

desc: By granting the citizens certain fundamental rights, we will reduce the likelihood of a peasant uprising.
entities.name: Bill of Rights

desc: Writing and reading are fundamental pillars of our society. Religious texts, as well the details of our history, need to be written down so that future generations can learn of our cultural achievements. We have an abundant supply of birch trees in this nation, and their papery white bark will become our parchment.
entities.name: Birchbark Manuscripts

desc: Our dedication to fine arts, cultivating artistic talent, and innovative thought have led us to be regarded as one of the foremost leaders of cultural, philosophical, and scientific advancements around the world.
entities.name: Birthplace of the Renaissance

desc: Bison are a crucial resource for our people. We use every part of the animal as a tribute to its sacrifice. We feed our people with its flesh, we use its bones for tools; we use its fur to protect ourselves against the cold and its hides for our clothes. Even the animal's soul has symbolic meaning for us. Such is the importance of the bison to our culture that we would feel lost without them.
entities.name: Bison Hunters

desc: The Black Guard is an elite corps of former slaves. Raised since childhood to abide by a religious creed, they excel in archery, horsemanship, musketry, and masonry. These troops form the backbone of our army at a time when our people need protection the most.
entities.name: Black Guard

desc: A more expensive method than traditional metallurgy, the use of blast furnaces allows us to further refine pig iron into cast iron by re-melting it with different quantities of iron, steel, limestone, and charcoal. Cast iron made into wrought iron this way creates an excellent material for making complex products such as cannon.
entities.name: Blast Furnace

desc: Islam has expanded to many new places since its origins in Arabia, and with this spread, it came into contact with many different peoples and ways of life. Many exchanges of influence happened during this process, to the point that many characteristics not originally part of Islam have become intrinsically associated with the faith.
entities.name: Blend of Influences

desc: The University of Bologna remains at the cutting edge of the Enlightenment. The discovery of animal electricity in a Bolognese laboratory has laid the groundwork for modern bio-electricity and physics. This spirit of inquiry will turn the city into a hub for early industrial and scientific pioneers, bridging the gap between ancient scholasticism and the modern laboratory.
entities.name: Galvanism

desc: Bologna became the intellectual laboratory of Europe with the rise of its organized university, the oldest in the world, earning the nickname of ''La Dòta'' (''La Dotta'' in standard Italian: the Learned). Culturally, this moved the society away from feudal trial-by-combat toward a civilian jurisprudence based on recovered Roman Law. This produced a class of professional lay-notaries and judges who could manage complex urban administrations, giving Bologna an unmatched bureaucratic efficiency.
entities.name: The Dòta

desc: Through the fertile bounty of the Po Valley and the mastery of the Bolognese guilds, our capital will earn a reputation for unparalleled opulence and a second nickname: ''La Grâsa'' (or ''La Grassa'', the Fat One, in standard Italian). By investing in the Quadrilatero markets and the production of refined meats and pastas, we will ensure that every traveler leaves with a full stomach and a lighter purse.
entities.name: La Grâsa

desc: ''La Råssa'' (the Red, or ''La Rossa'' in standard Italian), as Bologna is also known, celebrates the crimson soul of our skyline; the ancient terracotta brickwork and the defensive sea of red rooftops seen from the Asinelli Tower inspire awe in our subjects and defiance against our foes. Red is becoming so associated with our city that we must start creating laws to make sure that anything not currently in our preferred palette is rebuilt in red terracotta as soon as possible.
entities.name: La Råssa

desc: As the wild energy of the Renaissance cools, education is shifting toward organized Academies. These are state-sponsored institutions for scientists, writers, and painters, whose aim is to reform art education by moving away from Mannerism toward naturalism and life drawing. These reforms will allow the state to direct artistic and scientific production toward national prestige, leading to the birth of the 'Bolognese School' of painting, which will dominate European tastes for decades.
entities.name: L'Académia di Incaminè

desc: Bologna will become the center of development for the concerto and the professionalization of the orchestra. By abandoning the unpredictable modal traditions of the past, we will establish the rigid architectural laws of modern major-minor tonality. This synthesis will transform the violin from a folk instrument into the primary voice of the Baroque era, standardizing the ''Trio Sonata'' and the ''Concerto Grosso''. This apparent simplicity will soon become the benchmark of prestige, spreading from Italian cathedrals to the most distant European courts. It will also represent the final transition from the experimental Renaissance to the era of disciplined, instrumental virtuosity.
entities.name: The Bolognese School of Music

desc: Employing effective formations and patrols near enemy ports will make it easier for us to cut off their supply lines, shortening sieges.
entities.name: Blockade Tactics

desc: Cannons are an impactful asset to military campaigns. We must ensure an efficient artillery corps that specializes in dealing damage to the enemy's rows before they even start to clash with our soldiers on the field.
entities.name: Artillery Corps

desc: A mixture of ancient urban architecture, Muslim engineering influences, and traditional Bengali roof-building techniques, the unique Bengali architectural style is used for religious and cultural buildings of all kinds. Due to our expertise in this style, constructing such buildings is significantly easier and more affordable for us than other nations.
entities.name: Bengali Architecture

desc: Bengal is uniquely situated in India to start a revolution unlike any seen before. Muslin — the special cotton fabric Bengali spinners are famous for — is a prime trade good for industrialization. We stand poised to exploit new developments in our already world-class textile industry. Let us begin an industrial revolution!
entities.name: Industrialized Muslin Production

desc: The ''paiks'' are the backbone of our military. While other states have the Paik System active and use paiks as their general levies, our state maintains smaller, but very well-organized paiks, and provides them with sufficient military support.
entities.name: Bengali Paik

desc: The written word is one of the most influential and enduring forms of art. Bengali poetry shall tell the tales of epic conquerors, relatable dramas, and engaging philosophical questions, all of which shall further the spread and reputation of Bengali culture.
entities.name: Bengali Poetry

desc: The Bengali trade fleet brings exotic goods from foreign lands, as well as precious Gold and Silver, to the markets of the Ganges Delta. Our merchants are well renowned in far-flung parts of the world, thanks to our impressive trade fleet.
entities.name: Bengali Trade Fleet

desc: The Indian Ocean connects our local markets with those of South East Asia and China. We shall therefore greatly emphasize maximizing our presence in these markets via sea routes, and through this increase our trade profits.
entities.name: Bengali Traders

desc: During the reign of Delhi, the Bengali people served their overlord as productive vassals. The Dehlavi system shall serve as the foundation for our own vassal systems for the years of Bengali sovereignty to come.
entities.name: Bengali Vassal System

desc: Abyssinian slave-soldiers play a significant role in our military as elite infantry. Those who excel as leaders shall be given greater levels of command, while those who demonstrate exceptional loyalty shall make up the palace guard.
entities.name: Habshi Generals

desc: India is home to many religions: Hinduism for the majority, Islam as the preferred faith of the ruling classes, and a few remarkable minor religions such as Buddhism and Jainism amongst the working minorities. Promoting one religion over another will cause inevitable chaos and unrest. Thus, we should aim for religious pluralism, and neither favor nor discriminate against any religion in our state.
entities.name: Religious Pluralism

desc: The lack of a widely adopted standardized currency is stunting our commercial development. As one of the foremost economic powers on the subcontinent, we are in a good position to begin minting a new silver coinage with standard weights, which we shall call the ''rupee''.
entities.name: Minting of Rupees

desc: Maritime trade is vital to our state. Our trade and our warships are some of the most important aspects of our economy, and therefore we focus heavily on supporting the shipbuilding industry.
entities.name: Shipbuilding Industry

desc: Although slow, the maneuverability of elephants in the riverine terrain of our country is crucial to quickly resupplying our military. Additionally, war elephants will aid our troops on the battlefield with their imposing stature and terrifying strength.
entities.name: War Elephants

desc: By teaching our naval officers to lead boarding actions against enemy ships, we can gain an edge in naval combat even when fighting superior enemy [
entities.name: Boarding Parties

desc: Our fief sits upon the most famous pass in history, and we have taken the lessons of Leonidas to heart by fortifying the mountain tracks with Frankish stone. Every narrow path is a deathtrap for the invader, and every cliffside is a vantage point for our archers and scouts. To pass through Bodonitsa is to run a gauntlet of steel, ensuring that the heart of Greece remains shielded from northern threats.
entities.name: Guardians of the Thermopylae

desc: Living among the crags of Mount Kallidromos, our people have developed a form of light infantry combat that emphasizes vertical mobility and the use of the crossbow. These 'Mountaineers of the Pass' can disappear into the rocks after a volley, making them impossible for traditional heavy infantry to engage. They serve as the eyes and ears of the southern states, providing early warning of any movement from the north.
entities.name: The Alpine Skirmishers

desc: To manage the wealth generated by the resurgence of the northern trade routes, the Marquisate has established the ''Curia of the Three Keys''. The state treasury and the legal archives are locked in the citadel of Bodonitsa, requiring three separate keys held by the Marquis, the Latin Bishop, and a representative of the local Greek burgesses. This primitive but effective system of 'Checks and Balances' prevents the embezzlement that often plagues small feudal states, ensuring that the heavy tolls collected at Thermopylae are actually spent on the fortress walls.
entities.name: The Curia of the Three Keys

desc: Reflecting our Venetian heritage, we have established consulates in the major ports of Euboea and Attica to represent the interests of Bodonitsan merchants. These offices act as intelligence hubs, funneling information about naval movements directly to the Marquis. We may be a mountain state, but our eyes are always fixed on the horizon of the sea.
entities.name: The Maritime Consulates

desc: In the age of gunpowder, the rugged woodsmen of the Oeta mountains have been organized into specialized light-infantry corps. These riflemen excel in hit-and-run tactics, using the steep terrain to harass invading columns with lethal precision. They are the nightmare of any general attempting to force the northern passes of Greece.
entities.name: The Oeta Riflemen

desc: The Marquisate of Bodonitsa had evolved from a mere frontier watchtower into the administrative nerve center of Central Greece, necessitating a transition from feudal whim to a professionalized civil service. The establishment of the Great Chancellery overlooking the Spercheios valley signals a move toward a centralized, modern state where the old Frankish baronial privileges are replaced by a cadre of legally trained 'Civil Knights' who manage the complex tolls and land registries of the Phocian heartland.
entities.name: The Spercheios Civil Chancellery

desc: Since antiquity, our people have venerated our ancestors. The most influential of our rulers erect entire temples, where they will be entombed and then worshiped after death, and where their deeds and words will be remembered for all time.
entities.name: Bodaiji

desc: Regardless of the school of Buddhism one adheres to, a Bodhisattva is an important figure, although their exact characteristics and importance vary between the different traditions. In all cases, however, they are deserving of reverence and admiration.
entities.name: Bodhisattva

desc: There are very few workshops in the known world with the capacity to craft glass and crystal with the same quality and clarity as ours, let alone rival our superior production techniques.
entities.name: Bohemian Crystal

desc: Our place within the Holy Roman Empire is one of prestige, grandeur, and authority. Few members wield as much soft power as us, due to our capable diplomats and alliance networks.
entities.name: Bohemian Holy Roman Standing

desc: For years, the standard currency in our country has been the ''groschen'', a coin made of silver and used all throughout the Holy Roman Empire. The discovery of new sources of silver allows us to create another kind of bigger coin, the ''thaler'', also called 'toler' or 'daler', which will become strong and influential enough to dominate all trade and become a new standard.
entities.name: Bohemian Thaler

desc: A method where lead is smelted in the open air using the constant strong winds at the top of hills to blow fresh air into the melting ore.
entities.name: Bole Smelting

desc: Our valiant armies never waver! They demonstrate exceptional morale and loyalty, standing firm whether defending our realm or supporting allies. With indomitable spirits, they will press forward even in desperate circumstances, refusing defeat until physically unable to continue.
entities.name: Bonded by Loyalty

desc: Sometimes money is short, and we need to borrow. Lenders always worry that they will not be paid back. By maintaining meticulous records, we will be able to ensure that everyone gets reimbursed, which will allow us to negotiate lower rates of interest.
entities.name: Bookkeeping

desc: Our raiders are famous for their ability to carry out lightning-fast attacks against unaware enemies. Their speed and ability to evade enemy retaliation should be studied and employed by our regular troops as well.
entities.name: Skilled Raiders

desc: We share the blood of the Borjigin, of Genghis Khān himself. All countries bow in recognition of our heritage, and all territories of the steppes shall recognize us as their own.
entities.name: Borjigin Blood

desc: In the secluded valleys of our nation, monks of our monasteries have compiled the ''Ljekaruše'' — extensive medicinal codices written in the native ''Bosančica'' script. By synthesizing ancient Greco-Byzantine theory with the high-altitude herbalism of the Dinaric Alps, these manuals provide a sophisticated system of community healthcare in an era where professional physicians are a rarity. This mastery of folk-medicine and surgery ensures our population remains resilient against the plagues that devastate the lowlands, fostering a cultural identity defined by intellectual self-reliance and the preservation of Slavic scientific knowledge.
entities.name: Bosnian Ljekaruše

desc: Our people practice unique customs that transcend religious differences. The construction of ''stećci'', elaborately decorated tombstones, is a tradition shared by all of us, regardless of faith. These distinctive monuments mark our lands as uniquely Bosnian.
entities.name: Stećci of Bosnia

desc: Bosnia is a land of forested hills and mountains, cut through by river valleys. This terrain lends itself naturally to delaying and tiring invading armies, and we should use this to our advantage. Engaging our enemy only when it benefits us and letting the hostile terrain itself claim both their supplies and troops will preserve our strength.
entities.name: Defiant Terrain

desc: Our nobility regularly gathers together to discuss the most pressing issues for our country. These meetings ensure our noble lords are aligned in their policies and show unity during our parliament sessions.
entities.name: Stanak Meetings

desc: Parts of our population are organized into self-governing, pastoralist communities. Instead of bending them to a central government's will, we should cooperate with them, and in doing so try to extract more resources from our more remote areas.
entities.name: Vlach Katuns

desc: The achievements and hard work of our people deserve recognition and protection. We will establish a prestigious title for ourselves and thereby secure that recognition from neighboring rulers, formalizing our status through diplomatic bonds.
entities.name: Kingly Ambitions

desc: Bosnia is home to several faiths. Not only is our land shared between the Orthodox and Catholic Churches, but it is also home to the South Slavic Christian faithful, the ''Krstjani''. Isolated from central supervision, we will have to foster a local understanding and harmony between these different groups to maintain our stability.
entities.name: Many Churches of Bosnia

desc: Drawing on the inexhaustible silver veins of the central mountains, our urban craftsmen have perfected the art of Filigran — intricate silver wire-work that has become the hallmark of Bosnian luxury. These guilds operate as a powerful economic estate, exporting ceremonial daggers and fine jewelry to the markets of Venice and Vienna. By turning our raw mineral wealth into high-value artistic exports, we have created a prosperous urban middle class that is fiercely loyal to the Crown. This industrial refinement elevates the prestige of our nation in every foreign court, proving that the 'Iron Heart' of the Balkans possesses a sophisticated cultural edge that rivals the great capitals of the West.
entities.name: The Filigree Guilds

desc: As the mines of Srebrenica become the premier source of bullion in the Balkans, the realm has moved beyond the mere export of raw ore. We have established a Royal Mint and an Assay Office to regulate the purity of Bosnian silver, producing a coin which rivals those of Venice in reliability. By mandating that all silver extracted by Ragusan or Saxon miners be processed through state-controlled refineries, we capture a massive share of the value-added profit. This liquid wealth allows us to make Bosnia the most financially solvent power in the Dinaric Alps.
entities.name: The Srebrenica Mint Office

desc: The Bosnian people have unified around ''Bosančica'', a unique, cursive Cyrillic script used for everything from diplomatic treaties to private merchant ledgers. This national script serves as a powerful cultural gatekeeper; it is difficult for foreigners to read but universal among the Bosnian literate class, regardless of their specific confession. By maintaining this distinct script, the people ensure that their legal and historical records remain a 'closed book' to imperial administrators, preserving the secret nuances of Bosnian property law and lineage in a format that reinforces their unique Slavic heritage.
entities.name: Bosančica

desc: The geography of the Bosnian heartland is a vertical maze of limestone ridges and valleys that defy conventional mapping. Our people have adapted to this logic, mastering the secrets of the subterranean cavern networks and the logistics of the mule-train.
entities.name: People from the Hills

desc: The ancient cultural concept of ''Susjedstvo'' — the sacred social obligation to protect and honor one's neighbor — has evolved into a sophisticated civic philosophy that transcends religious divides. In the face of external pressures, this unwritten code mandates that a neighbor's safety and property are as sacred as one's own. This practice prevents the 'Divide and Rule' tactics often used by foreign powers to incite internal strife. By prioritizing local solidarity and the 'Law of the Neighborhood', we maintain a level of social harmony and internal stability that allows the nation to present a single, unbreakable front against any attempt to dismantle our shared homeland.
entities.name: Susjedstvo of Bosnia

desc: We are one people, and we have one army. By bringing troops from across all of our territories together, and pressing conquered peoples into military service, we can better integrate them into our society, and also increase their acceptance of our rule.
entities.name: Bound by Service

desc: The formalization of the Princely Chancellery allows for the systematic recording of land grants and diplomatic treaties in Church Slavonic and, eventually, Romanian. This bureaucratic evolution will enable the Voivodes to more efficiently tax the rural peasantry and maintain a permanent corps of diplomatic envoys at the courts of Europe. It will mark the transition from a tribal military society to a sophisticated medieval state.
entities.name: The Establishment of the Chancellery

desc: The hummingbird holds a crucial role in our mythology. Linked to the god of war, Huītzilōpōchtli, it embodies fallen warriors' reincarnation and is honored for its bravery. The hummingbird will be made a new symbol for our banners, one that will inspire our soldiers to fight unto their deaths!
entities.name: Brave as a Hummingbird

desc: As other nations have, it is time to codify the liberties of our subjects, in order to identify and safeguard their rights and motivate them to continue working towards a better future for our country.
entities.name: Brabantian Rights

desc: With the foundation of the University of Leuven, Brabant has placed itself firmly at the center of culture in the Netherlands. Students from all over Europe come to our lands to study and share their knowledge.
entities.name: A Land of Culture

desc: The Four Quartiers are the four provinces into which the core of Brabant is divided. Each quartier is formed by a satellite of large and smaller towns, some walled and others not. They all work in perfect synergy like a well-greased engine, filling our coffers with great riches.
entities.name: The Four Quartiers

desc: Ever since our ancestors came from Britain, our extensive coastal holdings have been bustling with activity. Our people live by the sea and for the sea, and our ports are always full of trade and fishing boats.
entities.name: Breton Peninsula

desc: The necessity for huge amounts of brewed drinks is resulting in more centralized centers of production where the old artisanal process has been systematic and mechanized.
entities.name: Brewery Manufactory

desc: Large Breweries will be able to utilize steam powered engines and automatized mechanism to increase the output of their facilities.
entities.name: Brewery Mill

desc: A sweeping series of reforms limiting royal power, particularly in judicial matters. Among other stipulations, they state that the monarch may not unilaterally raise armies, prescribe cruel and unusual punishment, or interfere with the free election of members of Parliament.
entities.name: English Bill of Rights

desc: Bronze is an alloy of Copper and Tin, discovered and developed to make much more durable tools and weapons, as it also more ductile and easier to work with than Copper.
entities.name: Bronze Working

desc: Called different names and even containing different texts, depending on the branch of Buddhism, the Buddhist Canon is a collection of sacred Buddhist texts. Containing everything from monastic rules to ''Sūtra'', or teachings of the Buddha, any person dedicated to Buddhism should be familiar with them.
entities.name: Buddhist Canon

desc: Throughout Buddhist history, monastic councils have discussed canonical texts across different schools. Although the specific form, outcomes, and records of the councils may vary from school to school, the unifying power of such councils — bringing diverse traditions into dialogue — should not be underestimated.
entities.name: Buddhist Councils

desc: Meditation is a common practice among all Buddhist followers, regardless of their school. The aim is to train the mind and the spirit to develop mindfulness, tranquility, and insight, and thus ultimately achieve enlightenment.
entities.name: Buddhist Meditation

desc: Buddhism has its origins in India, but it has since spread far and wide, coming in contact with many different beliefs. As such, it contains much syncretism not only with the previous Hindu traditions, but with the many other deities it has been exposed to.
entities.name: Buddhist Syncretism

desc: Since antiquity, Buddhist centers have also been hubs of learning and knowledge, attracting people from all over to study in our institutions. Nālandā was the biggest of these centers in the past, but many others have followed in its footsteps since.
entities.name: Buddhist Universities

desc: There is nothing worse than arguing with one's neighbor. If we want to avoid border tensions, having other states act as a buffer between us and our potential enemies will allow us some breathing room.
entities.name: Buffer States

desc: The capital of Tarnovo, perched upon the cliffs of Tsarevets and Trapezitsa, is arguably the most formidable fortress in the Balkans, symbolizing the power of the Asen dynasty. By continuously expanding the complex of palaces, patriarchal cathedrals, and triple-layered walls, we have created an administrative center that is immune to sudden coups or sieges. This architectural dominance projects an image of imperial stability that cowers the local Boyars and convinces the populace that the 'Third Rome' has truly moved to the banks of the Yantra.
entities.name: The Bastion of Tsarevets

desc: To prevent the internal strife that plagued the 14th century, we will evolve into a 'Consultative Autocracy' where the most powerful Boyars are integrated into a permanent State Council. This body will serve as a high court and a military planning board, ensuring that the interests of the landed nobility are aligned with those of the crown. This political stability will allow us to maintain a large standing army and avoid the devastating civil wars that have historically left the empire vulnerable to its neighbors.
entities.name: The Boyar Council

desc: Knowledge is power. We have instituted a decennial census that records every person, unit of livestock, and hearth in the empire. This precise data allows for the most efficient taxation and conscription system in the Balkans. By knowing exactly what the nation can provide, we can plan long-term campaigns with a level of logistical certainty that ensures our armies are always well-fed and our coffers never empty.
entities.name: The Bulgarian Census Bureau

desc: Drawing on the iron mines of the Balkan mountains and the expertise of Saxon miners, we will establish the first major domestic gunpowder industry in the region. These foundries will produce heavy siege cannons and early handguns, allowing the Bulgarian army to transition away from purely feudal cavalry toward a more modern, infantry-heavy force. By controlling the production of saltpeter and iron, we will ensure that our walls remain the most dangerous obstacle for any would-be conqueror in the Balkans.
entities.name: The Bulgarian Gunpowder Foundries

desc: At its peak, the chancellery in Tarnovo was the most sophisticated diplomatic hub in the Orthodox world, producing intricate Slavic charters that influenced the courts of Serbia and Russia. By professionalizing the class of ''Logothetes'' and scribes, the Tsars will ensure that every land grant and international treaty is meticulously recorded and legally binding. This administrative rigor will allow the state to extract taxes more efficiently and manage its complex network of vassalage with a degree of central control that is rare in the late medieval period.
entities.name: The Chancery of the Asens

desc: The intellectual legacy of the 14th-century Tarnovo Literary School is revived in the 17th century through the creation of a modern state university. This institution focuses on civil law, engineering, and the translation of Western scientific texts into the Bulgarian vernacular, creating a class of bureaucrats who are as capable as any in Paris or Vienna. This modernization of the elite will ensure that we can manage a complex, multi-ethnic empire while maintaining the cultural purity of its Bulgarian core.
entities.name: The Grand Academy of the Yantra

desc: The spiritual teachings of Grēgórios Sinaítēs have moved from the hermit's cell to the halls of power. By adopting Hesychasm — a philosophy of inner stillness and divine light — as the unofficial state ideology, we foster a populace that is deeply pious and resilient. This shared spiritual identity acts as a powerful deterrent against the influences from our enemies, making the Bulgarian subjects immune to foreign conversion or subversion.
entities.name: The Hesychast State Philosophy

desc: We have fully embraced our role as the natural leader of the Balkan peoples, articulating a formal doctrine for the reunification of all former Bulgarian lands. This fate is backed by a modern, professionalized army and a sophisticated diplomatic corps that seek to play the Great Powers against one another. The belief in a 'Greater Bulgaria' becomes the central pillar of the state, driving a policy of aggressive expansion and cultural assimilation that seeks to restore the empire of Simeon the Great.
entities.name: The Imperial Restoration Doctrine

desc: Utilizing the fertile Thracian plains and the unique climate of the Rose Valley, we have established state-protected guilds for the production of luxury oils and silk. These high-value, low-weight goods are perfect for overland export to the courts of Europe and Asia. The wealth generated by these guilds allows the state to build a massive gold reserve, making our economy one of the most stable and credit-worthy in the entire Mediterranean basin.
entities.name: The Silk and Rose Guilds

desc: Moving away from seasonal levies, we have established the first permanent 'Regiments of the Lion'. These infantrymen are trained year-round in the use of firearms, following a rigorous drill based on the successes of neighbor models but adapted for Balkan terrain. This professional infantry core give us a reliable tool for offensive warfare, capable of out-marching and out-shooting the traditional armies of our neighbors.
entities.name: The Standing Drilled Infantry

desc: The restoration of the Bulgarian Patriarchate in 1235, confirmed by the Council of Lampsacus, established Tarnovo as a sovereign spiritual rival to both Constantinople and Rome. By the 14th century, the Patriarchate functioned as the ideological spine of the Asen and Shishman dynasties, utilizing its autocephalous status to provide divine legitimacy that transcended the political fragmentation of the Bulgarian lands. From its seat on Tsarevets Hill, the Church managed an expansive administrative network of eparchies and monasteries, such as the Zograf Monastery on Mount Athos, which served as repositories for the Bulgarian recension of Church Slavonic.
entities.name: Bulgarian Orthodox Patriarchate

desc: The Bulgarian towns will be transformed into the industrial heartland of the peninsula through the specialized production of ''Aba'' (a durable, thick woolen cloth) and ''Gaitan'' (decorative braid). By organizing the local weavers and shepherds into powerful, self-governing guilds, the Bulgarian merchants will be able to secure massive state contracts for the outfitting of the regional armies and the growing urban middle classes of the Mediterranean. This economic surge creates a merchant aristocracy that will signal the transition of the Bulgarian people from a rural peasantry to a sophisticated, proto-industrial society with the financial power to dictate terms to their neighbors.
entities.name: The Bulgarian Cloth Industry

desc: Driven by the writings of monks like Paisius of Hilendar, the Bulgarian people have rediscovered their imperial history and linguistic pride, sparking a massive educational and political rebirth. This movement has moved beyond local grievances to demand a centralized, modern state that can take its place among the great powers of Europe. The result is a highly motivated and literate populace, ready to serve in a modern bureaucracy or a national army, fueled by the conviction that the glory of the Tsars is not a memory, but a future.
entities.name: The Bulgarian National Awakening

desc: Leveraging their position as the gatekeepers of the Lower Danube, Bulgarian merchant families have established a sophisticated trade network connecting the Black Sea to Central Europe. By utilizing shallow-draft barges and fortified river ports, they have managed to bypass the expensive and dangerous overland routes, controlling the flow of salt, grain, and timber across the Balkans. This riverine expertise has turned the Danube into a Bulgarian artery of wealth, funding the rise of a new urban elite that we can tax so they keep their privileges.
entities.name: The Danubian River Merchants

desc: We can consider ourselves to be both members of the traditional lands of the Holy Roman Empire, and of the realm of France. While this can complicate feudal relations, the situation has molded us into adept diplomats, able to skillfully play both sides to our own advantage.
entities.name: Between Two Realms

desc: We occupy a prestigious position within the feudal system of France. Therefore, it is only right that our troops are seen as a reflection of the Burgundian spirit.
entities.name: Knightly Prowess

desc: The lands of Burgundy are well-suited to growing plants and herding animals. Grapes are particularly apt for local growing conditions. With skilled cultivation, it should be easy to foster an agricultural industry.
entities.name: Foster Agriculture

desc:
In order to best utilize the lands and subjects we control, we must enlarge, reorganize, and professionalize our bureaucracy. We shall create organizations dedicated to administering specific aspects of the state, and thus eliminate the need for ad hoc solutions.

Let us consult with our universities to determine how to most efficiently rule and govern. Meanwhile, we shall encourage our young nobles to serve the state with a pen rather than a sword in hand.
entities.name: Bureaucratic Offices

desc: The position of the Burghers is not only reinforced by their privileges, but also by our laws.
entities.name: Rights of the Burghers

desc: The world was created with flames, and in flames shall we all end. Our god has gifted the fire of life to us humble mortals, burning our souls in the process and making us see the truth of its danger. Thou shall not be afraid.
entities.name: By the Grace of God

desc: Primarily focused on border defense, these light troops are also given lands to farm as well as protect. Akritai are most adept at defensive warfare, especially against cavalry, and are often the first response against external threats.
entities.name: Akritai

desc: The rediscovery and revival of ancient Greek arts has provided us with a wonderful opportunity to better educate the masses and to preserve our lofty scientific and cultural ideals. We shall make a diligent study of the wisdom of our ancestors.
entities.name: Ancient Greek Studies

desc: Our great nation is the undisputed heir to the splendor and prestige of Rome, and reclaiming that long-lost territory is our primary motivation.
entities.name: Autokratoría Rhōmaíōn

desc: Our administration heaves under the weight of our complex web of bureaucracies, a legacy of centuries of imperial rule.
entities.name: Byzantine Bureaucracy

desc: Europe is engulfed in religious turmoil. We must be prepared to rip up noxious weeds of heresy that appear in the garden of our Empire, lest it become overgrown with heathens. Our pious defense against heretic incursion will prevent us from sinking into instability.
entities.name: Byzantine Inquisition

desc: Although warfare has evolved significantly since the first incarnation of our empire, including the introduction of gunpowder, the battle tactics refined by our forebears centuries ago are often still effective. Our cataphracts shall embody the best of both our ancient and modern combat wisdom.
entities.name: Late Cataphracts

desc: The court of Constantinople attracts diplomats and dignitaries from every corner of the known world. As a result, we ensure all languages receive equal respect and accommodation — a practical necessity for an empire at the crossroads of civilizations.
entities.name: Court of Languages

desc: Byzantium is located between Europe and Asia, making it in many ways the connection between East and West. Our advantageous position is highly lucrative, and has also allowed us to significantly expand our maritime influence.
entities.name: Intercontinental Crossroads

desc: Constantinople is the beating heart of vibrant faith. We take great pride in being the home of Orthodoxy, holders of the Ecumenical Patriarchate, and defenders of Christendom against our heathen enemies.
entities.name: Heart of Orthodoxy

desc: Our people stand on the shoulders of giants; it is our responsibility to leave comprehensive records of our empire's glory to inspire and instruct future generations. By thoroughly documenting the lives of our extraordinary ancestors, tracing our prestigious lineages, and detailing our intricate traditions, we will surpass mere historical records and become truly legendary.
entities.name: Byzantine Historiography

desc: The ''Strategikon'' — the ancient manual of cavalry tactics, logistics, and battlefield doctrine — has served us well in times of war. However, as war changes, so must we. Our tactics and regiments have adapted to modern combat, employing weapons of such destruction that Maurice himself could never have anticipated their devastation.
entities.name: Modernized Stratēgikon

desc: Byzantine culture has taken Europe by storm, particularly ''poikilia'' — our unique aesthetic. Emphasizing visual variety and a dizzying array of vibrant hues, poikilia creates a symphony of colors and elements in our art and architecture alike.
entities.name: Poikilia

desc: Bureaucracy is a nightmarish endeavor for a country our size. To better refine the religious proceedings required every time we call the Orthodox Synod, we will cut down on the red tape, and revisit the associated legislation.
entities.name: Reformed Synod Proceedings

desc: We stand between Europe and a sea of heathens, a shield against foreign threats. Our sword will forever be raised against those who seek to eradicate our faith, ready to strike against any who disrespect our traditions.
entities.name: Shield of the West

desc: We are already familiar with deploying and refining powerful siege engines. However, by adapting our designs to use gunpowder, we will be able to completely dominate our foes with our cannons.
entities.name: The City-Taker

desc: Our army has lagged behind others in Europe for far too long. By enacting sweeping military reform and expanding our conscription efforts, we hope to build a modern army befitting the resurgent and resplendent phoenix that symbolizes our empire.
entities.name: The New Imperial Army

desc: By establishing an executive council, we are able to assemble our most skilled diplomats.
entities.name: Cabinet

desc: The cabinet is the highest office in the government and our ruler's personal advisors. Cabinet ministers and secretaries enjoy special privileges and rights.
entities.name: Cabinet Laws

desc: The ''Ḵilāfa'', or Caliphate, is the union of all Muslim faithful under a single ruler in the form of the Ḵalīfa, who is to be the political and spiritual successor of Muḥammad, peace be upon him. Although there are different ideas about who is eligible to be Ḵalīfa, the idea of all Islam united under a single banner has always been the primary focus of this process.
entities.name: Ḵilāfa

desc: Long ago, our illustrious forefathers sailed forth and established colonies in the North. Our sagas even tell us that they reached a new world and established Vinland. We must follow in their footsteps.
entities.name: The Call of our Forefathers

desc: Our tributary regions will receive appointed tribute collectors, called ''calpixqueh'', who will be in charge of ensuring the flow of tribute never stops. There will be a ''calpixqui'' in the region, and another in the capital of our nation, for each tributary state.
entities.name: Calpixcāyōtl

desc: Warriors obviously make up the bulk of our armies, but no army can consist of fighters alone. Without the extra entourage of people transporting food and equipment for the army, it would not be able to feasibly go anywhere. By organizing and structuring these camp followers, we can greatly increase their usefulness and efficiency.
entities.name: Camp Followers

desc: In a Cannon Foundry cannons are cast and assembled from molten metal. Key for equipping armies with artillery, enhancing a state's military capabilities.
entities.name: Cannon Foundry

desc: A guild specialized in crafting and assembling cannons. These powerful weapons are essential for sieges and defense.
entities.name: Cannon Maker

desc: The ever-increasing demand of artillery for our armies requires us to increase the capabilities of the Cannon production.
entities.name: Cannon Workshop

desc: Lightweight canoes are perfectly adapted to the waterways of North America. These vessels can navigate shallow rivers and are light enough to portage — carry overland— when necessary. In this way, we can turn disconnected waterways into full trade routes, making it much easier to direct the flow of commerce and people.
entities.name: Canoes

desc: Every boy born in Prussia is born into a regiment. Each province will supply its own soldiers to its own officers, who will know their men by name. When war comes, we will not scramble to fill the ranks, they will already be there.
entities.name: Cantonment System

desc: A potent mix of Capetian dignity and Angevin ambition courses through our blood. Though we no longer wear the crown of Jerusalem, we remain heirs to a legacy of kingship that once stretched from Anjou to Albania. With careful diplomacy and planning, we may yet revive the grandeur of our forefathers and claim what was unjustly taken from us.
entities.name: Capetian House of Anjou

desc: We fight wars mainly to take captives, which replace our own losses. However, not all those captives need to be adopted into our tribe, and some can be used for labor instead.
entities.name: Captives in War

desc: Trade routes appeared in Central Asia over the last millennium, creating the network known as the Silk Road. Key to this was the flourishing of Caravanserai, places where merchants and their caravans could stop and rest along the way.
entities.name: Caravanserai

desc: The Caroleans are the Swedish and Finnish infantry of the Swedish Empire. Recruited from the peasantry, the Caroleans go under strict training and are renowned for invoking fear in the hearts of their enemies.
entities.name: Caroleans

desc: Inspired by other water systems across Europe, which are used for both commercial purposes and irrigation, the ''Canal de Castilla'' will bring water from the mountains in the north of the ''Meseta'' and irrigate the cereal fields of Old Castile. This feat of engineering will increase our yield, create a surplus with which we can trade, and be the way to transport it for export.
entities.name: Canal de Castilla

desc: Situated as we are on a peninsula, surrounded by sea on three out of four sides, and with the valuable Strait of Gibraltar bitterly fought over by different powers, dominating the seas has become a matter of life and death. From our hundreds of kilometers of coastline, our ancestors started taming the waves, evolving our nation into a fearless naval power.
entities.name: Castilian Navy

desc: By compiling the chronicles written by previous rulers, we are able to create a compendium that details every past event in our realm and the origins of all our rulers. This knowledge will help us not only to create better cultural foundations, but will also help present and future rulers to correctly assess present events through comparisons to past ones.
entities.name: Crónicas Reales

desc: Inspired by the Genitour Moorish cavalry, the Lanzas de Castilla are mobile cavalry that, however, charges into the crowd as a heavy cavalry would do while not as heavily armed.
entities.name: Lanzas de Castilla

desc: With a strong navy comes the need for crew members adept at combat in any situation, including having to fight outside their vessels. In order to overcome this challenge, we will regulate our marine infantry so they become a powerful weapon no matter where they fight.
entities.name: Castilian Marine Infantry

desc: As the Reconquista is no longer our main focus, we can no longer justify the independence of Holy Orders. By having our ruler assume the position of Master in every Order, they will not only gain significant power, but they will also have access to the military knowledge of these crusaders.
entities.name: Masters of the Orders

desc: Newly-discovered lands can be claimed and settled by enterprising colonists, and will send valuable trade goods back to our realm. We will send a few loyal colonists to the New World, have them stake their claims and find ways to harness the treasures of nature, and thereby form the backbone of our colonial endeavors.
entities.name: The New World

desc: While the ''Pasos'' of the Holy Week are an old tradition in Castile, the sculpted artworks that accompany them have recently reached a stunning new peak. Artists such as Juan de Juni and Gregorio Fernández have started down the path of making Castilian ''Pasos'' the most impressive on the Peninsula.
entities.name: Castilian Pasos

desc: As our language evolves and spreads across the world, the need to regulate and preserve it becomes obvious. To preserve the essential character and defining traits of our mother tongue, the ''Real Academia Española'' will be established to set standards for how to properly speak our language.
entities.name: Real Academia Española

desc: With the approval of the Reform of the ''Millones'', we might be able to tax our populace more efficiently. This will be an indirect extraction of revenue, done through a levy on food products.
entities.name: Reform of the Millions

desc: The extensive conquests of our ancestors have created a country with more land than people available to inhabit and work it. That has resulted in a dire need to attract migrants from other regions.
entities.name: Repoblaciones

desc: To combat the export of raw materials instead of more valuable manufactured goods, we will develop a system of government-backed factories that will industrialize our nation. More robust domestic manufacturing will lead to a stronger national economy.
entities.name: Royal Factories

desc: In the many years since the Visigothic Kingdom fell to invaders, we have waged war against the Moors. This has given us the sort of iron discipline that not many can boast of. Arise, warriors of Castile, and show the world your determination!
entities.name: The Reconquista

desc: A Castle is usually a fortified residence of the nobility or the headquarters of a military order. However, the Castle here serves first and foremost as a defensive structure protecting the location from invading forces.
entities.name: Castle

desc: The Catalan Galley is a larger version of the ancient Greek galleys that once dominated the Mediterranean Sea.
entities.name: Catalonian Galleys

desc: A cathedral is one of the largest and most important types of Christian temple, where the Bishop has a ''cathedra'', or seat. While a church can be beautiful and detailed, a cathedral is majestic, of enormous dimensions, and adorned with the finest and most intricate details.
entities.name: Cathedral

desc: ''Whose realm, his religion.'' We will have to accept that other countries follow other faiths, and that this will sometimes be a crucial factor in diplomacy.
entities.name: Cuius Regio, Eius Religio

desc: For our faith to withstand the attacks of the Enlightenment, we must adapt, and present new perspectives in and about the Church.
entities.name: Catholic Enlightenment

desc: The holy sites of our faith should be seen by every follower. Encouraging pilgrimages, and elevating those who have undergone the process, should be a priority of our administration.
entities.name: Catholic Pilgrims

desc: Educating the people is an important part of our religious duties. We should establish schools, closely tied to our normal worship services, to provide basic education to our flock.
entities.name: Sunday Schools

desc: The ''Ç̌äwa'' serve as Ethiopia's noble feudal warriors, recruited and appointed for the Emperor's army service. They are a professional soldier class, renowned for their ferocity.
entities.name: Ç̌äwa Regiments

desc: Taira no Masakado, a great warrior and close kinsman of our clan, once tried to become the Emperor of Eastern Japan. Sadly, Masakado could not fulfill his ambition, but his dream of founding a new nation of samurai should be our guiding star.
entities.name: Dream of Masakado

desc: Large parts of our domain is marshland that cannot support intensive agriculture. Recent developments in irrigation technology, however, make it possible to drain marshes and cultivate new arable lands. Let us undertake a grand project of developing these otherwise useless lands; we stand to profit enormously.
entities.name: Irrigation of Southern Kantō

desc: Katori Shrine is dedicated to Futsunushi no Kami, a patron god of martial arts who is revered by every warrior in Japan. By becoming the shrine's primary patron and encouraging our samurai to train there, we will assert our legitimacy while also strengthening the morale and abilities of our warriors.
entities.name: Katori Shrine

desc: The Chiba clan is an old branch of the Taira, having split from them in the late Heian period. This gives us more power and influence than our political situation would otherwise indicate.
entities.name: Taira Lineage

desc: From crofter to chieftain, many have left our shores through hardship or hope, weaving a far-flung web of kinship that carries our language, customs, and pride to distant lands.
entities.name: Celtic Diaspora

desc: Our union is founded on the ideal of uniting the diverse peoples of the Celtic world under a shared banner. Through cooperation, we aim to preserve our heritage, promote our values, and ensure that the Celtic nations thrive together in the face of external pressures and changing times.
entities.name: Celtic Nations

desc: Centuries of living under the shadow of conquest have taught our warriors the art of patience and resilience. We can rush headlong into danger, but we can also endure, defend, and strike only when the moment is right.
entities.name: The Hills Speak Celtic

desc: Our vision of a united Celtic world is more than an ideal - it is a rallying call to all who share our heritage. Together, we forge bonds that reach beyond borders, making our identity as enduring as the hills and seas we call home.
entities.name: Pan-Celticism

desc: After long centuries of silence, the ancient spirit of the Celtic peoples stirs once more, ready to reclaim its place amongst the great civilizations of the world.
entities.name: The West's Awake

desc: For millennia we have fished, traded, and fought along the wild Atlantic coasts. From these harsh waters, we have learned seamanship unmatched by any rival.
entities.name: The Western Shore

desc: For millennia, our ferocious and agile guerilla warfare has harried our foes, besting them with a devastating succession of evasive skirmishing and blood-curdling charges.
entities.name: Furor Celtica

desc: With the Banking institution firmly established, the state can now charter a permanent Central Bank empowered to issue Government Bonds. These bonds allow the crown to raise large sums quickly from private investors, repaying them through steady interest rather than relying on estate lending alone.
entities.name: Central Banking

desc: The Council of Trent has reformed doctrine and sharpened the institutional boundaries of the Church, but the Papal States themselves remain a patchwork of cities, lordships, and client territories whose local princes have long treated our authority as negotiable. We act now to close that gap — absorbing the revenues, appointments, and legal jurisdictions that local lords have quietly accumulated over generations, and placing them under direct administration from Rome in the manner that the reformed ''Curia'' demands. This consolidation of crown authority over our territories gives the Papacy the financial and administrative foundation that the Counter-Reformation's ambitions require.
entities.name: Centralize the States

desc: The refomation of our government, in an attempt to support the sprawl of our newly-attained urban territories, shall be united under firm oversight, creating a more orderly and dependable administration.
entities.name: Centralized City Governance

desc: If we centralize the state, then we will find it easier to advance the ideas and agenda of the center over the other regions.
entities.name: Centralized Government

desc: The rulers of Cephalonia and Zante have developed a long tradition of raiding any enemy vessel foolish enough to sail without adequate protection through the Ionian approaches. These island-based raids amass considerable wealth through plunder and ransom while simultaneously weakening our enemies' naval logistics in the western Aegean, thereby allowing the tiny county to punch far above its weight and preserve its independence.
entities.name: Cephalonian Raids

desc: As the lords of Cephalonia, Zante, and Ithaca, we sit at the crossroads of the Adriatic and the Mediterranean, acting as the first line of defense for Italy. Our naval strategy focuses on 'Anti-Access' warfare, using heavy fortifications and fast scouting vessels to deny the enemy the ability to harbor in the Ionian Isles. We are the gatekeepers of the West, and no fleet enters the Adriatic without our silent consent.
entities.name: Ionian Sea-Wall

desc: We have transformed the natural deep-water bay of Argostoli into a premier naval refitting station. Unlike the massive Arsenals of Venice, ours specializes in the rapid repair of small-tonnage vessels like brigantines and galiots used for Aegean raiding. This specialized infrastructure keeps our fleet at sea longer than our rivals, ensuring local naval superiority.
entities.name: The Arsenal of Argostoli

desc: Our administration has evolved to issue all decrees in Latin, Greek, and Italian, reflecting the diverse merchant and noble classes of the Ionian Isles. This linguistic inclusivity attracts high-value migrants from the mainland and the Italian peninsula who seek a stable, multi-cultural legal environment. It effectively reduces the friction of governance in a sea of diverse identities.
entities.name: The Chancery of the Three Tongues

desc: The unique climate of the Ionian Islands allows for the mass cultivation of the ''Zante currant'', a luxury dried fruit that has become a staple of European diets. By dominating the production and export of this niche crop, we have created a specialized economic engine that generates vast wealth for a relatively small territory. The 'Currant Lords' of Cephalonia are among the wealthiest nobles in the Latin East.
entities.name: The Currant Trade

desc: We have granted extensive privileges to our local merchants, allowing them to form self-governing trade companies that manage the most lucrative exports and imports. This mercantile autonomy has fostered a wealthy urban class that bankrolls the County's modern administrative reforms.
entities.name: The Ionian Merchant Experts

desc: Due to our challenging native terrain, would-be conquerors must rely on their naval capabilities when attempting to invade us. Decades of piracy in the surrounding seas have taught us valuable boarding tactics, which allow us to use an opponent's own ships against them.
entities.name: Boarding Tactics

desc: Although some of our neighbors see our culture as inferior, they are just in denial, as many of our cultural aspects make their way into their self-proclaimed 'civilized' courts. Cham drumming, songs, dances, poetry... all of these art forms have left a clear and lasting mark on what other nations consider artistic achievement!
entities.name: Cham Cultural Influence

desc: Much of our wealth comes from trade. We should concentrate on expanding and refining our exchange practices, with the ultimate goal of creating a commercial state in the process.
entities.name: Commercial State

desc: The Dharmic gods bless us with their presence. May their strength guide us through the most difficult of times.
entities.name: Dharmic Presence

desc: The resinous heartwood of our native trees, known as agarwood or ''Trầm Hương'', is treasured not only for its enchanting aroma but also for its spiritual and medicinal properties. Across the seas, nobles and monks alike covet it for incense, perfumes, and offerings. By protecting our forests and refining our harvesting methods, we can turn this rare natural gift into one of our most prized exports.
entities.name: Gỗ Trầm Hương

desc: The Haluwbilau are elite warriors who occupy key positions in both our land and naval forces. Selected for their talents and bravery, these men lead armies and ships into battle against external threats, and also mediate disputes in local communities.
entities.name: Haluwbilau

desc: The Kṣatriya is a term adopted from Hindu societies, and describes the elite nobles of our state. Given the origin of this term, it follows that our nobility take  similar roles in military and court affairs as their counterparts in India.
entities.name: Kṣatriya

desc: Women in our society are given more reverence and appreciation than in many of our neighboring countries. The birthright of any child comes from their mother's side, and women have a wide array of liberties and social responsibilities.
entities.name: Matrilineal Heritage

desc: Our society is a melting pot of different religious influences. The Buddhist ideas from China, the Hindu practices from India, and the spread of Islam in South East Asia create a unique environment where religious tolerance is paramount to keeping our society together.
entities.name: Religious Tolerance

desc: As a maritime power, much of our wealth and power comes from the sea and our dominance over it. In order to secure this supremacy, our shipwrights have designed special large warships which are known as ''Towers on the Water'', hybrid creations between a heavy ship and a galley.
entities.name: Towers on Water

desc: Our state relies on maritime dominance to secure its political, military, and economical presence in Indochina. As such, being able to build ships swiftly is of great importance to our survival.
entities.name: Veteran Shipbuilders

desc: To help connect our people across our vast realm, we need a unified language, and require many literate members of the clergy to spread it. The development of such a language to record our history and maintain our administrative apparatus is not only a sign of national pride and prestige, but also a means of creating a distinct government, separating us linguistically and culturally from our neighbors to the east.
entities.name: Chancery Slavonic

desc: The Karluk language of the eastern steppes is far more worthy to carry the thoughts and ideas of our great lineage than Persian or Arabic ever could be. We must promote the use of our ancestral language, and create a new literary tradition.
entities.name: Karluk Literature

desc: A chancery is a bureaucratic office that medieval rulers developed for governing their domains as societal changes made them more complex and increasingly difficult to manage. The main function of a chancery is to write, send, and receive documents related to the management of these domains.
entities.name: Chancery

desc: The growing apparatus of chanceries requires another level of administration, since their bureaucracy is becoming even more complex to manage. This comes in the form of chancery records, an office established to keep all letters received at the chancery, as well as a copy of all the documents issued by its scribes and notaries.
entities.name: Chancery Records

desc: The world is a big place, and in order to develop our global trade, we must take some serious risks. Luckily there are merchant in our country willing to do so, using mostly their own capital. By sanctioning such companies with a government charter giving them special rights to exercise government powers as well as monopolies in certain areas, we can control and encourage commercial development of everything from foreign trade networks to our colonial possessions overseas.
entities.name: Chartered Companies

desc: The ''chasquis'' are the messengers of our state. Chosen from the fittest and most durable runners of our country, these agile men carry Quipu strings, messages, gifts, and other kinds of information, and deliver them to the target recipient. The spread of ideas, as well as the bulk of our diplomacy, rests on their shoulders.
entities.name: Chasqui

desc: Surrounded by people that would oppose us, we face a constant struggle to maintain our borders. Our ever-vigilant soldiers have plentiful opportunities to hone their skills in battle, giving birth to a combat-hardened warrior people ready to reclaim the legacy of the Great Khān.
entities.name: Ceaseless Border Wars

desc: The horses of Genghis Khān trampled and conquered territories stretching from Europe to China. As his heirs and successors, our cavalry will instill fear of the same thing happening into our enemies.
entities.name: Chagatai Riders

desc: Let it be known that boy cannot be a man unless he has ridden first with our invincible host, that he can take no wife until he has taken another man's wife, that he is not worthy of a hut until he has burnt down someone else's. Let service in our armies be the only route to manhood.
entities.name: The Glory of Conquest

desc: The legacy of Genghis Khān is ours through his son Chagatai. All shall tremble before us as we reclaim his glory!
entities.name: Legacy of Chagatai

desc: The constant power struggles between the various princes, nobles, cities, and tribes in the Chagatai Khanate have produced a nation of highly adept schemers. If we can put aside our quarrels and channel this energy towards outsmarting our enemies, it would be a great boon to our people.
entities.name: Scheming Court

desc: We can trace our line back to Chagatai Khān, the second son of Genghis Khān, who once ruled these lands and established a powerful Mongolian successor state. Although a long time has passed since then, we can still claim considerable legitimacy by appealing to the legacy of our fierce ancestor.
entities.name: Sons of Chagatai Khān

desc: We lie sheltered between Balkhash Lake and the Tiānshān Mountains. It is a harsh and unforgiving land, one which our people know how to use as a weapon against would-be invaders.
entities.name: The Mountain Khanate

desc: Conquering people can be a tricky business; not everyone is ready to accept our enlightened government. Still, we have discovered that there are easier ways to bring people into our empire than building a mountain of skulls — something that our ancestors never learned.
entities.name: Tradition of Conquest

desc: Our armies shall march like the great hordes of Genghis Khān. Our troops shall trample our enemies under our hooves like blades of grass of our native steppes. All shall fear the power of our armies!
entities.name: Unrelenting Horde

desc: Our realm rests upon a tradition of sophisticated administrative institutions, from the Central Secretariat that coordinates all civil governance to the Censorate that holds our officials to account. We shall make this legacy of imperial administration the foundation of our state.
entities.name: Imperial Bureaucracy

desc: While the great rivers flowing through our lands do have some associated risks for nearby settlements, they are also an invaluable tool for crop production.
entities.name: Fertile Rivers

desc: Our origins may be humble, but we have proven our ability to lead, and have inspired and won the loyalty of many faithful subjects. We are now seen as worthy claimants to the Mandate of Heaven and the Middle Kingdom.
entities.name: Claim to the Mandate

desc: Proficient in terracing hills for cultivation and skilled in crafting arable land on shallow lake portions through ingenious ''chinampas'', our populace's remarkable agricultural abilities will significantly benefit our society.
entities.name: Chinampas

desc: Our thick, sturdy fortifications represent generations of defensive engineering expertise. Conversely, our thorough understanding of fortification weaknesses, learned from building impregnable walls, helps us to develop particularly effective siege tactics and strategies.
entities.name: Planned Sieges

desc: The people of the Kievan Rus' were among the first of the Eastern Slavic people to accept the light of Christ and convert to Orthodoxy. From there, the faith spread throughout the region.
entities.name: Christianization of the Slavs

desc: Adopting a mandatory church attendance policy will emphasize the importance of our religious values and beliefs, and will minimize the costs of maintaining law and order.
entities.name: Church Attendance Duty

desc: As the Church must be united in its judgments, any matter too complex for a single bishop to resolve requires us to call a council, where the bishops will consult the mind of the Church itself. The council's decisions shall therefore reflect the consensus of the Church as a whole.
entities.name: Church Councils
