desc: The Scriptures are the Word of God, but only the Church is able to interpret their correct meaning and to relate it accurately to the flock. Any independent reading or interpretation of the Scriptures outside of Church guidance would only lead to being lost in falsehoods and on the path to heresy.
entities.name: Church Guidance

desc: Our settlements lie unprotected, and are easy prey to any invader. As these settlements grow, however, we can directly incorporate the hilly terrain into our defensive lines, enhancing their protection. If necessary, we can even create the elevated terrain required ourselves.
entities.name: Fortified Towns

desc: To unify our people, we shall elect the greatest of our lords as the Grand Prince, who will serve as an inspiring leader for our troops.
entities.name: Grand Princedom

desc: Our position at the edge of the steppes has resulted in multiple mounted invasions of our homelands. If we want to ensure our independence, we will need to raise a great host ourselves, and expand our influence over the steppes, securing our heartland.
entities.name: Skilled Horsemen

desc: Our lands have again and again been raided by foreign powers, and our people enslaved. Some of these slaves, used as soldiers, have advanced in their new lives, accumulating power and wealth of their own. With some convincing, we could convince them to return to our lands, and protect it from future invasions.
entities.name: Circassian Mercenaries

desc: Our lands are frequented by many Catholic, Muslim, and Orthodox people, who frequently engage in trade with our population. We should foster a collective tolerance between all our subjects, to promote peace and stability.
entities.name: Religious Coexistence

desc: We will elect a nominal leader of our people, who will act as our representative but will not meddle with the oversight of local lords.
entities.name: Tribal Elections

desc: Developing our urban centers has become central to national prosperity, and is a cornerstone of the urbanization movement. By systematically constructing infrastructure and specialized buildings within our cities, we will fuel our economic growth.
entities.name: City Building

desc: Through patronage of the world's greatest artists, the glory of our city will become known throughout the world. All will marvel at the greatness of our painters, poets, singers, and actors. Let Neapolitan culture be the mark by which other centers of art are measured!
entities.name: City of Artists

desc: There are over eighty Orthodox churches in Novgorod, and some are the largest landholders in the principality. Their wealth and religious prestige allows the Church to significantly influence the population in many areas, and our citizens are more pious as a result — in a good way.
entities.name: City of Churches

desc: Tlemcen has long been a center of Islamic learning and intellectual exchange. Our madrasas attract scholars from across the Maghreb and Al-'Andalus, fostering scientific and theological progress for generations to come.
entities.name: City of Scholars

desc: Establishing a civil service of eager young bureaucrats will ensure that we can quickly adapt to new advances in administration and governance.
entities.name: Civil Service

desc: Claiming something as yours is easy; persuading everyone else that your claim is valid is much harder. By spreading our diplomatic net wide, we can ensure that the people who matter know that we have staked this claim.
entities.name: Claim Fabrication

desc: The exchange of payments and advanced transactions are some of the principal conducts of business within our realm. The Clearing House offers the environment to further increase our grip across the trade that flows through our realm.
entities.name: Clearing House

desc: The position of the Clergy is not only reinforced by their privileges, but also by our laws.
entities.name: Rights of the Clergy

desc: Through a masterclass in marital diplomacy and unwavering loyalty to the Holy Roman Emperors, we have risen from local lords to Princes of the Holy Roman Empire. By securing marriage ties to the thrones of our neighbors, we have positioned ourselves as the indispensable 'Shield of the South'. This meteoric rise grants us the prestige to demand respect from the greatest of European houses.
entities.name: The Count's Ambition

desc: Following our deep involvement in the successions of our neighbors, we formalize our legal claims to oversee the southern frontier of the Empire as the primary protectors of the realm. Even as our rivals attempt to absorb our lands, the administrative structures and 'Imperial Immediate' status we have secured ensure that our territory remains a privileged hub of regional governance.
entities.name: The Last Count's Legacy

desc: To reflect our status as Princes of the Empire, we have invited Italian architects to redesign our urban centers in the grand Baroque style. These sprawling palaces and public squares are not merely for show; they serve as centralized administrative hubs where the state's bureaucracy is professionalized. The sheer splendor of our capital serves to overawe foreign diplomats and domestic rivals alike, cementing our legitimate right to rule.
entities.name: The Marble Palaces of Celje

desc: Our ancestral valleys have been transformed from a feudal pastoral land into the industrial heartbeat of our realm. We have seized this momentum by establishing massive industries, alongside modern steam-powered mills that process the raw timber and iron of the surrounding mountains. This rapid modernization has created a new class of skilled laborers and engineers, turning our capital into a center of technological innovation that propels the entire state into the industrial age.
entities.name: The Modernization of a Nation

desc: Before we were Princes of the Empire, the House of Cilli was defined by the sharp blades of the Sanneck knights. By leading elite mercenary companies for the Hungarian and Imperial crowns in the fields of Dalmatia and Italy, we have turned the 'contract of war' into a tool for dynastic elevation. This tradition of professional military service allows us to field superior sellswords at a fraction of the cost.
entities.name: The Sanneck Condottieri

desc: As the primary lords of the southern frontier, we have transformed our estates into a permanent military supply chain. By patronizing the ironworks of the Savinja Valley, we ensure our heavy cavalry and border guards are equipped with the finest plate and firearms forged in Inner Austria. This localized military industry reduces our reliance on foreign armaments and keeps our regiments battle-ready at all times.
entities.name: The Windic March Arsenal

desc: For us, our subjects are not something separate from the nation, but rather an integral part of it. We keep close ties with them, and they are fully integrated into our bureaucracy and administration.
entities.name: Close Subjects

desc: Cloth represents the various fabrics and clothing made from wool and linen. The Textile Manufactory specializes in the production of Cloth from various materials such as Wool, Cotton and Fiber Crops.
entities.name: Cloth Manufactory

desc: Easier methods of cleaning fibers and dedicated workshops for the production of Cloth will increase the output of our textile industries.
entities.name: Cloth Workshop

desc: By streamlining the coal refining process, we can use it more effectively as fuel while eliminating side effects that would negatively impact other industrial products.
entities.name: Improved Coking

desc: For the production of coke, a vital part of iron processing, we need many beehive ovens. With improved construction techniques and better usage of bricks, we will be able to accordingly raise the quality of the produced coke.
entities.name: Improved Beehive Ovens

desc: As the threat of pirates and hostile fleets approaches, a set of rudimentary coastal fortifications are called for, to protect us from invasions.
entities.name: Coastal Fort

desc: The safest way for any ship to sail is to do it close to the coast. Unless they actually have to cross the sea, there is no real need for our ships to sail away from the protective coastline, and it is still quicker traveling by ship than by land. As such, maintaining a constant flow of ships along our coasts will allow for easier circulation of goods and people.
entities.name: Coastal Expansion

desc: Statutes and regulations are the backbone of any well-functioning society. If we are to hone our efficiency and internal capabilities, a set of robust codified laws is of vital importance.
entities.name: Codified Laws

desc: Though others have attempted to transplant our beloved bean, the Coffee of Arabia remains unmatched in flavor and fame. From the bustling port of Mocha to the courts of faraway rulers, the world's desire for our drink is insatiable.
entities.name: Coffea Arabica

desc: This is a new type of blast furnace, which uses coke instead of charcoal as its fuel. It is cheaper and allows us to build larger furnaces, although coke has the disadvantage of being less pure than charcoal, which is a problem yet to be addressed.
entities.name: Coke Blast Furnace

requires_state: text: unlocked advance coke smelting tt
has variable: unlocked advance coke smelting

desc: The invention of coke smelting, specifically its application in Iron and Steel production, is closely tied to the Industrial Revolution. Iron and Steel are currently produced using traditional methods like charcoal smelting, whereas this new method will result in improved output and reduced maintenance costs.
entities.name: Coke Smelting

desc: Overseas colonies are often hubs for the exchange of a wide variety of goods and products. As a result, the administrative dependencies also flourish, supporting and regulating the activities of colonial traders.
entities.name: Colonial Administration

desc: Many of our people settled in the New World to start a new life; to discover the wonders beyond the sea and make an untamed continent their home. Their ambition is ours as we push further and further into the unknown.
entities.name: Colonial Ambition

desc: Much of the legislative power over taxes and government spending has been moved into colonial administrations.
entities.name: Colonial Assembly

desc: These new documents will ensure the rights of our countrymen when they settle the untamed New World. They give our colonies the exclusive right of governing these new lands and regulate their relationship with the mother country.
entities.name: Colonial Charters

desc: As a colony, we bear the heritage of our mother country's imperial ambitions.
entities.name: Colonial Heritage

desc: In the absence of regular garrisons, colonial militias played an important role in local conflicts and border raids against native tribes and other colonies. They were typically made up of adult male citizens who were usually expected to provide their own weapons and equipment.
entities.name: Colonial Militia

desc: The new lands and frontier territories that our people are colonizing require new forms of management and organization.
entities.name: Colonial Policy

desc: Our state was formed and shaped by the ambitions of the 'founding fathers,' the first colonists to come over from the old country. Many of the customs and traditions they brought with them have influenced our own society in this new and strange world.
entities.name: Colonial Traditions

desc: Enables us to send more colonists to uncharted lands.
entities.name: Colonial Ventures

desc: Be it by sending our own people to settle in new lands, by imposing our rule over the natives in our overseas holdings, or through a mix of both, establishing a colony creates a foothold for our power that will let us further expand our control — and borders — in these unclaimed territories.
entities.name: Colonies

desc: The coat of arms that hangs on our banners originates from one of our most celebrated dynasties, the Gediminid family. Many of their brightest have led our nation through turbulent times into ample prosperity with careful statesmanship and capable guidance. The columns of such great leaders symbolize the strong foundation and tenacity of our country and our fellow men and women.
entities.name: Columns of Gediminids

desc: Warfare is becoming increasingly complex, driven by the widespread adoption of standing armies composed of soldiers hired for permanent service. The introduction of new weapons, such as firearms and cannons, encourages an approach that balances and combines light and heavy infantry, cavalry, and artillery, supported by auxiliary units.
entities.name: Combined Arms

desc: The regular use of combined arms over several centuries has led to the dominance of this type of warfare. Light infantry and cavalry have the role of weakening and disorganizing enemy forces, while simultaneously screening and protecting their own. Heavy infantry and cavalry bear the brunt of the fighting, seeking decisive charges to rout the enemy, while artillery and auxiliary forces support them from a distance at the rear.
entities.name: Advanced Combined Arms

desc: We have recently received a rather curious new tome. It is called ''On the True Significance of Comets against the Vanity of Astrologers'', and it is positively filled with vital information on these highly suspicious entities. We have decreed that all in the realm should be aware of its contents.
entities.name: Comets?

desc: This lively center of commerce is where goods from near and far are exchanged for gold. This is the beating heart of the local trade.
entities.name: Commerce Center

desc: Our Empire is home to people from hundreds of different backgrounds. They speak a multitude of tongues, and come from all the directions of the horizon, but each in their own tongue pays homage to our ruler, binding us together.
entities.name: Domain of Many Tongues

desc: Our reliance on feudal levies has proven inadequate for the demands of modern warfare. The creation of permanently contracted cavalry units, the ''Compagnies d'Ordonnance'', provides us with a reliable and professional military force directly loyal to the Crown.
entities.name: Compagnies d'Ordonnance

desc: To bring the focus of our trade home, we must be able to beat competition from other countries. We need to ensure that our legal system gives our merchants every possible advantage.
entities.name: Competitive Merchants

desc: In order to know who should pay taxes, we must first know who owns what. A comprehensive land survey, and regularly updating it, are therefore essential. We will always get what we are due!
entities.name: Comprehensive Land Survey

desc: For too long, our nation has been unevenly governed by multiple ''Stadtholders'' across different provinces, with the most powerful acting as ''Primus inter Pares'' among their peers. It is time to make the position hereditary and concentrate authority in a single ruler.
entities.name: Concentration of Power

desc: The Reformation gives us the opportunity to define a new creed for our people and, more importantly, to accept critique and make adjustments accordingly.
entities.name: A New Confession

desc: Court expenses can easily bankrupt even the richest nation. In order to achieve a good balance between luxury and sensible expenses, we can adopt small measures to reduce those costs without reducing the magnificence of our court.
entities.name: Confessional Court

desc: There are a myriad of different interpretations of what the Faith should be, and as such, there has been an increased interest among religious and secular authorities alike to clearly define the methodology of their specific confessions, enforcing their particular rules and views on all aspects of faith and life.
entities.name: Confessionalism

gate: any international organizations member of international organization type
any international organizations member of international organization has policy

desc: Private learning schools for elite-class students who are learning the Confucian teachings and ideals to pass the national service examinations.
entities.name: Confucian Academy

desc: If we are to manage our realm properly, our advisors shall find great wisdom about administration in Confucian teachings, which emphasize meritocratic selection of officials, attention to administrative detail, and other foundational advice for creating a healthy and prosperous government.

mods.label: Head of the Cabinet Promotion Cost Modifier

entities.name: Confucian Influences

gate: any international organizations member of international organization type
any international organizations member of international organization has policy

desc: These learning institutions focus their efforts in the education and training of government officials in the Confucian ideals.
entities.name: Confucian School

desc: In these turbulent times, we must clearly define orthodox Christian doctrine, while systematically refuting the false beliefs that endanger the very souls of our people.
entities.name: Refute False Confessions

desc: From Arabia to China and the coasts of South Asia, merchants of every shore converge upon Malacca. Drawn by fair laws, secure waters, and bustling markets, they will form a great congregation that enriches our ports and carries our name across the seas.
entities.name: Congregation of Merchants

desc: Our envoys have secured recognition from China's most prestigious sovereigns. Tribute and goodwill flow between us, granting us prestige, protection, and a privileged place in the vast network of their trade.
entities.name: Connections with China

desc: Treaties and trade agreements with Christian states ensure that diplomacy and pragmatism serve our long-term interests. Though our faith differs from theirs, we should not close the door to opportunity.
entities.name: Connections with the Christian World

desc: Our glorious empire emerged from the legacy of great conquerors. It was the ferocity of Genghis Khān's troops that allowed him to conquer from Europe to China. As his successors, our troops will be as fearsome as the ones in his army.
entities.name: Conqueror's Legacy

desc: The discovery of the New World attracts adventurers of all stripes to risk their fortunes and lives on uncertain expeditions, with the promise of unparalleled wealth, fame, and power. These expeditions are formalized through agreements between expedition leaders and the government, legally manifested as 'capitulations of conquest'.
entities.name: Conquistadors

desc: Reluctant soldiers obligated to fight, massed Conscripts can overwhelm a trained army through numbers alone.
entities.name: Conscripts

desc: The Conscription Center is the most efficient building increasing the [
]. It replaces the Barracks in [Urban Locations] and the Regimental Camp in any [Rural Location].
entities.name: Conscription Center

desc: Verona sits at the point where the road from the Brenner Pass descends into the Po plain, making whoever holds our city the keeper of the most traveled route between Italy and the German lands. We have rebuilt our walls with the full depth of bastioned fortification and maintained the largest permanent garrison in northern Italy. This position means that any army moving south must either take Verona first or leave a hostile city at its back, and we intend to make both choices expensive.
entities.name: Gateway of the Alps

desc: We have inherited a wealthy realm, but we have been stymied from achieving true prosperity by the constraints of archaic laws and customs. Previous rulers balanced noble privilege with economic power, but we must bring attitude and regulations into the modern era. By strengthening courts of the nobility and consolidating their landholdings, we will create a clearer legal hierarchy. Simultaneously, we will empower cities as centers of royal authority and encourage the proliferation of urban trade and craftsmanship.
entities.name: The Royal Domain

desc: This allows more constructions to be done at the same time in an [Urban Location].
entities.name: Construction Center

desc: Building construction has become more sophisticated over time, incorporating methods and techniques from a wide range of disciplines, commonly considered a type of engineering.
entities.name: Architectural Engineering

desc: The standardization of plank and brick production using more modern techniques aims to enable easier construction.
entities.name: Standardized Planks and Bricks

desc: The writing of architectural treatises, which often compile centuries-old knowledge, allows for faster learning and dissemination of effective construction techniques.
entities.name: Architectural Treatises

desc: Freemasons rely on broader associations, known as guilds, to share and preserve their knowledge and experience in a system where veteran masons teach younger apprentices.
entities.name: Mason Guilds

desc: The development of more advanced metallurgy of wrought and cast iron allows for more elaborate metallic structures, such as pillars and columns, which makes building construction much faster.
entities.name: Cast Iron Structures

desc: Our construction efforts should never rest and leave our villages and towns idle. Employing a master mason, who will oversee and plan our construction work, we can make significant improvements in expanding our country.
entities.name: Master Masons

desc: The extensive reach of Islam has brought Muslim countries in contact with many different foreign lands. Maintaining a rich network of international contacts such as ours is always beneficial for diplomacy.
entities.name: Contacts Network

desc: While the New World colonies had to import a lot of manufactured products, they also became a major supplier of raw materials for markets in Europe.
entities.name: Continental Trade

desc: Missionary efforts to carry our faith to the far corners of the world can never be considered finished. We need to sponsor more missions to further bring the light of Catholicism to these unilluminated souls.
entities.name: Missionary Works

desc: Any and all trade from India and Africa must pass through the strait called Gate of Grief. Let us enforce our dominion over this maritime chokepoint and turn every passing ship into an opportunity.
entities.name: Red Sea Control

desc: The narrow Inner Strait of Malacca is the backbone of our maritime commerce. By controlling this vital strait, we channel the wealth of nations into our harbors and establish ourselves as the unrivaled gatekeepers of the east-west trade.
entities.name: Control the Malacca Strait

desc: Those who have done wrong will fall to their knees under the heavy weight of their own wickedness! Their evil deeds shall haunt them forevermore, and they will not sleep until they have atoned for the devious nightmares they themselves have caused.
entities.name: Conviction of Sin

desc: Wood may be the ideal material for shipbuilding, but it tends to deteriorate over time. By fitting our ships with copper sheathing below the waterline we can reduce this deterioration, allowing them to better withstand long journeys.
entities.name: Copper Bottoms

desc: Our artisans have begun to craft tools out of Copper, a precious metal found throughout our territory. If we were to master this art, it would give us a tremendous advantage over our neighbors.
entities.name: Copperworking

desc: We will formalize the ''Capituli'' — written agreements between the central Crown and the rugged mountain communes of the interior. These charters will grant the highlanders specific tax exemptions and the right to local self-governance in exchange for their perpetual military service and loyalty. This is a masterstroke of internal diplomacy that will trade royal authority for absolute loyalty, ensuring that the most difficult terrain on the island is held by a motivated, state-aligned citizenry rather than rebellious feudal lords.
entities.name: Capituli de Corsica

desc: For decades, Corsicans have been seeking service as elite guards for the Papacy and the kings of France, among others, earning a reputation for unyielding loyalty and ferocity. We will leverage this by incentivizing these veterans to return and train the local militias. This will create a culture of the 'Professional Returnee', where the nation's defense is led by men who have mastered the latest European tactics. This influx of expertise will turn a nation of irregular mountain skirmishers into a disciplined, modern infantry force.
entities.name: The Guardia Corsa

desc: Under our ruler, Corsica will adopt the world's first modern written constitution, which will grant universal suffrage to all property owners. This will foster a culture of 'Enlightened Citizenship', where the Corsican people view themselves as the vanguard of European liberty. This political maturity will allow the state to establish powerful national institutions. The Corsican Constitution will become a 'Beacon of Liberty', influencing revolutions to come and providing the people with a sense of immense pride and historical purpose that will transcend our geographical size.
entities.name: The Corsican Constitution

desc: Under our direction, the Corsican clans are formalizing their traditional levies into a structured 'Militia of the Kingdom' as a result of pressure coming from our enemy's maneuvers. This will require a cultural shift from clan-based skirmishing to a national military duty. Every parish will be required to maintain a standardized armory and conduct regular drills. This 'Nationalization of the Sword' will ensure that the island possesses a standing army of citizens who are personally invested in the defense of their homes. It will bridge the ancient gap between the north and south, creating a unified military identity that will be the precursor to modern national statehood.
entities.name: The Milizia di u Riamu

desc: The Kingdom has traditionally been divided into ''Pievi'', traditional districts centered around a mother church. These were not just religious units but the primary nodes of civil administration. The state has utilized the ''Pievani'' (parish priests) as royal registrars and judges, creating a highly localized and efficient tax-collection network. This ensures that the Kingdom can mobilize resources from even the most remote mountain hamlets, turning the rugged geography into a structured administrative grid.
entities.name: The Pievi

desc: To reduce dependency on foreign-educated officials, the Kingdom will establish its first secular gymnasiums and colleges. This will foster a home-grown class of state jurists who are experts in the specific geography and common law of our land. This intellectual boom will be the cradle of the Corsican Enlightenment, producing a generation of administrators who prioritize rational governance and the 'Rights of the People' over ancient clan traditions, preparing the state for modern constitutionalism.
entities.name: U Ginnasiu Corsu

desc: Developments in bottle manufacturing have allowed wine producers to create bottles in standardized sizes, and as a result, they have been able to reintroduce the use of cork bottlestoppers. This is a much more efficient way to seal in the wine than with cloth stoppers, and means that it can now be transported much farther away than was previously possible. Perhaps we are now seeing the birth of a worldwide Wine trade..,
entities.name: Cork Stoppers

desc: This legislation establishes the kingdom as an indivisible, collective entity, owned not by any single dynasty or monarch but by the entire noble class. Rulers serve the realm, they do not ''own'' it. This concept of collectivity is deeply entrenched in our society.
entities.name: Corona Regni Poloniae

desc: Traditional armies relied on furious discipline to maintain order in the ranks. By appealing to unit pride, however, we can reach even higher levels of discipline.

mods.label: Movement Time when Attached to Another Unit

entities.name: Esprit de Corps

desc: New tactics have developed, making for more flexible and coordinated infantry, cavalry, and artillery units on the battlefield, usually grouped as brigades.
entities.name: Flexible Battle Formations

desc: As our professional armies grow, the commissioned officers that lead them are commanding increasingly bigger formations. To assist them, we will create the rank of lieutenant. These officers take charge of transmitting orders from command, and also lead smaller units on the battlefield.
entities.name: Lieutenants

desc: Professional armies have made it possible to create a new type of unit, the regiment, which not only is a permanent position for soldiers, but also a useful battle formation.
entities.name: Regimental Organization

desc: The development of professional armies has led to the appointment of permanent command positions, offices granted by direct commission from the ruler.
entities.name: Commissioned Officers

desc: The growth of armies and their deployment in longer campaigns has created a need to assign designated officers to planning and logistics, focused on effectively coordinating the different corps on the battlefield.
entities.name: General Staff

desc: During the long years of foreign military pressure, the Corsican oral tradition of ''Chjam'è Rispondi'' (Call and Response) evolved into a sophisticated tool of social cohesion. This improvised poetic competition allowed the people to debate politics, honor their fallen heroes, and mock their occupiers through coded metaphors in the town squares. This all has ensured that the principles of the Enlightenment and the memories of the Revolution remain accessible to even the illiterate segments of society. By encouraging this we will create a unified cultural narrative that is immune to censorship, ensuring that the flame of Corsican identity remains burning bright through every situation.
entities.name: Chjam'è Rispondi

desc: The Corsican culture of oral poetry, specifically the ''Lamentu'' (''Lamento'' in standard Italian: mourning songs) and ''Voceru'' (''Vocero'' in standard Italian: songs of vengeance), has become the primary vehicle for preserving national memory. These songs act as a living archive of the people's struggles and the names of their martyrs. Culturally, this ensures that the spirit of resistance is ingrained in every child from birth, making it impossible for an occupier to 're-educate' or assimilate the population. This oral tradition functions as a powerful psychological weapon, maintaining a state of perpetual high morale and cultural defiance even during the darkest periods of foreign military occupation.
entities.name: Lamentu and Voceru

desc: Past Genoese occupation heavily promoted the cultivation of the chestnut tree, particularly in the central highlands. This has created a unique culture around the chestnut that provides the population with a reliable, low-labor food source that is immune to the grain-price fluctuations of the Mediterranean market. This gives the Corsicans incredible strategic autonomy; they can retreat into the mountains and subsist indefinitely on chestnut flour, making them immune to the standard naval blockades and 'siege by starvation' tactics employed in the past by the Genoese maritime fleets.
entities.name: The Castagniccia

desc: A wave of Baroque church construction has hit the island, funded by the wealth of returning mercenaries and merchants. These churches are characterized by an 'Austere Grandeur', reflecting the rugged and pious nature of the people. Culturally, this is a display of civilizational defiance — a statement to our neighbors that Corsica is a wealthy, cultured society capable of producing grand monuments. These churches will serve as the primary nodes of social cohesion, where the community gathers to celebrate their distinct identity through choral polyphony and theatrical religious ritual.
entities.name: Corsican Baroque

desc: The Corsican interior, dominated by the dense, aromatic evergreen shrubland known as the ''Machja'' (''Macchia'' in standard Italian: the Scrubland), has become the central pillar of the people's survival strategy. Rather than fighting superior maritime invaders on the vulnerable coasts, the population has developed a culture of 'Strategic Retreat' into the impenetrable granite mountains. This has created a society of highlanders who are masters of concealment and rapid movement through vertical terrain. This cultural adaptation has turned the island's geography into a living fortress for our culture, where the people can preserve their laws and customs indefinitely, safe from the naval reach of any invader.
entities.name: The Machja

desc: As past occupiers of our island attempted to impose a rigid legal framework, the Corsican people responded by strengthening their own traditional justice system based on the Vendetta. While viewed as lawlessness by outsiders, this is a sophisticated social mechanism of honor and self-regulation. It creates a culture where the individual is responsible for his own protection and that of his kin, leading to a populace that is universally armed and tactically proficient. This 'Culture of the Long Memory' means that any offense is met with a generational blood-feud. In a national context, this means making the cost of occupation by foreign troops prohibitively expensive in both coin and lives.
entities.name: The Vindetta

desc: People from all over admire the beauty and sophistication of our Muslim court. We have therefore become an appealing destination for talented luminaries of all kinds, which only adds to our overall court vibrancy and prestige.
entities.name: Cosmopolitan Court

desc: By granting our Cossack leaders dual roles as both generals and administrators, we will be able to streamline army recruitment, and ensure a high training standard.
entities.name: Cossack Administration

desc: Our Cossacks live in a near-permanent state of war, and have adopted pillaging and raiding tactics similar to those of the Mongol hordes. Although that will surely not earn us many friends, it will decidedly enrich our coffers.
entities.name: Cossack Raids

desc: Our Cossacks have already built for themselves a reputation of fierce warriors. That in itself is enough to instill fear in the hearts of our enemies when they have to face them in battle.
entities.name: Fearsome Reputation

desc: Our Cossacks are already used to roaming freely and going beyond our borders. We can use them to advance further settlement, and thus expand our influence to those unclaimed lands.
entities.name: Cossack Colonization

desc: Many Cossacks were born into serfdom. Tired of feudal oppression, they fled their masters, and sought lives of freedom on the steppes. We must continue to welcome these escaped serfs into our society.
entities.name: Escaped Serfs

desc: Our Cossacks live at the edges of our country, making them excellent candidates to serve as explorers and go beyond our borders to the final frontier, to explore strange new lands, to seek out new countries and new civilizations, to boldly go where no one has gone before...
entities.name: Cossack Exploration

desc: There are no kings or khans among the Cossacks. They are led by the ''ataman'', who is their highest military commander, but in matters of state and society simply the first among equals. Political power lies in the Rada, the legislative and military assembly, in which all Cossacks can have their say.
entities.name: Cossack Hetmanate

desc: There is almost no division between civil and military society among the Cossacks. They are a host, defined by their people rather than by the land they control, and their people are warriors. We must ensure that military divisions properly meet our administrative needs as the host expands.
entities.name: Military Society

desc: The Cossacks are fearsome warriors, and their skill in surviving in the unforgiving wilderness of the steppes is almost unmatched. There is a place for them in our state as well as our military, as an elite force that will enforce our lordship over the steppes.
entities.name: Cossack Recruitment

desc: As the ranks of our Cossacks swell, we must keep account of the strength of each regiment, their numbers, and how well they are supplied. A centralized registry will allow us to support the needs of all Cossacks.
entities.name: Cossack Registers

desc: No man should suffer tyranny among the Cossacks. When we conquer new territories, the serfs, peasants, and slaves there will be treated as equals to our own people.
entities.name: Cossack Serf Autonomy

desc: Any form of local governance needs a proper place for its gatherings and adequate function. A building of sufficient size and equipment and with a big enough debating chamber are crucial.
entities.name: Council Hall

desc: Our tribal government ensures that everyone in it has a voice and an equal say in crucial decisions. This collaborative administration encourages us to consider new perspectives.
entities.name: Council of Elders

desc: Our country has a long-standing history of accepting destitute, persecuted Jewish people. To that end, a council that will look after their needs and advocate for their rights will benefit the stability and spiritual strength of this realm.
entities.name: Council of Three Lands

desc: We cannot expect to perform well in either the diplomatic or military spheres if our secrets can easily be leaked to any foreign country. We must keep stronger control over how our information flows to quickly plug any possible leakage.
entities.name: Restricted Information Access

desc: It is well known that our activities attract unwelcome attention. If we wish to keep our plans hidden from these curious gazes, we should encrypt our communications.
entities.name: Secret Codes

desc: The Counting House is an office which keeps track of the financial books of the businesses of the town. Appointments and correspondences related to businesses related to payments are handled as well.
entities.name: Counting House

desc: Now that we know who owns what, the logical follow-up is to get a clearer idea of who lives where. This will tell us where to look when we need fresh recruits for our armies.
entities.name: Counting the People

desc: The earlier we start integrating the administration of our subjects to follow the rules of our own, the easier the integration of other matters will be. Creating a permanent liaison with our subjects will make this process significantly smoother.
entities.name: Subject Supervision

desc: The court is the symbol of our country, and its prosperity shall represent that of the nation. However, this does not mean that the court can spend more than the country can sustain; there should be proper accounting for what is spent at court.
entities.name: Court Accounting

desc: Dante Alighieri spent years of his exile walking our streets, and his presence drew others — poets, scholars, and master builders who found in Verona's Roman ruins and abundant stone a city still worth adding to. We extend this tradition of welcome into deliberate policy, offering patronage to displaced talent and drawing the finest craftsmen to the ancient workshops of the ''Marmorina'', where the stone-cutting skills of generations meet the fresh techniques that newcomers bring from across Italy. This reputation for hospitality draws artists of unusual quality and gives our ambitious construction projects a depth of skilled labor that rivals who must import both talent and stone cannot easily match.
entities.name: Court of Great Refugees

desc: A preoccupied noble is a well-behaved noble. There are so many courtly titles in our realms that some say half of our men have one. Let us make sure our courtiers spend their time competing with one another for attention and visibility; they will be too busy to plot against our rule.
entities.name: Courtly Competition

desc: Monasticism in Christianity was born in Egypt, when the Christian faithful retreated to the desert to pray and dedicate their lives to God. Miaphysitism can therefore claim this history as their own through the Alexandrine tradition.
entities.name: Cradle of Monasticism

desc: To ensure consistent recruitment and sufficient supply of fighters, we must establish a formal regimental system. This reform will allow us to organize manpower more effectively, centralize command structures, and reduce dependence on local nobles and foreign mercenaries.
entities.name: Create the Regimental System

desc: Crimean elites mimicked aspects of Ottoman military-administrative practices, blending Turkic and Muslim systems to manage manpower and military efficiency.
entities.name: The Devshirme of the Steppes

desc: We place no restrictions on pastoral farmers for the grazing of their great herds of horses and cattle. Herders are free to go about their business as they wish, able to traverse the steppe safely and trade freely.
entities.name: Free Cattle Grazing

desc: Our forefathers rode with Genghis Khān as he ravaged the known world. We have kept our military traditions alive, and continued to be ruled by Khāns who claim descent from the Genghisid line.
entities.name: Genghisid Legacy

desc: There is a fortune to be made from the Slaves trade; unwitting Christian believers who fall into our grasp fetch a high price in Turkish, Arabian, and Italian markets.
entities.name: Slavers of the Steppe

desc: Crimean cavalry commanders have mastered the art of mobility in steppes warfare, using speed, flanking, and ambush to outmatch slower European armies.
entities.name: Steppe Commanders

desc: Our cultural identity has been forged in the fire of the 'Century of Martyrs'. We have embraced the role of the ''Antemurale Christianitatis'' (Shield of Christendom), transforming our military struggle into a sacred religious mission. This mythos instills a deep, unshakable sense of historical duty in the population, viewing the defense of our nation as the defense of civilization itself. This 'Heroic Spirit' ensures that the national fire remains alive even in our darkest hours.

mods.label: Damage Done versus Heathens in Battle

entities.name: Antemurale Christianitatis

desc: Our culture has embraced a dramatic and intense Baroque Catholicism, characterized by massive religious processions and the construction of grand, ornate churches. This 'Visual Piety' serves as a powerful unifying force, bridging the gap between the urban nobility and the rural peasantry through shared ritual and spectacle. This intense religious identity acts as a cultural shield against both Protestant and Eastern influences, ensuring that the Croatian soul remains firmly anchored in the Catholic-Mediterranean world, even while defending the central European plains.
entities.name: The Baroque Pietas

desc: The coastal cities have become vibrant centers of the Renaissance, where scholars and artists blend classical Italian influences with a distinct Slavic sensibility. This intellectual movement produces great thinkers who contribute to European science, poetry, and philosophy, proving that Croatian culture is at the forefront of the modern era. The patronage of wealthy merchant families allows for the construction of magnificent cathedrals and palaces, turning our coast into a beacon of high culture that attracts the finest minds of the age.
entities.name: Influx of Foreign Knowledge

desc: We look back to the glorious age of our native kings, such as Tomislav and Zvonimir, to inspire a sense of independent destiny and national pride. By tracing our lineage and institutions back to these sovereign rulers, we bolster our diplomatic standing among the courts of Europe and assert our right to a crown that is older than many of our neighbors'. This historical prestige commands respect from the Holy See and serves as a powerful unifying mythos that rallies the disparate regions of the kingdom under a single, storied banner of Romanic-Slavic royalty.
entities.name: Legacy of the Trpimirović

desc: This legal bedrock formalized the union between the Twelve Noble Tribes of Croatia and the Hungarian Crown. By preserving the right to elect the monarch and maintaining a separate coronation with the Zvonimir Crown, we ensure Croatia remains a distinct political entity in the case of falling in Union with other nations. This contractual sovereignty prevents total absorption into a foreign administration, allowing our nobility to manage internal justice and defense under their own ancient laws.
entities.name: The Pacta Conventa

desc: The state must harness the ferocity of the frontier without succumbing to its chaos. The Pandurs — once mere night watchmen and local security — are reorganized by charismatic leaders into a professionalized light infantry. These soldiers are a terrifying sight on the European battlefield, accompanied by their own bands of martial music. They are the masters of skirmishes, specializing in raiding supply lines, screening the main army, and psychological warfare. While their discipline remains erratic and their propensity for plunder high, they provide a ruler with a flexible tool of intimidation that conventional line infantry cannot match.
entities.name: Pandurs

desc: To counter the advance of our enemies, we have transformed our coastal fortresses into a sanctuary for the Uskoks — refugee warriors who wage a permanent war. These light-infantry units use small, fast boats to conduct lightning raids against enemy supply lines, surviving in the rugged karst where regular armies cannot follow. This policy turns our coast into a lethal 'no-man's-land' for our enemies, providing us with a cheap and fiercely motivated frontier guard that requires no support from the central treasury and keeps our enemies constantly on the defensive.
entities.name: The Lessons from the Uskoks

desc: We have asserted the right of ''Monetaria'', establishing a sovereign mint to produce the Banovac silver denar. By maintaining a higher silver content than neighboring currencies, our coin has become the primary medium of exchange in the northern Adriatic and the Drava basin. This fiscal independence allows us to fund its administration without relying on external subsidies, turning our court into a regional financial hub that attracts Ragusan and Venetian capital.
entities.name: The Banovac Silver Denar

desc: The cultural soul of Croatia is anchored in the 'Zvonimir tradition', where our history is carved in stone. We have promoted the memory of our independent kings through epic poetry and historical chronicles, instilling a 'Royal Consciousness' in every peasant and noble. This historical pride ensures that even when ruled by foreign kings, the Croatians view themselves as part of an ancient and sovereign nation, fostering a resilience that ensures our culture remains vibrant and resistant to external cultural decay.
entities.name: The Baška Tablet

desc: We have established one of the earliest and most daring printing houses in the Slavic world. By moving our technological heart to the 'impassable' valley of Kosinj, we ensure that the production of our sacred Glagolitic texts remains shielded from the maritime raids and border skirmishes that plague the littoral. This press is not merely a tool for literacy; it is a laboratory of cultural survival where we forge the first printed missals in our native tongue. By standardizing our ancient script through the modern press, we provide every parish in the Kingdom with a unified, incorruptible source of our laws and liturgy. This ensures that the Croatian identity remains intellectually fortified and spiritually independent, as it reaches the hands of every shepherd and noble, anchoring the soul of the nation in an unshakeable, home-grown tradition.
entities.name: The Croatian Press

desc: Founded by the invited Jesuit Order, this academy has evolved from a local gymnasium into the intellectual heart of our nation. By establishing a rigorous curriculum of Aristotelian philosophy, mathematics, and rhetoric, the academy has created a home-grown elite of 'Enlightened Croats' who are as comfortable in the salons of Vienna as they are in the Sabor. This institutional modernization ensures that our bureaucracy is led by a technocratic class capable of navigating the complex legal and scientific shifts of our century.
entities.name: The Jesuit Academy

desc: To combat the sudden amphibious raids of enemy fleets or border transgressions, we will establish a sophisticated visual system using smoke and fire signals atop the highest Velebit crags. This 'Mountain Watch' will allow our forts to communicate across the jagged terrain in minutes, bypassing the slow mountain trails. By coordinating these signals with the inland garrisons, we will be able to mobilize our nation and reinforce our walls before any action happens. This high-altitude surveillance will turn the impassable peaks into a centralized command tower, ensuring that no enemy can approach without our immediate knowledge.
entities.name: The National Garrison System

desc: We have established the ''Consilium Regium'' in our capital, creating a dedicated executive government for the Croatian Nation. This body will act as a proto-ministry, handling the economy, education, and internal security of the ''Triune Kingdom''. This era of 'Government by Council' will foster a professional class of Croatian civil servants who view the state as a rational, modern machine rather than a collection of feudal privileges. The experience gained in these halls of power will provide the administrative expertise necessary for the Croatian people to navigate the transition from a medieval kingdom to a modern European nation-state.
entities.name: The Royal Council of Croatia

desc: The cultural soul of Croatia has reached a literary peak with works like ''Judita'' by Marko Marulić, the 'Father of Croatian Literature'. By using biblical allegory to describe the contemporary defense of our lands, Marulić has provided the nation with a high-culture blueprint for survival. This literature creates a bridge between the Renaissance urbanite and the frontier soldier, unifying all classes under a shared heroic mission and ensuring the preservation of the Croatian tongue as a language of high art and theological debate.
entities.name: The Marulić Epic Tradition

desc: To break the isolation of our coast, we will oversee the monumental construction of numerous roads, linking the inland to our ports. This engineered highway will be carved through the limestone heart of the Velebit mountains, featuring advanced stone bridges and serpentine curves to accommodate heavy wagons. The road will transform our littoral from a desolate frontier into a vital economic artery, allowing the timber and grain of the interior to reach international markets. By physically binding the mountain hinterland to the Adriatic, we will complete the territorial integration of the nation, fostering a new age of trans-Velebit commerce.
entities.name: Uniting the Coast and the Inner Lands

desc: During these convulsed years, the world has taken notice of the distinct, elite light-cavalry regiments from the Croatian Military. Beyond their legendary mobility and ferocity, these horsemen have introduced a unique sartorial innovation: a functional, knotted cloth worn around the neck to secure their shirt collars and provide protection from the chafing of breastplates. This ''cravat'' — a name derived from the French mispronunciation of ''Croate'' — has rapidly transcended the battlefield to become the height of Parisian and European fashion. By transforming a rugged military necessity into a hallmark of fashionable dressing, our culture has achieved a subtle but permanent victory. This sartorial dominance ensures that the image of the Croatian officer is one of both tactical lethality and unparalleled gallantry.
entities.name: The Cravats

desc: Our culture is defined by the unique privilege of the Glagolitic liturgy — the only place in the Catholic world where the Mass is sung in the native Slavic tongue. This tradition bridges the gap between the Latin cities and the Slavic heartland, creating a unified cultural identity. By preserving this ancient script, our people maintain a secret cultural language that reinforces their distinctiveness, providing a sense of national pride that resists assimilation by both the Italian and Germanic cultural spheres.
entities.name: The Glagolitic Lithurgy

desc: Over the last few years, our nation has witnessed the explosion of the ''Illyrian Movement'', a cultural and political revolution that seeks to unify all Croats under a single banner. This movement effectively aims to unify the disparate regions of our nation into a single, cohesive political and cultural national body. By standardizing the grammar and orthography, we will transform our medieval nation into a modern one, ensuring that the Croatian name, language, and statehood will never again be forgotten or suppressed.
entities.name: The Illyrian Movement

desc: The crushing weight of feudal obligations in the face of constant war caused peasant revolts in the past. The peasantry rose not against us, but against the 'unjust' nobility who failed to protect them while demanding excessive tithes. Though these revolts have been usually brutally suppressed, they have left a lasting legacy of social consciousness and have transformed the relationship between the classes, forcing the state to eventually moderate its tax demands to maintain internal stability.
entities.name: The Peasants' Revolts

desc: Our caravanserais support the flow of commerce, information, and people from China to Europe across our lands. This proximity to important trade routes has unleashed a flood of affluence throughout our nation.
entities.name: Crossroads of Commerce

desc: Hinduism, Buddhism, Islam, and even Tengrism are religions that have expanded into parts of the world very far from their places of origin. Asia has witnessed this exchange of beliefs for centuries, and in many cases the blending and syncretism that has happened among them.
entities.name: Crossroads of Religions

desc: As our ruler's authority becomes the dominant power in our domain, it highlights the need for a comprehensive government structure, as well as a proper bureaucratic corpus to manage it.
entities.name: Statecraft

desc: While our ruler has a firm grasp over matters mundane, it is becoming a necessity that they also take control of heavenly concerns. Church and state must become one.
entities.name: 'Cuius Regio, Eius Religio'

desc: Traditional governance required rulers to negotiate with estates and balance competing powers. Modern theories of government, however, establish the ruler as supreme authority within the realm — above all other institutions, estates, and subjects, while bowing to no earthly power.
entities.name: Sovereignty

desc: After unifying all the powers under the iron fist of our leader, subjects across the nation have suddenly become aware of a sense of belonging. Whatever region our monarchs rule, they are part of the nation and its people all the same.
entities.name: Nation

desc: The position of the Crown is not only reinforced by their privileges, but also by our laws.
entities.name: Rights of the Crown

desc: The fierce Cretan mountain dwellers have been integrated into a professional light cavalry corps, blending Western discipline with the hit-and-run tactics of the Balkan frontier. We have established permanent training grounds where the sons of the local nobility and the Latin settlers learn the art of the ''Saber and Carbine'' to protect the island's interior. These units are now exported as elite mercenaries to many states, providing a steady stream of military prestige and revenue.
entities.name: Academy of the Stratioti

desc: The constant threat of external invasion and internal revolt led the Latin Kings of Candia to abandon the strict segregation of the early conquest. We have established a 'Great Council' where the ancient Venetian-descended nobility sits alongside the ''Archontes'' (the Greek Orthodox landowning elite). This shared governance allows for a unified administrative front, where the military traditions of the West are funded by the deep roots of the local Greek bureaucracy, ensuring the island remains a stable and indigestible bastion for any would-be conqueror.
entities.name: The Council of the Two Peoples

desc: As new threats loom larger, the engineers of the nation have transformed the entire island into a maritime bastion of the ''Trace Italienne'' style. By reinforcing the walls of Candia, Rethymno, and Chania with earthworks capable of absorbing heavy cannon fire, we ensure that every siege becomes a multi-decade ordeal for the invader. This infrastructure allows a small garrison to hold out indefinitely against a numerically superior foe while awaiting relief from the sea.
entities.name: The Cretan Labyrinth of Fortifications

desc: By standardizing the parts used in the construction of light galleys at Suda Bay, we have pioneered an early form of modular shipbuilding. This allows us to replace lost vessels at a fraction of the time and cost of other Mediterranean powers. A ship built in Candia is recognized for its speed and its ability to navigate the treacherous currents of the Cretan Sea.
entities.name: The Galley Assembly Line of Suda

desc: The sun-drenched slopes of Mount Ida produce the famed Malvasia grape, which has become the most coveted dessert wine in the royal courts of Northern Europe. By strictly regulating the quality and the ''Seal of Saint Mark'' on every barrel exported, we have created a high-value trade monopoly that funds our naval defense. This liquid gold ensures that even as a colony, Candia remains the most profitable jewel in the Venetian maritime empire.
entities.name: The Malvasia Wine Export

desc: We have expanded the cultivation of sugarcane in the fertile Messara plain, building advanced water-powered mills (Trapete) for refining. Cretan sugar is now a luxury sought after by the courts of Europe, competing directly with the products of the Levant. This industrial-scale agriculture provides the crown with the gold needed to fund its naval supremacy.
entities.name: The Trapete of Messara

desc: Knights of our Order were present in the wars against Saladin and defended the last Outremer Crusader outpost, Acre. If any among us needs inspiration to do heroic deeds, they need to look only at what the Knights of the Order of the Hospital of St. John have accomplished in the past. The name Knights Hospitaller is truly eternal, as is our famed courage in battle.
entities.name: Crusader Tradition

desc: In this country, we have a long tradition of sending our finest knights and aristocrats to spread the true faith to heathens in the Baltic and Mediterranean regions. We will fulfill our Christian mission by bringing the faith to the unenlightened, while also acquiring experienced commanders for our armies.
entities.name: Baltic Crusades Experience

desc: Local barons still exert a large degree of power over the Neapolitan countryside. If we wish to continue centralizing our kingdom, we must crush the power of these barons, or risk them conspiring against us.
entities.name: Crushed Power of the Barons

desc: Our home province Tosa has always been divided between powerful clans. If we wish to expand our holdings, we must join forces with these other clans — they will help us rise up, and in return we will increase their power.
entities.name: Clans of Tosa

desc: Japan is a nation of islands, and as a result, a strong navy is an absolute necessity. Tosa is an ideal place to begin building an armada of our own.
entities.name: Expand the Navy

desc: The ancestral founder of our clan, Hata no Kawakatsu, was highly admired as the patron god of all art, from traditional dances to theater. Our clan must live up to his legacy if we are to earn the respect we deserve.
entities.name: God of the Arts

desc: Shikoku is seen as a poor, isolated land by the rest of Japan, where nothing of importance happens. Let them continue thinking that and overlook our unification of the island until it is too late.
entities.name: Unification of Shikoku

desc: It is time for our trade factories to reach beyond the mythical pillars of Hercules. Combining ancient colonization knowledge with modern discoveries allows us to settle more efficiently than other younger nations, those who are fairly new to this experience. Carthaginian colonies shall soon be found all around the world!
entities.name: Beyond the Pillars

desc: Centuries ago, our advances in irrigation and olive cultivation earned Carthage the nickname of 'the breadbasket of Rome.' We will now consult our ancient agricultural knowledge, and once again do battle with the desert to plant our olive groves, just like in antiquity.
entities.name: Breadbasket of Rome

desc: The ancient Carthaginian ''cothon'' was a technological marvel that helped facilitate efficient ship construction. Now, this great legacy will serve as a blueprint for our whole country. Studying ancient shipbuilding techniques allows us to excel in this area once again, and the Carthaginian navy will soon dominate the Mediterranean.
entities.name: Cothon

desc: Hannon the Sailor was a legendary ancient explorer who ventured far into the south of the African coast. We shall follow his example, and mount exploration voyages in order to restore our lost trading empire. This time, we will push our expeditions even further, seeking out fresh trading opportunities across the entire world.
entities.name: Legacy of Hannon

desc: Our ancestral empire did not have a massive population, so for centuries, we relied on mercenaries during war. Since the reformation of Carthage we have continued that tradition to save our population from dangers of the battlefield.
entities.name: Army of Mercenaries

desc: Phoenician trade fleets traveled through the Mediterranean for centuries. This economic legacy means that we are more efficient — and ruthless — when it comes to trade. We shall once again preside over the ebb and flow of goods!
entities.name: Merchant Legacy

desc: After restoring our ancient kingdom, we started reaching out to our Phoenician brothers in Libya. As a result, we have a steady influx of volunteers that want to join the restoration of the ancient Phoenician kingdom of Carthage. It seems we can maintain a much bigger navy now...
entities.name: Phoenician Sailors

desc: For centuries, our nation dominated the Mediterranean trade. Now, with all the new discoveries made in the centuries since, we stand poised to dominate the globe. Soon, there will be a Carthaginian trading vessel in every port in this world!
entities.name: Punic Global Trade

desc: Our ancient kingdom was headed by an elected head of state called the ''Šūfeṭ''. In this new modern age, we shall reorganize our government, taking experience from antiquity and combining it with modern theories to create a powerful Republican system, one that will outshine every Republic created up to this date!
entities.name: Rule of Šūfeṭ

desc: In ancient times, we created a Wine trading pipeline by producing large amounts of low-quality Wine to trade, and importing the good stuff for ourselves. Building on that tradition, we are looking into expanding our Wine production capabilities — we ''will'' dominate the Wine trade in the Mediterranean!
entities.name: Punic Wine Trade

desc: The jungle is a harsh environment in which to live, especially for farming cultures. Clearing portions of the jungle to create arable land is therefore one of our most vital tasks. We must organize our people in such a way that we can employ large labor forces to carry out these works whenever the need arises.
entities.name: Cultivate the Land

desc: It is apparent that as we absorb other peoples into our nation, the foreign traditions they bring with them may cause friction with our own. One way of resolving this is to simply tolerate such foreigners as if they were our own kinsmen, and not to attempt to subdue them to our culture.
entities.name: Cultural Acceptance

desc: Asia is a highly diverse region, home to a wide variety of cultures. This diversity, and the cultural exchange and blended influences that result from it, has empowered our countries and allowed them to flourish in every domain from architecture to music to horticulture, and beyond.
entities.name: Cultural Melting Pot

desc: Different cultures have different customs, and for some reason, they tend to resist attempts from their rulers to change said customs. We can turn this weakness into a strength by incorporating local leaders into our system of government and having them carry out our will in a way that will be palatable to their people.
entities.name: Cultural Ties

desc: Ancient tradition is the foundation of many cultures and civilizations. While progress is what will drive us to greatness, our traditions will always serve us as the reminder of our origins, and as a source for the strength and unity of our people.
entities.name: Cultural Traditions

desc: A country's expansion will inevitably result in it bringing other cultures into its fold. Thus, if we want to further expand our borders, we need to be prepared to become more multicultural.
entities.name: Multicultural Ambitions

desc: Under the visionary leadership of our rulers, we will achieve the geopolitical impossible: the unification of all Romanian lands under a single banner. This 'Great Idea' will ignite a latent national consciousness that will transcend ancient feudal borders, proving to the world that a unified ''Dacia'' can stand as a European Great Power in its own right. This vision will set the legal, military, and symbolic precedents that will provide us with a permanent, historical claim to regional hegemony and the eventual gathering of all Romanians.
entities.name: Cunning Diplomacy

desc: Using a cylinder-shaped furnace, this method provides a cheap and efficient process of smelting iron, with the unique ability of continuous smelting.
entities.name: Cupola Smelting

desc: In the sprawling patchwork of our great empire, cooperation and collaboration between neighboring groups is vital to the health of our economy. We shall join the customs union of the Rhine and adopt their ''gulden'' coins to make business transactions less complicated for our merchants, and streamline our international diplomacy.
entities.name: Rheinischer Münzverein

desc: Our realm is home to a lively market, with many merchants importing fascinating goods from far-away lands. The regulation of such goods and the control of this flow, falls under the jurisdiction of the Customs House.
entities.name: Customs House

desc: Two Byzantine theologians from the 9th century, these men were instrumental to the evangelization of the Slavs. They are credited for developing the Glagolitic alphabet, the first one to ever be used to transcribe Church Slavonic, and their followers later developed the Cyrillic alphabet, naming it after Cyril in his honor.
entities.name: Cyril and Methodius

desc: Our ancient legends state that our royal line is descended from the union of a princess and a panther. This ancient and mystical tale will enhance our prestige and fame.
entities.name: Children of the Panther

desc: Building a sprawling palace complex in our capital would be an elegant, yet imposing demonstration of our power. Any who may consider taking up arms against us will surely be deterred by the sight of our sumptuous palaces.
entities.name: Palaces of Abomey

desc: By secretly placing male courtiers disguised as royal wives in the harem, they will be able to act unseen as the king's eyes and ears, especially in matters of palace intrigue.
entities.name: Lagredis

desc: The Migan and the Mehu are the ruler's two chief ministers. One oversees the north, the other the south; one oversees justice, the other commerce. Together, they bring stability and prosperity.
entities.name: Migan and Mehu

desc: While raiding the surrounding territories, we obtain slaves who cannot only be employed economically or bartered to our neighbors, but who can serve in our armies. In this way, we will increase the number of fighters that can be called to arms.
entities.name: Slave Hunts

desc: As more and more foreigners are coming to our shores, we should establish a new office in our government to study and learn from their ways, so that we may benefit from this exchange of cultures.
entities.name: The Yovogan

desc: A corp of female warriors, recruited from among the king's wives. They have earned their reputation as mythological Amazons due to their ferocity in battle and the fear they strike in the ranks of their opponents. These Dahomey Amazons are entirely devoted to Dahomey and its interests.
entities.name: Dahomey Amazons

desc: The Ca Trù is a Vietnamese genre of musical storytelling which serves both entertainment and religious purposes.
entities.name: Ca Trù

desc: Our state bureaucracy is obviously of the utmost importance, and as such, we select only the most capable administrators to hold government office. Learned in the Confucian texts of China, these bureaucrats ensure smooth and stable bureaucratic operations.
entities.name: Confucian Administration

desc: The Đôn Điên is a system which utilizes military colonies, in which soldiers and landless peasants clear the area for the establishment of new villages. These villages are then incorporated into our administrative system after three years, and the people who cleared the land may then claim and work it.
entities.name: Đôn Điên

desc: The Giao Chỉ Arquebus is a staple of our military. Self-produced and adapted to the specific needs of our troops, this type of arquebus gains praise from not only Chinese people, but also Western observers.
entities.name: Giao Chỉ Arquebus

desc: Trần Hưng Đạo was an Imperial Prince of Đại Việt long ago. He served as officer during the first Mongol invasion of Đại Việt in 1258, and as leading commander during the second war against the Mongols in 1285 and their third attempt in 1287. During these bloody conflicts, Trần Hưng Đạo managed to develop tactics which reliably repelled the oncoming onslaught of cavalry.
entities.name: Trần Hưng Đạo Tactics

desc: The Vietnamese countryside is built upon the enduring strength of the ''làng'', autonomous villages that embody the principle: 'customs of the village outweigh the laws of the king.' In a land of rugged mountains and winding rivers, these communities govern themselves, raise local militias, collect taxes efficiently, and uphold royal authority at the grassroots.
entities.name: Viet Autonomous Villages

desc: For centuries, we used Classical Chinese to write our documents. However, the script used to write our language is Chữ Nôm, a native script based on Chữ Hán, the script of Classical Chinese. Chữ Nôm was non-standardized and not used often enough compared to Classical Chinese, so there has been some pressure to reform the script and make it more suitable for our administrative purposes.
entities.name: Literary Reform

desc: The Nhã Nhạc is the traditional music played at our courts and performed at annual ceremonies. It is a prominent aspect of our culture, and a pillar of our traditions.
entities.name: Nhã Nhạc

desc: Thuận Thiên, or Heaven's Will, is the name of the legendary sword wielded by our liberator, Lê Lợi. According to the tales, the sword gave him the strength of a thousand men, enough to finally throw off the yoke of Chinese rule. Many in our country look upon Lê Lợi as the perfect embodiment of the ideal leader.
entities.name: Thuận Thiên

desc: Our existence has been shaped by China for too long. To leave our own mark on the world, we must expand our reach beyond the Chinese sphere of influence.
entities.name: Trading Contracts

desc: Though influenced by the Chinese, our architecture remains distinct and unique to our state. While still following the concepts of Fēng Shuǐ, many typical Chinese elements have been left out or adapted to our unique environment.
entities.name: Vietnamese Architecture

desc: Recognizing that the Mediterranean is becoming a sea of fire, we have commissioned a new class of heavy, oak-reinforced oared vessels built in our best shipyards. By utilizing the iron-hard timber of the coastal mountains, these ships can withstand heavier broadsides and are designed to navigate the shallow, rocky karst inlets where large Venetian galleys founder. This superiority allows us to police our own waters and defend our coasts from any enemy.
entities.name: Adriatic Oak Galleys

desc: To secure the loyalty of the coastal cities against Venetian encroachment, we will issue privileges that guarantee the internal autonomy and Latin laws of those comunes (a unit of government). By allowing these cities to elect their own priors and manage their own local taxes, we create a loyal urban class that views us as a protector rather than an oppressor. This decentralized urban defense ensures that the coast is a patchwork of loyal, fortified comunes that can hold out against maritime raids, bringing the coasts and inner lands together.
entities.name: Comune Privileges

desc: We have pivoted our economy toward intensive agriculture, taking advantage of the climate of the Dalmatian coast. By establishing state-monitored 'Agricultural Pacts', we have reclaimed the coastal hills for large-scale production, turning our rugged land into a green garden of exports. This economic diversification reduces our reliance on the maritime trade and provides a new source of wealth for the coastal nobility, funding the construction of grand summer villas and urban theaters that rival those of the Italian mainland.
entities.name: Dalmatian Olive Pacts

desc: We have integrated the Morlachs — the fierce Vlach and Slavic shepherds of the interior — into a permanent military reserve. These irregulars are granted land rights in exchange for constant readiness, serving as the eyes and ears of the nation. Their intimate knowledge of the karst geography allows us to conduct deep-strike ambushes and night raids that paralyze the enemy's logistics. This creates a 'Nation in Arms' culture in the Dalmatian hinterland, where the boundary between civilian and soldier is entirely erased in the name of our defense.
entities.name: Morlach Frontier Levies

desc: As we consolidate our rule, we have turned our population into the 'Sword of the Nation'. Our men are recruited into elite ''Schiavoni'' (Slavic) regiments, serving as the frontline heavy infantry for our wars. This military service provides our people with professional training and exposure to the latest European warfare techniques, creating a culture of career soldiers. While our cities may lose their mercantile edge, our people become the most respected warriors in the Mediterranean, ensuring that our military tradition remains unbroken even under foreign administration.
entities.name: The Soldato Dalmantine

desc: The Dalmatian culture has matured into a truly bilingual society where Latin is the language of the law and Slavic is the language of the heart. This linguistic flexibility allows our people to navigate the complex social strata of the Renaissance Adriatic with ease. By mastering both tongues, our merchants and sailors become the indispensable intermediaries for all trade between the Italian city-states and the Slavic interior. This bilingualism creates a 'Dalmatian Bridge' culture that is uniquely adapted to international trade and diplomacy, ensuring that our people are always at the center of Mediterranean commerce.
entities.name: The Union of the Two Souls

desc: Centuries of maritime trade and bilingualism have produced a culture of Cosmopolitanism, where our people are at home in any port from Venice to the Levant. This cultural openness allows us to absorb and adapt the best ideas from across the globe, creating a society that is uniquely flexible and resilient. Our people are the 'citizens of the sea', possessing a world-view that is far broader than that of the landlocked interior. This cosmopolitan spirit ensures that the Dalmatian culture remains vibrant and commercially successful, serving as the 'window to the world' for the entire Balkan Peninsula.
entities.name: Mediterranean Cosmopolitanism

desc: Modeled after the Italian literary academies, the intellectuals of our cities have founded societies like the ''Accademia degli Oziosi'' to discuss physics, astronomy, and classical poetry. These 'Idle' scholars are anything but — they serve as the scientific advisors to the naval admiralties, applying the new Baroque rationalism to cartography and ballistics. This cultural institutionalization of curiosity ensures that the Dalmatian urban centers remain the 'Scientific Watchtowers' of the Adriatic, preserving the coast as a hub of European Enlightenment even as the interior of the Balkans remains locked in traditionalist cycles.
entities.name: The Accademia degli Oziosi

desc: Every Dalmatian city is anchored by the intense veneration of its own unique patron — Saint Chrysogonus in Zadar, Saint Domnius in Split, Saint Tryphon in Kotor. These saints are not just religious figures; they are the 'Foundational Sovereigns' of the city. Their feast days are the primary social and political events of the year, uniting all classes in a shared ritual that reinforces the city's independent identity. This intense localism ensures that Dalmatian culture is a mosaic of fiercely independent urban identities, making it impossible for any foreign power to culturally dominate the entire coast at once.
entities.name: The Cult of the Local Patron Saint

desc: The abundant, bone-white limestone of the coast has birthed a culture of master stone-cutters who view the karst as a canvas. Our craftsmen have developed a 'Gothic-Renaissance' style that is world-renowned for its structural innovation and delicate carving. This is not merely art; it is a physical statement of our permanence. By building every church, palace, and city wall from local stone, our people create a landscape that is both beautiful and indestructible, fostering a national pride that views the Dalmatian town as a sacred, eternal monument to our skill that no sea-borne empire can truly erase.
entities.name: The Guild of the Stone-Master

desc: The Dalmatian patriciate has adopted the 'High Dalmatian' literary standard for their private correspondence and diplomatic registries, emulating their Italian Peninsula counterparts. This cultural pivot away from the medieval Latin towards the refined vernacular aligns the coastal cities with the heart of the Italian Renaissance. This shared linguistic aesthetic creates a seamless intellectual bridge with the Venetian ''Studio'', allowing Dalmatian poets and lawyers to participate in the most exclusive humanist circles of Italy. This 'Linguistic Refinement' ensures that our diplomats are regarded as cultural peers in any Western court, providing a diplomatic shield based on shared civilization rather than raw military force.
entities.name: The High Chancery Style

desc: Our culture is defined by the Commune, where every citizen's honor is tied to the prestige of their city. This spirit of urban competition drives our people to build more beautiful cathedrals and faster ships than their neighbors, creating a culture of extreme local pride and innovation.
