This 'City-State' mentality ensures that our people are highly invested in their local governance and defense, fostering a population that is exceptionally resilient and self-reliant, capable of managing its own affairs even when the central crown is distant or weak.
entities.name: The Maritime Commune Spirit

desc: With the establishment of a centralized college to train our naval commanders, we will be able to produce skilled leaders familiar with our coastal waters. This will improve our marine defense strategy, and ultimately better safeguard Danish sovereignty.
entities.name: College of the Admiralty

desc: While the Danish terrain is relatively poor in terms of rare materials available to exploit, they make up for it with agricultural abundance. We shall focus on optimizing our farming and food production, safeguarding our people against future periods of famine.
entities.name: Agricultural Focus

desc: The regional laws of Jutland, Zealand and Scania formed the basis of our legal code for centuries. For the benefit of our realm, we should compile and unify these laws into a single comprehensive legal system, which will be known as the ''Danske Lov''.
entities.name: Danish Legislation

desc: In the tumultuous religious landscape of Europe, we must set Denmark on the path to righteousness, and remain true to the doctrines of our church.
entities.name: Religious Uniformity

desc: Our country has a long and proud history of shipbuilding. Our experienced shipwrights need a modern and spacious dock in which to construct a navy worthy of calling itself Danish. The waters around Copenhagen are the perfect place to construct such a dockyard.
entities.name: The Copenhagen Dockyard

desc: Our domain is protected by natural barriers, namely the Jutland Peninsula and the Danish archipelago. This defensive geography is extremely helpful when we are under attack, as it gives us time to raise levies before our enemies can reach our core territory.
entities.name: Reliance on Levies

desc: Every part of our country is surrounded by the waters of the Baltic and North Seas. This gives us the unique advantage of being able to utilize waterways for both transport and communication, considerably shortening the time it takes to travel between regions.
entities.name: Danish Sea Networks

desc: Denmark cannot rely on a vast population to supply their armies. Therefore, we need to ensure that mercenary companies are willing to serve our state, while guaranteeing their loyalty with solid contracts.
entities.name: Reliance on Mercenaries

desc: By establishing a separate department for our Treasury, the ''Rentekammeret'', we will have better control over our finances and be able to run the government more efficiently. With the documentation of all our financial records, we will be able to estimate our future expenditures more easily, stabilizing our finances.
entities.name: Rentekammeret

desc: Our country is surrounded by water, and therefore vulnerable to domination by any power with a large enough fleet. To ensure this will never happen, we must fund a navy capable of protecting our coastline and projecting our power over the north of Europe.
entities.name: Danish State Navy

desc: The Royal Life Guards are an elite Danish regiment that also serve as the ruler's personal guard and perform ceremonial duties.
entities.name: Royal Life Guards

desc: The rulers of Denmark have claimed overlordship over the Nordic regions for centuries. Embellishing the legacy of Kings like Canute 'the Great' will grant us the internal and external legitimacy needed to support our assertions.
entities.name: True Rulers of the North

desc: The Scanian Regiment is a military unit composed of drafted peasants, established to reduce reliance on mercenary forces and build a more organized standing army under direct royal authority.
entities.name: Scanian Regiment

desc: We cannot produce everything we need to maintain economic stability on our own. We must instead rely on a stable trade network to export our goods and import everything that we ourselves are not able to produce.
entities.name: A Maritime Nation

desc: Denoting generosity, Dāna is defined as the act of giving without anything in return, and is a key virtue in all religions related to the Dharma. Helping others selflessly, whereas individually or communally, is one of the key ways of accumulating karma.
entities.name: Dāna

desc: Denmark's long naval traditions and its mastery of maritime logistics culminated in major dockyards like those in Copenhagen. As Scandinavia, we inherit these powerful infrastructures and traditions, boosting our diplomatic standing and naval readiness.
entities.name: Danish Dockyard Legacy

desc: For centuries, households in Japan have had close relationships with local Buddhist temples, giving them financial patronage in exchange for the temples taking care of their spiritual needs. Formally enforcing this system will keep our people devoted to the faith, and secure the vital role our religion plays in society.
entities.name: Danka System

desc: Debt is sometimes simply unavoidable. However, an organized debt market will allow us to float loans at a lower interest rate.
entities.name: Debt and Loans

desc: Ever since our split from other Christian faiths, the heretics have come to us with accusations and condemnations many times. They may call themselves Christian, but their views are obviously clouded, whereas our vision is made clear by the light of God.
entities.name: Defense Against Heretics

desc: We have been driven from Acre and Cyprus, but the Order of the Hospital of St. John will retreat no further. In pagan times, a Colossus stood sentinel over the harbor of Rhodes, but today, the greatest fortifications the world has ever known have taken up the guard!

mods.label: War with No Casus Belli Cost

entities.name: Defense of the Faith

desc: The Republic of Velikiy Novgorod is the target of many external threats. But be it the western heretics from Scandinavia, the rampaging Germans to our southwest, or even other Russian powers to our south; they all shall all crumble at the feet of our unbreakable fortifications.
entities.name: Defenses of Velikiy Novgorod

desc: The rise of many powerful states around us has hastened our need for a robust defensive force, as we intend to maintain our territorial integrity. Knowledge of our homeland's native terrain, hidden paths, and regional tactics will see us through this turbulent period.
entities.name: Defensive Army

desc: There are those who think that attack is the best form of defense, but that is foolish. Let our enemies come to us instead; we shall counter with incredible zeal. Our troops will defend their homes tenaciously, and our fortresses will withstand sieges for longer.
entities.name: Defensive Mentality

desc: Originally called the 'Council of Deliberation', this body evolved from informal institutions that promoted collaborative governance among the leaders of the realm. The Council's structure has been transformed, focusing on collective aristocratic governance and policy deliberations, mainly in foreign and military affairs. Membership is restricted to military leaders from outside the imperial clan, ensuring elite participation while maintaining the ultimate authority of the ruler.
entities.name: Deliberative Council of Princes and Ministers

desc: We must ensure the supremacy of the one true faith, and denounce all criticisms of it as the bitterest of heresy.
entities.name: Denunciation of Heretics

desc: Our region is inhabited by many peasants and tribal groups, who represent the lower classes of our society. Despite their relative poverty, they command great influence over trade routes that cross the barren deserts between our cities. Bringing these people under our jurisdiction, and ensuring their allegiance, will help us establish ourselves as powerful scions of the desert.
entities.name: Desert Power

desc: Join the battle cry of the Crusades — 'God wills it' — and crush the heretics!
entities.name: Deus Vult

desc: Though dry and rocky, the islands of Qeshm and Ormus have sustained urban life thanks to careful provisioning and rich trade. With proper investment, their ports and workshops can flourish further, turning them from logistical hubs into centers of innovation and productivity.
entities.name: Invest in Qeshm and Ormus

desc: With more and more countries sending their subjects or citizens abroad on various trading ventures and with so many living so close to each other for so long times it has become absolutely essential to have at least a basic concept of common laws of the seas. With publications such as 'Mare Liberum' or the later 'De Dominio Maris Dissertatio', the foundations to an international law of the seas have been laid.
entities.name: Development of Maritime Law

desc: The ''Devotio Moderna'', or modern devotional movement, is rapidly gaining popularity among members of our faith. We should implement some of their teachings into our court, so as to make ourselves appear particularly devout.
entities.name: Devotio Moderna

desc: We must revive Augustinian theology, and recognize that our beliefs are built on the emotions and fervor of the faithful.
entities.name: Devotionalism

desc: Religion is one of the most important bulwarks of our rulership. By making grand displays of our religious devotion in public, we will inspire the people to follow suit, and this proliferation of piety amongst our people will strengthen our rule.
entities.name: Devotion

desc: Once a spiritual stronghold of Orthodox Christianity and home to one of the oldest bishoprics in the region, the Diocese of Smolensk embodies our people's unshakable faith.
entities.name: Diocese of Smolensk

desc: Continued communication with our subject nations through dedicated emissaries will positively impact our relations, strengthening the core of our domain and ensuring the loyalty of all countries that stand under our banner.
entities.name: Subject Emissaries

desc: Regular diplomatic endeavors require paperwork and detailed documentation of our contacts.
entities.name: Expanded Archives

desc: Through the establishment of a professional diplomatic corps, we will ensure that the hard-earned knowledge of senior diplomats is passed on to the younger generation.
entities.name: Diplomatic Corps

desc: By focusing on diplomacy, we can increase the power we wield on the world stage, and win many friends and potential allies.
entities.name: Diplomatic Influence

desc: Diplomacy between countries has always been important. However, the art of diplomatic maneuvering is growing in intensity and complexity, and it has become common to send our envoys ever further afield than before to expand our foreign relations.
entities.name: Foreign Envoys

desc: Maintaining an established network of skilled diplomats around us allows us to send envoys to countries even further away.
entities.name: Diplomatic Network

desc: The current international situation requires that we set up permanent offices for our diplomats in neighboring countries. It is the only way to ensure that our interests are upheld in our region while we extend our reach beyond it.
entities.name: Embassies

desc: The complexity of modern politics can no longer be handled by single envoys. To expand our influence even further and protect our interests in those faraway places, we will send skilled teams of expert diplomats to each country.
entities.name: Diplomatic Missions

desc: With every nation trying to expand its reach even farther, the world has become more interconnected than ever before. Only establishing permanent embassies all over the globe can allow this interconnectivity to sustain itself.
entities.name: Global Embassies

desc: Our diplomatic playbook has been refined, and as a result, we have added excellent diplomats to our entourage in an attempt to bolster our foreign efforts.
entities.name: Diplomatic Training

desc: During combat, only three things matter: firepower, manpower, and the discipline to combine the two. Regular military drills and exercises shall elevate our to a new standard.
entities.name: Disciplined Drills

desc: Dividing our lands between heirs has weakened dynasties across the Empire. We will establish a clear rule of succession, the eldest inherits all. Our nobles may grumble, but an undivided Mark is worth their discontent.
entities.name: Dispositio Achillea

desc: It is from the most distant places that the most lucrative trade goods come. For many years, Muslim traders have traveled huge distances both on land and across the seas in search of profitable trade opportunities.
entities.name: Distant Trade Ventures

desc: A center of production where the secrecy of an old time guild is drowned by the great demand for increased amounts of distilled goods. This need has shaped a new and modern system of production that prioritizes quantity and profit.
entities.name: Liquor Manufactory

desc: Large Distilleries will be able to utilize steam powered engines and automatized mechanism to increase the output of their facilities.
entities.name: Distiller Mill

desc: By distilling in larger workshops with ample storage for aging, we will be able to produce larger quantities of alcoholic drinks.
entities.name: Distillers Workshop

desc: Distribution of Power determines how authority is divided among the ruler, administrative bodies, and estates. The state is a complex and fragile entity — a well-balanced power distribution ensures stability, while giving any single institution too much power risks breeding tyranny or administrative paralysis.
entities.name: Distribution of Power

desc: The beliefs of the people of India center around the concept of Dharma and the text of the Vēdaḥ, but they are manifested in a myriad of forms and practices. Even the gods recognized and worshiped are not the same for everyone, but a common thread of concepts is present throughout.
entities.name: Diversity of Beliefs

desc: United, the three estates form an effective block against the power of the ruler. To consolidate our control, we must systematically leverage the nobility against the other estates.
entities.name: Divide the Estates

desc: Many of our composers have created their greatest works thanks to the inspiration provided by their faith. We should actively seek out the most talented artists and hire them immediately so as to never let our churches and cathedrals suffer from inferior music.
entities.name: Divine Church Music

desc: Times are changing. Faith was once the most important thing in our lives, but now, ideas once seen as blasphemous are spreading among the common folk. In the face of an evolving world, our clergy finds solace in their unshaken dedication to our cause.
entities.name: Divine Passion

desc: It is of the utmost importance that we rid our nation and its surrounding borders of the non-believers that plague our lands.
entities.name: Divine Supremacy

desc: Called the festival of light, Diwali is when we celebrate the triumph of the Dharma; the victory of good over evil and light over darkness. We will light candles and lanterns to symbolize this victory, and we will honor our ancestors.
entities.name: Diwali

desc: Much of the Dehlavi nobility is drawn from the ranks of the Afghan community, a people with a long history of conquest and rule in northern India. Though at times a political hindrance, their martial skills are beyond question.
entities.name: Afghan Nobility

desc: India is a massive subcontinent with several religions present. In order to ensure stability within our realm, we should expand the rights of the different faiths, and secure the loyalty of their worshippers.
entities.name: Cosmopolitan Religions

desc: The Grand Trunk Road runs from Kābul in Afghanistan to the coast of Bengal. Many of the most important trading cities along its route are part of our empire, and so it falls to us to ensure that the road is well maintained and free of banditry.
entities.name: Protect the Grand Trunk Road

desc: Foreign ideas of nationalism and cultural identity have reached India. While the cultural diversity of India will remain high, it is clear that our geography, as well as the values of Islam, give us all a sense of unity in the form of a Hindustani identity.
entities.name: Hindustani Identity

desc: Persian has been the dominant language of the court ever since the first inception of the Dehlavi Sultanate. As such, the influence of Persian has synthesized with local Indian cultures.
entities.name: Indo-Persian Culture

desc: The Hindustani language developed from Apabhramsa — a Middle Indo-Aryan language — and emerged as the contact language of Delhi. As Hindustani has influences from Persian, Arabic, and Turkic but also Old Hindi, diplomacy with the Muslim world and the Hindu world becomes an uncomplicated task.
entities.name: Origin of Hindustani

desc: The once vast Dehlavi Sultanate has lost most of its former possessions, but we have not forgotten the means of administering them. As we work towards restoring our past glory, we will remind local rulers of their duties to the Sultan.
entities.name: Re-integrate Former Provinces

desc: The Dehlavi Sultanate once encompassed nearly all of India. It must rise again!
entities.name: Restore the Greatness of Delhi

desc: The foolish economic decisions of Ghiyath al-Din have brought nothing but financial ruin to the state of Delhi. We must revert his madness and restore the usage of gold and silver for our coins.
entities.name: Revert Ghiyath's Reforms

desc: During the height of the tughlaq dynasty and the most stable period of our state, great architects and artists of grand vision constructed mosques and tombs in the unique Tughlaq style. As the decades went on and our power was challenged by internal issues, the resources for maintaining this architecture faded. It is time to revive it, and re-establish Delhi as an empire of art and wonders.
entities.name: Tughlaq Architectural Revival

desc: The thriving textile industry in Delhi makes our nation a hotspot for related technological innovations. As early adopters of the cotton gin and worm gear roller, we know the importance of staying ahead of the curve in these matters. We must now ensure that the spinning wheel is adopted as widely as possible.
entities.name: Innovative Textile Production

desc: For centuries, every great Indian empire has been ruled from Delhi. It is the seat of conquerors and our birthright. All must know that Delhi is once again home to the rightful ruler of all India!
entities.name: Indian Throne

desc: Although we call India our home, the ancestors of our state were of Turkic origins. Their early successes as conquerors and rulers from the days of the Mamlūk dynasty, as well as the achievements of the following Khalji dynasty, inspire our military and diplomats alike to push the borders of Delhi into every corner of India.
entities.name: Turkic Conqueror Roots

desc: A dock is the most basic shore infrastructure that allows for the building and repairing of boats.
entities.name: Dock

desc: Governing two territories separated by foreign lands demands more than ordinary administration. We will ensure our laws reach the far corners of our realm and that every magistrate answers to the same authority, however distant from the capital he may be.
entities.name: Double Electorate

desc: Both Alexandria and Antioch see themselves as having two different patriarchates, one for Miaphysitism and another for Orthodoxy. Although they both may claim legitimacy, only Miaphysitism preserves the true patriarchates.
entities.name: Double Patriarchate

desc: The ''Hatun Runas'' are the peasant class of our empire. One in fifty men are chosen for military service on their twenty-fifth birthdays, and conscripted for the next seven years. This conscription system helps us maintain a substantial professional army with superior discipline than the troops of our adversaries.
entities.name: Drafted Hatun Runas

desc: Interpreters, translators, and guides in one, the Dragomans are skilled officials who work to enhance our diplomatic and commercial efforts with different communities and countries. Most dragomans are of Greek ancestry, though some hail from Jewish, Armenian, or other multilingual backgrounds.
entities.name: Dragomans

desc: No longer shall we depend upon untrained levied men. If we are to defend our borders and smite our rivals, we must conduct regular and organized drills.
entities.name: Drill Army

desc: The Drokpa nomads often operate as herders and traders, porters that connect distant settlements. Through their traditions and unparalleled knowledge of the terrain, they traverse the high-altitude routes between Tibet, Bhutan, Ladakh, and Nepal. Their seasonal caravans carry Salt, Wool, and dried meat in exchange for grain and manufactured goods. These networks knit our mountains into a vibrant lattice of commerce and diplomacy.
entities.name: Drokpa

desc: It is a port building that provides the necessary infrastructure to construct and repair boats in isolated dry basins that can be flooded at will. This ease of access to the hull of the ship improves in great measure the efficiency and capacity of the building process.
entities.name: Dry Dock

desc: Our might and power will be the envy of our enemies. Our name will forever be associated with the Dragon of Ōshū.
entities.name: Dragon of Ōshū

desc: As one of the branches of the northern house of the Fujiwara, the legitimacy of our rule is impeachable.
entities.name: Fujiwara Hokke

desc: Many dismiss Ōu as poor due to its harsh weather and mountains, yet the region holds great potential. Through infrastructure investment — new towns, waterways, expanded cultivation — and by abolishing stifling tolls and taxes, we can substantially improve our heartland and make our subjects wealthy.
entities.name: Intensive Domain Development

desc: As an honorable clan dating back to the early Kamakura period, we have a strong claim to rule over the entire Ōshū province. Fortunately for us, what land Ōshū exactly covers is not well-defined.
entities.name: Ōshū Shugo

desc: While our people always enjoyed superior literacy rates at all levels of society, this advantage is becoming more apparent in the world taking shape before us. Only those with a limited understanding would not take advantage of and increase this edge.
entities.name: Dutch Education

desc: The Netherlands have historically been at the forefront of technological and cultural advancements. We must continue to patronize inventors, artists, and writers to maintain our edge over other nations.
entities.name: Dutch Art

desc: Only by extensive manufactories dedicated to the production of various dyes, will we be able to satisfy the increasing need for pigments and fancy colors.
entities.name: Dyes Mill

desc: Dyes and pigments can be created from a variety of sources, but they need to be processed in a certain manner, usually only known to a selected people.
entities.name: Dyes Workshop

desc: A dedicated and expanded dyes production will ensure that our population gets access to as much variety of pigments and colors as they desire.
entities.name: Dyesworks

desc: A truly innovative court is one where any person may rise to prominence. We must strive to make sure that old traditions, as well as prejudices around one's birth or level of wealth, do not hinder the development of our court or act as a barrier to talented people wishing to serve our state.
entities.name: Dynamic Court

desc: The proliferation of pirates, brigands, and robbers in the waters along our trade routes has forced our merchants to band together and form Merchant Leagues, which facilitate the protection of their boats during long journeys.
entities.name: Anti-Piracy Leagues

desc: A ruler cannot be in all places of the country at once. By delegating governance to local authorities, the authority of the court can be made manifest even in the most remote parts of our country.
entities.name: Local Council

desc: Originally of Iberian origin, the first caravels were small but very fast ships that were used for offshore fishing and coastal trade. Their use in iberia is so widespread that the region can easily boast of possessing the most advanced caravels.
entities.name: Early Iberian Caravels

desc: An early, but powerful ocean-going vessel, the Early Iberian Galleon is an original invention from iberia that has a lower forecastle and a long hull, making them especially stable and resistant to headwinds.
entities.name: Early Iberian Galleons

desc: Over time, it became apparent that a more centralized bureaucracy, with administrative bodies run by educated officials employed directly by the state, was a necessity to complete the ambitious projects of the Early Modern rulers.
entities.name: Early Modern Administration

desc: Our strategic position between eastern and western empires has given our merchants the opportunity to act as essential middlemen for lucrative regional trade routes.
entities.name: East and West

desc: The lands of East Africa are at the crossroads of great trade routes. From the land of Egypt and the ports of the Mediterranean through the Red Sea, to the riches of the East accross the Indian Ocean, and southwards along the Swahili Coast, the bustling movement of goods and people is constant. The countries in these lands are thus also accustomed to exchanging goods and valuables as a means of establishing diplomatic relationships.
entities.name: Eastern African Trade

desc: We are part of the branch of so-called Eastern Christianity, which amalgamates many different denominations with different theological and liturgical traditions, but also with many common cultural aspects.
entities.name: Eastern Christianity

desc: Christian denominations from the Oriental Orthodoxy are often confused with Eastern Orthodoxy by the uninitiated. Although they are different from us in many key issues, they are still Christian, and our many commonalities could be used to bring them back to the correct faith.
entities.name: Eastern Ecumenism

desc: The Peace of Westphalia has excluded us from the diplomacy of princes, but it has not settled the question of who speaks for the Catholic Church within each Catholic kingdom — a question now pressed with dangerous urgency by those who would make the Church a department of the crown. We assert our primacy over the bishops of France, Germany, and Austria not as a formality but as a living doctrinal reality, condemning the propositions of ''Gallicanism'' and forcing clergy who have drifted toward national loyalties to account for the authority they owe to Rome. This reassertion of the Pope's exclusive right to define Catholic doctrine brings wavering churches back under the orthodoxy of the Holy See and restores the flow of tithes and ecclesiastical revenues that national rulers had begun to redirect toward themselves.
entities.name: Ecclesiastical Primacy

desc: The economy and wealth of a country should serve the government, not the opposite way around. As such, it is in the state's best interests to accumulate the lion's share of resources, both as a show of our power and in order to better carry out our will. Only with this system can our nation truly prosper.
entities.name: Subservient Economy

desc: A nation's economic policy sets out specific economic objectives and means to achieve them, and makes decisions and creates regulations for taxation, spending, currency, trade, and more.
entities.name: Economic Policy

desc: The Reformation has harmed our cause as knights from Germany and Scandinavia have started murmuring questions about the nature of the Communion Host, but the always-present Turkic threat has a way of making such disputes seem minor. Perhaps we should focus on defending the realm, and debate theology once the Saracen threat is safely at bay?
entities.name: Ecumenical Defenders of Christendom

desc: Determining how to deal with the heretics in our realm is always tricky. Although the good, old-fashioned fire-and-sword approach will solve most problems eventually, diplomacy can also succeed. By encouraging dialogue between the various sects, we can reduce misunderstandings and promote peace in the realm.
entities.name: Ecumenism

desc: Our neighbors drive out their most industrious subjects for the sake of religious conformity. Their loss is our gain. We open our doors to the persecuted and the skilled alike, and our cities grow richer for it.

mods.label: Possible Burghers in Towns and Cities

entities.name: Edict of Potsdam

desc: A bit of bookkeeping will help us to weather any religious strife that could befall our realm. This harmless edict will surely not spark any further conflict.
entities.name: Edict of Restitution

desc: A legal code published by Emperor Ashoka 'the Great' in the 3rd century BCE, these edicts include strictures promoting for Buddhism. Although this code is from many centuries ago, it still deserves respect and reverence from any member of the Buddhist faithful.
entities.name: Edicts of Ashoka

desc: The officials running our administration are not illiterate and lazy heirs to their parent's seats, but rather educated and talented individuals who have earned their positions through effort and merit. An administration like this will undoubtedly run more smoothly and efficiently than any other.
entities.name: Educated Bureaucrats

desc: Bureaucracy is the oil that makes the wheels of our administration turn smoothly. With the appointment of efficient bureaucrats that have both talent and the will to properly fulfill their tasks, we will ensure the seamless operation of our government structures.
entities.name: Efficient Bureaucracy

desc: Our efficient building strategy allows us to complete complex work orders without taking any half measures.
entities.name: Efficient Construction Plans

desc: Logistics and communications are what allow us to properly administer our entire territory. To facilitate better communication between our provincial governors and the central rulership, we need a well-established network of roads for our messengers to travel upon.
entities.name: Efficient Logistics

desc: We shall issue a decree to refine every aspect of metal mining within our domain, in an effort to regulate its presence in our markets.
entities.name: Efficient Mining

desc: Most peasants would happily sell their own mother for gold, but there are some with skills and talents that we in the government might find very useful for...ah, ''statecraft''. Although finding these worthy commoners is difficult, through experience we are learning to separate the wheat from the chaff.
entities.name: Efficient Spies

desc: Cultivating the doctrine of attack is the hallmark of our army. Our men must fight with ''élan'' — spirit and vigor — giving us a clear edge on the battlefield.
entities.name: Élan!

desc: The Eltham Ordinances represented England's first attempt to streamline royal bureaucracy and make it more adaptable and cost-effective. The Ordinances attempted reform through reducing royal household expenditures and consolidating certain bureaucratic functions.
entities.name: The Eltham Ordinance

desc: For a long time, we have restricted land ownership to only those we felt were trustworthy enough. If we were to lift these restrictions, then land holdings could be consolidated. This in turn would create a pool of seasonal labor for whom the army life might be worth pursuing.
entities.name: Emancipation

desc: Our faith has a long tradition of sponsoring and promoting great works of art. The development of the splendid new Baroque style reflects the pathos and glory of our theology beautifully, and should receive particular sponsorship.
entities.name: Promote Baroque Art

desc: In the wake of the Enlightenment's emphasis on reason, we must not forget the power of emotion and imagination. By embracing Romanticism, which celebrates nature, folklore, and national character, our artists will produce works that stir the soul.
entities.name: Embrace Romanticism

desc: The construction of massive public opera houses will become a state priority. These theaters will be the 'Parliaments of the People', where the rising bourgeoisie meet to share common national myths through music. This culture will ensure that the Emilian population is the most politically mobilized in Italy, steeling the population to face every challenge.
entities.name: Al Melodràm

desc: Living in a flood-prone plain, the Emilian people have mastered the art of river canalization. These are not just for drainage but serve as a renewable energy source for silk mills and grain grinders. This has not only allowed our landlocked cities like Modena and Bologna to function as industrial hubs, transporting goods via artificial waterways to the Po River and the Adriatic Sea, but also tamed the Po river and its destructive floods.
entities.name: Al Pô Domâ

desc: The Emilian courts have developed a culture where each chef acts as an ambassador of the region. Our region's unique products (balsamic vinegars, cured hams, and aged cheeses) are used to woo foreign monarchs. This strategy of conquering through the palate will ensure that we are always influential in the courts of Europe, securing alliances through the sheer exclusivity and quality of our premium foods.
entities.name: Dispenza Emigliàna

desc: To maximize the efficiency of the Po Valley, the state will implement a scientific mapping of every drainage ditch and field. This measuring will turn the landscape into a giant spreadsheet. It will allow for the most precise tax collection in Europe, ensuring that every acre of the fertile silt is paying its fair share to our treasury to fund the modernization of the nation.
entities.name: La Mzûra dal Sōl

desc: Facing our enemy's modern cannons, we have realized brick is too brittle. We will pioneer the use of rammed-earth and brick-faced ramparts. This adaptation to the lack of stone - that will be known by many as the ''Trace Italienne'' - will make our engineers become the world's most sought-after military consultants, exporting our 'Silt-and-Brick' defensive science to the rest of the world.
entities.name: The Tèra Crûda

desc: Emilian cities shall leverage their position on the Via Emilia (the ancient Roman artery) to establish international trade fairs. We will provide the means for these activities to develop with total security and will standardize weights and measures. This will help us gain the trust of international traders, so that traders from the Alps and the Mediterranean can meet. This trade-centric mindset will allow Emilian states to thrive as essential middlemen in the luxury silk and spice trades.
entities.name: The Via Emilia

desc: Things are what they are because we can feel them, see them, and overall experience them with our senses. It is by using this empirical evidence that we come up with newer ideas.
entities.name: Empiricism

desc: We have inherited an exquisite city from our predecessors. We must continue to beautify and improve this metropolis of the Mediterranean so that it can continue to grow and prosper. No longer can we content ourselves with merely repairing and maintaining the port and buildings; we shall make holistic improvements that better sustain our people by also building aqueducts, draining wetlands, and paving more roads.

mods.label: Possible Burghers in Towns and Cities

entities.name: Encouraged City Living

desc: Carlo Borromeo's administration of Milan became the most closely studied model of institutional reform of the age — rigorous reorganization of local hierarchies, standardized training for officials, and regular inspection visits that reached every village in our territory. We adopt his model wholesale, using every institution at our disposal to extend education and discipline throughout our realm. This reform builds a population that is both more literate and more tightly bound to the institutions of the realm, making civic order far easier to maintain.
entities.name: The Borromean Reform

desc: As long as ships have been built in Arabia, there have been guilds who control the production. Although they may have performed a valuable service in keeping shipbuilding traditions alive, they now stand in the way of progress. We must open up the shipbuilding industry to all with talent.
entities.name: End of the Shipbuilding Guilds

desc: The principle of volunteering underpins our whole army structure, but sometimes there are simply not enough willing conscripts. We should force — erm, ''encourage'' people to volunteer.
entities.name: Enforced Service

desc: Elite marksmen equipped with the long-range Baker Rifle and trained to screen the main force in small independent pickets, Experimental Riflemen represent a modern vision of infantry combat formations.
entities.name: Experimental Riflemen

desc: Life in the English army is grueling and strictly regimented, but it instills in one a certain character. The unflappable nature of our troops, as well as their expertise with firearms, strikes fear into the hearts of our enemies.
entities.name: Redcoats

desc: Allows us to gather the greatest technological minds our nation has to offer, and make use of their unrivaled services.
entities.name: Engineer Corps

desc: A massive sea presence is required for any nation attempting to rule the waters. Our fleet will be so imposing that the shores of our enemies will always be surrounded by our vessels.
entities.name: Rulers of the Waves

desc: Our island protects us from outside enemies, but that will not matter if we do not protect the surrounding waters. By being true masters of our surrounding seas, we will keep a firm control on those who threaten our land.
entities.name: Our Island Home

desc: The bravery and discipline of English foot soldiers has been witnessed from the shieldwalls of Northumbria to the darkened skies of France. Inspired by the lion-hearted spirit of our kings and the stoicism of the common man, our infantry fights with the ferocity of the Anglo-Saxon warriors before them.
entities.name: Lionhearts

desc: The values of the Enlightenment are ever-present in any modern court, and with them comes the presence of the most intellectual and learned people. Thanks to these illustrious and enlightened courtiers, much more can now be achieved with far less effort.
entities.name: Enlightened Court

desc: The last century has seen Rationalism and Empiricism gain ever-increasing popularity among the greatest minds of the age. The Light of Reason has been lit, and many will not rest until it has been brought to all corners of the earth.
entities.name: Enlightenment

desc: No matter which people we rule over, the Church provides a way to give them a unified structure.
entities.name: Entrenched Church

desc: Located at the heart of a bustling and vibrant market, the Entrepôt is the best place for our mercantile efforts to flourish.
entities.name: Entrepôt

desc: To thrive as a trade hub, our cities must be connected by solid infrastructure. By empowering the noble class to build and maintain strategic roads, we improve internal trade and strengthen the arteries of our realm.
entities.name: Entrepôt Connections

desc: By securing the ports of Valona and Butrint, Epirus sits as the warden of the Adriatic Sea. We have leveraged this position to negotiate favorable trade treaties with Venice and the Italian city-states, who must pass through our sphere of influence to reach the Levant. By levying precise tariffs and providing 'protection' services against corsairs, we have transformed our once-isolated despotate into a wealthy commercial hub that bridges the gap between East and West.
entities.name: Adriatic Gatekeepers

desc: To bolster our dwindling numbers, we have invited the fierce Arvanite clans to settle in the fertile valleys of Epirus and Acarnania. In exchange for land and autonomy, these warriors provide us with a tireless light infantry force that excels in the brutal, close-quarters combat of the Balkan frontier. Their unique martial culture, blended with our Roman military tradition, creates a hybrid force that is both exceptionally loyal and terrifyingly aggressive in the shock of battle.
entities.name: Arvanite Communities

desc: Epirus sits at the crossroads of the Greek, Slavic, and Latin worlds, and we have turned our royal daughters into our most effective diplomats. Through a complex web of strategic marriages with Serbian Kings, Albanian Chieftains, and even Italian Counts, we have made the House of Doukas-Komnenos the indispensable arbiter of Balkan politics. These blood-ties ensure that when we go to war, we are never without powerful allies willing to strike from our enemies' flanks.
entities.name: Balkan Marriages

desc: The city of Ioannina has been transformed into a true stronghold. Utilizing the latest in Italian military engineering, we have surrounded our capital and its lake with a series of interlocking bastions and water-forts that can withstand months of sustained bombardment. This defensive network serves as the anchor for our entire national strategy, allowing us to retreat into an impregnable core whenever the tides of war turn against us in the open field.
entities.name: Fortresses of Ioannina

desc: In the rugged, rain-swept peaks of the Pindus mountains, the Despots of Epirus have carved out a sanctuary that no Latin army can penetrate. We have mastered the art of 'mountain-ambush' warfare, using the vertical geography of our realm to trap and destroy much larger forces in narrow defiles. This environmental mastery turns our entire country into a deathtrap for invaders, ensuring that while the plains may fall, the mountains remain forever Greek.
entities.name: The Eagle of the Pindus

desc: Centuries of survival between powerful enemies have made our diplomatic corps the most sophisticated in the world. We have developed a 'neutrality-of-strength' doctrine, playing the great powers against one another so skillfully that they compete for our favor rather than seeking our conquest. Our ambassadors are renowned for their ability to weave peace treaties that always seem to leave Epirus with more territory and influence than when the conflict began.
entities.name: Sublime Diplomacy

desc: The Epic of Sundiata tells of the legendary campaign of Sundiata Keita, the founder of the Malian Empire and hero of our people. His story has passed from generation to generation, and has always been a great source of inspiration to our people.
entities.name: Epic of Sundiata

desc: For millennia our people have preserved the legends of gods and heroes through epic poetry. Works such as Homer's Iliad and Odyssey, alongside Hesiod's Theogony, stand among the greatest monuments of our cultural heritage. These timeless narratives continue to shape our identity and inspire generations.
entities.name: Epic Poetry

desc: Corvettes are a class of small warships that are designed to escort friendly vessels and harass the enemy, relying on speed and maneuverability rather than massed firepower.
entities.name: Corvettes

desc: While other religions have somewhat lax and inconsistent views towards how their holy sites are used, the rules of Islam about sacred places are quite clear. Our people will undoubtedly make their pilgrimages with the appropriate reverence and dignity.
entities.name: Established Holy Sites

desc: According to some, the Estates-General have existed since 1303. Over time, its form has shifted from being a council of royalty appointees to one of elected representatives. This change in structure has given the Estates-General, and the taxes levied by them, greater legitimacy.
entities.name: Estates-General

desc: First called in the 14th century, the Estates of Brittany allowed free men from all rungs of society, even the Third Estate, to share their grievances and petition the ruler for redress. By calling in the Estates, we can mitigate some of the tension felt throughout our domain.
entities.name: The Estates of Brittany

desc: As a Christian nation, we find ourselves surrounded by Muslim adversaries who seize every opportunity to attack us. To ensure our survival, we must be prepared to fight back immediately.
entities.name: An Eternal Crusade

desc: Not only do coin and profit move along the Silk Road, but ideas and knowledge also follow the ebb and flow of the merchants traveling along its path.
entities.name: Exchange of Ideas

desc: The Varangians have served our country for centuries with distinguished honor and unwavering faith. By expanding their ranks, we will further secure the stability and protection of Byzantium.
entities.name: Expand the Varangian Guard

desc: The growth of our urban centers has created an increasing demand for reliable fresh water. If our towns and cities are to flourish, we must commit to greater feats of engineering and expand our aqueduct networks.
entities.name: Expanded Aqueduct Systems

desc: For centuries, the Arsenale of Naples has been the center of our ship production and our main naval installation. However, it needs to be expanded and modernized to remain effective against hostile Mediterranean fleets. Let us expand both the commercial and military capabilities of our port, building a more efficient Arsenale to maintain a larger, more powerful fleet.
entities.name: Expanded Arsenale

desc: Our territory has plenty of land which is well-suited for grazing animal herds, making it easy for us to expand our output of Livestock.
entities.name: Expanded Grazing Grounds

desc: Our national road network is a vital part of our commercial and administrative success. As such, we should care to maintain and improve it.
entities.name: Expanded Infrastructure Network

desc: The demand for Slaves from external traders grows greater by the day. Our position in Africa makes us the ideal middlemen for this trade. Let us encourage those that seek slave markets to do so in our lands, and to make their business in our marketplaces.
entities.name: Control the Slave Trade

desc: Investing more resources into our supply trains will allow our army to operate for longer periods of time in hostile territory.
entities.name: Expanded Supply Trains

desc: Pochtēcah merchants extend their routes far beyond our lands, enriching every marketplace loyal to the Mexihcah.
entities.name: Expansion of Merchant Guilds

desc: We must ensure that our merchants are always welcome wherever they go. Thus, we will use any means possible to make sure that all rulers we know about welcome our merchants.
entities.name: Expansion of Trade Contacts

desc: The world is huge, and we should not grow complacent with our position in it, for our neighbors will not necessarily do the same. We shall set our sights on expanding our borders and making ourselves stronger, lest we risk being swallowed up by growing neighbor states.
entities.name: A Seed Among Thorns

desc: As the Balkans fractured, many rising powers looked outward. Ambitious rulers pursued integration of diverse lands under a single, stronger crown, taking advantage of Byzantine weakness.
entities.name: Expansionist Ambitions

desc: From its origins in Arabia, Islam has expanded far and fast. In a few generations, its believers spanned from Iberia to India, the most rapid religious expansion the world has ever seen. There are new lands waiting to be touched by our light, however — perhaps it is time for a second Muslim expansion.
entities.name: Expansionist Faith

desc: Brandenburg's infertile, sandy soil has earned it the unflattering nickname 'Sandbox of the Holy Roman Empire.' Such poverty spurred the margraves to aggressively expand, pursuing claims to neighboring territories. These conquests have made our country much more culturally diverse than the rest of the Empire.
entities.name: Expansive Policies

desc: Sometimes it is simply enough for people to ''believe'' that we are powerful. We have worked hard on our diplomatic service to ensure that our word carries extra weight.
entities.name: Experienced Diplomats

desc: Trading Fur with other tribes and foreigners is an essential part of our economy. We take great pride in our hunting abilities, and therefore are able to provide the best quality pelts.
entities.name: Fur Trade

desc: Wherever our traders land, be it the coasts of South Asia or the markets of distant China, they are respected for their sharp tongues and keen judgement. Navigating both seas and bargains with equal finesse, they ensure that our trades are never at a disadvantage.
entities.name: Expert Hagglers

desc: Our lands are frequently crossed by merchants wishing to trade Salt, Silver, and Livestock in the rich lands to our south. We would be foolish not to take advantage of their presence, and therefore will establish bustling trade hubs in our own lands to attract their business.
entities.name: Trading Hubs of Bavaria

desc: Our naval superiority allows us to project power well past our own horizons, extending a natural claim to distant lands as our own by right of discovery.
entities.name: Exploration Ideas

desc: The key factor when building a ship is its capacity for resisting inclement weather and the relentless pounding of waves. By developing sturdier methods of ship construction, we can ensure that our vessels can sail for longer periods of time.
entities.name: Sturdy Construction

desc: Beyond our shores lie uncharted lands, ripe for the taking! We shall recruit brave explorers to set course for the unknown and bring back exotic goods. This is a vital — and possibly very lucrative — opportunity for us.
entities.name: Explorer Commissions

desc: Costs to export valuable goods from our controlled markets can be quite high, making our products less attractive. By performing these export actions quicker, we can make our trade more dynamic.
entities.name: Agile Exportation

desc: By controlling key exports such as olive oil, textiles, and Dyes, we ensure both domestic prosperity and leverage abroad. Such protectionist practices allow us to project power through commerce as much as conquest, ensuring our own merchants maintain dominance over foreigners in our markets.
entities.name: Export Monopolies

desc: The troublesome heretics in our domain could easily foment rebellion against our ruler. It would be better if we redirected them to our overseas colonies instead, where they can cause less trouble.
entities.name: Expulsion of Heretics

desc: To eradicate the evil of heresy, the Lord Himself will arise and purge them from our lands!
entities.name: Exsurge Domine

desc: The foundation of Sundanese society lies in every ''kampung'', rural communities that dot the landscape. Investing in the infrastructure of these villages ensures sustainable growth, strong local leadership, and resilience against both famine and invasion.
entities.name: Extend the Kampung-Kampung

desc: The many rivers that cross our domain have tremendous economic potential. By constructing extensive canal networks, we can connect waterways to inland settlements, making transportation easier while also providing a reliable water supply to our people.
entities.name: Extensive Canal Works

desc: Our envoys to Rome and Iberia, looking for military support, were quite successful — in fact, they put us on the map. These endeavors to find allies should continue.
entities.name: External Friends

desc: Based on the concept of Ahiṃsā, Hinduism always advocates for pacifism and nonviolence. However, our enemies should still be wary of provoking us, lest we end up exemplifying the complete opposite extreme when roused into war.
entities.name: Extreme Pacifism

desc: Master gemcutters have made a breakthrough in diamond-cutting by experimenting with diamond dust suspended in oil on their scaifs. This allows the artisans to cut stones in entirely new shapes, and to a much higher brilliance. The resulting technique, known as faceting, produces a stone of a pleasing geometric shape and with better optical qualities. As the new stones, and the technique for cutting them, spreads across courts and workshops, the demand for jewelry and precious stones increases greatly.
entities.name: Faceting

desc: Deeply rooted in our culture, falconry represents a bond forged between our people and these magnificent birds of prey, and we have finely honed our skill in this ancient art. Our falconers are renowned for their ability to train these majestic raptors to hunt and capture prey.
entities.name: Falconry Mastery

desc: The Farari Corps are the elite of the Malian military. Commanders in their own right, they are highly respected for their experience and bravery.
entities.name: Farari Corps

desc: Sometimes the key to closing a trade deal is to be the quickest one. We must ensure that our merchants can always successfully close their deals.
entities.name: Fast Negotiations

desc: You cannot simply send colonists out to the New World and expect them to just build a colony. There is first a time-consuming process of preparing the expedition with everything they will need to survive in their new home. We can speed this process up, now that we have some prior experience.
entities.name: Faster Colonists

desc: All male peasants are required to be proficient with a spear or bow and to train regularly, so as to be a competent soldier if ever they are called to arms.
entities.name: Mandatory Weapon Training

desc: Our rulers are famed for their close connection to the common man. May our people always live free and happily under the guiding light of their majestic, heavenly rulers!
entities.name: Father Governs Children

desc: The legend of the Feathered Serpent is well-known across our lands. Although this figure represents many things to many people, such as Quetzalcōātl among the Nahua, K'uk'ulkan among the Maya or Q'uq'umatz among the K'iche', he is a unifying figure for all of them.
entities.name: The Feathered Serpent

desc: We should unite with other groups of our kin to form a federation, which will put mutual trust and development as its first priority.
entities.name: Federation Builders

desc: Despite our small size, we control the vital ports that connect the vast fur-producing forests of Russia to the markets of the Mediterranean. We have negotiated exclusive rights with the local Tatar Khans to be the sole shippers of these furs across the Black Sea. This lucrative monopoly provides us with the wealth necessary to pay for Genoese engineers and Byzantine scholars, ensuring our tiny principality remains a center of wealth and sophistication amidst the steppe.
entities.name: Black Sea Fur Trade

desc: In the isolation of the Crimean mountains, the remnants of the Crimean Goths and the local Greek population have fused into a single, resilient identity. This culture combines the stoic, martial heritage of the North with the administrative and maritime brilliance of the South. This 'Theodoran' spirit is our greatest defense, creating a population that views itself as the last true guardians of the Roman frontier, willing to fight to the last man for their unique way of life.
entities.name: Gothic-Hellenic Synthesis

desc: Our capital, Mangup-Kale, is a literal mountain carved into a fortress, surrounded by sheer cliffs that defy any siege engine. We have expanded these natural defenses with a series of sophisticated tunnels, cisterns, and hidden sally ports, allowing the city to hold out for years if necessary. This impregnable base ensures that even if our lands are ravaged by the Golden Horde, the heart of our Principality remains safe, serving as a beacon of hope for all Christians in the North.
entities.name: The Bastion of Mangup

desc: Drawing upon the ancient, grim traditions of our Gothic ancestors and the disciplined military manuals of the Romans, we have formed the ''Red Guard''. These elite shock troops are recruited exclusively from the highest mountain villages of the Crimea, trained to fight in the pitch-black tunnels of our fortresses and the claustrophobic ravines of the coast. Armed with heavy polearms and the latest flintlock pistols, they are masters of the sudden, devastating raids. Their reputation for never taking prisoners and never retreating makes them the most feared infantry in the Euxine basin, capable of breaking the morale of even the most hardened regiments.
entities.name: The Gothic Red Guard

desc: The Gothic-Greek hybrid culture of Theodoro has fully shed its defensive shell, transforming into a 'War Machine'. No longer content with mere cliffside survival, we have industrialized our mountain strongholds into massive foundries and barracks, producing a professional officer corps and a conscript army trained in the brutal school of steppe warfare. Every citizen of the Principality is now a soldier first, viewing the surrounding plains not as a threat, but as a harvest field for Gothic glory and Roman reclamation. This 'Total War' footing allows us to strike with a ferocity that terrifies our larger neighbors, as we field a military machine that is disproportionately powerful relative to our small territorial size.
entities.name: The Iron Harvest

desc: As the main Greek-speaking state in the North, Theodoro has become a symbol of religious resistance and cultural survival. We have established our Prince as the ''Protector of the Pontic Greeks'', drawing immigrants and scholars from distant places. This religious prestige gives us a moral authority that transcends our borders, making us a key player in the grand religious struggles as the ''Northern Star'' of the Greek Orthodox faith.
entities.name: The Northern Star of Greece

desc: Our court has become the most celebrated literary gathering in Italy, where poets recite in the great halls and scholars debate philosophy in the gardens, their work supported as an instrument of statecraft as much as a private pleasure. Our name is synonymous with excellence in the vernacular tradition, attracting talents from every corner of the peninsula who compete for our favor and patronage. This reputation for culture deepens our artistic heritage and turns every great work produced here into an advertisement for the prestige of our state.
entities.name: The Court of Letters

desc: The silkworms of our lands and the skilled hands of our weavers have long produced cloth of exceptional quality, and we have turned this craft into one of the most reliable pillars of our economy. By regulating the trade and protecting our master artisans, we ensure that raw silk is processed into finished goods here rather than exported cheaply to competitors. This mastery of the cloth trade keeps our merchant guilds prosperous and ensures that every bolt produced here carries the prestige of our name to the markets of Europe.
entities.name: Ferrarese Silk

desc: Ferrara has originated the concept of the 'Ideal City'. Instead of organic medieval growth, the state will implement large-scale, planned urban expansions with wide boulevards and symmetrical plazas. This will be the first example of modern urban planning in Europe, designed to reflect the order and majesty of the state. It will improve public health, facilitate military movement, and make Ferrara the most modern and prestigious nation in the West.
entities.name: L'Adizión Erculéa

desc: The marshy delta of the Po has long been a wasteland of standing water and malarial fog on our doorstep. By organizing a systematic program of drainage and embankment, we transform these wetlands into productive farmland, adding to our tax base while reducing the disease burden on our border communities. This transformation of the landscape into something orderly and profitable is our approach to governance made visible — the state as engineer of the land itself.
entities.name: The Po Delta Reclamation

desc: The University of Ferrara, founded by the Este and among the first of its kind, has attracted humanists and jurists from across Italy to our court. Under the guidance of eminent scholars, our classrooms become workshops of the New Learning, training the lettered servants and diplomats our growing state requires. This institution ensures that knowledge and new institutions spread faster through our lands than in any realm that relies on war alone.
entities.name: Lo Studio di Ferrara

desc: As the free communes transitioned into Signorie (Lordships), the Ferrarese court became a center of Late Medieval chivalry. This was a cultural synthesis of French Arthurian legends and Italian humanist wit. It created a sophisticated courtly etiquette that has become the gold standard for European nobility, turning our court into a diplomatic hub where the 'Art of the Possible' is practiced through refined conversation and artistic patronage.
entities.name: The Curtesia

desc: In general, the lands of Asia are blessed with plentiful rain, and many rivers cross its territories even in areas with less precipitation. Except for some of the most arid areas of the desert, our land provides ample food to our population. Even in those regions where it does not, the people living there are able to do much with what they have.
entities.name: Fertile Lands

desc: ''De jure'' - 'by law' - is a description of legally acknowledged practices regardless of the reality of its practice. The systems of a feudal society are built on this very concept.
entities.name: Feudal 'De Jure' Laws

desc: Feudalism is a political system that is based on service or labor in exchange for holding and working land. It is a collection of rights and obligations to which each member of a structured societal model is bonded.
entities.name: Feudalism

desc: The heretical addition of the ''Filioque'' clause, which states that the Holy Spirit proceeds from the Father 'and the Son', was done without calling the appropriate ecumenical council, and therefore it is illegitimate. We are the guardians of the true prayer, and Rome shall be damned for their heresy!
entities.name: Filioque Issue

desc: Fine Cloth is traditionally a marker of status for the elites and wealthy classes. The Fine Cloth Manufactory focuses on the crafting of these valuable textiles using Cloth or Silk.
entities.name: Fine Cloth Manufactory

desc: Powered by Waterwheels, a Fine Cloth Mill can mass-produce Fine Cloth at rapid speed.
entities.name: Fine Cloth Mill

desc: Easier methods of cleaning fibers and dedicated workshops for the production of Fine Cloth will increase the output of our textile industries.
entities.name: Fine Cloth Workshop

desc: The discovery and development of new metal alloys has made it possible to extract and exploit new fine metals on a larger scale, making the process highly profitable compared to other types of mining.
entities.name: Fine-Metals Mining

desc: How steadily those troops take the ground! How beautifully those cavalry form! Fine horses with well-trained riders are a hallmark of any modern fighting force, and ours are particularly impressive.
entities.name: Finest of Horses

desc: The Finnish cavalry — ''Hakkapeliitta'' — gained a fearsome reputation in wars in Europe These riders, raised in the wild forests and plains of Finland, bring experience, adaptability, and toughness to our ranks. By formalizing their role, we will create a permanent elite force within our armies.
entities.name: Finnish Frontier Cavalry

desc: The rising demands of protecting our borders come with an increase in the production and demand quotas from our military production complex. This need is met by the Firearms Factory where large quantities of guns are made.
entities.name: Firearms Factory

desc: Often described as the lifeblood of our military production complex, the Firearms Manufactory produces firearms of many shapes and sizes such as pistols, rifles, and more.
entities.name: Firearms Manufactory

desc: The great al-Muwaḥḥidūn once prided themselves upon owning one of the most formidable navies in the entire Mediterranean Sea. Our people today still possess the traditions and expertise to reignite that passion and restore our greatness across the oceans.
entities.name: First Fleet of the Mediterranean

desc: Sometimes it is difficult to believe that some of our people were born on land and not in the water, for their bodies swim with such agility that it is nearly impossible to distinguish them from the current of the river. As a result, we are experts at fishing.
entities.name: Fishing Habits

desc: The foundational code of Buddhist ethics and morality, the Five Precepts represent the most basic rules believers must follow in Buddhism, whether part of the ordained monastic community or not. They instruct people to abstain from killing, stealing, sexual misconduct, lying, and intoxication.
entities.name: Five Precepts

desc: The Flemish Cloth industry is the envy of the world. Merchants come from far away to sell their Wool in Flanders, where we manufacture the best quality Cloth.
entities.name: Flemish Cloth

desc: As one of the most prosperous regions on the continents, much of the wealth we have created naturally flows toward artistic patronage. Flemish merchants commission master painters to create art that, while perhaps not practical, casts light over even the cloudiest of days. With dozens of our merchants actively hiring artists and commissioning new pieces, we are creating a distinctive Renaissance of our own.
entities.name: Flemish Renaissance

desc: As our cloth, luxury goods, and financial industries face growing competition, it is becoming obvious that we need to manage our land use better. By creating regional granaries, we further diversify our economy, and bolster our food stores against famine or poor harvests.
entities.name: Prospering Agriculture

desc: The Late Middle Ages saw the birth of a powerful textile industry in the Low Countries. Manufactured from imported English and Castilian wool, fabric of the highest quality were exported to all of Europe.
entities.name: Flemish Cloth Industry

desc: The flesh may be weak and corruptible, but the soul is not. Our armies have learned to fight as if they shared the same soul, and thus their morale can never be broken.
entities.name: Flesh is Weak

desc: Our nation is caught in a conflux between the warring religions of Europe and a variety of foreign threats. The only way we can ensure our survival in this storm is to take a flexible stance towards cooperating with local mercenary bands.
entities.name: Flexible Loyalty

desc: You can never quite predict what could be gained during peace talks, so we should enter with all options open.
entities.name: Flexible Negotiation

desc: With the development of improved flintlock guns and special ammunition for hunting, our hunters will be even more capable of bagging their prey.
entities.name: Improved Hunting Guns

desc: In the house of Count Giovanni de' Bardi, musicians, poets, and scholars have been gathering to recapture what they imagine the performance style of ancient Greek tragedy must have sounded like — a quest that will produce something entirely new and entirely ours. The conversations, experiments, and compositions that emerge from these evenings are drawing gifted performers who value the creative freedom our court offers over the higher wages they might command elsewhere. This circle of artistic innovators, the ''Camerata Fiorentina'', makes our city the origin of a musical revolution that will spread our influence into every court that hears what we have created.
entities.name: The Camerata Fiorentina

desc: The military engineers of our city have mastered the design of low-profile angled bastions whose sloped walls scatter artillery fire and eliminate the blind spots that made older round towers so easy to undermine. Every significant stronghold we build draws on the geometry our architects have refined, producing fortifications that are both cheaper to garrison and far harder for any attacker to breach. This mastery of the ''Trace Italienne'' makes our walls the most modern in Italy and transforms the cost of holding them into a manageable advantage rather than a treasury drain.
entities.name: Florentine Bastions

desc: The great families of our city have built commercial networks that span the continent — agents in London, factors in Bruges, correspondents in Alexandria — so that the letters of exchange bearing our names pass as freely as coin in cities that have never seen our walls. By formalizing and expanding these networks under the protection of our constitutional government, we ensure that our merchants operate from a position of stability and trust that no prince-led rival can easily replicate. This reach of our ''Merchant Houses'' drives the revenue of every trade we conduct and opens the most distant and profitable markets to the goods our workshops produce.
entities.name: Florentine Merchant Houses

desc: Machiavelli's argument against mercenary armies fell for generations on reluctant ears — the guilds preferred to pay condottieri than to march themselves — but the catastrophes of 1494 and 1512 demonstrated at ruinous cost what hired soldiers will and will not die for. We answer by organizing the men of our districts into standing companies, trained and equipped at public expense, whose stake in the defense of Florence is not a monthly wage but their own homes and trades. This commitment to arming our own citizens produces infantry that will hold when paid soldiers would retreat, giving our army a core of men who fight for something that cannot be renegotiated at the end of the campaign season.
entities.name: Florentine Citizen Militia

desc: The workshops of Florence — Giotto, Brunelleschi, Masaccio, Botticelli, and Leonardo — have redefined what painting and sculpture mean to an entire civilization, each generation expanding the boundaries of what the human eye and human hand can achieve in stone, pigment, and bronze. No patron who wishes to be taken seriously commissions a work without first consulting Florentine masters, and our artists carry this reputation wherever they are summoned, turning the name of the city into a credential that outlasts any individual canvas. This unbroken tradition of artistic leadership fills our ateliers with the finest talent in Italy and ensures that the works we produce command the admiration — and the gold — of the most demanding patrons in Christendom.
entities.name: Florentine School

desc: Since 1252, the gold ''Fiorino d'Oro'' struck at our mint has been the most trusted currency in Christendom, accepted without question from the counting houses of London to the bazaars of Alexandria because its weight and purity never varied through the ambitions of a dozen kings. Merchants who trade in florins trade in our reputation — every exchange carried out in our coin is a quiet advertisement for the solidity of Florentine governance and the reliability of the institutions that stand behind it. This universal confidence in our currency smooths every transaction conducted in our courts, and keeps the treasury supplied with the tax revenue that only a genuinely trusted medium of exchange can consistently generate.
entities.name: Fiorino d'Oro

desc: The Folwark System was a system of production that emphasized creating agricultural surpluses. Peasants were encouraged to work through either the use of rents or through compulsion. This system formed the bedrock of our economy.
entities.name: Folwark System

desc: Until recently, land ownership and use was relatively common and free. However, there is now an increasing tendency to start a process of specific land delimitation, clearly determining the borders and size of fields exclusively dedicated to agriculture. With this kind of specified use, their production and exploitation can be greatly increased.
entities.name: Closed Fields

desc: New and improved crops can be introduced to increase agricultural productivity. Whether through selective breeding of existing varieties or importing superior foreign cultivars, we can significantly boost our food production.
entities.name: Market Agriculture

desc: Agriculture is the foundation of most societies. Recent advances have improved the productivity of our fields and farms, creating valuable food surpluses.
entities.name: Intensive Agriculture

desc: We are hunters and live in communion with nature, even those of us dwelling in cities. It is in our blood to find the correct path in a dark forest; to know which of Nature's gifts to take with us. This wisdom lets us survive everywhere without difficulty.
entities.name: Foraging our Way

desc: In our many conquests across Indonesia, we have encountered many new and incredible forms of art, all of which could be adopted and refined by our people to further our legacy. By introducing new techniques and sponsoring artists, our culture will come to exemplify the artistic achievements of our region.
entities.name: Foreign Architectural Influence

desc: As our state grows in size, so does the complexity of our social structures. Cultural unity within our state is no longer a given, and we now require policies to establish and maintain internal peace.
entities.name: Foreign Cultural Law

desc: Diplomacy is a delicate balancing act that requires us to balance the needs and desires of multiple entities at the same time. Maintaining embassies in other countries that report to us on a regular basis will give us the information needed to better weigh our diplomatic options.
entities.name: Foreign Embassies

desc: From foreign scholars and texts, we shall adopt new administrative, military, and scholarly practices, accelerating the pace of our technological development.
entities.name: Foreign Learning

desc: We have recently received an influx of barbarians from foreign lands. Some are merchants but some are fighting men. Let us make use of them in our armies.
entities.name: Foreign Mercenaries

desc: Precious stones have been appreciated by humanity for millennia. By coming into contact with foreign peoples from faraway lands, we can learn not only about the types of Gems they value most, but also about the techniques they use to obtain them.
entities.name: Foreign Mining Techniques

desc: To prevail over our foes, we must establish proper diplomatic channels and official cooperation with countries that share our animosity towards them.
entities.name: Foreign Politics

desc: Our realm has recognized the importance of fostering friendly relations and alliances with neighboring countries. To facilitate this, we will establish a specialized bureau dedicated to foreign affairs. By maintaining a dedicated focus on diplomacy, we are better positioned to navigate the complex web of international relations and secure our nation's prosperity.
entities.name: Foreign Relations Bureau

desc: Correct procedures and a well-oiled administrative apparatus result in a prosperous country, for without a proper administration, anything that the state attempts to accomplish will just remain fruitless. We will formalize and standardize our administration, so that the will of the state flows through it naturally to all corners of the nation.
entities.name: Formal Administration

desc: At a time where power is shifting from the hands of powerful individuals towards control by a centralized authority, it is wise to build bridges and open channels of communication between us and our neighbors. Diplomacy is key, and more so than ever in the face of these rising powers.
entities.name: Formal Diplomacy

desc: Traditionally, our military officers come from the nobility, but we do not have enough people in that estate to fill the necessary roles. However, there are many skilled members of the lower classes in our armies who would do nicely — we should consider promoting some of them as professional officers.
entities.name: Formalized Officer Corps

desc: Establishing formal relations with neighboring countries of interest is crucial if we are to maintain a balance of power and promote our interests.
entities.name: Formalized Relations

desc: Official castellans are appointed to manage local strongholds and their garrisons, marking the first organized framework for the administration and maintenance of fortresses.
entities.name: Castellany System

desc: Regional wardens coordinate multiple castles along frontier marches, establishing supply routes, reporting chains, and mutual defense between neighboring strongholds.
entities.name: Border Wardens

desc: The Crown centralizes oversight of fortifications under a formal bureau in the capital, consolidating records, funds, and maintenance orders into a single administrative authority.
entities.name: Defense Bureau

desc: Professional inspectors travel the realm to evaluate garrisons, stores, and walls, enforcing consistent standards and ensuring the reliability of each fortified place.
entities.name: Inspectors General

desc: National standards for construction and repair are introduced, enabling efficient planning, shared designs, and predictable maintenance across our network of fortresses.
entities.name: Standardized Engineering

desc: Comprehensive mapping and logistical integration link every fortress into a coherent defensive system; an achievement of bureaucracy, science, and state power working in unison.
entities.name: Ordnance Surveys

desc: By ordering our system of fortifications in an organized manner, both construction-wise and logistically, we may save some coin on maintaining it in the long term.
entities.name: Fortification Logistics

desc: Through the ravages of the Hussite Wars, and in an effort to safeguard our faith and people, we funded many fortified towns. Since then, we have gained great expertise in erecting fortifications and engineering impenetrable defenses.
entities.name: Fortified Towns

desc: The Fortress is the most advanced defensive structure, created by military engineers to withhold the power of the most advanced artillery. They are complex compounds, made of interconnected bastions and casemates, which are designed to maximize the defensive firepower.
entities.name: Fortress

desc: The Fortress Church is a building with a dual purpose. It serves its community as a normal church with all its religious functions, but is also used in case of sieges as a defensive building.
entities.name: Fortress Church

desc: We have recognized that spiritual purity alone cannot halt the encroaching craze of the world. To survive, the state has pivoted toward a doctrine of total territorial fortification, transforming the Balkan Mountains into an impassable granite wall. By reinforcing our lands with tiered stone redoubts and permanent garrisons, the nation has created a strategic depth that forces any invader into a lethal war of attrition. This policy ensures that the Bulgarian heartland remains a sanctuary of Orthodox stability, where the flame of our people's heart is shielded behind a ring of iron and stone that no storm can easily douse.
entities.name: Fortress of the Balkans

desc: Only with a formidable standing army will we have the military might necessary to match our ambitions. With careful focus, we can expand it without having a ruinous impact on our state's finances.
entities.name: An Army for Bavaria

desc: This refers to all the politicians, soldiers, diplomats, and others who played an influential role in establishing their nation by winning their country's independence and creating a new system of governance.
entities.name: Founding Fathers

desc: Each presiding over one of the cardinal directions, the Four Heavenly Kings are in charge of protecting the Deva realm from the Asuras. They are also responsible for assessing the virtue and morality of mortals.
