entities.name: Four Heavenly Kings

desc: The foundational teachings of the Buddha, the Four Noble Truths explain the reality of being. Nothing is permanent, which causes pain to the spirit, due to its attachment to this transient existence. This spiritual pain can only be eased by liberating oneself from desire and letting go of these attachments, which is achieved by following the Noble Eightfold Path.
entities.name: Four Noble Truths

desc: We must replace the chaotic patchwork of laws governing our state with a single, unified legal code that applies to our entire population. This ''Code Civil'' will serve as the foundation of our government and establish a just system for everyone in our realm.
entities.name: Code Civil

desc: We trace our nation's lineage back to the empire of Charlemagne, and can therefore claim all those lands to be part of our rightful territory. With the support of dedicated courts, we will be able to identify and re-claim all of this long territory.
entities.name: Historic Claims

desc: Reliance on a levy system has exposed our government to great risks, and has proved to be severely limiting. We should recruit heavily armed cavalrymen and pay them a fixed salary in order to create a standing army.
entities.name: Gendarme Companies

desc: Our influence over other states is undeniable. Why not use this persuasive power to incorporate them directly into our country?
entities.name: Consolidation of the Country

desc: The intendants responsible for collecting the taxes of the people shall not be appointed by the estates, but by our ruler directly. This way, we will ensure these officers will be loyal to the ruler alone, and gather all of the rightful tribute owed.
entities.name: Establishment of Recettes Générales

desc: Direct competition with other maritime powers could be detrimental to our finances. We should empower our mercantile fleet to plunder and seize the merchant ships of our enemies. This will not only ensure a healthy income for our state, but also disrupt the maritime economies of our rivals.
entities.name: Reliance on Privateers

desc: As a nation much enriched by the Renaissance, we should invest in the creation of a unique, distinctively French aesthetic. By inviting foreign artists to our realm and sponsoring a school for artist training directly, we will be able to brand any artistic works produced as identifiably French.
entities.name: Northern Mannerism

desc: Our people have committed a long line of proud knights to Imperial service. They embody knightly ideals that have become less common over time, but remain an essential part of our identity. We have a long history to look at for proper education in both chivalric conduct and military matters. This tradition of Imperial knights naturally increases the willingness of our noble class to contribute levies in hopes of winning glory in honorable combat.
entities.name: Knights of the Empire

desc: The ''bocksbeutel'' is a major part of our winemaking traditions. Being easily recognizable, the shape of this bottle serves as a sort of ambassador for the beautiful wines produced in our region, such as the Silvaner or Riesling. The exemplary talents of our glassmakers and winemakers will surely bring us economic advantages.
entities.name: Silvaner and Bocksbeutel

desc: The original division of the Byzantine Empire in 1204 remains our legal foundation, granting us permanent, divinely sanctioned claims on the remnants of the Greek world. We do not view ourselves as conquerors, but as the rightful heirs to the fiefs assigned to our ancestors by the Latin Emperor and the Venetian Doge. This legal certainty allows us to pursue a relentless policy of expansion and reclamation against any local lords who refuse to acknowledge our feudal suzerainty.
entities.name: Frankokratia

desc: Centuries of living at the crossroads of East and West have taught our merchant class to navigate the most complex trade networks, from the silk routes to the spice markets of the Levant. We act as the essential middlemen between the resource-rich Black Sea and the manufacturing hubs of Western Europe, profiting from every transaction that passes through our ports. Our merchants are as comfortable negotiating with Egyptians as they are with Flemish weavers, ensuring our ports are never empty.
entities.name: Levantine Trades

desc: To maintain power against overwhelming odds, we have integrated the local Prónoia system — granting land in exchange for military service — with the Western tradition of knightly tenure. This creates a hybrid martial class of ''Latinikon'' who are loyal to the Latin Crown, but intimately familiar with the rugged Greek terrain and Eastern tactics. These soldiers combine the heavy shock of the Frankish charge with the endurance and skirmishing capabilities required to hold the Balkan frontiers.
entities.name: Synthesized Levies

desc: The final evolution of our states sees the emergence of a ruling class that is culturally ''Latin'' in its chivalry and faith, but linguistically and socially integrated with the Greek population. By encouraging intermarriage and the adoption of local customs by the lesser nobility, we have ended the era of foreign rule and created a unified national identity. This ''Greco-Latin'' culture is fiercely loyal to its own soil, blending the best of Western feudalism with the resilience of the Greek spirit.
entities.name: The Frankish-Greek Symbiosis

desc: The centuries of struggle have culminated in a unique Eastern European Enlightenment, where the crusading spirit has been replaced by a rationalist, imperialist drive for order. The Frankokratia states are no longer 'crusader outposts' but are now a sophisticated, unified block of powers that blend Western technology with Eastern strategic depth. We have become the definitive bridge between civilizations, a 'Third Way' that is neither purely Western nor purely Byzantine, but something entirely new.
entities.name: The Latin Enlightenment

desc: By installing a Latin Patriarch who respects the ancient Greek liturgy and the Julian calendar while acknowledging Papal supremacy, we bridge the Great Schism within our borders. This ''Uniate'' compromise stabilizes the realm by allowing the Greek peasantry to keep their ancestral rites while ensuring the urban elite remains tied to Rome. It effectively neutralizes the threat of religious revolt and provides a theological justification for our continued rule over the Orthodox heartlands.
entities.name: Union of the Soul

desc: It is a type of [Succession Law] of a Monarchy in which the new [
] ascends to the throne once he has demonstrated that his fortune is superior to the fortunes of his rivals, usually through the elimination of each one of them.
entities.name: Fratricide

desc: Giving our cities self-governance in matters of trade will allow us to open new, profitable trade routes.
entities.name: Free Cities

desc: Only so many people are willing to move abroad to expand our great colonial empire. However, the promise of a plot of land to farm in freehold will encourage many more people to seek their fortunes abroad. The nice thing about this is that there is plenty of land for everyone!
entities.name: Free Colonies

desc: In more reactionary and hidebound societies, merchants are looked down upon as somehow being less than those who own land. Well, this foolish attitude is not for us; we know that wealth is power regardless of where it comes from.
entities.name: Free Merchants

desc: Although giving a servant a damn good thrashing might be satisfying, it is surprisingly not the best way to make them work harder. Some natural philosopher has stumbled upon the idea of making profit the prime motivation for working people. If we replace monetary rents with payment in kind, our peasant laborers will be incentivized to produce more.
entities.name: Free Subjects

desc: The belief that every man is entitled to both freedom of thought and freedom of speech is widely held in our colonies. Without these rights in place, there could be no such thing as civil liberty.
entities.name: Free Thinkers

desc: Our leading merchant families wish to secure trade privileges as their exclusive preserve, but we are unwilling to do so, and will therefore allow the growth of the merchant class.
entities.name: Free Trade

desc: When measured against our adversaries, our need for military reform becomes painfully apparent. By introducing modern drilling techniques, we can transform our troops into a disciplined force capable of destroying any foe in combat.
entities.name: Grande Armée

desc: The aristocrats of our nation have always provided the best soldiers for our armies. Their well-trained fighters will serve our nation and defeat our enemies in the name of righteous glory!
entities.name: A Knightly Nobility

desc: For a long time, Latin has been the language of cultural exchange in Europe... but to be honest, that language is nearly as dead as the ancient Romans who spoke it. We need to find a new ''lingua franca'', and nothing says 'lingua franca' like French.
entities.name: French Language in All Courts

desc: Our diplomatic maneuvers are renowned for their complexity and finesse, and our skilled envoys emulated across the continent. Yet only a fool would become complacent now — we could further refine our diplomacy through measures such as cultivating networks of informants and perfecting the art of negotiation. Let other nations muddle through yesterday's techniques while we pioneer tomorrow's.
entities.name: La Cour de France

desc: It has been proposed that holding religious councils more frequently would prevent theological disputes and criticisms from festering unchecked. While we may not have full control over the curia, we can at least use our influence to encourage regular synods that address relevant issues before they can become crises.
entities.name: Frequent Councils

desc: There is only one path that will lead us to undying, everlasting happiness. To know the divine is to also know its sacred agents on this Earth, who will help us find that path.
entities.name: Friends in High Places

desc: Our Order was formed by faithful souls from every nation in Christendom. This fact, combined with our need for external support to fulfill our missions, have made us adept at recruiting helping hands for our cause. We will take advantage of our omnipresence in Europe to reach the ears of powerful catholic_adj rulers, and sway them to our side.
entities.name: Friends in Need

desc: There are stories in our lands about a pirate who was seven feet tall and strong as an ox. These tales inspire many to take to the seas and do what our ancestors did best: loot unguarded coasts.
entities.name: The Legend of Grutte Pier

desc: Surrounded as we are by enemies, our people are accustomed to aggressively defending their lands, fighting so fiercely that many would-be invaders turn tail and never return. Those who cannot escape us can take comfort in the thought that their blood shall nurture the Frisia soil.
entities.name: Resisting the Invader

desc: Long before the counties south of us developed their own routes, our ancestors dominated coastal trade in Europe, from the Baltic to Biscay. We must revive this ancient maritime expertise to reclaim our rightful position.
entities.name: Trading Traditions

desc: During the long conflicts between France and England, we stood as a strategic battleground. The pressures of war forged a hardened officer corps and traditions of battlefield excellence that endure to this day.
entities.name: Frontline of the Caroline War

desc: As people are rejecting foreign influence in our culture, they are also starting to reject the teachings of Buddhist and Confucianism interfering in our faith. Given this emerging demand for doctrinal purity, a formal revitalization of Shintō might be wise.
entities.name: Fukko Shintō

desc: Artisanal carpentry might not be enough to meet the demand for furniture, especially in urban environments filled with bourgeoisie eager for more specific products. Organizing furniture manufacturing in larger workshops might be necessary to meet this growing demand.
entities.name: Furniture Manufactory

desc: Rising social wealth generates a growing demand for manufactured goods such as furniture. The only way to continue increasing supply may be to produce them in factories using industrial methods.
entities.name: Furniture Mill

desc: With the rising wealth of our burghers so rises their demand for goods like Furniture. Shifting the production into larger workshops will ensure more Furniture can be produced.
entities.name: Furniture Workshop

desc: As the Reformation takes hold and the state assumes control over religious administration, a new responsibility arises for the emerging state: education, which was previously the duty of the Church. We will found princely schools at Pforta, Grimma, and Meissen using former monastic properties. Thus, the state will take on a significant role in shaping the educational landscape, fostering knowledge and intellectual growth for the future leaders of Saxony.
entities.name: Fürstenschule

desc: Despite many attempts by nonbelievers to stop our faith from spreading, it has nevertheless made its way to many different peoples and cultures, bringing light wherever it goes.
entities.name: Further Reaches

desc: By conscripting our able young citizens for our garrisons, we can ensure that we have enough guards to defend our borders.
entities.name: Conscripted Garrisons

desc: Ormus controls the strait that links the Indian Ocean to the interior of Asia. Whoever holds this vital passage dictates the rhythm of maritime traffic. Our command of these waters must be absolute, lest our influence be diminished.
entities.name: Gate of the Persian Gulf

desc: These mountain shooters are unmatched in traversing alpine terrain and besting our foes in the treacherous mountain passes. Their light equipment and loose organization makes them perfectly equipped for high-altitude combat.
entities.name: Gebirgsschützen

desc: The ''Geheimer Rat'' is an elite advisory body composed of high-ranking nobles and officials, serving as the central institution for guiding our political, military, and administrative decisions.
entities.name: Geheimer Rat

desc: As in the case of Brabant, Guelders has traditionally been divided into four quarters. This system of provinces arranged around a strong central city has proven to be an efficient way to govern our nation, and we should apply this system to new regions that join our realm in the future.
entities.name: Expand the Kwarteers

desc: We have expanded our borders not only by the sword, but through careful financial planning, which allowed us to purchase influence over desirable territories — or to buy them outright. With continued wise budget management, this economic trend should be sustainable.
entities.name: A Healthy Economy

desc: Some may call us bellicose, but that is only because they fear our might. A well-trained standing army is essential for survival in this chaotic age. Our adversaries will soon learn to respect our hardened spirit.
entities.name: A Warring Spirit

desc: As the great Atlantic trade routes have drawn commerce away from the Mediterranean, we have answered by declaring our harbor a ''Porto Franco'' — a free port open to merchants of all nations, exempt from the duties and restrictions that weigh down our rivals. Ships that once bypassed Liguria now put in at our quays, and the city fills again with foreign factors, warehouses, and coin. This openness to all comers turns our harbor into one of the busiest entrepôts of the western Mediterranean, drawing trade and people in equal measure.
entities.name: Porto Franco

desc: Waging war cannot wait on the consent of our estates. We will establish a permanent organ of military finance, empowered to levy what the army requires. Our estates may not approve, but a well-funded army wins wars they cannot afford to lose.
entities.name: Kriegskommisariat

desc: As governments grow, so too does the need for a more complex and efficient bureaucracy. By creating specialized departments to handle specific aspects of governance, we can ensure that our administration runs smoothly and effectively.
entities.name: Executive Bureaucracy

desc: Genoese Crossbowmen are a respected military unit that was used by the Genoese during the First Crusade up until now. Equipped with Genoese crossbows and the pavise, these infantrymen serve as the protection of their home as well as mercenaries in Europe.
entities.name: Genoese Crossbowmen

desc: In the turbulent years of the early sixteenth century, ''Andrea Doria'' restructured our republic, consolidating the old noble factions into twenty-eight great houses — the ''Aberghi'' (''Alberghi'' in standard Italian: great houses) — and granting us a political stability we had long been denied. That same pragmatic spirit reshaped our fleet, redirecting our naval expertise toward service across the Mediterranean rather than tying us to a single strategic posture. This reinvention allows us to maintain our navy at reduced cost and to convert our war galleys to lighter vessels when the moment demands it.

mods.label: Can Convert Galley to Light Ships

entities.name: The New Republic

desc: The Genoese Galley is the backbone of the Genoese navy. Lighter and longer than other galleys used in the Mediterranean Sea, this ship is able to achieve unmatched speed while also having a significant cargo advantage at the cost of maneuverability and durability.
entities.name: Genoese Galley

desc: We have built our republic on the twin pillars of commerce and credit, pioneering instruments of debt and exchange that have funded our trading posts from the ''Levant'' to the Black Sea since the early Middle Ages. Our colonies and comptoirs across the Mediterranean are as much diplomatic outposts as commercial ones, granting us a reach that no purely military power could match. This network of finance and statecraft ensures our bankers and envoys work as one, reducing the cost of credit and keeping more ambassadors in our service.
entities.name: La Superba

desc: The prosperity of centuries of trade has made Genoa a city of collectors and patrons, and from this milieu there has emerged a distinct ''Genoese School'' of painting celebrated for its mastery of dramatic light and rich texture. Artists nurtured in our republic have carried Genoese taste and prestige to courts and collections across Europe. This flourishing of artistic culture deepens our traditions and extends our influence far beyond what politics alone can achieve.
entities.name: Genoese School

desc: A dynasty so old that its origins are shrouded in mystery, kings and queens of the Bagrationi house have ruled Georgia ever since the 9th century, first as its princes and then as monarchs.
entities.name: Bagrationi Dynasty

desc: Georgia has been a haven for Christianity in the Caucasus for centuries, even after being surrounded and isolated by followers of Islam. The ardent faith of our people is a source of inspiration for all our religious brethren.
entities.name: Beacon of Christianity

desc: Georgia has experienced tumultuous centuries since the Mongol invasion, marked by periodic division, shifting external pressures, and the rising influence of the local nobility. The old Georgian feudal system has been made obsolete, or at least partially discarded. The Dasturlamali, a comprehensive set of rules and guidelines detailing the obligations of subjects and nobles toward king and state, strengthens internal order and serves as the foundation for our kingdom's legal framework.
entities.name: Dasturlamali

desc: Considered the greatest ruler in the history of our country, King Davit the Builder brought Georgia to its pinnacle. He built a powerful, culturally influential kingdom, and a beacon for Christianity and the Georgian people.
entities.name: Davit the Builder

desc: We have a tradition of establishing strong diplomatic ties with all nations around us, regardless of our possible differences. As a result, our diplomats are always well received and respected.
entities.name: Georgian Embassies

desc: Georgia enjoyed a cultural and religious Golden Age that was brought to a sudden stop, due to the Mongol invasions. That period witnessed the peak of our cultural achievements, but we will now return to it, and achieve even greater heights.
entities.name: Georgian Golden Age

desc: The lands of Georgia are nestled among the Caucasus Mountains, and no foreign power has ever found it easy to penetrate our territory. Our tenacity and resilience are legendary.
entities.name: Georgian Highlands

desc: Surrounded by powerful countries with vastly different religions and cultures from ours, we are forced to use opportunistic diplomacy, and often change allegiances in order to appease everyone and preserve peace for as long as possible.
entities.name: Georgian Isolation

desc: Our country has a rich tradition of minting coins, inscribing them not only in Georgian but also in Arabic and Persian, as they serve as currency for trade through our country and those that neighbor us.
entities.name: Georgian Numismatics

desc: Our regional administration is divided into many different principalities and territories. Delegating authority this way allows us to exert our rule more effectively.
entities.name: Georgian Principalities

desc: Our country has been torn apart, by external and internal influences, more than once in its long history. However, like the phoenix of legend, it has risen from the ashes and established itself as a presence to reckon with each time. The resilience of our people is commendable.
entities.name: Georgian Resilience

desc: The 'Georgian alphabet', created centuries ago, is not just one alphabet, but in fact three. ''Mkhedruli'' is the script used by the civil administration, while ''Asomtavruli'' and ''Nuskhuri'' is used by our church. As such, our Holy Scriptures can remain uninfluenced by the lay language, while our people can still feel connected to them.
entities.name: Georgian Script

desc: 'King of Kings, strong and invincible, majestic and protector of the holy kingdom of the Abkhazians, Iberians, Ranis, Kakhetians, Armenians, Shahanshah and Shirvanshah, of the East and the West, of the South and the North, of both countries, of two thrones and crowns, the godlike Suzerain and the Sovereign of the Throne.' The titles of our ruler are numerous, and all at court shall respect them!
entities.name: Georgian Titles

desc: Georgia has been divided in the past, both by foreign influences and internal causes. But the patriotic Georgian people are more than willing to fight to ensure that Georgia is never divided again.
entities.name: Georgian Unification

desc: Our association with the legendary Saint George is well known through both the Christian and Muslim worlds. As he bravely faced and slew the fearsome dragon, so will our soldiers face our enemies in battle.
entities.name: Legacy of Saint George

desc: Georgia has one of the oldest Christian churches in the world, tracing its roots back to the conversion of the region by Saint Nino over a millennium ago. Through the centuries, the Georgian Church has served as an increasingly unifying force in all Georgian states, and has served as a central element in Georgian culture in the face of Byzantine, Mongol, and Muslim influence. With few other Christian kingdoms left in this region, and given the splintered loyalties within Georgia, the Church still plays an important role as a unifying force against outsiders.
entities.name: Legacy of Saint Nino

desc: Tamar was one of the greatest rulers our nation ever had. Her military and cultural successes are legendary, and the mere utterance of her name still stirs reverence in all Georgian hearts.
entities.name: Legacy of Tamar

desc: Our many fortresses and churches have helped our country to resist and continue to survive among encroaching foreign influences. Our fortresses protect the land while our churches protect our spirit, and we must keep both in prime condition if we are to thrive.
entities.name: Restoration of Fortresses and Churches

desc: ''Sadrosho'', banners, are special military districts used for mobilization purposes. By dividing our territory into several sadrosho, each under the command of their own dedicated military official, we can better organize the recruitment and distribution of all our troops.
entities.name: Sadrosho Districts

desc: Harsh climates breed hardy people. Traversing the cold Baltic Sea has certainly left its mark on our sailors, making them mentally resilient and particularly skilled at their profession. This is for their ultimate benefit, as the sea can be a merciless mistress.
entities.name: Baltic Sailors

desc: The Biedermeier period marks a shift in social conservatism stemming from the upper classes and their nostalgia for the time when they held the most influence and power in our country. This social change has led our more free-thinking citizens to shroud their creative and intellectual pursuits in relative secrecy, well out of the public's disapproving gaze. While this inadvertently strengthens the development of a cultural identity amongst our merchants, it has also forced many valuable minds to leave our nation, seeking their lost freedoms — and taking their talents — elsewhere.
entities.name: Biedermeier

desc: Imperial fairs are a rare privilege granted to only a few select cities, creating some of the largest marketplaces in Europe and making these cities the commercial heart of the Holy Roman Empire. The centralized nature of these markets allows merchants to plan and negotiate effectively in a setting where they can benefit from freedom and access to a diverse variety of goods.
entities.name: Reichsmessestädte

desc: Since Roman times, road networks have connected places across Germany, making trade and travel easier and more accessible. These roads also provide critical logistical advantages, particularly when moving troops.
entities.name: Imperial Road Network

desc: A small castle placed on a crucial mountain pass facilitates control over passing traders, granting our state a vital share of the local trade income.
entities.name: Mountain Toll Castle

desc: By encouraging settlement in rural areas and giving the people land to work there will be a great foundation to slowly but surely increase the wealth and productivity of our more sparsely populated territories.
entities.name: Attracting the Right People

desc: A small castle placed along the river facilitates control over passing traders, granting our state a vital share of the local trade income.
entities.name: River Toll Castle

desc: In keeping with steppe traditions, our nobles are warriors of the frontier, and we shall be fearless in the fight to expand the Abode of Islam.
entities.name: Ghazi

desc: While our people are now united, the act of bending the knee to a common overlord has not come easy to them. By summoning all subjugated rulers to the capital, we can employ them as prestigious royal envoys. Some would call this a policy of hostage-taking; we simply see it as a way to remind our more independent-minded subjects of their loyalties.
entities.name: Gifts and Hostages

desc: Dedicated Glass Mill industries will be able to increase our production of Glass further than ever before. By rolling molten glass on iron tables, we will not only be able to increase the size of our produced Glass but also significantly speed up the manufacturing process.
entities.name: Glass Mill

desc: Glass is a vital part of the every-day needs of our entire population. The increased capabilities of the Glass Workshop will ensure that our efforts will not grind to halt.
entities.name: Glass Workshop

desc: Refinement of traditional Glassblowing techniques and the addition of new materials make it easier to mass-produce Glass.
entities.name: Glassworks

desc: Our great country is also called the Kipchak Khanate, ruling over all the territories of the Cuman-Kipchak Confederation. With such swathes of land under our command, the armies we can gather will be innumerable.
entities.name: Kipchak Khanate

desc: After Genghis Khān died, his son Jochi also passed not long after. However, his presence and legacy are still felt in our country, to the point that we are still known as the Ulus of Jochi. Warriors flock to our banners to uphold that legacy.
entities.name: Legacy of Jochi

desc: We were one of the main constituent parts of Genghis Khān's empire, and we represent the main political force in Eastern Europe and the Steppes. The world shall tremble before us!
entities.name: Legacy of the Golden Horde

desc: It was long ago that Genghis Khān's armies first seized control of the steppes. Our country has since surpassed our ancestor's every expectation, and now we stand as a global power on our own merit. We shall now begin the process of modernizing our territories, so that one day we shall be the beacon of all the world.
entities.name: Modernization of the Steppes

desc: Our ancestors refined our administrative system over the centuries, and they were not shy about incorporating the ideas and methods of the cultures they subdued. Our current system of administration is in part based on traditions dating back to the Great Genghis Khān himself, and in part on what we have adopted from Persian and Muslim bureaucrats in the lands conquered.
entities.name: Perso-Mongol Administration

desc:
Constraining, inflexible doctrine has never won many admirers among the Tatar hordes. When the Great Öz Beg Khān adopted Islam, it was the faith of a Sufi Shaykh or a zealous Qāḍī that he invited into his lands.

Centuries of tradition and loyalty are what we would rather build our state upon. Religion has a part to play, but we would prefer to see our country thrive than to fall apart in the chaos of forced religious homogeneity.
entities.name: Religious Pragmatism

desc: Not all riches in this world originate in our territory. Trade is the source of all wealth, and the Golden Horde has always protected merchants. By ensuring the safety of anyone who wishes to move goods through our country, we can ensure a steady stream of furs, silk, spices, and other necessities to our cities. Whether they choose to sell their goods to us or not, their mere presence will generate wealth for our people.
entities.name: Secure the Trade Routes

desc: Our empire may no longer be ruled from horseback, but our armies remain masters of the mount. Over the centuries, we have stayed true to our origins, ensuring that few can match the skill of our riders. As we go forward and adopt new technology and tactics when needed, we build on the strong organization and martial traditions of the Mongol Empire.
entities.name: Tatar Traditions

desc: Members of our merchant class rely on their abilities to make a living, and those abilities in turn depend on their having had a thorough education in certain fields. Their increased wealth also increases their demand for any literature that might broaden their written culture.
entities.name: Merchant Literature

desc: Clerics are required to be literate by the nature of their occupation, which centers around learning, interpreting, and spreading their religious doctrine. Therefore, their spiritual formation and overall efficacy relies heavily on their access to religious doctrine and teachings.
entities.name: Clerical Literature

desc: Our commitment to our colonial empire has transformed attitudes towards working in the colonial administration. No longer seen as a haven for fortune-seeking freebooters, it is now regarded as a prestigious career for the brightest and best. This shift is reflected in more efficient tax collection.
entities.name: Global Empire

desc: The nobles are increasingly changing their primary function from being warriors to courtiers in the direct service of their ruler, leading them to give more importance to intellectual matters than military concerns. This has created a demand for engaging literature that appeals to their aristocratic sensibilities.
entities.name: Nobiliary Literature

desc: Land warfare is becoming more dependent on supplying bigger and bigger armies. Therefore, better organization of our supply carts would lead to an increased operational capacity.
entities.name: Supply Lines

desc: How far an army can march is a consequence of its logistics. With proper study and planning, armies can withstand longer and more distant campaigns.
entities.name: Army Logistics Planning

desc: Planning the logistics of warfare has become increasingly complex, as the growth in average army size has made it possible to field several armies at once for long-term campaigns, involving hundreds of thousands of soldiers for multiple years.
entities.name: Campaign Logistics Planning

desc: Goods have been moved across continents since antiquity, but all trade is now increasingly becoming part of a greater world network. It may still be early to speak of a truly global economy, but surely the first seeds have been sown.
entities.name: Global Trade

desc: The world has become larger, thanks to so many new discoveries, but it has also grown smaller with the proliferation of international trade routes. With ships constantly carrying goods and people to and from far away lands, those distant shores actually seem closer than before.
entities.name: Overseas Trade Routes

desc: The sight of our glorious and prestigious army will make all adversaries tremble in fear.
entities.name: Glorious Arms

desc: The great popes of our age have transformed ''Roma'' from a city of medieval ruins into the most magnificent court in Christendom — commissioning artists, architects, and scholars to fill the Vatican with beauty that will outlast any dynasty and draw the eyes of Europe to the Apostolic See. We build on the bones of the ancient empire deliberately, wrapping our spiritual authority in the prestige of classical civilization and ensuring that every ambassador who enters our city understands he is visiting a power with roots older than any kingdom he serves. This investment in permanent magnificence means our prestige does not diminish with the passing of individual popes, because what we have built speaks for itself long after the man who commissioned it is gone.
entities.name: Glory of Rome

desc: The twin gold fields at Bambuk and Bure are renowned as the largest gold deposits anyone has ever heard of, and they belong to us! Bure's gold mines in particular produced fantastic wealth that famously destabilized the entire Egyptian economy through inflation when Mansa Mūsā visited there. Our economy, though, is used to a constant influx of gold, and is more difficult to inflate.
entities.name: Gold of Bure

desc: Some say that Salt is worth its weight in Gold... perhaps it would be more accurate to say that Gold is worth its weight in Salt. Either way, by exchanging these two commodities, we have established thriving trade networks.
entities.name: Gold to Salt Trade

desc: One of Europe's foremost chivalric orders. Being a Knight of the Golden Fleece is a mark of great status, and reflects well upon us.
entities.name: The Order of the Golden Fleece

desc: Although it looks rather odd, the 'goose step' is specifically designed to facilitate our men holding their line as they advance towards the enemy. This provides our armies with a tangible advantage on the battlefield.
entities.name: The Goose Step

desc: Our people stand at the threshold of a new era. In order to harness our internal capabilities, we must adapt our government and refine our administrative domain.
entities.name: Early Administrative Reformation

desc: Current events have determined that rulers need to approach the management of the state more systematically, taking into account both the different estates of the country, and the distinct diplomatic actors that surround them.
entities.name: The Prince

desc: Our people are always eager to celebrate any good tidings, be they in honor of our country or to mark days on the calendar. Instead of letting them hold these joyful gatherings on their own, we should have our administration organize grand public celebrations, so that we can show our people we care about them while fostering a greater sense of unity between them at the same time.
entities.name: Government-Sanctioned Celebrations

desc: Concentrating power in the hands of the rulers allows them to take direct action, but they still need people under them to help carry out those actions. Giving those subordinates no real power, while making them unfailingly loyal to the ruler, allows the Crown to host more of them without fear of infighting or discontent.
entities.name: Loyal Subordinates

desc: Our domain consists of many administrative sectors, and as we expand it, we must make the necessary adjustments to our government to account for this growth.
entities.name: Early Administrative Capacity

desc: Rulers traditionally had a council of advisors to counsel them through making important decisions. Over time, our government has grown so complex that we need to establish more permanent advisory positions to help us deal with day-to-day governance.
entities.name: Permanent Cabinet

desc: With the establishment of official forms of popular representation, the government is better able to address important issues than ever before.
entities.name: Modern Representation

desc: The 'Five Mountains System' originated in China from state-sponsored Chán Buddhist monasteries, atop the holy mountains that gave the system its name. In Japan, the practice continued in the Kamakura period by the sponsoring of the Zen temples, the Five Mountains of Kyōto and the Five Mountains of Kamakura. By maintaining our sponsorship of such institutions, we can use them to help stabilize our rule.
entities.name: Gozan Jissetsu

desc: Al-'Andalus was once a center for learning, home to exceptional scholars like 'Aḥmad Ibn Rušd, 'Abū al-Qāsim, and Muḥammad bin Ṭufayl. We should endeavor to continue this long-standing intellectual tradition.
entities.name: A New Golden Era

desc: For decades, generations of our ruling family have fought incessantly with each other, destabilizing our nation. It is about time a powerful ruler decisively asserted their authority, proving they are the only one who can keep the peace and bring prosperity to our nation.
entities.name: A Strong Rule

desc: Our privileged position as middlemen between Christian and Muslim nations is being challenged. This threat could be an opportunity to modernize our trade methods and recover our position as a link between more distant markets and Europe.
entities.name: Adaptive Trade

desc: We descend from the Banū l-Ḫazraj tribe and come from the lineage of Saʿd ibn ʿUbāda, a companion of the Prophet Muhammad. The founder of our dynasty, Muhammad I, controlled a territory that included Granada, Jaén, Almería, and Málaga, though some of those lands fell to the Christian forces. Since then, we have been resisting their advances with tenacity, and we will continue doing so with the strength of our ancestors.
entities.name: Banū Naṣr

desc: The lands of Granada are fertile, but expanding our irrigation canals would allow us to make better use of our water supply, and grow better-quality crops as a result.
entities.name: Expand the Qanāh

desc: Since the foundation of our dynasty, our territorial holdings have been shrinking. However, we are now in a stronger position, capable of not only recovering every piece of lost land, but enlarging our realm even beyond those original borders.
entities.name: Expand the Frontier

desc: As the descendants of the warriors who fought under the Prophet, we must defend our realm with similar bravery. Every battle for Granada is a ''ghazawat'' — a holy struggle to preserve Islam against the onslaught of Christianity.
entities.name: Nasrid Ghazawat

desc: Modern times demand a modern economy, capable of thriving in a highly competitive environment. By upgrading our infrastructure and making our production methods and processes more efficient, we will maximize production using the same amount of resources.
entities.name: Modernized Economy

desc: Granada has a limited number of people, and we cannot draft enough soldiers to defend our nation effectively. However, where we lack people, we do not lack gold, and that can be used to bring mercenary swords under our banners.
entities.name: Mutawwi'a Armies

desc: The artisans and architects of Granada are the most skillful in the world. They create things that are not only useful, but pleasing to the eye, beautifully combining form and function.
entities.name: Nasrid Art

desc: The borders of our enemies are tantalizing opportunities for us. Should we boldly strike with lightning attacks, we can catch the enemy off-guard and inflict lasting damage.
entities.name: Nasrid Razzias

desc: Our skillful use of diplomacy has been the deciding factor between life or death many times before. But we must not let ourselves be lulled into complacency; we must train our envoys even more to ensure their success.
entities.name: Skillful Envoys

desc: Although they were quick to brand us as heretics, Miaphysitism did not cut ties with the rest of the Christian world instantly. We kept in contact with the other patriarchates, and attended the councils, but it was gradually made clear that Miaphysitism is too different from those heretical beliefs.
entities.name: Gradual Departure

desc: The fertile fields of our domain are home to Europe's richest grain crops, in part thanks to the Folwark System. Through our grace, we supply the markets beyond our borders, ensuring our people continue to prosper and never go hungry.
entities.name: Granary of Europe

desc: Allows us to create one of the largest and most powerful armies the world has ever seen.
entities.name: Grand Army

desc: No important matter can be discussed without an accompanying meal, and the more important the matter is, the more indulgent the meal should be. Having regular grand banquets allows us to constantly and properly discuss all matters that need consideration.
entities.name: Grand Banquets

desc: Maintaining control over our territories, policymaking, and military operations is vital for the continuation of our dynasty. Through the creation of Grand Coordinators, a body of high-ranking officials who can coordinate governance across our vast empire, we will succeed in cementing our position through effective stabilization of internal and external matters.
entities.name: Grand Coordinators

desc: To honor God, we need to construct great monuments in His name. Not only will this display our devotion to our faith, but it will also demonstrate the magnificent skills of our sculptors and architects.
entities.name: Grand Displays of Faith

desc: Leading troops is the most important duty for the Grand Duke, who is appointed to rule over the Veche Republic. Under such strong and experienced leadership, our armies will become far more deadly in battle.
entities.name: Grand Duke's Army

desc: This is a grand place of commerce, where deals and exchanges flourish.
entities.name: Grand Marketplace

desc: Our illustrious military history of our people is a great source of inspiration and pride for our people. By conducting elaborate parades to showcase our armies, we will decisively demonstrate our martial experience and unparalleled strength.
entities.name: Grand Military Parades

desc: Allows us to create one of the largest and most powerful navies the world has ever seen.
entities.name: Grand Navy

desc: This massive port infrastructure is a sight to behold, with innumerable vessels and sailors coming and going at any given time. Its ability to build and repair whole fleets make it a pinpoint for our expanding maritime power.
entities.name: Grand Shipyard

desc: By formally codifying the societal roles of each estate in written law, we will clarify their exact privileges and obligations. When rights and responsibilities are clearly defined, each estate knows exactly what it is owed and what it owes in return, and therefore it will be easier for us to grant new privileges without sparking rivalries.
entities.name: Codified Privileges and Duties

desc: We have revolutionized the agriculture of Greece, moving away from subsistence farming toward high-value export crops, specifically the famous ''Malvasia'' wine and sun-dried currants. By investing in modern irrigation and processing techniques, we have made our agricultural products a staple of the European luxury market. The resulting economic boom funds a professional standing army and allows us to maintain a courtly splendor that rivals the great kings of the West.
entities.name: Greek Viticulture

desc: The dream of a restored Hellenic world, stretching from the Ionian to the Anatolian coast, has become the guiding star of our national policy. We have developed a legal and historical framework that justifies our expansion into all lands once held by our ancestors, framing our conquests as 'liberations'. This ideological fervor drives our administration to integrate new territories with unprecedented speed, as the populace welcomes their return to the Hellenic fold.
entities.name: Megali Idea Realized

desc: We have looked to the golden age of the Middle Byzantine period to solve our manpower crisis. By granting hereditary land plots to ''Akritai'' (border guards) in exchange for perpetual military service, we create a self-sustaining defense force deeply rooted in the soil they protect. This system reduces our reliance on expensive mercenaries and ensures that every province has a dedicated militia capable of holding the line until the main imperial army arrives.
entities.name: Rebuilding the Theme System

desc: To survive the chaos of the Fourth Crusade, the scattered Greek fragments must return to the principle of a single, absolute Basileus. We have dismantled the local ''Archon'' rivalries that allowed the Latins to conquer us piecemeal, re-establishing a central court that commands absolute loyalty. This centralization of power ensures that the state speaks with one voice and acts with one sword, suppressing the internal bickering that once bled the Empire dry.
entities.name: Restoration of Power

desc: A unified Greece must be the master of the 'Inner Sea' if it is to survive between the giants of East and West. We have established a centralized Admiralty in Piraeus, standardizing ship construction and training a professional officer corps in the latest navigational sciences. By merging the speed of the galley with the firepower of the galleon, we create a fleet that is both agile in the Aegean winds and formidable in the open Mediterranean.
entities.name: The Hellenic Admiralty

desc: As gunpowder reshapes the battlefields of Europe, we have synthesized Western musket drills with our traditional tactical manuals. Our infantry, the ''New Stratikon'', are trained to maintain rigid discipline under fire, mimicking the legendary resilience of the ancient phalanx but armed with modern harquebuses and pikes. This professionalization of the rank-and-file ensures that we are no longer a medieval relic, but a modern military powerhouse capable of standing toe-to-toe with any empire.
entities.name: The New Stratikon

desc: If we are to survive and continue to prosper, our governmental mechanism must run efficiently and be based on robust foundations. The parliament shall adopt modernized procedures and strengthen its authority. The goals of this evolution are to curtail the power of the nobility and mitigate the escalating abuses of serfdom.
entities.name: Great Sejm Reforms

desc: Our wealthy nation has ample coin and bounteous, fertile fields, but all this abundance requires comprehensive taxation. The Great Tax Reform enables more efficient revenue management, which should guarantee a healthier budget for our realm.
entities.name: Great Tax Reform

desc: Sera, Ganden, and Drepung, these towering monastic universities form the intellectual heart of Tibet. Their scholars train one generation after another of monks, diplomats, and rulers. With their rise, our realm became not only a bastion of faith but a cradle of rigorous thought and institutional progress.
entities.name: The Three Great Seats

desc: The jagged coastlines and thousands of islands of the Aegean are our natural fortifications. We have transformed our maritime culture into a defensive doctrine, where every merchant vessel is armed and every fisherman is a potential marine. By patrolling the narrow straits and hidden coves, we ensure that any hostile fleet attempting to move through our waters is subjected to constant harassment. This decentralized naval power makes our maritime heartland nearly impossible to occupy.
entities.name: Aegean Coastal Defense

desc: In an era of political decay, the spiritual movement of Hesychasm, championed by Grēgórios Palamâs, provides a profound inner strength. By focusing on the 'uncreated light' through silent prayer, our people find a unity that transcends failing borders and imperial intrigue. The monasteries of Mount Athos become the spiritual nerve centers of the Greek world, ensuring that neither the Pope's emissaries nor the Sultan's janissaries can break the religious cohesion of our populace.
entities.name: Hesychast Traditions

desc: The rugged landscape of the Balkans has birthed a unique class of warrior: the Stratioti. These light cavalrymen, often wearing a mix of Byzantine armor and local attire, are masters of the 'hit and run' tactics necessary to harass larger, slower Western or Ottoman armies. Their reputation for ferocity and scouting excellence makes them indispensable, turning the tide of mountain battles where heavy knights flounder. They are the vanguard of a Greek military resurgence.
entities.name: Stratioti Levies

desc: The ''Diafotismós'' brings the fire of Western scientific inquiry back to the lands where philosophy was born. Greek intellectuals ship thousands of books back to the homeland, sparking a massive educational reform. This movement replaces old superstitions with the ideals of liberty, equality, and a renewed Hellenic identity. The resulting national awakening transforms our subjects into citizens, ready to fight for a modern, enlightened state.
entities.name: The Modern Greek Enlightenment

desc: Within the narrow streets of the Phanar district, a new class of Greek merchant-diplomats has risen to prominence. Leveraging their literacy and linguistic skills, these families have made themselves indispensable to the administrative machinery of the Mediterranean powers. They serve as dragomans, governors, and financiers, creating a shadow empire of influence that spans from the Danube to the Nile. Their secret correspondence provides our state with unparalleled intelligence and diplomatic leverage.
entities.name: The Phanariote Network

desc: The fall of Constantinople at the hands of the crusaders was not the end of the Roman soul, but its crucible. Across the fragmented themes, a fierce ''Ethnos'' begins to coalesce, defined by a refusal to bow to the Latin ''Frankokratia''. This defiance manifests as a spiritual and physical mobilization, where every village becomes a cell of resistance against the crusader lords. By clinging to our rites and language, we turn local skirmishes into a holy war for the restoration of our rightful heritage.
entities.name: The Spirit of Resistance

desc: Our rites and canonical practices have been for centuries well-defined following the Greek rites of Constantinople. Although there may be some small variations in certain places, there is remarkable homogeneity in the rites performed throughout Orthodoxy.
entities.name: Greek Rite

desc: The Green Standard Army, a military force mainly composed of ethnic Hàn soldiers, coexists with our Eight Banner armies. Originally formed by surrendered troops and recruited on a voluntary, long-term basis, they attract individuals from socially disadvantaged backgrounds. Used as a police force post-consolidation, they will play a crucial role in local military governance, while Bannermen will be reserved for emergencies and sustained resistance.
entities.name: Green Standard Army

desc: Although not technically the same substance as Alum, Green Vitriol has been traditionally conflated with it in alchemical writings, and both have similar properties. As such, it is not uncommon to use one as a substitute for the other.
entities.name: Green Vitriol

desc: The ''griots'' are storytellers, historians, counselors, musicians, and poets all at once. They safeguard the stories and legends of past generations, mediate between warring parties, and serve both their rulers and local people as advisors.
entities.name: Griots

desc: As successors to the ancient cities of Carthage and Kairouan, we bear the mantle of guardianship over the heart of the Maghreb. Our rule brings stability, and shall be welcomed by all in a once-contested region.
entities.name: Guardians of Ifrīqya

desc: The fortress of Athlone, standing astride the mighty river Shannon, is the key to controlling the heart of Ireland. The O'Kellys of Hy Many, long-standing lords of these lands, have fought fiercely to defend their holdings against Norman incursions.
entities.name: Guards of the Shannon

desc: A guild is an association of merchants or craftsmen who have come together for mutual protection, aid, and for the pursuit of their own interests. Guilds establish monopolies of their goods and trade, and set standards for the quality and price of trade goods.

mods.label: Possible Burghers in Towns and Cities

entities.name: Guilds

desc: Originating out of the worship dances done by women in praise of the Hindu goddess Ambaji, our people have refined a new and very graceful form of dance called the Garba. The basics of the dance are singing and clapping rhythmically in a circular formation. Today, our men and women use this dance to celebrate any occasion with great fervor, coming together as a community and wearing exquisitely embroidered outfits. All of us together, young and old, peasant and prince, Muslim and Hindu, dancing in an ever-growing circle.
entities.name: Garba!

desc: The Gujarati Lipi is a new script and writing system developed by mercantile interests. Also known as the ''saraphi'' (bankers), ''vaniasai'' (merchants), or ''mahajani'' (traders) script due to its association with commerce, its use has rapidly become widespread throughout Gujarat, Kutch, and Sindh for writing regional languages and studying Sanskrit. The Zoroastrianism community has also adopted it as a writing system for Avestan. This common writing system unites diverse communities, facilitating both practical communication and a common identity.
entities.name: Gujarati Lipi

desc: Our people trade on every shore, pursuing commerce and following the trade winds. Our fleets sail constantly in pursuit of new opportunities, and our merchants understand both the craft of shipbuilding and the value of building good, hardy ships on a limited budget.
entities.name: Gujarati Merchant Diaspora

desc: Due to the nature of the monsoon tradewinds and its specific location, Gujarat has long served as the hub of the East-West trade in the Indian Ocean, connecting the Red Sea, Egypt, and Malacca. Due to this, Gujarat merchants were important middlemen bringing such precious goods as spices from the Maluku Islands and Silk from China, and then selling them to the merchants coming from the west.
entities.name: Hub of the Indian Ocean Trade

requires.label: Hub of the Indian Ocean Trade

desc: Jainism is an ancient way of life, shaped into its current form by Mahavira. For a thousand years, Gujarat has been the stronghold of the Jain community and faith, with many holy sites and temples. Royal dynasties have patronized the religion, forming a community with the Hindu people. Muslim invasions from the west by Mahmud Ghazni and Mohammad Ghori, oppressed the Jain community, vandalizing temples or converting them into mosques, as well as burning Jain libraries. However, the Jain people of Gujarat have survived, adapted, and prospered, using their connections with Jain communities across the world to serve as a hub for both faith and commerce.
entities.name: Jain Connections

desc: A large-scale factory where cannons were manufactured in bulk. Its expanded production capacity is a great way to facilitate the growing needs of our military forces.
entities.name: Gun Factory

desc: Dedicated to the production and maintenance of firearms, the Gunsmith produces various quality firearms as well as related components such as barrels, locks, and triggers.
entities.name: Gunsmith

desc: The usage of gunpowder on the battlefield will certainly have a positive impact on our performance and allow us to excel in military engagements.
entities.name: Gunpowder

desc: Gunpowder may have been invented in the Far East, but it was through Islam that it became widely used throughout the world. Gunpowder weapons have been a staple of our armies for generations, and its production and use is one of our defining characteristics.
entities.name: Gunpowder Empires

desc: The ever-increasing demand of guns for our armies requires us to increase the capabilities of the Firearms production.
entities.name: Guns Workshop

desc: Gustavus Adolphus, ruler of Sweden, made several innovations to his infantry that improved their performance. His formations were narrowed and made rectangular to increase the number of muskets that could fire in each volley, and the attachment of small artillery pieces further increased their firepower.
entities.name: Gustavian Infantry

desc: Our people are highly adapted to traverse the obstacles of our country, from the high peaks and passes of our mountains to the wide rivers of our valleys.
entities.name: Land of Mountains and Rivers

desc: Given our location at the center of all Europe, we must adopt a highly flexible attitude towards external diplomacy. Alliances and rivals can shatter as easily as they are formed, and our diplomats must be trained to cover every possible position.
entities.name: Austrian Diplomatic Expertise

desc: Hachiman is one of the most venerated divinities. Originally a deification of Ōjin Tennō, after the introduction of Buddhism he was later also identified as a Bodhisattva. He is the protector of the Imperial line and the tutelary god of the warrior class.
entities.name: Hachiman Worship

desc: Our lively urban settlements are full of potential. With just a little effort, we can make them and their hinterlands incredibly wealthy, allowing us to thoroughly tax them.
entities.name: Bustling Towns

desc: Our rulers have always been skillful with their words, and their diplomatic acumen has established their influence far beyond our national borders. As time goes on and geopolitical pressures intensify, we must start cultivating friendship with other nations for protection while expanding our sphere of influence.
entities.name: Expert Ambassadors

desc: As a border province of the Holy Roman Empire, Hainaut has developed a rough-and-ready spirit, born from centuries of frontier conflict. This spirit makes our people naturally inclined towards taking defensive action, which we can exploit to our benefit.
entities.name: A Frontier March

desc: Finland is considered a rather poor and backwards region, but service in the Swedish cavalry offers skilled Finnish horsemen ample opportunities for glory and plunder. Superior horsemanship and high-quality mounts allow us to raise the feared ''Hakkapeliitta'' — cavalry so effective in battle that our enemies whisper they must be protected by witchcraft.
entities.name: Hakkapeliitta

desc: Our country survives through its strong ties to maritime trade and the constant exchange of goods. To maintain an orderly harbor, we will need to dredge fresh waterways and build more docks and warehouses, attracting new merchants and their ships.
entities.name: Port Networks

desc: Primitive metal tubes which were a lesser form of later, more advanced guns. First developed in China, the early hand cannon spread to Goryeo and Japan in 1270.
entities.name: Hand Cannon Guild

desc: In our faith, the practice of ''Harae'', or ritual purification, is key to removing all ''tsumi'', sins, and ''kegare'', spiritual uncleanness. Mandating that our population performs the Harae rituals properly and frequently ensures that our country remains spiritually pure.

mods.label: Cost of Cleansing Ritual Religious Action

entities.name: Harae

desc: Islam has, since its inception, found its way to civilizations in some of the harshest environments of the world. If anyone from outside our region tries to invade our territories, they will find it fiendishly difficult — as they should!
entities.name: Harsh Environments

desc: The Haudenosaunee Confederacy has become a model for success. All nations around us are awestruck by our excellent rulership!
entities.name: Model Confederacy

desc: It would be a mistake for our enemies to regard us as weak based on our diplomatic strength. Our warriors are as fierce and proud as those from any militaristic society, and underestimating them is the leading cause of death among our rivals.
entities.name: Fierce Warriors

desc: The basis of our trade interactions is represented in the form of gift exchanges. As our people come together and work for the benefit of the whole, the act of gifting is guaranteed to be followed by another gift in return.
entities.name: Haudenosaunee Gift-Giving

desc: The legendary Hiawatha, renowned among the Haudenosaunee people as a great speaker and leader, has set a very high precedent for what a diplomat should be. We will honor him by following his example in our diplomatic relations.
entities.name: Legacy of Hiawatha

desc: Conquering territory from weaker peoples is a necessary evil in our state. These circumstances have created a unique warrior code, according to which capturing and not killing the enemy is the highest display of bravery and valor. This has made our warriors famous for their mastery in capturing people alive.
entities.name: Head Hunters

desc: Orthodox religious buildings are designed in imitation of heaven. Their construction centralized around the basilica, the central dome that serves as a roof and symbolizes the heavens. Richly decorated in beautiful images and gleaming golden icons, they are a wonder to behold.
entities.name: Heavenly Architecture

desc: The city of Heian-Kyō has been the residence of the Emperor for centuries, and is a center for art and culture. It is there where the lavish court of the Fujiwara flourished, and all the people in Japan looked to it with awe and inspiration. We shall embrace its traditional role, and with our patronage make the culture of our capital flourish once again.
entities.name: Heian-Kyō

desc: The legacy of Rollo, the Viking founder of Normandy, continues to define our ruling house. Such a prestigious line has led to strengthened legitimacy and respect from our peers.
entities.name: Heirs of Rollo

desc: Many have claimed to be the heirs of Rome and indeed the whole Roman Empire. However, only our religion is the true faith of the old Empire, and therefore only we can legitimately claim to be a direct descendant from it.
entities.name: Heirs of Rome

desc: After surviving a turbulent period, and winning the struggle to dominate our neighboring Beyliks, the time has finally come for us to restore the borders of the once-great Sultanate of Rûm!
entities.name: Scions of Rûm

desc: The lands of the Rus' shattered into fragmented states long ago, but the memory of our once-great empire, ruled from Kyiv, burns brightly in us all. If we style ourselves in the old fashion, and highlight our connection to our ancestors, we will be able to carve out a distinctive set of traditions for our people.
entities.name: The Legacy of the Rus'

desc: Our strategic position within the Empire makes us an attractive staging ground for other princes' armies whenever outside threats arise. However, hosting foreign troops hurts our finances. To prevent this costly burden, we must raise our own troops and put them into service of the Empire.
entities.name: Professional Army Core

desc: Elite light troops composed of expert hunters. Their knowledge of our own terrain will increase our ability to fight in dense forests, although their equipment is not suited for prolonged fighting.
entities.name: Hessian Jäger

desc: Our Norman forebears built splendid towers to maintain their grip on the hostile interior of Ireland.
entities.name: Hiberno-Norman Keeps

gate: is capital in south america or carribean

desc: In a land of immense peaks and impenetrable rainforests, many of our cities are nearly inaccessible to outsiders. They could easily remain hidden for centuries, forgotten by the world.
entities.name: Hidden Cities

desc: Governing a state as large as an entire subcontinent is no easy task. We will need to develop a robust system of administration in cooperation with local princes to get the most out of our production and to ensure widespread stability.
entities.name: Indian Administration

desc: Many Hindu faithful worship the river Ganges as a goddess that brings purity and redemption to the faithful. We implore pilgrims to visit the river banks to bathe in the sacred waters. Through Gaṅgā, our nation is made pure.
entities.name: Gaṅgā

desc: Our mastery of gunpowder warfare has brought us glory and helped us found our great state. This dominance would be impossible without fostering firearms production for our troops.
entities.name: Gunpowder Empire

desc: No ruler, be they Muslim, Hindu, Buddhist, or Jain, has ever succeeded in conquering the entirety of the subcontinent. We shall be the first universal rulers of India!
entities.name: Imperial India

desc: Conditions in our economy are ideal for rapid industrial growth. With new technology we can ensure better conditions for our local production, particularly in the textile industry. Our focus on new methods means that our state can ensure steady industrial expansion.
entities.name: Industrialization of India

desc: Foreign languages and noble customs have richly influenced the courts of India for a long time. We should utilize these connections to invite the most capable advisors to serve under our guidance.
entities.name: Persianate Courtly Culture

desc: Iron-cased rockets have yet to be widely adapted for military purposes, yet their explosive power surely has tactical applications. We should experiment with this technology and test it on the battlefield.
entities.name: Develop Rocket Technology

desc: Neglecting the importance of the infantry has been the downfall of many would-be conquerors. We must ensure that our troops are equipped with the most effective firearms and drilled in tactics that can adapt to any foe.
entities.name: Sipâhi

desc: Muslim princes across the world compete to attract the wisest Sufi teachers. As our renown has grown, more of these Sufis have joined us. Towns are founded wherever they settle, often in previously inhospitable regions, and the local people are inspired to convert through the wisdom of the Sufis.

mods.label: Invite Religious Figure from Same School Cost

entities.name: Attract Sufi Missionaries

desc: The many people, cultures, languages, and nations that make up India shall be finally united under a single banner. Only with common understanding and a carefully fostered unity among all our people can we strive towards greater ambitions.
entities.name: United India

desc: Regardless of the style of construction, be it a Śikhara, Vimāna, or Prāṅg, Hindu temples are recognizable everywhere for their tall, decorated towers. A representation of Mount Meru, more or less emphasized depending on the region, these spires serve both as a signal of faith and a demonstration of power.
entities.name: Hindu Architecture

desc: There have been many empires in the past that followed Hinduism. From the Maurya and Gupta empires in India, to the Śrīvijaya Empire in Indonesia, and the long-lasting Chola Dynasty, Hinduism has always been the spirital force behind the throne of powerful rulers.
entities.name: Hindu Empires

desc: There has been a lot of interaction in the past between Hinduism and Islam, and there will continue to be so. Our peoples have learned to live peacefully together and there has even been some degree of syncretism between the two faiths.
entities.name: Hindu-Muslim Relations

desc: Despite the differences in beliefs and practices throughout Hinduism, there are more commonalities between us than differences. A common unified view of Hinduism has started to emerge, and our people can gain a great sense of unity through it.
entities.name: Hindu Unification

desc: Culture and the arts define the identity of any country. By proudly promoting our cultural achievements, we will leave a lasting impression on the entire world.
entities.name: Land of Culture

desc: Our cities reflect a unique blend of Andalusian elegance and Maghrebi architecture. The Hispano-Moresque style, passed down from foreign artisans and nobles, inspires a new cultural flowering and elevates the prestige of our court.
entities.name: Hispano-Moresque Style

desc: Our war council can only function with a proper bureaucratic structure. Only when we know every detail about our troops and logistics can we defend our realm from hostile intruders.
entities.name: Hofkriegsrat

desc: A great court needs more than soldiers and clerks. By welcoming artists, philosophers, and men of science into our service, we turn the court of Brandenburg into a beacon of culture, and show the world that our ambitions reach beyond the battlefield.
entities.name: Hohenzollern Court Culture

desc: Our estates have long held sway over the governance of the Mark. By establishing a council of advisors answerable to the Elector alone, we bring our ablest men to the center of power, and quietly reduce the estates to a consultative role.
entities.name: Hohenzollern Privy Council

desc: As a maritime nation, our sailors are accustomed to naval combat, whether against members of rival nations or pirates attempting to plunder our trading vessels. In any case, our navy must be prepared to face any enemy at any time.
entities.name: Maritime Warfare

desc: A land of sands and flooded terrain, the people of Holland have always looked at the sea as their natural second home, where bountiful resources and glorious adventures await those brave enough to pursue them.
entities.name: Hollander Sailors

desc: Our country is surrounded by the sea, so it is only natural that we would brave the roiling waves in search of trading ports and enriching goods to bring back.
entities.name: Trading Spirit

desc: Held at the beginning of spring to celebrate its arrival, Holi is the festival of colors and love. We commemorate agriculture and good harvests, and at the same time enjoy the myriad of colors that spring offers. It is also the time to have fun and resolve conflicts, removing one's emotional impurities.
entities.name: Holi

desc: For centuries, paper mills have relied on mechanical hammers to beat lumpen paper pulp, crushing the fiber to create the raw material needed to then create paper. Using local windmills for power, enterprising artisans have now devised a more efficient solution: the 'Hollander Beater', a vat containing a wind-powered horizontal roller with blades. These blades can shred as much pulp in hours as the old hammers did over days.
entities.name: Hollander Beater

desc: The Word of Allāh was revealed to His Prophet Muḥammad, peace be upon him, and transcribed in the Holy Qur'ān. Through its verses, Allāh's will is passed to His faithful, and all Muslim believers should be familiar with its passages.
entities.name: Holy Revelation

desc: Rivers and their veneration have always been an important part of Hinduism. From the Indus to the Ganges, there are many rivers considered holy, on the shores of which many rituals are held. Their waters are considered sacred, and they are a common site for purification rituals.
entities.name: Holy Rivers

desc: Although light cavalry formations are an old concept, the first Balkan hussars — or ''gusars'' — appeared as auxiliary units of Byzantium, recruited mainly from Byzantine-held Serbia in the 10th and 11th centuries. Even after Byzantine power dwindled, this tradition remained, and was further refined over the following centuries.
entities.name: Home of the Hussars

desc: Konya, our spiritual center, is home to the followers of Mevlânâ Jalāl al-Dīn Muḥammad Rūmī. Their sacred practice — the ''sema'' — symbolizes the soul's journey toward divine truth. Their presence deepens the mystic traditions of our realm and reinforces our Sufi roots.
entities.name: Home of the Whirling Dervishes

desc: Ritual and religious practice have been traditionally relegated to shrines and temples. However, more and more of our people are placing in their homes both local family shrines, called ''kamidana'', to venerate the Kami, and ''butsudan'' as Buddhist altars for their ancestors.
entities.name: Home Shrines

desc: One of the key practices in Shinbutsu-Shūgō is to identify the local ''Kami'' as manifestations of the different Buddha, and the Buddhas as manifestations of the different ''Kami''. In the end, they are one and the same, with core forms or ''Honji'' taking on different aspects, or ''suijaku''.
entities.name: Honji Suijaku

desc: Our horses are almost as fierce and terrifying to our enemies as their riders are. The sight of our cavalry marching to war is like watching an unstoppable force of demons from hell.
entities.name: Horde Ardor

desc: Raiding has always been part of our identity. Pillaging and plundering are how our people learn to fight and obtain much of their personal fortune. There is no harm in fomenting even more raids — at least, no harm for us.
entities.name: Raid Profits

desc: The loyalty of our people is unquestionable. No soul who has lived under the thriving rule of the Khān would think of ever leaving it.
entities.name: Horde Loyalty

desc: At the narrowest point of the Persian Gulf stands Ormus, the gatekeeper of east-west maritime trade. No vessel passes without our knowledge — or without paying our fee. For centuries, this toll has not just made us richer, but shaped our diplomacy and how we project power across the vast seas.
entities.name: Ormus Toll

desc: Our people and horses share an inseparable bond. Children grow up alongside foals, learning horsemanship from infancy. The careful breeding and exhaustive training of these mounts is our greatest pride, and we are recognized far and wide as the greatest horse-lords in the world.
entities.name: Horse-Lords of the Steppes

desc: The domestication of horses has revolutionized the way people move and transport goods. Additionally, the use of horses in combat provides mounted warriors not only with a faster way of moving, but also a higher ground from which to attack their enemies — or even to crush them under the weight of their mounts.
entities.name: Horse-Riding

desc: Hospitals were first established during the Middle Ages to provide care for the sick, poor, and disabled. Typically run by religious orders, these hospitals offered a range of medical services, including basic nursing care, herbal remedies, and eventually, surgery. They were often located near churches or monasteries and had separate wards for men and women. Despite limited medical knowledge, these hospitals played a vital role in offering sanctuary, comfort, and some form of medical treatment to those in need during a challenging period in history.
entities.name: Hospitals

desc: The problems posed by the coke blast furnaces, especially the amount of impurities the coke creates in the final cast iron, has led to the development of the hot blast. It not only greatly reduces the use of coke, therefore improving the quality of the Iron, but also allows the use of raw mineral coal as fuel if available, which is a great step forward in Iron metallurgy.
entities.name: Hot Blast Furnace

desc: A building to house a permanent [
], to keep it central and under better control.
entities.name: House of Parliament

desc: Over the past centuries, we have worked tirelessly to integrate our dealings into the global scale of trade. Now, more than ever, we must protect our own merchants, lest we fall victim to factionalism and external competition.
entities.name: Concept of Mercantilism

desc: The merchants who conduct business under our seal carry with them tremendous influence and purses brimming with coin. As such, solidifying their privileges in foreign and domestic markets will only further increase our capacity for profitable business.
entities.name: Draft Merchant Privileges

desc: Our traveling merchants who carry our business abroad are excellent resources of foreign knowledge. Whenever they return to our shores, they bring innovation and inspiration in their wake.
entities.name: Exchange of Ideas

desc: The widespread adoption of trade on a global scale has shaken the mercantile world to its core. It is now customary to do regular business with foreign traders from all corners of the world, and our treasury has benefited as a result.
entities.name: Global Reach

desc: The Burgtor is more than a gate. It is a statement of power and permanence, raised at the entrance to our greatest cities to announce that the wealth of the Hansa is well protected. Where our merchants travel and prosper, the fortifications of the Hansa shall stand to safeguard them.
entities.name: Hanseatic Fortifications

desc: At a time when Europe is enveloped in war, with rulers desperate for expansion pressing claims in all directions, they look to us to build grand fleets that will allow them to fulfill their ambitions. Armed with centuries of accumulated shipwrighting knowledge, and some of the best timber on the continent, our ship-building process is unparalleled!
entities.name: Hanseatic Shipwrights

desc: Our League is home to a great many cities and merchant guilds, all with their own agendas and endeavors. In order to maintain our prosperity and expand our reach, we must take a keen interest in diplomatic efforts.
entities.name: Hanseatic Ties

desc: A strong economy is but one result of our prosperity. With ample coin and overflowing coffers, we have established ourselves as robust and dependable creditors.
entities.name: Hanseatic Treasury

desc: Originally minted between the cities of Lübeck and Hamburg, the ''Hohlpfennig'' was a hollow currency developed as a countermeasure to rampant debasing, during an era where each mint had different standards regarding the concentration of silver on each coin. As a means of conducting transactions, the currency will smoothen our trade activities and bridge the gap between foreign markets and our merchants.
entities.name: Hohlpfennig

desc: Our maritime traditions have linked our fortunes to the mighty sea. To reap all the benefits we possibly can from our marine resources, we must learn to harness the awesome power of the sea — and to treat it with the proper deference. This will have tremendous effects on our trade activities.
entities.name: Mastery of the Sea

desc: In times of troubles and evolving thought, our central institutions for assembly and deliberation must adapt to deal with emerging challenges and new paradigms.
entities.name: Reform the Hanstag
