desc: The many entities within our League must be brought under our firm control in a bid to standardize their monthly and annual contributions to our treasury.
entities.name: Standardized Contributions

desc: In markets across Europe, from London to Novgorod, our merchants are famed for their affluence. Our ability to mobilize great trade fleets and bring dozens of cities into a perfect symphony of profit and exchange of commodities is second to none.
entities.name: Seal of the Hansa

desc: The Hanseatic Cog is the pride of our trade fleet. Originally conceived during the late 12th century, it has been redesigned and improved continuously over the next hundred years. Characterized by its bulbous shape, single mast, square sail, stern rudder, and flat bottom, it revolutionized cargo transportation. Its design facilitated navigation in shallow waters, making it highly practical for trade. With a modest crew, a cog could efficiently transport substantial cargo, providing the Hanseatic League with a distinct edge in commerce over its rivals.
entities.name: The Hanseatic Cog

desc: Our widespread clan controls rich territories through a network of loyal kinsmen and retainers. By maintaining internal harmony in our dynasty, our clan will become one of the most powerful in Japan.
entities.name: Branches and Retainers

desc: Our clan's territory has traditionally been situated around the Kii Channel. Taking control of trade entering the mainland through that point will bring us massive profits, and we shall flourish immensely.
entities.name: Control of the Izumi Sea

desc: Although our origins are relatively humble, even compared to other clans descending from the Ashikaga, we have managed nonetheless to grow our influence considerably. Our clan is decidedly on the rise, and our ascension must not be hindered!
entities.name: Rising Clan

desc: Our clan is not content to occupy a single location, and we do our utmost to project our influence all over the country. No matter how far it may spread, our clan authority must be unquestionable in all our holdings.
entities.name: Clan Spread

desc: Some consider our clan leaders to be rebellious troublemakers due to the stigma attached to our clan name. However, this enmity is naught but a symbol of our resilience. We have been reborn; we will never surrender, and will fight for what is ours no matter who may oppose us!
entities.name: Hatakeyama Heritage

desc: As a clan descending from one of the branches of the Ashikaga, we have particularly strong ties to the authority of the Shogunate. As long as we maintain this association, our clan will continue to be held in high regard.
entities.name: Shogunate Ties

desc: Long has war defined our fate, but now it shall define our strength. From the ruinous embrace of warfare and siege, Smolensk rises as a center of military production — cannons, firearms, powder and doctrine flow outward from our armories. Let the world see us not as a prize to be taken, but as a hammer to be feared, ready to strike the anvil of foreign conquerors.
entities.name: Hub of Militarism

desc: We exist geographically wedged between the soaring ambitions of more powerful enemies. To survive this predatory encirclement, our lords have mastered the art of pitting our neighbors against each other, wherein we perpetually offer vassalage to the distant wolf to deter the one at our doorstep. By playing the Catholic West against the Orthodox East and the Bosnian Krstjani against both, we ensure that no single hegemon can fully digest our lands without triggering a massive intervention from their rivals. This culture of sophisticated political duplicity transforms our perceived weakness into a survival mechanism, as we grant trade concessions and military access to whichever power currently guarantees our internal autonomy, effectively keeping the greater wolves at each other's throats while we remain the undisturbed masters of the Neretva.
entities.name: A Sheep Surrounded by Wolves

desc: Refining centuries of mountain warfare, we have implemented the 'National Redoubt' doctrine, where every major city and pass is integrated into a single, cohesive defensive plan. Using modern Western ballistics and cartography, we have pre-positioned batteries and supplies in hidden mountain caches. This doctrine ensures that even if the valleys are lost, the state can continue to function as a sovereign military entity from the high peaks, mocking any occupier with a permanent, active resistance that makes the cost of holding Hum prohibitively expensive for any empire.
entities.name: Modernized National Redoubt

desc: To manage our state, we have centralized our administration into a mobile but highly organized Chancery. By maintaining precise records of land ownership, clan lineages, and tax obligations even during wartime, we prevent the social disintegration that often follows foreign occupation. This bureaucratic resilience ensures that the state can resume full operations the moment an invader is repelled, maintaining a clear and unbroken chain of command that stretches from the ruler's palace to the smallest mountain hamlet in the high karsts.
entities.name: The Humite Chancery Records

desc: Inspired by the Kosača dynasty, the Principality has started centralizing the military under a single dynastic banner, the state has moved away from fragmented feudal levies toward a professionalized core of heavy infantry and mercenary crossbowmen. This military consolidation allows us to defy our enemies, turning the rugged landscape of our lands into a power-broker in the southern Dinaric Alps.
entities.name: The Kosača Iron Fist

desc: We have mastered the climate-controlled secrets of the Trebišnjica river system, the world's longest losing stream. By utilizing the stable temperatures and dry upper galleries of the ''ponors'' (sinkholes) during the summer, we have established a national network of subterranean granaries. This 'Hidden Reserve' ensures that our grain supplies are immune to the scorching Herzegovinian heat and, more importantly, invisible to the foraging parties of invading armies. While our enemies starve in a scorched valley, our forces remain well-fed by tapping into the earth's own cool depths, allowing us to maintain a high-morale standing army even during multi-year blockades.
entities.name: The Ponor Storage System

desc: The limestone-rich, sun-drenched slopes of the Herzegovinian valleys produce a distinct, high-sugar grape that is the envy of the Adriatic. By establishing a royal monopoly on the export of Žilavka and Blatina wines, we can create a luxury trade that bypasses the volatility of the grain markets. This 'Liquid Diplomacy' allows our court to maintain a lifestyle that rivals the Italian city-states, using high-end wine exports as a diplomatic lubricant to secure favorable treaties with the Republic of Venice and the Kingdom of Naples.
entities.name: The Viticulture of the Sunny Scree

desc: Mankind is the highest creation of our Lord, and thus it is natural to place it in the center of Creation. Every aspect of human nature has to be preserved and encouraged, from its well-being to its propensity for free will and exploration.
entities.name: Humanism

desc: By striving to create a more tolerant society, and attempting to solve our social and religious problems in more rational ways, the risk of civil disorder will be diminished.
entities.name: Humanist Tolerance

desc: With Turkish power rising in the south, it falls to the people of Hungary to defend faithful kingdoms from the Turkish threat. Let it be known that we will not flinch from our sacred duty!
entities.name: Bulwark of Christianity

desc: The Castle Warriors, one of the most select classes in our society, are duty-bound to provide military service to their local ''ispáns'' in royal castle districts. Stalwarts from the earliest days of our nation, these privileged landholders hold a unique position, actively defending their realm while cherishing their hereditary rights.
entities.name: Castle Warriors

desc: Made up of horse archers as well as swift horsemen, our light cavalry is the backbone of our military force. Our mounted forces have shown their mettle time and time again, and will inevitably lead our forces to glory once more.
entities.name: Composite Light Cavalry

desc: Hungary is not blessed with protective natural frontiers. The wild plains that first brought our ancestors here were perfect for launching raids into the West, not for defense. If Hungary is to defend itself, we will need resources. The best solution is to allow our magnates to bind the peasants more closely to the land, ensuring greater productivity.
entities.name: Curtail Peasant Liberties

desc: Inspired by the writings of Julius Caesar, Hungary shall maintain a corps of professional soldiers. These warriors will be so fierce that our enemies shall whisper terrified tales of 'The Black Army' to their children at night!
entities.name: Found the Black Army

desc: Drawing inspiration from the storied legacy of King Matthias I Corvinus' cavalry, this idea introduces the 'Royal Hussar Regiments,' granting a formidable edge to Hungary's light cavalry forces. With their swift and fearless charges, these regiments are a symbol of Hungarian martial prowess, proving indispensable on the battlefields of Europe.
entities.name: Hungarian Hussars

desc: The ideas of the Reformation spread through Europe like wildfire, and as such were bound to find their way to our lands eventually. Our realm has been threatened by outside powers for long enough. By joining the Reformation and abandoning the duty of following the Pope like a lapdog, we can break at least one of the shackles oppressing us!
entities.name: Hungarian Reformation

desc: Although our subjects have faced many external threats over the years, the spirit and will of the Hungarian people remains unbroken. Unifying Hungarian hearts is greatly inspiring to our patriotic soldiers, who will defend our homelands to the last man.
entities.name: Hungarian Unity

desc: The Carpathian Basin is home to more than just Hungarian people. Slovak, Ruthenian,Cuman, and Carpathian German people, among many other different minorities, call our realm their home. Given this diversity, it is only natural that our government proficiently absorbs and adopts these different cultures into our state.
entities.name: Realm of Many Cultures

desc: The ideas of the Reformation spread through Europe like wildfire, and as such were bound to find their way to our lands eventually. Alas, the Reformation has split families apart, made former friends into enemies, and threatened the very stability of many nations. However, our realm knows better than to fall victim to this theological quarreling. We are a people and a realm of many religions, after all.
entities.name: Realm of Many Religions

desc: To pay for our new professional army, we will need a steady stream of revenue. Reforming the coinage to standardize weights will make this much easier, because we shall know exactly how much people need to pay.
entities.name: Reformed Coinage

desc: The peasants consider their ruler a just one because they are officially protected from having excessive demands and other abuses heaped upon them by magnates. The ruler of Hungary is a true Renaissance prince — a successful military leader and administrator, an outstanding linguist, and an enlightened patron of the arts.
entities.name: A Renaissance Prince

desc: As military technology advances, so do battlefield tactics. It is imperative to the survival of our state that we keep pace with the ever-evolving nature of land warfare.
entities.name: Revolutionary Military Tactics

desc: Towns are key factors in producing the wealth Hungary needs to grow and prosper. If we ensure the operations of our townships are protected from the power-hungry machinations of the nobility, they will continue to bring in trade, which we can tax.

mods.label: Possible Burghers in Towns and Cities

entities.name: Strengthen the Towns

desc: The ideas of the Reformation spread through Europe like wildfire, and as such were bound to find their way to our lands eventually. Yet, the hearts of the faithful remain strong. God and His loyal servants will withstand this heretical madness.
entities.name: The Catholic Shield

desc: The designs of Feodor Apraksin are robust and resilient, enabling ships to weather most storms that Mother Nature is able to conjure. The innovative construction greatly contributes to any burgeoning maritime ambitions.
entities.name: Hurricane Hardy

desc: Through struggle and brotherhood, the adherents of our faith withstand all external conversion pressures. Our unshaken religious roots, stemming from ancient teachings, ring true to the hearts of all those who seek to protect their beliefs and live in peace alongside their fellow Christian faithful.
entities.name: Hussite Traditions

desc: Agriculture is the bedrock of our economy, and therefore efficient village management is paramount. To this end, we will implement the ''hyangyak'' system, which establishes self-governance for villages. These agreements establish behavioral standards, dispute resolution regulations, and other civil procedures aimed at creating stable, self-reliant communities.
entities.name: Hyangyak System

desc: Unlike the Ḵilāfa or a divinely appointed Shiite Imām, an Ibadi Imām does not rule over the entirety of the Muslim world, but instead governs locally. Every community can be ruled independently by its own Imām.
entities.name: Ibadi Imamate

desc: The need for faster and more reliable caravels has driven our shipbuilding experts to make improvements to their design. While caravels have become common across Europe, the Iberian models remain superior in both innovation and speed.
entities.name: Iberian Caravels

desc: The Iberian Galleon is a more stylized version of the Early Iberian Galleon. They are tremendously powerful vessels that absolutely crush any opposition on the high seas.
entities.name: Iberian Galleons

desc: One key feature of any Orthodox church is that of the Iconostasis, a wall of icons that separates the main body of the building from the altar. The icons it contains serve as a visualization of the link between the worshipers and the Holy of Holies, and thus the link between Heaven and the people, serving as a guide for the people towards Heaven.
entities.name: Iconostasis

desc: The blood of the Khāghān runs through our veins. Let no man forget that our rule was ordained on the steppes and sealed by conquest. Our horsemen remain unmatched, and our banners bear not just a name, but a birthright.
entities.name: Descendants of Genghis Khān

desc: What was once broken is now reborn. Our banners fly once more across Persia, invoking awe and fear in equal measure. As word of our rising power spreads, the world will remember what it means to be ruled by a true Īlkhān.
entities.name: Īlkhānān Resurgent

desc: The days of pure steppe conquest lie behind us. We have sown ourselves into the soil of progress and reformation. From that soil, a more stable, sophisticated state shall grow. Though our hearts may still beat to the rhythm of the open fields, our future lies in lasting institutions, not fleeting raids.
entities.name: New Roots

desc: Our ancestors ruled with the sword, but their greatness was measured in palaces, libraries, and minarets. Let us follow their example and fund not only walls and roads, but mosques, gardens, and schools as testaments to Īlkhānān grandeur.
entities.name: Persian Arts and Architecture

desc: The Yäm, our ancient system of relay stations and messengers, once connected the furthest corners of the Mongol world. By restoring this vast network across Persia and beyond, we ensure that our orders are swift, our envoys safe, and our dominion responsive, just as it was in the golden days of the Khans.
entities.name: Restore the Yäm

desc: The basis of Shiite faith is that Muḥammad, peace be upon him, designated 'Alī ibn Abī Ṭālib as his successor. As such, the figure of Imām is that of a spiritual leader coming from the line of Muḥammad, peace be upon him, to lead all Muslim faithful.
entities.name: Imamate

desc: As our clan is descended from the Ashikaga family, we have a strong claim on the position of Shōgun, should the main line perish. Even if the Bakufu is not threatened, it would still be in our best interests to remind everyone of our legitimacy. Just in case it ever becomes relevant...
entities.name: Claim to the Shogunate

desc: In these dangerous times when Japan and Kyōto are mired in political chaos, anyone could march into the capital and seize power. As close kinsmen of the Ashikaga, it is our obligation — and our right — to ensure the stability of the country.
entities.name: March to Kyōto

desc: The Tōkaidō is the most important trade route between Central and Eastern Japan. As our ancestral lands are in the middle of all this trade, it would behoove us to take control over the entire region, so as to reap the most benefits from local commercial activity.
entities.name: Control of the Tōkaidō

desc: Sometimes, the best way to defeat an enemy is to make them your friend. Securing our rule through strategic marriages will not only pacify our foes and gain us new allies, but will also ensure that we can ultimately dominate our rivals through blood.
entities.name: Unlikely Alliances

desc: The Imperial University is dedicated to the study of philosophy, medicine, and law, and plays a significant role in Russian education and research. It is established as part of educational reforms conceived by polymath Mikhail Lomonosov, emphasizing the importance of scientific inquiry and innovation.
entities.name: Imperatorskiy Moskovskiy Universitet

desc: The great empires of the past are a source of inspiration for artists and poets alike, always spoken of with awe and admiration. If we want to generate the same reaction towards our own country, we should aspire to the same grandeur.
entities.name: Imperial Ambitions

desc: The rapidly changing nature of warfare urges us to modernize our troops and tactics. In order to stay ahead of our foes, we shall make our artillery the pride of the Imperial army.
entities.name: Imperial Artillery

desc: Orthodoxy has been the official faith of the Roman Empire ever since its adoption of Christianity. The heresies of the West and their falsely proclaimed 'emperors' will not be able to discredit our legitimacy.
entities.name: Imperial Creed

desc: This new school, ''Mühendishane-i Bahr-i Hümâyûn'', will help us train shipwrights, naval officers, and sailors for both the navy and the merchant fleet.
entities.name: Imperial School of Naval Engineering

desc: Our ever-growing diplomatic corps necessitates our creating a permanent Foreign Affairs Ministry to manage and coordinate our many envoys and coordinate their efforts.
entities.name: Permanent Foreign Affairs Ministry

desc: Diplomatic gifts have been exchanged since ancient times, as a measure of impressing or persuading foreign rulers by emphasizing the high status and enviable wealth of the giver. Gifts could range from fine cloth, to splendid jewelry, to astonishing animals such as giraffes or elephants.
entities.name: Lavish Diplomatic Gifts

desc: The blossoms of thought and knowledge must be watered by a steady supply of books if we are to prosper and cultivate as a people.
entities.name: Improved Bookbinding

desc: Traditionally, we were unable to fight effectively in lands that did not supply enough food. However, our troops have become better at acquiring food in the wild, making it possible for larger armies to fight.
entities.name: Improved Foraging

desc: The modern art of war nowadays clearly differentiates between amateur officers who talk about tactics, and professional officers who actually study logistics.
entities.name: Improved Logistics

desc: Tactical positioning is a vital skill for any commander. The ability to maneuver troops effectively around the battlefield will give us a significant edge.
entities.name: Improved Maneuver

desc: The concept of outfitting warships with rams goes back thousands of years, but great advancements in metallurgy have been made since then, and we should take advantage of these to create sturdier rams.
entities.name: Improved Rams

desc: To defend our interests around the globe, we will require a strong [
]. We must ensure our shipyards can produce ships as quickly as possible to replace any losses we may suffer.
entities.name: Improved Shipyards

desc: Modern warfare demands more and more resources for our armies, especially since the development of salvo fire and the widespread use of artillery on the battlefield.
entities.name: Improved Supply Lines

desc: The introduction of light infantry troops has led to a significant change in warfare. Skirmishers are deployed forward in loose order to distract and harass the enemy before the main infantry attack, which is typically delivered in either a line or a column formation.
entities.name: Impulse Warfare

desc: Our road system is one of our empire's most valuable assets. To further benefit our military and administration, we will erect ''tambo'' way stations along all the main roads. These stations will be built within a day's march of each other, and will provide shelter and carry supplies for travelers.
entities.name: Improved Tambo Way Stations

desc: No other empire is as well adapted to the heights of the Andes as we are. By maintaining settlements and storehouses at every altitude, from the lowest valleys to the highest plateaus, we have mastered the method of moving men and goods across the most difficult terrain, where other states would falter. Our llama caravans, our roads carved into sheer cliffsides, and our highland communities turn the Andes from a barrier into our own highway.
entities.name: The Vertical Economy

desc: The Incamisana is a temple in honor and worship of water and the divine patrons of it. As a combination of architectural beauty and technical ingenuity, the Incamisana has a dual purpose of being a religious building and an irrigation system.
entities.name: Incamisana

desc: The practice of burning incense is a staple of any Buddhist ritual or offering. Varying in shapes and forms, it is common for both lay people and ordained monks and nuns alike to light incense before performing any ritual or meditation. As such, the smell of incense constantly permeates any Buddhist temple.
entities.name: Incense Burning

desc: Incense has been a staple of life in Asia for centuries, maybe more so than anywhere in the world. Although other religions also use it for their rituals, its near-ubiquity in Hindu and Buddhist ceremonies, as well as its everyday use by Islam people, give it a constant presence anywhere in Asia.
entities.name: Incense Preeminence

desc: The high demand for Incense, not only in Asia but also beyond it, requires the establishment of many trade routes dedicated to its commerce. Akin to the more famous Silk Road, this trade of Incense links the East with the West.
entities.name: Incense Trade Route

desc: As our mighty country grows, we will need to keep a tight grip on our population.
entities.name: Increase Control Widely

desc: The Swedish allotment system divides the peasantry into groups of ten for recruitment purposes. This system made it easier to find people to serve in the army and organize them into units.
entities.name: Indelningsverket

desc: For many years, we were a subject of Mali. As Mali's power has weakened, ours has grown, and we can now claim to be fully independent of Malian overlordship. Let us take steps to make sure we remain so.
entities.name: Independence from Mali

desc: Due to the isolation of Miaphysitism, it has been difficult at times to contact other patriarchates. As such, our leaders have learned to act independently, while at the same time keeping in contact with the rest of the Christian world as much as possible.
entities.name: Independent Leaders

desc: The dangerous ideas of the Reformation will spread like a toxic fungus in the minds of our subjects if they have access to written works propagating these silly thoughts! We must forbid certain dangerous texts, and keep a comprehensive list of which books are not allowed.
entities.name: Index of Forbidden Books

desc: Our merchants deal in goods from the markets of Alexandria, to the shores of Aden, and as far away as India itself. These extensive networks of contacts, business, and capital have positioned us at the forefront of maritime commerce.
entities.name: Indian Networks

desc: Muslim traders have sailed the waters of the Indian Ocean for generations, traveling impossibly far in search of rare and valuable goods. From the eastern coasts of Africa, to the shores of India, and even as far as the spice islands of Indonesia, the waters are crossed by vessels of the Muslim faithful.
entities.name: Indian Sea Trade

desc: Sometimes the best way to get people to do what you want is to let them believe that they have had a choice in the matter. A system of indirect rule like that will reduce the unrest in newly acquired provinces, giving them the impression that they have more self-determination than they truly do.
entities.name: Indirect Rule

desc: Our islands are home to many different people, speaking different languages and believing in many different gods. Only if we establish a common understanding and tolerance between them can we secure a prosperous country.
entities.name: Land of Many People

desc: Our political relevance within the archipelago almost solely relies on the strength of our naval forces. By improving our shipwrighting techniques and crew training, we will ensure our domination over the lesser states of Indonesia.
entities.name: Naval Prowess

desc: Maritime connections naturally play a huge role within our society, as we are surrounded by waters. Our reliance on maritime trade and transport makes traversal of the seas a trivial task for our people.
entities.name: Indonesian Archipelago

desc: No matter their origin or destination, every trader in Asia will eventually have to cross our lands, bringing both precious goods and tales of their travels with them.
entities.name: Trade Hub of the East

desc: The Industrial Revolution has brought about permanent change — not just to commerce and business, but to the social fabric of many nations. Inventions such as the power loom and steam engine shall push the capabilities of mankind to its highest zenith yet.
entities.name: Industrialization

desc: Conflicts with other states are not only fought on the battlefield, but in the shadows as well. Knowing the enemy's next move is an invaluable asset when trying to win wars. Our spies shall specialize in infiltrating state administrations, and forward any relevant information they gather to us.
entities.name: Infiltrate Administration

desc: Although the ancient Nizārī Shiite order of the ''Ḥashshāshīyīn'' has been largely mythicized beyond their original scope, their tactics of subterfuge and assassination were undeniably effective. If we employ such infiltration tactics ourselves, we should benefit from the same success.
entities.name: Infiltration Tactics

desc: Ending a war requires negotiations between the two opposing parties, and sometimes one party proves itself too stubborn to accept defeat. In such cases, the art of diplomatic pressure — and gently reminding them of their potential imminent annihilation — shall motivate them to accept our generous terms more easily.
entities.name: Pressuring Diplomacy

desc: The traditional Estates General favors the clergy and nobility, but the rising wealth and political importance of towns can no longer be ignored. By refining its structure to reflect the growing strength of the merchant class, we ensure more balanced governance while preserving the privileges of the other estates. A stronger urban voice will also enhance our administrative capacities and speed up the rate of urbanization.
entities.name: Influence of the Burgundian Towns

desc: Securing peace with our southern neighbor has led to a steady influx of English aristocrats entering our administration. This makes it possible to exert our control over our country more effectively.
entities.name: English Administrators

desc: The architectural innovations made by Inigo Jones will undoubtedly have a significant impact on future generations of architects. His promotion of classical architecture and his priority on proportion and harmony are considered hallmarks of the neoclassical movement in England.
entities.name: Palladian Architecture

desc: Natural curiosity, and the desire to understand our world and how it functions, is what pushes us forward. Our people are eager to gain knowledge, and it is this spark in their minds that will ignite progress for our nation.
entities.name: Thirst for Knowledge

desc: The Inquisition was created in the 12th century as a means to combat the Cathar heresy, but its reach grew significantly in the Late Middle Ages as the main tool of the Catholic Church to counter the spread of dissident doctrines.
entities.name: Inquisition

desc: While our Order's principal duty is to fight, we serve our people in other ways as well. Over the centuries, we have developed the art of rapid construction, erecting buildings and fortifications with remarkable speed. We will use this expertise to make our capital into both an impregnable fortress, and a dynamic center of culture.
entities.name: Inspired Builders

desc: By abolishing the Collateral Council and establishing the ''Real Camera di Santa Chiara'', we will implement important legal reforms in Naples. Ongoing projects will aim to reorganize the legislative complex, consolidate laws into the ''Codice Carolino'', and implement the ''Onciario Cadastre'' for tax reform.
entities.name: Institutional Reorganization

desc: A further reduction of risk came with the development of insurance. By paying a small fee to an insurance broker, merchants could protect themselves against catastrophic losses. This reduced risk of investment led to a subsequent flourishing of trade.
entities.name: Insurance Companies

desc: Our administration is improving, and as such, we can afford the manpower to integrate larger sections of land into our country at once.
entities.name: Better Integration

desc: By bringing the ruling elite of our subject nations into our government, we can significantly streamline the process of integrating their provinces.
entities.name: Integrated Elites

desc: The intelligence agency is an organization within the state which conducts spycraft activities such as espionage, cryptography, and providing security from internal threats.
entities.name: Intelligence Agency

desc: The patriarchates have absolute authority over their own jurisdictions and those who occupy them. By tying their authority to that of the ruler, we can take advantage of the resources of the Church, and use them to strengthen state authority.
entities.name: Interaction Between Church and State

desc: Our merchants frequently bring back fascinating things from the courts of faraway countries. Perhaps it would be possible to reach even further shores?
entities.name: Far-Reaching Trade

desc: Despite having independent patriarchs, all branches of Miaphysitism maintain mutual communion. This helps them build relationships with each other, and promotes unity in the Church.
entities.name: Internal Communion

desc: Many foreign merchants and travelers frequent our roads, bringing vast wealth to our land. We could convince some of these avid traders to permanently settle in our towns and cities, if we assure them they will not face persecution for their beliefs.
entities.name: Foreign Influences

desc: International relations is a tricky business. Some say that the merchant class, who are used to dealing with foreigners, are best suited for this. Those who say so, however, ignore the kindred ties that our noble families have established through the years. We should take advantage of these ties to help our cause diplomatically.
entities.name: International Nobility

desc: With the increased involvement of the laity in the day-to-day administration of our Church, our people have found a more personal connection to the faith itself.
entities.name: Involved Laity

desc: Although our lands are located mostly in the highlands of the Zagros Mountains, Persia does have coastal possessions. While past dynasties might have paid little attention to the maritime protection of the empire, our people are more aware of the sea, and our sailors are eager to defend our coasts.
entities.name: Persian Gulf Coastal Defense

desc: Persian art is highly in demand. Collectors from near and far travel here in droves to purchase our exquisite creations. We should offer state support for our talented artists, as this trade in aesthetic goods is extremely lucrative.
entities.name: Encourage Art

desc: A system of upgrades to roads and bridges, a system of guards to protect the roads — for a small fee — and a chain of Caravanserai for rest and refreshment. All these improvements will help the merchants as they traverse the Silk Road, and also provide revenue for the state.
entities.name: Improve the Silk Road

desc: The Islamization of Persia has been a lengthy process. It is not yet completely finished, but our religion has still become one of the major pillars of our national identity. Many of our ancient traditions have been combined with the teachings of Islam, and now make up our current core culture.
entities.name: Persian Islam

desc: The Jazāyerchi are the elite musketeers of the empire. Equipped with heavy flintlock muskets with superior firepower and accuracy and exposed to constant drilling, the Jazāyerchi manage to overcome even the most one-sided odds in battle.
entities.name: The Jazāyerchi Infantry Corps

desc: The ''Nāẓir'', or overseers, are territorial administrators, and represent the eyes and ears of the Šâhanšâh. All actions of the court are supervised by the Nāẓir, and courtiers are promoted on their command. Even the Grand Vizier must work in association with the Nāẓir.
entities.name: Court Nāẓir

desc: Horses play a fundamental role in our society. Many of our people are raised alongside their steeds, which is reflected in both the care our horse breeders take and the durability of our cavalry.
entities.name: Persian Horses

desc: The great plateau at the heart of our realm does not result in a weakness for us but instead turns into our strength. As the origin of great empires, our people have for countless generations crossed its great plains and the rugged mountain ranges surrounding it, like the Zagros or the Alborz. The same terrain that exhausts foreign armies is where our soldiers, our merchants, and our administrators thrive. We will use this familiarity to move across our lands and govern them with an ease that no outsider can match.
entities.name: The Iranian Plateau

desc: Persia has long been famous for its beautiful carpets and rugs. However, when the Mongols devastated the empire, much of this cultural heritage was lost. For Persia to fully recover its tumbled glory, we must regain our economic strength, and restoring this legendary ancient industry is the first step in that direction.
entities.name: Persian Rug Production

desc: As a consequence of the Mongol invasion of the past, Persia is somewhat depopulated compared to the earlier empires which claimed these lands as their own. Promoting the practice of irrigation should help our people develop the agriculture needed to boost the local population and help us recover from the death toll of past conflicts.
entities.name: Promotion of Irrigation

desc: No matter what the official faith of our state is, Persia will always be an inherently religious country. Every aspect of our life is guided by religious principles, and even the government itself acts with our core beliefs in mind when dealing with matters of morality and justice.
entities.name: Religious State

desc: The time of great religious divides has come to its end. In these turbulent times, Islam cannot afford any more in-fighting. We shall advocate for a policy of internal and external religious unity, and come to peace with what we used to consider heresy.
entities.name: Religious Unity Policy

desc: The Mongol invasion of Persia was catastrophic for the entire region. Population centers of magnificent size were reduced to mere rubble. But it is finally time to rebuild what was once destroyed, and restore the awe-inspiring empire of Persia.
entities.name: Restoration of Cities

desc: The Ṣafawiyya Order Hall is a building dedicated to the Sufi order of the Ṣafawiyya. While highly religious in nature, the building also serves as the military training grounds for the Kızılbaş.
entities.name: Ṣafawiyya Order Hall

desc: Before the Islamic Conquest of Persia, the region was home to the Sasanian Empire, which once ruled from Caucasia in the West to the Kirthar Range in the East. Many of its great cultural accomplishments have shaped our cultural and artistic identity.
entities.name: Sasanian Heritage

desc: The ''Šāhnāme'' - the Book of Kings - is an epic poem, and a national treasure of the Farsi people. Describing the historical and mythical past of the empires which once occupied Greater Persia, its stories contribute to the Farsi culture in uncountable dimensions.
entities.name: Šāhnāme

desc: Persian is an ancient language with a history longer than the lifespan of many empires. Even the Muslim conquest could not diminish the core of the Persian identity, and many other states try to imitate our culture.
entities.name: Persian Influence

desc: The Ḡilmān are a military unit made up of formerly Christian slaves with Caucasian origins. The Ḡilmān undergo strict military training and are well-practiced in the usage of firearms, making them an essential part of the national army. They serve as a counterbalance to other influential branches of the military.
entities.name: The Ḡilmān

desc: The ''Kızılbaş'' - the Red Heads - are a Shia military movement founded by the Ṣafawiyya. Guided by their religious convictions and deep ties to Sufism, these warriors are primed to fight for our state and to form the core of our army.
entities.name: The Kızılbaş

desc: While the Kızılbaş are the backbone of the Persian military, the ''Qurchi'' are the royal bodyguards enlisted from their ranks. Instead of being given land, these soldiers are paid from the royal treasury.
entities.name: The Qurchi

desc: The Tofangchi are our musket corps. Although firearms have been in use for a while, their presence in our ranks is highly irregular, as many of our fighters prefer to use their traditional weapon of bow and arrow. The regiments of the Tofangchi aim to change this, as they are trained in the use of modern weaponry.
entities.name: The Tofangchi

desc: The Tupchi - ''artillery-men'' - are a specialized military unit that focuses on the usage of cannons and siege weapons. Similar to the Tofangchi, the Tupchi are an example of modern warfare exercised by the Persian Empire.
entities.name: The Tupchi

desc: County grand juries levy the cess for roads, bridges, and courthouses. With judges riding the assizes, oversight tightens in every county.
entities.name: Grand Jury System

desc: A permanent army in Ireland — and controlled ''from'' Ireland — keeps garrisons ready and costs down. For our regular soldiery, this means regular pay. For our logisticians and quartermasters, it means a growing network of barracks that keeps the costs in hand.
entities.name: Irish Establishment

desc: Citizen corps are raised for home defense and coastal watch. Drilling at their own expense, they rouse public spirit and stiffen the line.
entities.name: Irish Volunteers

desc: In Ireland, cattle-rearing is our way of life. The noble bovine is not only a source of food, but a symbol of wealth. By ''booleying'', a system of moving our herds from one distant pasture to another, we can grow that wealth.
entities.name: Cattle Booleying

desc: The land we have seized from the Irish is ripe for exploitation. We just need to ensure that only the right sort of people migrate here to settle these cheap crofts.
entities.name: Irish Frontier Settlements

desc: Although we are now aligned with Roman Catholic practices in principle, religious life in our islands still puts a great focus on lay clergy.
entities.name: Insular Monasticism

desc: Traditional poets trained in courtly ways crisscross our lands looking for some likely lord to hire them.
entities.name: Traveling Bards

desc: Tools made from Iron will be sturdier than any other known production while not requiring the same time-consuming crafting process.
entities.name: Iron Foundry

desc: Utilizing blast furnaces, the Iron Mill will produce Tools at much higher quantity than any other method available.
entities.name: Iron Mill

desc: Enhancing our court's control over the Margraviate's lands will earn our ruler the moniker ''Iron Tooth'', as if we bit it like an attack dog. Our rule will leave a mark on our nation, a mark which will instill a sense of pride and loyalty in even the lowliest peasant in Brandenburg.
entities.name: Iron Tooth

desc: Iron is a key material for the production of different types of tools and weapons, making it vital for village blacksmiths as well as large manufacturing chains.
entities.name: Iron Working

desc: Interpreted differently depending on the school or branch of Hinduism, Īśvara refers to the Supreme Being or God. Therefore, it can refer to Śiva for Shaivism, to Viṣṇu for Vaishnavism, or to any personal god of the individual.
entities.name: Īśvara

desc: We are one of four powerful clans traditionally appointed to be the chief of military and police in the Samurai-Dokoro. It is thus our responsibility, and our privilege, to keep the peace in the capital and other important places.
entities.name: Minister of Samurai-Dokoro

desc: The province of Tango is the gate to Kyōto in San'indō and a place of crucial economic importance. By firmly establishing and expanding our presence there, we can take advantage of such prosperity.
entities.name: San'indō Gate

desc: Islam is not only a religion of peace, but of the arts. The calligraphy used to write the verses of the Qur'ān and the names of the prophets often straddles the line between scripture and art.
entities.name: Islamic Calligraphy

desc: The royal courts of Muslim countries have always been among the most admired in the world. Praised for our refined culture and luxurious appointments, tales of the magnificence of our courts have spread far and wide, and our people take great pride in this reputation.
entities.name: Islamic Courts

desc: The impact that the Islamic Golden Age had on the entire world, not only in Muslim countries, is absolutely undeniable. Some of these infidel nations are only now emerging from their dark ages of ignorance, making their first attempts at artistic and scientific 'discoveries' that we invented — and perfected — long ago.
entities.name: Islamic Golden Age

desc: One of the Five Pillars of Islam, Aṣ-Ṣalāh is the obligation for a Muslim faithful to perform daily prayers. Although the number of times one must pray every day and the specific movements when doing it may vary from school to school, the act of daily prayer is common among all Islam.
entities.name: Aṣ-Ṣalāh Farḍ

desc: Islam has always encouraged study and analysis of its scriptures, to the point where we have developed entirely different schools of thought on how to interpret them. Our scholars are therefore extremely learned in the Qur'ān and our other holy texts, capable of having the most in-depth theological discussions.
entities.name: Islamic Schools

desc: Miaphysitism has managed to spread to very distant places. Even while surrounded by enemies and heretics, our faith has remained strong.
entities.name: Isolated Reaches

desc: The fertile, mild land of our peninsula is a popular place for people from bordering countries to seek their fortunes. While many of our cities already rely on labor from seasonal migrants, we should increase our efforts to settle these people into our lands permanently.
entities.name: Appealing Landscape

desc: While the terrain of our lands allows for swift transportation and travel along the coastline, the interior of the Italian peninsula is much harder to traverse in many places. Connecting not only interior locales, but also coast with coast, will ensure easier mercantile operations and improved maneuverability of our troops.
entities.name: Connect the Interior

desc: Foreign interest in Italy has many times turned our lands into the battlefield of stronger countries. Sustaining our people during these times of need is a difficult task. Establishing secure locations to shelter our population during conflict will ensure their support during even the most dire wars.
entities.name: Hardships of War

desc: Our lands are blessed with many highly urbanized areas. This not only offers us ample opportunity to manufacture goods, but their mercantile connections also enable us to ship them to foreign markets for our profit. Clearing any obstruction to expanding these industries will guarantee their continued success.
entities.name: Flourishing Cities

desc: Italy is a desired possession for many foreign rulers. If we want to defend our country, we must expand recruitment for both our land and sea forces. Since Italy is vulnerable to invasions both from across the alpine passes and our vast coastline, we must ensure the army and navy are well-prepared to face any conqueror looking to disrupt the peace of the peninsula.
entities.name: A Prized Possession

desc: With its close proximity to the Holy See, Italy has a long tradition of powerful and talented clergy in the service of the faith. Regardless of where our religious matters will take us, we should maintain good relations with our clergy.
entities.name: Influential Clergy

desc: Our nation is renowned for producing great military minds, whether they serve their own interests or are sworn in loyalty to the state. We should ensure that these adept intellects are willing to serve us first and foremost.
entities.name: Great Condottieri Captains

desc: The galleass was an adaptation of the large merchant galley to counter the increasing use of man-of-war. Larger than the galley, the galleass had about 32 oar pairs, each oar manned by up to five men. As an answer to the men-of-war's armament and higher sides, the galleass had forecastles and aftcastles and gun decks above the rowers. This extra weight meant that they also had to rely more on sails, and were slower and less maneuverable compared to galleys. Like the galley, the galleass went out of regular use with the introduction of more advanced oceangoing men-of-war, but remained useful in shallow waters until the 18th century.
entities.name: Italian Galleass

desc: After the foundation of our unified Italian state, we have absorbed many great noble families into our country. We should utilize their prestige and reputation to improve our own, while keeping those capable people busy.
entities.name: Great Families of Italy

desc: Our ancestors helped Minamoto no Yoritomo during the foundation of the Kamakura Shogunate. As a reward for this contribution, we were ranked as his ''Gokenin'', and awarded a fiefdom in Hyūga Province. This is an honor few families in Kyūshū enjoy.
entities.name: Gokenin Family

desc: Foreigners coming to our land bring with them foreign beliefs. We must of course make sure that this is harmless to our traditional belief systems, but as long as there is no risk to us, we see no reason to disallow people from choosing their own faith.
entities.name: Sympathy for New Faiths

desc: Janissaries are the elite units of our armies, trained since childhood and forged through discipline.
entities.name: Janissaries

desc: The ancestral lineage of our clan is well-known, and our reputation is a pillar of our identity — one that we strive at all costs to uphold, as our history both defines us and ensures our right to rule.
entities.name: Ancestral Legacy

desc: Warfare has always been the domain of the mighty samurai. Recent developments, however, have proved the need for more substantial reinforcements, and thus our battlefields now also include peasant troops. These ''ashigaru'' will not be just common rabble, however, as their rigorous training and ample battle experience makes them formidable fighters, on equal footing with the samurai.
entities.name: Ashigaru

desc: Although never formally codified into specific rules, the way a warrior should behave is clear: A warrior's duty is to fight and win in battle, and to expand the glory of one's own clan, regardless of the methods needed to achieve that.
entities.name: Bushidō

desc: The expected behavior of a warrior is becoming increasingly idealized, with values such as honor and loyalty being given more importance than their actual utility in real battle. This romanticized and codified version of ''Bushidō'', however, will improve how our armies are perceived, even if it is not how they actually behave.
entities.name: Codified Bushidō

desc: Traditional carpentry techniques, or ''daiku'' have been used in Japan since the earliest days of our history. Our wooden buildings are resilient yet flexible, and admired by many for their beauty and skillful construction. From the lowliest hut to the most elaborate palace, wood is our most universal building resource.
entities.name: Daiku Construction

desc: The achievements of a warrior in battle are only truly noteworthy if they can be proven. To that end, samurai will collect the decapitated heads of enemies they have slain to present them later to their general. The more numerous and more important the heads that a samurai takes, the better the rewards he will receive.
entities.name: Head-Hunting

desc: Drawing first blood in battle is an honor and a good omen, and thus our warriors are eager to land the first strike whenever they have the opportunity to do so.
entities.name: Ichiban Yari

desc: Turbulent times are gravely dangerous for our people, so for safety, they tend to settle around the security of fortified places. These huddles eventually turn into cities, which of course provide commercial and cultural assets in addition to physical protection for those who huddle behind the walls.
entities.name: Jōkamachi

desc: Japan has a long and glorious history. Our unique cultural traditions, our brave soldiers, and our unconquerable geography make us stronger than many other states in our region. The time has come for the Land of the Rising Sun to take its place among the great nations of this world!
entities.name: Land of the Rising Sun

desc: Traditionally, we assessed land value based on size, but this failed to take into account that not all land is the same. From now on, it will be valued according to how much Rice can be grown there. This will streamline related economic actions and make it easier to get the best outcomes from our agricultural ventures.
entities.name: Reformed Land Holding

desc: Information is key to gaining the advantage in any situation. To that effect, we have long since used spies and infiltrators to gather reconnaissance. These Shinobi no Mono are usually from the samurai class, although they can also be recruited from the local peasant population, and are sent into enemy territory, where they blend in and establish networks of informants.
entities.name: Shinobi no Mono

desc: These private schools provide basic education to commoners, promoting literacy, numeracy, and moral values. ''Terakoya'' play a vital role in fostering a more educated and socially aware populace, contributing to national stability and progress.
entities.name: Terakoya

desc: It is fairly common for samurai to wander the country in search of the best employment opportunities, switching their allegiance to whoever pays them the most. These warriors come and go like the errant waves, but we can always make use of them.
entities.name: Wandering Rōnin

desc: A new era in warfare is dawning, and with it comes the need for a new regiment of loyal forces. Jaysh fighters, recruited from our tribal population, provide disciplined soldiers familiar with regional warfare and the local terrain.
entities.name: Jaysh Armies

desc: We always keep the holy city of Jerusalem in our minds, as not only it was the place where Jesus preached and died, but also where he will return to in his Second Coming. As such, we always pray facing in the direction of Jerusalem, no matter where we are.
entities.name: Jerusalem Focus

desc: Some native population of South America have been observed to use the bark of a specific tree to treat shivers. Thanks to the experiments of a Jesuit apothecary, this bark has been proven also effective for the treatment of malaria, and it is already known as 'Jesuit's Bark'. Distributing it to the affected population will greatly decrease the effects of the disease.
entities.name: Jesuit's Bark

desc: Islam arose from the sands of Arabia and spread across a largely arid region. Yet some Muslim cities became like prosperous jewels shining in the harsh desert, literal and figurative oasis made bountiful through trade, architecture, and irrigation. With wise investment and planning, any desert settlement can achieve a similar status.
entities.name: Jewels of the Desert

desc: Despite the best efforts of centuries of Sunni sultanates, Western Africa is still plagued by the menace of Animistic pagans. By lifting the banner of Jihād, we can cleanse our lands of the unbelievers and expand our frontiers at the same time.
entities.name: Jihād Against the Pagans

desc: Our Porcelain industry is emblematic of the prosperity and tradition of artisanal excellence alive in our Empire. By perfecting the already-superior Porcelain production techniques of Jǐngdézhèn, we will spread our cultural influence far and wide.
entities.name: Jǐngdézhèn Porcelain

desc: The administrator and supervisor of all the temples and shrines, the Jisha-Bugyō also oversees the activities these religious institutions perform, making sure that their interests align with those of the government.
entities.name: Jisha-Bugyō

desc: As trade grew, so did the associated risk. New ways of accumulating capital and managing this risk needed to be developed. In joint stock companies, the burden of enterprise was shared among their many shareholders.

mods.label: Max Level of Trade Company Headquarters

entities.name: Joint Stock Companies

desc: The time of our country and our Church has been for centuries measured by the Julian Calendar, promulgated by Julius Caesar in 46 BC. It not only unifies all eastern Christian nations, but it also serves to dictate when the important feasts and celebrations are to be held.
entities.name: Julian Calendar

desc: Also known as the Grand Council, the ''Jūnjī Chù'' is tasked with overseeing military affairs. As the most important privy council, it has come to overshadow the Grand Secretariat that held sway over previous dynasties. Despite its crucial role, this council will retain an informal nature within the inner court, with its members holding other official roles besides their councilorship.
entities.name: Jūnjī Chù

desc: In Prussia, a commission is not purchased, it is owed. Our nobles are expected to lead, and to lead well. Men who grew up on the land know how to march across it, and how to keep their soldiers alive along the way.
entities.name: Junker Officer Corps

desc: Our people are enthusiastic about feats of strength and other demonstrations of skill, as each Jurchen feels that by showing off their abilities they earn the respect of their peers. This well-earned self-respect makes our warriors immensely brave, ready to fight anyone.
entities.name: Jurchen Honor

desc: We cannot allow heathens and heretics to dictate our actions. It is our holy duty to cleanse the land of their impurity so that the true realm of God can be manifested on Earth.
entities.name: Justified Holy Wars

desc: By keeping our unruly princes confined to a special part of the harem, the Kafes, we can prevent wanton rebellions and the rivalry between brothers that used to plague our regime.
entities.name: Kafes

desc: Originally sacred ritual dances performed in front of the court by the ''miko'', the shrine maidens, the Kagura also inspired the performance of popular ritual dances all around Japan. These dances have evolved into a myriad of forms, but all of them preserving the tradition and ritual they come from.
entities.name: Kagura

desc: We must always honor the work of Hiawatha and the Great Peacemaker, the Great Law of Peace, which united our five nations under a single purpose, and gave us our rules of governance.
entities.name: Kaianere'kó:wa

desc: Kalaripayattu — the ''Practice in the Arts of the Battlefield'' — is an old Indian martial art with its origins in the Malabar. Warriors of our state shall be trained in the arts of Kalaripayattu to ensure their hand-to-hand and melee prowess.
entities.name: Kalaripayattu

desc: In order to regularize control of the Mark of Brandenburg, we will replace local common law with Roman law. We will further regulate justice by moving the Supreme Court from the court of the Elector, who is prone to moving around, to a fixed central location. This will simultaneously improve justice and curb the power of local magnates.
entities.name: Found the Kammergericht

desc: Cavalry has always been the cornerstone of Turkmen warfare. Our riders, trained from a young age and mounted on hardy Anatolian horses, uphold the proud traditions of steppe warfare with discipline and striking force.
entities.name: Karamanids Cavalry

desc: Formidable traders that primarily deal in spices, these maritime giants have profited greatly from the flow of exotic goods that trail their origin as far as the shores of India — and beyond.
entities.name: Kārimī Merchants

desc: Our Sultanate is enormous, and therefore we must make wise, careful choices about its administration. To employ particularly learned individuals as local governors is a brilliant move, one that should eventually tip the geopolitical scales in our favor.
entities.name: Kāshif

desc: Castellans represent the voice of the monarch across our domain. They are in charge of gathering taxes and enforcing the rule of law, and may even execute justice in the name of the Crown.
entities.name: Kasztelanowie

desc: Delegating administrative duties to local clan heads may mean relinquishing some of our central authority, but our advisors insist that we shall reap great benefits in return.
entities.name: Council of Clan Heads

desc: By establishing permanent military camps at strategic locations throughout our domain, we will ensure our army suffers fewer casualties from attrition and can be mobilized quickly when needed.
entities.name: Fixed Military Camps

desc: As warfare tactics advance, so must our strategy. By adapting foreign innovations and techniques like formations, lines of fire, and new gunpowder recipes, we will surely be victorious!
entities.name: Iron-Helmet Musketeers

desc: Our armies are experienced with siege machinery, but adopting mobile artillery that can maintain sustained fire would secure our victory whenever we attack an enemy's walls!
entities.name: Kanem Siege Tactics

desc: Used throughout the Muslim world, these small fortifications have provided protections to caravans, commercial hubs, and isolated communities alike.
entities.name: Ribāṭ Fortifications

desc: Serbia's rugged terrain has birthed a formidable network of defenses, epitomized by the imposing Smederevo Fortress. These enduring fortifications safeguard our nation, making invasion a daunting prospect. From the sprawling mountain ranges to the strategic river valleys, Serbia's defenses stand as a testament to our resilience and indomitable spirit.
entities.name: Keepers of the Gate

desc: The Kèlè-Koun, or 'war-head', are the commanders of infantry fighting for Empire, called the Kèlè-Bolo, or 'war-arm'. Unlike the Ton-Tigi, the feudal lords of Mali, the Kèlè-Koun are not necessarily part of the Nobility. The Kèlè-Koun have ''jonow'', 'slaves', serving as carriers of the weapons and equipment until their inclusion in the Sofa battalions.
entities.name: The Kèlè-Koun

desc: Despite our impressive ancestry, our clan is very new, as our split from the Sasaki clan is relatively recent. Our people are eager to prove their worth as scions of an independent name.
entities.name: Emerging Clan

desc: We are the Ōmi-Genji, descendants of the Uda Genji branch of the Minamoto family, who have governed Ōmi as hereditary ''Shugo'' for generations. Our well-established position gives us unquestioned legitimacy to defend and rule our ancestral domain.
entities.name: Ōmi-Genji

desc: Large empires are usually formed around a core territory, and otherwise surrounded by subject nations of somewhat dubious loyalty. We should take the necessary measures to keep these nations under our surveillance.
entities.name: Khedivates

desc: Elephants are impressive creatures and tower over any other animal we have seen. It is time to utilize these qualities to strike fear into our enemies by using these majestic animals in warfare. Elephants are also able to carry great weight, allowing us to mount war machines on them. Constructing double-stringed crossbows and equipping our elephants with them will create a tool that will allow us to dominate the battlefields better than ever before.
entities.name: Ballista Elephants

desc: In the past, we both fought with and alongside the fierce warriors of Champa. If we can secure the service of their most capable leaders in times of conflict, we can ensure our own forces are trained and well-rested, ready to leap into battle as fresh reinforcements.
entities.name: Mercenary Leaders of Champa

desc: While our own people are not familiar with silk-weaving and prefer other fabrics, we are lucky that foreign artisans have settled in our cities and established their own weaving workshops. We should adopt this approach for other industries by directly inviting foreign artisans to bring their skills here, and thereby universally expand our production.
entities.name: Invite Foreign Experts

desc: Our great cities are home to many ''barays'' and canals, primed to store and disperse water throughout the area. Constructing and maintaining this network of waterways with skill will ensure our population will thrive even during the unstable monsoon seasons.
entities.name: Hydraulic Cities

desc: While our existing water reservoirs meet our current agricultural demands, we could easily support more people if we were to dig new ''barays'' in other parts of our country, creating the foundations for new urban hubs.
entities.name: Expand the Barays

desc: We cannot allow others to dominate the seas and control the trade our state depends on. Let us create a new, modern naval force capable of taking on any pirate or rival navy in South East Asia.
entities.name: A Modern Navy for Khmer

desc: Our people were humiliated in the past by being forced to bow to foreign invaders. While not every defeat can be avoided, we use these old rivalries to spur our people to fight harder and longer on the battlefield, burning to erase the shame of these ancient humiliations.
entities.name: Guided by Rivalry

desc: Our lands are frequently threatened by invasion, and our precious Angkor lies especially vulnerable to siege. We must invest into a comprehensive system of fortifications, with sufficient garrisons to withstand any invading force, so that we can protect our people and national treasures from foreign conquest.
entities.name: Secure the Borders

desc: We will need to reinforce our army with new recruits, which are easily found among the peasant class. With some training, we will be able to ensure the ranks can be refilled at any time by capable soldiers.
entities.name: Recruit the Peasantry

desc: Our country has lived through tumultuous times as royal patronage shifted between both Hinduism and various branches of Buddhism. We must promote the chosen faith throughout our country to breed stability, and trust that our ruler has chosen the true path for our people.
entities.name: One Faith for Khmer

desc: The great city of Angkor was once a brilliant example of our architectural genius. Due to external pressures, we had to abandon our construction efforts, but we should connect to the roots of our society and start constructing new monuments to our splendor again.
entities.name: Restoration of Angkor

desc: Our rulers excel at creating dazzling processions, events of glorious splendor that very few others can rival. These extravagant demonstrations of our national wealth confirm the power and brilliance of the ruler and the astonishing riches of our nation. The glittering procession of elephants, treasure, and the royal guard will strike awe and respect in the hearts of our people, winning their unbroken loyalty and admiration.
entities.name: Khmer Royal Processions

desc: Our rivers provide an excellent way to transport goods harvested and produced in our inland territories to our harbors, which are connected to foreign trade routes. Utilizing this transport network will also connect our cities and make communication between them faster.
entities.name: The Lifeblood of Khmer

desc: Attracting merchants from as far away as Persia and Arabia, our capital has become a bustling commercial hub, facilitating business from the horn of Africa all the way to the shores of China.
entities.name: Kilwan Trade Networks

desc: Unlike other powerful clans in Kyūshū, our family settled here before the establishment of the Kamakura Shogunate. Our achievements are well known, and our name is respected.
entities.name: Distinguished Family

desc: Our contributions to defending the country against the Mongol invasions are well known. Kikuchi Takefusa's achievements in repelling the invaders are widely lauded, and all our troops aim to fight as bravely as him.
entities.name: Resistance Against Invasions

desc: The Murakami clan is well-known for committing piracy in the Seto Inland Sea. Let us integrate them fully in our own clan, and send these fearsome privateers after our enemies!
entities.name: Murakami Suigun

desc: The Seto Inland Sea has a special importance for trade routes of Japan, and maintaining naval dominance here could make or break our clan. We must ensure that we always have a strong navy with which to control maritime trade.
entities.name: Rule Over the Inland Sea

desc: Since the late Heian Period, we have been the biggest naval power in the Seto Inland Sea. In fact, our navy is how we became ''Shugo'' of this province.
entities.name: Shugo of Iyo

gate: is capital in south america or carribean

desc: By using arrangements of cords and knots to record information, we can greatly facilitate administration of our lands and keeping accurate records of vital information.
entities.name: Talking Knots

desc: Almost since its inception as a country, Japan and Shintō have been influenced by foreign ideas coming from China and Buddhism. A new movement is taking root, claiming that our own national spirit is naturally pure, and that our society must be cleansed of any foreign influences.
entities.name: Kokugaku

desc: Not so long ago, our city was nearly torn apart in the struggle between our burghers and our clergy. We must ensure that this conflict cannot repeat itself, and that every member of both our court and the city council cooperate in preserving Cologne as a central hub on the Rhine.
entities.name: Peace in the City

desc: Our city is home to many capable painters and craftsmen skilled in the art of bringing images to life through the media of wood, stone, and especially glass. With the support of a strongly established artists' guild, they will thrive under our sponsorship and illuminate our city to new glory.
entities.name: Cologne School of Painting

desc: Our government's need for capable administrators has led to systematic education reform. We will establish the first education ministry in Europe, devoted to spreading literacy throughout our population, which will hopefully lead to an increase in qualified candidates to staff our expanding administration.
entities.name: Komisja Edukacji Narodowej

desc: Before the rise of our realm, the people of this region governed themselves through clan councils and provincial alliances. What we now call Kongo emerged from centuries of interwoven relationships, where loyalty to the land and kin outweighed loyalty to borders. Uniting this patchwork into a centralized realm was no small feat, but we did it and we will keep it together yet.
entities.name: Bakongo Confederation

desc: The influx of foreigners and cultural exchanges have made an impact on our society. However, we have not abandoned our own ways. We call upon deities by Kikongo names, we proudly wear our religious insignia, and our ceremonies echo with both drums and hymns. This is a vibrant example of our clarity, and the gods seem to agree.
entities.name: Cultural Syncretism

desc: The strangers came from the sea with beards, books, and barrels of wine. They brought with them strange gods, stranger languages, and an entire ocean of opportunity. Our emissaries have learned their customs, their intentions, and — most importantly — how to turn their need for allies into our advantage.
entities.name: Contact with Europe

desc: All things must begin somewhere, and for our kingdom, that beginning lies with Lukeni lua Nimi. He was more than a conqueror. Indeed, he was a founder, the father of our realm. His bloodline commanded respect, not just for its ancestry, but because it reminds the people who first dared to dream of a unified Kongo.
entities.name: Lineage of Lukeni lua Nimi

desc: The musket may not make a man brave, but it certainly makes him fearsome. Let those in Europe boast of their superiority; we will buy their weapons, master their drills, and soon enough the only thing distinguishing our soldiers from theirs will be the color of their flags.
entities.name: Study European Firearms

desc: Prisoners and laborers are needed overseas to operate our many worksites, plantations, and mines. While this is far from a noble endeavor, none can deny the profitable nature of these exploits.
entities.name: Transatlantic Slaves Trade

desc: Our borders are constantly threatened, both by barbarians from the north and pirates from beyond the seas. To ensure our armies are always ready to meet every threat with swiftness, we will establish a council of officers dedicated to controlling and securing our borders.
entities.name: Border Defense Council

desc: Our aristocracy puts great emphasis on the cultural development of their spirit and mind. Literature, such as poetry in Classical Chinese, is seen as greatly valuable by the court. The nobility and ruling class alike are enthusiastic about the cultural impact of the written word.
entities.name: Court Poetry

desc: A new set of reforms that will gradually introduce previously ignored improvements into the tax system. The tribute tax levied against households will be replaced with a unified tax on arable land, and the tax on goods will be limited to a quota which lets enterprising peasants and wholesalers make and sell surplus goods. This will result in lower taxes for the peasantry, increased revenues for the state, and an overall rise in commerce.
entities.name: Daedongbeop

desc: The Gwiseon Turtle Ship is a Korean warship which utilizes oars and sails to outmaneuver other types of galleys, while also being equipped with light ''Chongtong'' - Korean firearms.
entities.name: Gwiseon Turtle Ship

desc: Korea was home to many kingdoms in the past. However, the influence of one kingdom in particular is still felt today: Goguryeo, the precursor to Goryeo. Goguryeo has left us many legacies, including its stone fortifications and castle-building techniques, which are still in use to this day.
entities.name: Fortresses of Goguryeo

requires_state: has advance: kor early turtle ship advance

desc: Defending our coastlines is vital to our survival, and as a result of this vigilance, we have developed the ingenious 'turtle ship'. These heavily armored behemoths will ensure that no enemy ship penetrates our coastal holdings.
entities.name: Geobukseon

desc: To ensure proper, stable governance, we must first codify exactly how the government will work. This will be the basis for our nation's first written constitution.
entities.name: Grand Code for State Administration

desc: Our forces have been aware of gunpowder's tactical value for centuries. Through reverse-engineering Chinese designs and the innovations of Choe Museon, we have mastered both gunpowder production and the construction of machines that employ it for military use.
entities.name: Gunpowder Engines

desc: The Korean language is so fundamentally different from any form of Chinese that the use of Chinese characters renders all except the most highly educated people illiterate. Our new alphabet is more scientific, and will allow all our people to be able to read and write in their own language.
entities.name: The Hangeul Alphabet

desc: The ''hopae'' is an identity tag system requiring all Korean people to carry proof of their name, birthplace, status, and residence. This allows authorities to quickly verify identities, and to track a person's movement, if needed.
entities.name: The Hopae System

desc: The Hwacha deliver devastating firepower through their barrages of rocket-powered arrows or iron-headed bolts. Their maneuverability forces them to take a more defensive role in battles.
entities.name: Hwacha

desc: Korea has always had artistic traditions, but art has truly blossomed since our national unification, thrusting us into a golden era of cultural achievement. Among our many accomplishments, the artisanry of our people shines as a beacon of skill and refinement.
entities.name: Korean Artisanry

desc: Our armies need a steady supply of troops to keep them in prime condition. Having local centers of recruitment and training will allow us to have easily available reserves.
entities.name: Korean Barracks

desc: Although we are already quite experienced at using gunpowder and cannon, we should not stop making technological advancements. By developing smaller, but more durable cannons, as well as inventing more efficient methods of reloading, we will revolutionize our artillery and greatly benefit both our army and our navy.
entities.name: The Korean Cannon

desc: As gunpowder technology advances, so does our ingenuity, and as a result we have devised a new defensive system. Although simple in concept and execution, installing cannons in our fortifications will increase their defensive capabilities tremendously.
entities.name: Korean Gunnery

desc: Movable type is an ancient printing technology first used by the Chinese people many centuries ago. But it is the Goryeo dynasty who developed the metal form of movable type, streamlining the printing process. We can now print books with unparalleled efficiency.
entities.name: Metal Movable Type

desc: The Panokseon is a multi-deck warship with greater size and firepower than the usual Geobukseon Turtle Ship. While still relying on oars, the sails of the Panokseon allow it to reach a greater speed comparable to galleys for its size.
entities.name: Panokseon

desc: The Kouroukan Fouga is the basic constitution of Mali. It covers every aspect of living, from simple family life in the villages all the way to the sovereignty of the Mansa.
entities.name: Kouroukan Fouga

desc: In an attempt to reform our monetary system, we will introduce a new currency, the ''Kraków Grosz''. Minted from silver, these coins are destined to challenge the power of the Bohemian ''Prague Groschen'' and help establish our realm as pioneers of centralized taxation.
entities.name: Grosz Krakowski

desc: Our homelands are surrounded by many would-be conquerors, hungry to subjugate our people. While our native terrain can slow down hostile armies, it also makes it difficult for our own troops to respond to threats swiftly. A strong cavalry, however, will allow us to quickly react to any threats, no matter how many there might be.
entities.name: Adaptable Cavalry

desc: Our people have long served as hired swords for foreign lords, gaining valuable combat experience in their service. With our own country now established, it is time to call those experienced fighters under our banner.
entities.name: Mercenary Experience

desc: In the times of foreign rule, many of our people established predominantly Kurdish quarters in cities. While these areas prospered even under distant rulers, we can now utilize their wealth directly, and better guarantee a prosperous future for our people.
entities.name: Prospering Kurdish Quarters

desc: Having asserted our authority over all Kurdish tribes, we will be able to call upon their experienced, hardened warriors to defend our country.
entities.name: Tribal Loyalty

desc: Our rulers must not just be capable warriors; they must also be educated in the matters of fine art and effective administration. By writing texts and documenting their reigns, our leaders will pass the knowledge and history of our people down through generations, ensuring no valuable insight is lost.
entities.name: Warrior Poets

desc: Our people have established several great dynasties, ruling territories from Egypt to Iran. Tying our own state to the glory of past rulers will allow us to be a unifying symbol for the Kurdish people, and make our rule seem more legitimate in the eyes of our subjects.
entities.name: Legacy of the Kurdish Dynasties

desc: As the keepers of the holiest of Japan's shrines at Ise, we are blessed by Amaterasu, goddess of the sun and the universe. We must rise to be worthy of the task of maintaining and caring for this national treasure, which will earn us the respect of the Japanese people.
entities.name: Blessing of Amaterasu

desc: From the wealthy south to the densely populated urban north, we have extended our control over the entire province of Ise. This will allow us to fully exploit provincial resources to further the growth of our clan's influence.
entities.name: Control of Ise

desc: We supported the Southern Court during the Imperial schism, showing loyalty to the Chrysanthemum Throne despite their struggles. This reputation for loyal service grants us more prestige and moral authority than many of the lesser houses that now dominate Japan.
entities.name: Supporters of the Emperor

desc: Our honorable ancestor Kitabatake Akiie proved that even the long march from Ōu to central Japan can be undertaken rapidly if one has enough determination. We must learn from this feat and train our armies in swift maneuvering, so that we can quickly move from one front to another as needed.
entities.name: March of Kitabatake Akiie

desc: Swedish rulers often depended on cooperation with the estates, especially with such a large peasant class compared to that of the nobility. During the reign of Gustavus Adolphus, however, a historic compromise was made with the aristocrats, who loyally pledged their resources to the disposal of the nation in return for new privileges.

mods.label: Estate Satisfaction from Destroying Estate Buildings

entities.name: Kung och Riksdag
