desc: The ancient blood of the ''Paleologue'' gives our marquisate a dignity and legitimacy that commands respect from the greatest courts of Europe. This lineage connects us to a world of ceremony and diplomacy that most smaller states can only admire from afar. We carry this heritage as a shield as much as an ornament, using it to open doors that our armies alone could never unlock.
entities.name: The Paleologue Dynasty

desc: Genghis Khān unified great swathes of territory under his banner. Having unified those territories again under the authority of a single Khān, all people in our empire shall swear allegiance to us.
entities.name: All Under a Khān

desc: The prowess of Mongolian horsemen is renowned across the entire world. Our enemies shake in terror at the sight of a dust cloud in the distance, fearing that it might signify our cavalry's approach!
entities.name: Ghostly Horses of the Plain

desc: The extraordinary Genghis Khān amassed a huge army like never before seen. We are heirs to his glory, and therefore our army will outstrip even the greatest Mongol hordes of the past.
entities.name: Glory of the Khān

desc: The system of ''yam'' posts all over our empire have facilitated communication and logistics since the times of the great Genghis Khān. After re-establishing and improving this system, our messengers can cross the massive expanse of our empire at speeds that were not even thought possible before.
entities.name: Improved Yam System

desc: The ''Kheshig'' once formed the formidable bodyguard of the Great Mongol Khān. Their descendants will continue to protect the Khān of Mongolia as they ride into battle.
entities.name: The Kheshig

desc: The steppe is a foreboding and unforgiving place for the unprepared. We are accustomed to living in this harsh environment, and as such our people are sturdy and have a knack for survival. We will ensure that all of our soldiers share these skills, and are thus able to more easily survive extreme situations.
entities.name: The Life of a Steppe Warrior

desc: Each of our soldiers typically maintains three or four horses, allowing them to change each time their mount becomes tired, and thereby travel at high speed for days without stopping. Furthermore, their extra mounts provide them with food reserves through mare's milk as well as horse meat, making our armies far less vulnerable to starvation than other, so-called civilized nations' armies. This allows us to outmaneuver our enemies with ease, covering a staggering amount of territory in shorter periods than they had believed to be possible.
entities.name: Mongolian Mobility

desc: The territories of the great Mongol Empire are home to many different peoples, all unified under the glory of the mighty Khān.
entities.name: Multicultural Empire

desc: Having unified all Mongolian territories under our banner, the stability and prosperity our people will be able to enjoy has not been seen since the times of the great Genghis Khān.
entities.name: Pax Mongolica

desc: As the original Mongols, we restored the ''Yeke Mongol Ulus'', the Great Mongolian State, resurrecting the glory of Genghis Khān's great empire. Given the slightest chance, our people will emulate the exploits of the Great Khān and reclaim his legacy, reuniting the once-vast territories of the Mongol Khanate.
entities.name: Yeke Mongol Ulus

desc: Ashta Pradhan - ''Modern Council of Ministers'' - is the system of ministerial delegation used by the Marathi people. The council is tasked with guiding the administration of the state, overviewing matters of the military, finances, diplomacy, and religion alike.
entities.name: Ashta Pradhan

desc: Our financial sector is dominated by Brāhmaṇa banking families. Let us integrate them further in our administration by hiring them as tax collectors, and creating regulations to strengthen their rights and protect their traditions. We will have gained the favor of our financiers as well as access to learned and able administrators.
entities.name: Encourage Brāhmaṇa Ties

desc: In these hilly and densely forested lands, maintaining a series of forts is an offensive necessity as well as a defensive one. Meticulous maintenance of our fortifications should therefore be a top priority.
entities.name: Forts of Maharashtra

desc: The ''Peshwa'' Shall be our chief minister, entirely devoted to both civil administration and overseeing military operations. This consolidation of power will make us versatile enough to expand quickly and efficiently.
entities.name: Office of the Peshwa

desc: The villages of the Desh are full of able men who would be more than willing to serve in our armies. Let us recruit the Marathi-speaking members of our population into our military.
entities.name: Peasant Soldiers

desc: Marathi cavalrymen have a long tradition of service as 'Bargirs' for the Deccan sultanates. The increased militarization of the Deccan due to the many wars fought in the area has made our cavalry one of the most dangerous forces in India.
entities.name: Tradition of Military Service

desc: The Buddha teaches us that we should avoid extremes, as neither with sensual indulgence nor extreme asceticism can one achieve enlightenment.
entities.name: Middle Way

desc: Mercantile opportunities and the promise of a better life are some of the reasons as to why our towns and settlements tend to receive constant waves of immigration. Many men and women relocate to our lands seeking their fortune, and their presence and contributions increase our fortune in turn.
entities.name: Migrant Opportunities

desc: We have raised a theatre on the site of the old church of Santa Maria alla Scala, large enough to seat two thousand and fitted with stage machinery that no other house in Europe can match. The first night drew every ambassador, merchant prince, and noble family who could claim a connection to Milan, and within a season premieres here were being discussed from London to Saint Petersburg. This stage makes our court the cultural arbiter of the continent, and the artists who succeed at La Scala carry our city's name everywhere they travel.
entities.name: Teatro alla Scala

desc: The coiled serpent of the Visconti has become the most recognized symbol of power in Northern Italy, stamped on our coins, our seals, and the gates of every city that answers to us. By making the ''Biscione'' the official mark of the ducal state, we tie the region's loyalty to our dynasty rather than to any one noble faction. This visual authority makes it far harder for rivals to question our rule, and our ambassadors find that the serpent on their credentials opens doors that other Italian lords cannot.
entities.name: Il Biscione

desc: The cities of Lombardy have governed themselves through elected consuls and independent courts since the time of the Lombard League, building a tradition of civic law that no emperor has managed to fully dismantle. We draw on this legacy by codifying these municipal liberties into a formal charter, granting our towns a recognized degree of self-governance in exchange for their loyal contribution of taxes and troops. This compact between the crown and the city keeps our urban population engaged and invested, reducing the friction that bleeds other states dry whenever they need to call on their subjects.
entities.name: Municipal Liberties

desc: The ever-increasing armies of the 16th century have imposed equally heightened demands on national administrations. By creating a permanent organization charged with military supply strategy and operation, and by keeping more troops on the rolls even during winter or peacetime, we will ultimately be able to field large armies more cheaply and to support those armies more efficiently.
entities.name: Military Administration

desc: Defending our frontiers is a serious issue, and puts significant financial pressure on the state. The solution we have hit upon is to make generous grants of frontier lands in order to build up a professional military class. This will ensure more discipline overall and facilitate migration to the underpopulated regions of our realm.
entities.name: Military Frontier

desc: Allows us to invest in military training and thereby improve battle formations, weapon handling, and our army's morale.
entities.name: Military Drill

desc: The ''mit'a'' is a mandatory public service system fundamental to Incan society, and forms the backbone of the military service. Every ''ayllu'' must contribute capable men, adapted to combat in the highlands, to provide labor for state projects and military service.
entities.name: Military Mit'a

desc: Our people remember the birth of our nation: surrounded by formidable powers that pose permanent, looming threats to our security. This enduring vigilance has forged a culture of unwavering readiness, ensuring our armed forces stand as a shield against adversity. Fearless and respected, our soldiers have transformed us from potential prey to a mighty adversary, deterring any who dare encroach upon our sovereignty.
entities.name: Military Modernization

desc: War never changes, but the manner of waging it does. Recent arms developments have proved that the old ways of fighting are obsolete, and armies have experienced a full paradigm shift. Adapting to those changes is the only way to continue being a strong military power.
entities.name: Military Revolution

desc: With artillery being mobile enough to accompany the rest of the army on the battlefield, its influence is no longer limited to whatever is in firing range. Semi-autonomous artillery formations led by artillery officers can instead be deployed where they are most needed.
entities.name: Field Artillery

desc: The nature of war is constantly evolving, and we must ensure that perceptions of our military evolve with it. By encouraging a tradition of service amongst our nobility, we shall entrench the idea that high social status is earned through glory on the battlefield. While bravery and combat skill remain important, true military excellence now lies in professional expertise rather than nebulous things like personal valor.
entities.name: Military Traditions

desc: The generalization of muskets as the main firearms during the 17th century allows local Militiamen units to be deployed as reserve and support units for the main armies on the battlefield.
entities.name: Militiamen

desc: By establishing unique codes of law in each of our empire's provinces, we can ensure that our rule will be viewed as equitable and just. These law books, known as ''Kanunname'', will take into consideration the local circumstances and traditions of each of our diverse and far-flung provinces.
entities.name: Kanunnames

desc: We eagerly embrace the ways of Byzantium, aiming to mirror their laws and overall style. Drawing from the rich tapestry of Roman influences, we strive to infuse our governance and legal system with their essence, in a conscious effort to emulate the grace and sophistication of Byzantium within our realm.
entities.name: Mimicking the Phoenix

desc: An essential part of Buddhist practice, Mindfulness means to be aware of the phenomena of both body and mind, while keeping the teachings of the Buddha always present in the mind. With this, one can avoid the arising of unwanted states, and develop into the wanted ones.
entities.name: Mindfulness

desc: Quarrying has been a basic economic activity since the dawn of humanity. The widespread use of metalworking only increased the importance of prospecting and mining different types of minerals and metals for the development of complex societies.
entities.name: Quarrying

desc: This law determines who owns the mining operations in our country.
entities.name: Mining Law

desc: Our land is rich in rare materials, ready to be ripped from the earth and sold to foreign merchants for large profits. We would be foolish not to exploit this.
entities.name: Mining Tradition

desc: The Minting Office is the main manufacturing building which creates the currency of the state. Different metals enter the office to be forged into coinage for the public.
entities.name: Minting Office

desc: Ormuzi coinage circulates from Basra al-Hamra to Bengal, trusted for its purity and weight. By institutionalizing our mint and expanding our issuance, we reinforce our financial sovereignty — and claim fiscal supremacy over the Indian Ocean.
entities.name: Mint of the Gulf

desc: There are many types of currency in circulation, but the one that bears our seal is the most widely accepted as trustworthy.
entities.name: Currency Ownership

desc: The growing demands of international trade will need to be accounted for in the planning of our trading endeavors. With this expansion of our trade depots, we can reach new shores without risking our valuable cargo.
entities.name: Expanded Trade Depots

desc: Trade with foreign countries is the lifeblood of our nation. By meticulously planning out the trading routes and stockpiling supplies for each voyage, we can reach markets further from our bases.
entities.name: Planned Trade Expeditions

desc: Although there is no shortage of people willing to spread the word of the true faith, most of them ultimately do more harm than good. However, establishing specialist schools to properly train missionaries will ensure we have more people who cannot only spread the faith, but do so successfully.
entities.name: Missionary Schools

desc: In order to undertake great building projects in the past, our rulers had to fulfill ancient traditions by inviting every single petty chief in our empire to the capital, showering them with gifts, and holding lavish feasts. As our state grows, however, this is far from an ideal way to undertake these projects. Supplying labor and materials for construction should be the duty of each and every chief in our lands.
entities.name: Mitma Obligations

desc: We establish a dedicated academy for the formal training of officers — moving the education of our military elite from the haphazard apprenticeship of the camp to the systematic instruction of the classroom. Geometry, fortification, tactics, and the art of command will be taught as disciplines, producing officers who can reason through problems rather than simply follow tradition. This institution will become one of the finest of its kind in Europe, and its graduates will be sought by armies far beyond our borders.
entities.name: Accademia Militare

desc: We will move the production of balsamic vinegar from its traditional role as a household good to a state-protected luxury product. Produced only by our elite families, it will become a diplomatic gift used to secure alliances and trade favors in the courts of our friends and rivals. These small luxuries will ensure that the Modenese brand remains synonymous with extreme quality and exclusivity.
entities.name: Diplomazia Balsàmica

desc: The workshops of Modena have long produced silk and wool cloth of a quality that commands premium prices at the great northern fairs. Under our patronage, we deepen this tradition by protecting the guild practices that concentrate weaving expertise within our walls and ensuring that the most skilled artisans train their successors. This investment in craft turns our merchants into trusted suppliers to the courts of Europe and brings steady returns to our treasury that do not depend on the fortunes of war.
entities.name: Este Textile Craft

desc: Among the great private libraries of Italy, ours stands apart — assembled across generations, its manuscripts and illuminated volumes draw scholars from across the continent to our court. We organize and expand this collection, making it a working institution where learned men advance the frontiers of knowledge under our patronage. This commitment to the life of the mind accelerates the spread of new ideas through our lands and signals to the world that our court is a place where civilization flourishes.
entities.name: The Estense Library

desc: We will build a palace worthy of our ambitions — a monument of stone and plaster that faces the world as a statement of permanence and power rather than the improvised grandeur of earlier generations. Every hall and gallery is designed to impress visiting ambassadors and reinforce the awe of our subjects, turning architecture into an argument for our dynasty. This investment in visible magnificence pays back in prestige and in the artistic commissions it draws to our capital.
entities.name: The Ducal Palace

desc: Before the great dynasties, the cities of the Po plain governed themselves through elected consuls and sworn associations of citizens, building habits of civic organization that no lord has fully displaced. We draw on this inheritance to formalize the relationship between the crown and our urban communities, offering recognized rights in exchange for the taxes and soldiers that sustain the state. This compact between crown and city roots our authority in consent as much as in force, making our subjects partners in government rather than merely subjects of it.
entities.name: The Ancient Commune

desc:
In order to best utilize the lands and subjects we control, we must enlarge, reorganize, and professionalize our bureaucracy. We shall create organizations dedicated to administering specific aspects of the state, and thus eliminate the need for ad hoc solutions.

Let us consult with our universities to determine how to most efficiently rule and govern. Meanwhile, we shall encourage our young nobles to serve the state with a pen rather than a sword in hand.
entities.name: Modern Bureaucracy

desc: The growth of towns and cities and the increased governmental needs consequently require an expansion of the building housing the local authorities, to be able to continue performing their function adequately. The increased size of archives and registers are all to serve as an expansion of the authority of the court itself.
entities.name: Expanded Council Hall

desc: ] has a modern flat surface and is of good quality.
entities.name: Modern Road

desc: Our state lives and dies by the capabilities of our army. Our military not only ensures our survival, but is also what has set us on the path to greatness. We cannot allow ourselves to fall behind in progress!
entities.name: Modernization of the Military

desc: Since the Wars of Independence, we have been looking at reinforcing and updating our navy. Previously, we had used feudal obligations to bulk out our fleets with crew and ships, but we will now create a modern fleet, owned by the King and based in our port of Newhaven.
entities.name: Royal Scots Navy

desc: The arrival of the philosopher Georgios Gemistus Plethon at the court of Mystras has signaled a radical shift in the Morean identity, as he has proposed a return to the laws and social structures of ancient Sparta. Plethon advocates for a national army of native Greeks rather than unreliable mercenaries, and a social order based on Hellenic heritage rather than just Christian confession. This proto-nationalist awakening will provide the Despotate with a powerful ideological weapon, transforming the defense of the Morea into a crusade for the survival of the Greek nation itself, which will bolster the prestige of our ruling house even if we stick to Christianity.
entities.name: Plethon's Vision

desc: Following the Byzantine recovery of the forts of Monemvasia, Maina, and Mystras, the Despotate of the Morea has dedicated itself to a long 'reconquista' of the peninsula from the Frankish Principalities. This campaign is not merely one of siegecraft, but of cultural subversion, as the Greek administration encourages the local population to rise against their Latin lords in favor of the 'rightful ruler'. Through a combination of strategic marriages, persistent skirmishing, and the gradual absorption of feudal fiefs, the Morea slowly knits together a fractured land into a cohesive province.
entities.name: Reclaiming the Peloponnese

desc: As the wave of Enlightenment sweeps across the Mediterranean, the despots of the Morea have taken the radical step of formalizing the relationship between the throne and the people through a written charter. This document, heavily influenced by the social theories of the Mystras Academy, dismantles the last vestiges of Byzantine courtly favoritism in favor of a meritocratic civil service and protects property rights for the burgeoning merchant class. By granting the citizenry a stake in the governance of the state, the Despotate fosters an intense national loyalty that makes the population far more resistant to foreign subversion. This political modernization will transform the Morea from a traditional autocracy into a sophisticated 'National Monarchy', capable of mobilizing the full psychological and financial resources of its people for the glory of the state.
entities.name: The Constitution of Morea

desc: Like Constantinople, the hill-city of Mystras ascends as the premier center of Hellenic culture, attracting the Empire's greatest scholars, artists, and theologians to its sun-drenched slopes. The Despots of the Kantakouzenos and Palaiologos houses foster a vibrant intellectual atmosphere where the study of Classical Greek philosophy is merged with Orthodox mysticism. This ''Mystras Renaissance'' ensures that the Despotate is no longer a mere provincial outpost, but a prestigious capital in its own right, possessing a gravitational pull that draws diplomats and thinkers from across the Mediterranean.
entities.name: The Court of Mystras

desc: Recognizing that the Isthmus of Corinth is the gateway to the peninsula, the Morean state will invest heavily in the reconstruction and modernization of the Hexamilion wall. Utilizing new developments in gunpowder fortification, the ancient barrier will be transformed into a sophisticated line of bastions, redoubts, and artillery batteries designed to withstand a modern imperial siege and, then, replicated across our nation. This 'Great Wall of Greece' will serve as the cornerstone of a defensive strategy that will allow the Despotate to project power safely behind an impenetrable line, forcing any invader to commit to a long and costly naval blockade.
entities.name: The Hexamilion Modernization

desc: The Peloponnesian silk industry, long a staple of the local economy, underwent a massive state-led expansion during the 17th century to fund the Despotate's growing military ambitions. By inviting Venetian master-weavers and Genoese dyers to settle in the capital of Mystras, the Despots have broken the foreign monopoly on luxury textile processing, ensuring that the entire value chain — from mulberry cultivation to finished brocade — remained within Greek borders. This economic protectionism will turn the Morea into a vital 'Silk Hub' that will link the luxury demands of the European Enlightenment with the raw materials of the East. The resulting surge in custom duties and trade tolls will provide the treasury with the gold necessary to maintain a modern bureaucracy and a standing army without overtaxing the peasantry.
entities.name: The Silk Road of Morea

desc: Our people descend from the Mohe tribes of the Amur forests. Their traditions of hunting, herding, and hardy frontier life shape our society.
entities.name: Mohe Ancestry

desc: Under the banner of the Golden Bull, representing our nation, Moldavia will become the 'Bulwark of the East', successfully defending against enemy incursions. We will start a tradition of building a monastery for every military victory that will create a landscape of religious sites. This fusion of religious zeal and military discipline ensures our soldiers fight with the conviction of crusaders.
entities.name: The Banner of the Golden Bull

desc: A transformative era of intellectual self-awareness has dawned! Our high boyars have begun to systematically document the history of our people in our native Romanian for the first time. By scientifically documenting the Latin origins and linguistic heritage we share with our Romanian brothers, we shift the state's foundation from a purely religious identity to a modern linguistic and historical one. This cultural awakening strengthens the internal legitimacy of the Prince and provides our diplomats with the historical arguments needed to assert our sovereignty among the European courts. History has become a weapon of the state.
entities.name: The Chronicles of Grigore Ureche

desc: Vineyards have remained Moldavia's greatest treasure, with the sweet white wines of Cotnari rivaling Tokay in the courts of Europe. We have already codified the first wine classifications, establishing a state interest in the export of 'Perle de la Moldavie'; now it is time to pass to action. This luxury trade will provide the Princely court with significant hard currency from neighboring markets, funding the lavish palaces in our capital.
entities.name: The Cotnari & Odobești Wines

desc: To counter the numbers of our enemies, we have reorganized our army into the ''Oastea Mare'' (The Great Army). By granting land to the ''Răzeși'' — free-holding peasants who owe service directly to the Voivode — we have created a loyal, self-equipped infantry core that fights with the ferocity of landowners defending their own soil. This system ensures that even when the boyars waver, the Prince has a reliable and massive pool of battle-hardened soldiers.
entities.name: The Great Military Reforms

desc: By securing the 'Moldavian Road' connecting the Baltic Sea to the Black Sea, we have positioned our main settlements as vital hubs for the Northern European fur and wax trades. We have granted extensive privileges to Slavic merchants and German burghers to settle in our customs towns, ensuring that every caravan passing from the Baltic to the Genoese ports of the south pays a heavy toll into our treasury. This commercial wealth allows us to fund a professional court and to build stone fortifications without taxing our free peasantry into rebellion.
entities.name: The Moldavian Road

desc: Dimitrie Cantemir has ascended to become a polymath of European renown, bringing the radical principles of the early Enlightenment directly into our court. By mapping the intricate history, music, and geography of our region for a Western audience, we have gained a profound strategic advantage in the shifting sands of Eastern European politics. We have transitioned from a medieval frontier march into a scientifically managed state that looks increasingly toward the modernized reforms of the West for its political and military inspiration. Knowledge is the new currency of the Moldavian throne.
entities.name: The Moldovan Enlightenment

desc: Authority cannot be entrusted to just any individual. Concentrating power and influence in the hands of the ruler will help them create order and stability throughout the realm.
entities.name: Monarchy Reform Traditions

desc: The traditions and the culture of the court play a significant role in the stability of the Monarchy. These customs will ensure the safe transition of power from ruler to heir, and limit the court intrigues significantly.
entities.name: Royal Court Customs

desc: The holy occupants of our monasteries are bastions of sensible, frugal living. Our clergy should consider adapting their own lifestyles to more closely resemble those of these monks and nuns.
entities.name: Monastic Frugality

desc: Buddhist life is centered around its communities of monks and nuns, called the ''Saṃgha''. They are governed by the ''Vinaya'', the rules and precepts that dictate the operations of any Buddhist religious community.
entities.name: Monastic Communities

desc: A fusion of spiritual and temporal rule defines our political landscape. From the smallest village to the halls of power in Sakya, monastic institutions are central to every sphere of life. Their moral authority and organizational prowess ensure loyalty, unity, and cultural resilience.
entities.name: Monastic Dominance

desc: Although Miaphysitism also proclaims that the figure of Christ has only a single nature, it differs substantially from the Eutychian Monophysite view which proclaims that the humanity of Christ was absorbed into his divinity. Though there may be some that also call us followers of Monophysitism, it is just an agreement in words, as in substance our views are clearly different.
entities.name: Monophysite vs Miaphysite

desc: In our people's many millennia of existence on this planet, they have endured thousands of catastrophes through sheer tenacity. This innate steely strength has come to be recognized as a defining feature of our society. We showcase our resilience in the strength of our army and the divine beauty of our art.
entities.name: Monuments of Greatness

desc: For generations, our realm maintained peace with the mainland through the ancient tribute system known as ''Moqarrariya''. Rather than depending on custom and negotiation, let us codify these tributes into formal pacts — securing fresh water, overland safety, and long-term stability through reliable diplomacy.
entities.name: Institutionalize the Moqarrariya

desc: The mountain ranges that occupy most part of our country — the various parts of the Atlas and the Rif — are the reason no empire has ever truly conquered Morocco. Our Amazigh mountain clans have been defendeding these passes since the times when Roman armies first marhced through them, and our knowledge of every track and refuge remains unmatched. The mountains do not slow us; they protect us.
entities.name: Strongholds of the Atlas

desc: Several groups of Ṣūfī teachers have made Morocco their home. We must make sure that we accommodate these holy men, and take their teachings to heart.

mods.label: Invite Religious Figure from Same School Cost
Invite Religious Figure from New School Cost

entities.name: Ṣūfī Marabouts

desc: No army can exist in a permanent state of action; all soldiers need time for rest and recovery. By establishing guidelines and procedures for them to rest, without permitting any laziness, we can keep our troops in prime condition.
entities.name: Established Rest

desc: The formation of guilds has shaped our economy for a long time. While they are common organizations amongst our artisans, the same cannot be said for our merchants. We should encourage our traders to form similar guilds in order to streamline our mercantile ambitions.
entities.name: Merchant Guilds

desc: The lands of Russia have been ruled by one dynasty since time immemorial. We should utilize our position among our peers and our blood ties to take a leading role.
entities.name: Rule through Dynastic Ties

desc: Governing the vast expanse of Russia is no easy task. We should establish local recruitment centers to make drafting levies into our armies easier.
entities.name: Organized Levies

desc: Our position as the collector of tribute for the Golden Horde has given us many years of experience in gathering tribute... and in retaining some of the profits for ourselves.
entities.name: Gatherers of Tribute

desc: Kyiv was once the shining capital of a great empire spanning from the northern forests of Novgorod to the southern shores of the Black Sea. After suffering the dissolution of the Rus' and the invasions of the Mongols, little remained of it. But the time has come for our revival, and no matter what our cities have endured, we vow that they will recover and prosper for centuries to come!
entities.name: The Mother of Rus' States

desc: The ceremonial mounds built by our ancestors are monuments to their sophisticated earthwork engineering skills. By incorporating these mounds into the planning of our infrastructure, we will preserve a defining tradition of our civilization.
entities.name: Mound Builders

desc: Mount Meru is the sacred mountain at the center of the universe in both the physical and spiritual sense for Hinduism, Buddhism, and Jainism. As it is the center around which everything else revolves, so does our entire country revolve around our ruler.
entities.name: Mount Meru

gate: is capital in south america or carribean

desc: Our cities and fortresses occupy the tops of immense mountains, well past the clouds. They present a formidable obstacle to anyone who might attempt to invade us.
entities.name: Summit Fortresses

desc: To facilitate easier distribution of goods, a great network of mountain roads connecting far-off valleys together and crossing deep gorges is required. Let us build it.
entities.name: Mountain Roads Network

desc: Our people have thrived on horseback for centuries, and these majestic creatures are an integral part of our culture and power. We take immense pride in our unrivalled skills in our equine husbandry and talent for mounted archery, both of which contribute to our supremacy on the battlefield.
entities.name: Mounted People

desc: It is a long-established tradition of our people to adopt captured warriors into our tribe. But to replenish our numbers and ensure our defensive and offensive strength, we should seek to adopt entire tribes into the Haudenosaunee, not just individual fighters.
entities.name: Mourning Wars

desc: Ōe no Hiromoto, a scholar and politician who made great contributions to the establishment of the Kamakura Shogunate, was the ancestor of our clan. To this day, his spirit is embodied in our people, and we take pride in effectively administering the lands he secured for us.
entities.name: Descendants of Ōe no Hiromoto

desc: The three daughters of Susanoo-no-Mikoto are patron goddesses of the sea and navigation. Their blessings will make our navies unstoppable.
entities.name: Munakata Three Goddesses

desc: The biological wealth of our coastal waters provides a stable food supply that supports a larger standing militia even during regional famines. By monopolizing the harvest of the lagoons, we ensure that our population remains healthy and our granaries full, fueling our state's survival.
entities.name: The Lagoon Fisheries

desc: We specifically train our levies to lure enemy units into the deep bogs where their armor becomes a liability. In these environments, our light, unarmored infantry reigns supreme through ambush tactics, turning the very earth into a weapon. Our ability to adapt to any terrain and move fast in the worst conditions makes us a dangerous foe.
entities.name: Marshland Guerillas

desc: We have begun the process of draining parts of the Myzeqe marshes to create even more fertile farmland. This engineering feat not only increases our tax base but allows us to construct permanent roads through what was once impassable bog.
entities.name: Reclamation Engineering

desc: Our domain is protected by the labyrinthine Karavasta Lagoon, where our people have mastered navigation through mudflats and hidden channels. This watery landscape serves as a natural fortress that is nearly impossible for heavy foreign armies to map or conquer, providing a sanctuary that no cavalry charge can reach.
entities.name: The Masters of the Karavasta

desc: We have unified all coastal harbors under a single administrative authority, streamlining the collection of dues and customs. This centralization has made us the most efficient trade administrators in the Adriatic, attracting foreign investment.
entities.name: The Mataranga Port Authority

desc: By controlling the river mouths and coasts, we can successfully dictate the flow of timber and grain from the interior to Venetian galleys. We have positioned ourselves as the indispensable middlemen of the Adriatic trade, ensuring no merchant can bypass our tolls.
entities.name: The Trade Monopolies

desc: Though we came to India as foreigners, we now rule as Indian Padishah, embracing local traditions while transcending divisions of caste and creed. As our realm is one of many faiths and cultures, our administration will draw talent from all communities, giving everyone — regardless of caste, religion, or culture — an equal opportunity to serve our great house and glorious realm.
entities.name: Indian Padishah

desc: The Fatawa-i-Alamgiri is a sharia-based compilation, serving as the primary legal code regulating various aspects of life in our empire. It is one of the most comprehensive collections of Muslim laws, ethics, military strategies, economic policies, justice, and principles.
entities.name: Fatawa-i-Alamgiri

desc: A great empire demands equally monumental buildings. In our cosmopolitan realm, architects are already creating marvelous edifices that will awe generations to come. Our dynasty should be at the forefront of this movement, creating great architectural works such as the world has never seen.
entities.name: Mughal Architecture

desc: The Ibadat Khana - ''House of Worship'' - serves as a meeting place for spiritual leaders of diverse religions to engage in discussions and debates on religious teachings. It aims to foster understanding among different faiths, leading to the conclusion that all religions share a common goal.
entities.name: Ibadat Khana

desc: The Zamindar are feudal rulers who govern our territories autonomously or semi-autonomously. While they are owners of the land they administrate and part of our nobility, in the end, they serve as internal vassals to the Crown itself.
entities.name: Zamindar System

desc: Swedish Iron, prized for its purity and strength, supplies not only our domestic needs but also the foundries and armories of nations across the continent. The ''Mulltimmer Masugn'' was not built just with stone, but also with wood isolated with sand, gravel and dirt.
entities.name: Mulltimmer Masugn

desc: Austria is a diverse and multicultural realm, committed to embracing and accommodating its numerous ethnic minorities to maintain unity and stability amidst growing nationalist tensions.
entities.name: Multicultural Empire

desc: From the many paths of the Silk Road, to the salt routes across the Sahara, our people have a tradition of embarking on trade ventures to faraway lands, providing us and the rest of the Muslim world with a wide selection of available goods.
entities.name: Muslim Caravans

desc: Ever since the times of Muḥammad, peace be upon him, Islam has been intrinsically linked to rulership structures. As such, our dynastic line is also legitimized by the faith itself.
entities.name: Muslim Lineage

desc: The presence of Muslim traders in faraway lands puts them in contact with many different peoples and beliefs. The establishment of trade communities among them allows for a certain degree of blending and syncretism of their beliefs with the true Word of Allāh.
entities.name: Muslim Trade Communities

desc: Within the lush valleys of central Champa lies the sacred temple complex of Mỹ Sơn, where for generations our kings and priests have performed solemn rites to Śiva, protector of our realm. These towers are carved with devotion and adorned with sacred symbols, connecting us to our ancestors and the divine. As long as incense burns in their sanctuaries, the soul of Champa shall endure.
entities.name: Mỹ Sơn Sanctuary

desc: Hidden behind masks, symbols, and sacred ritual, influential initiates gather within secretive mystery cults. These organizations exercise considerable social and political influence, shaping events through ritual authority, wealth, and discreet alliances. Wise rulers maintain good relations with these mystai, lest their influence and intrigue turn against the state.
entities.name: Mystery Cults

desc: We have turned our capital into a center of culture, preserving the wisdom of the East and the West for future generations. This intellectual prestige makes our court the destination for the finest minds of the Orthodox and Latin worlds alike.
entities.name: Literary Patronage

desc: Our land sits on the primary trade routes from the interior; by taxing the silk caravans, we maintain a full and prosperous treasury. This revenue allows us to patronize the finest calligraphers and icon painters, turning our domain into the cultural capital of southern Albania.
entities.name: Silk Road Waystations

desc: The fertile valleys of our heartland allow us to fund a lavish court and a highly trained cavalry force through advanced irrigation. This agricultural surplus provides the economic bedrock for our political ambitions, allowing us to sustain a larger professional retinue than our rivals.
entities.name: Agricultural Wealth of the Devoll

desc: Ruling from the Castle of Berat, the 'City of a Thousand Windows', we represent the peak of Albanian urban sophistication and Byzantine-style administration. Our court serves as a magnet for scholars and artisans, turning our capital into a beacon of culture that rivals the grand cities of the East.
entities.name: The Despots of Berat

desc: Our family keeps meticulous and grand records of our history and territorial rights, ensuring our ancient claims are never forgotten. This literary tradition preserves our high Byzantine titles, overawing local rivals with our imperial dignity and historical depth.
entities.name: The Muzaka Chronicle

desc: We have introduced the large-scale cultivation of cash crops in our most fertile valleys, fueling a new domestic industry. By processing our own raw materials into high-value products, we have created an industrial base that supports a wealthy and loyal urban population.
entities.name: The Muzakan Industrialization

desc: Our ruler is the king of all kings; the heir to the pedigree of the kings of Aksum along with that of the first ruler, Menelik I, the son of King Solomon and the Queen of Sheba. All of our kings are descended from the Solomon dynasty, and the line of inheritance need not be from father to son.
entities.name: Nəgusä Nägäst

desc: The superiority of Nahua culture is very clear, as neighboring peoples increasingly adopt it as their own. This cultural diffusion and spread of influence creates opportunities for us to extend our political control well beyond our borders.
entities.name: Nahua Domination

desc: The Nairs are a diverse group of Hindu castes from Malabar and have a long history of involvement with the military. Their experience, as well as their role for the Kalari, will be of great value in our current conflicts.
entities.name: Nair Military

desc: The Nambardar Levy, or ''čerig-i nambardar'', refers to our troops that do not come from Mongolian or Turkic origins, but instead come from the native Iranian population. Thanks to them, we can build larger armies than would have been possible before.
entities.name: Nambardar Levy

desc: The temples of Nara have been influential since Buddhism first came from China. The six schools that formed around these temples are a renowned repository of knowledge, especially about the teachings of the Buddha and the various ways of achieving enlightenment. However, they also teach more mundane, but equally valuable subjects, such as how to properly administrate a monastery.
entities.name: Nanto Rokushū

desc: Sieges are a costly and time-consuming occupation for our army. Instead of focusing on every fortification in our way, we need to dedicate our tactics entirely to landing the decisive blow that will win us the war.
entities.name: Napoleonic Warfare

desc: Also called ''Niraya'', Naraka refers to the realms of suffering where one's bad karma is cleansed before being reincarnated. There are many Naraka realms, and both the time an individual must reside in them and the punishments they will receive while doing so depends on how much karma they need to gain before being reborn in one of the upper realms.
entities.name: Naraka

desc: Some schools of thought in Hinduism deviate from the mainstream, rejecting the authority of the Vēdaḥ and the existence of Ātman. These schools, like Jainism and Buddhism, are thus heterodox, although they still contain many of the shared core beliefs of Hinduism.
entities.name: Nāstika Schools

desc: Uniting as a single culture under a single flag is a powerful, moving idea. By fostering a sense of national identity, we will ensure the loyalty of our subjects and citizens to our cause.
entities.name: Nation State

desc: An assembly composed of representatives of the entire nation. Depending on the type of government, it may have all the powers of government, or only legislative ones.
entities.name: National Assemblies

desc: By establishing a central authority for financial matters, we will have better control over our nation's economy.
entities.name: National Bank

desc: The State must take greater control over the Church in our land. We cannot allow foreign entities to exercise undue influence over our ecclesiastical administration; our Church must serve our realm first.
entities.name: National Church

desc: Increases our military numbers by making military service compulsory for those eligible.
entities.name: National Conscripts

desc: The presence of different autocephalous patriarchates in our Church allows for certain variations between the national rites of each country. However, the unity of the message remains, and the Church as a single entity is not broken.
entities.name: National Rites

desc: The many long wars in the first half of the 17th century have led to an international diplomatic system for which the territorial integrity of states is a cornerstone. States, rather than individual rulers or supra-national groupings, are the actors in the international arena, and no state has the right to intervene in the internal affairs of another.
entities.name: National Sovereignty

desc: Cloth, wool, and other sought-after commodities have made their way across the world. At an age where a nation's commerce reaches faraway shores, we must make sure our merchants always have the advantage!
entities.name: National Trade

desc: By adopting a national trade policy, we can strengthen our commercial presence and increase the effectiveness of our trade.
entities.name: National Trade Policy

desc: Giving our troops adequate support is vital to national defense. With our excellent administration, we are able to secure generous discounts on our military supplies.
entities.name: Nationalistic Enthusiasm

desc: The new lands discovered by our daring explorers are usually inhabited by people we find strange and unsophisticated. It is time that we created an official policy to regulate encounters between our expeditionary forces and the natives of the lands they explore.
entities.name: Natives Policy

desc: With the growth of our fishing industry, we have also seen a corresponding expansion in the number of sailors in our realm. We should take advantage of this and recruit some of them to our navy, as seamanship is just as important as the ship itself.
entities.name: Natural Seamanship

desc: Though our realm originates in the mountain valleys of the Pyrenees, our people have been heavily influenced by humanistic ideas coming from both north and south. By embracing this new way of thinking, the people of Navarre are not abandoning their traditions, but merging them into their overall identity.
entities.name: A Renaissance Realm

desc: The quality of our ships, the proficiency of our merchants, and the efficacy of our production processes have made our trade incredibly lucrative. The influx of wealth into our nation will make us stronger than ever before.
entities.name: Adept Traders

desc: We were born as a small realm, encircled by formidable adversaries from every direction. This has profoundly influenced the development of our national character and our approach to engaging with the world. Consequently, we remain ever-watchful, poised to respond to the slightest indication of a threat.
entities.name: Always Ready

desc: The land we live in might not be the richest, but the Basque people are industrious individuals, working hard to obtain what they need. Be it by smelting Iron in our ironworks, converting wood from our forests into charcoal, or building the finest ships, our realm is bountiful thanks to the efforts and expertise of our community.
entities.name: An Industrious Folk

desc: Even before the Battle of Roncesvalles, for which the French still weep, or the campaigns of the Navarrese Company, our people have always been considered ferocious fighters. We should never let our enemies forget it.
entities.name: Basque Ferocity

desc: Each historical territory will form a council, dependent on the ruler and elected by the locals, which will guarantee the respect of their traditional laws or ''Fueros''. This intermediate step will give us better and more efficient administrative power over our lands, without meddling in local interests.
entities.name: Chartered Councils

desc: Our nation has maintained bureaucratic traditions since the realm's establishment, but changing times demand new approaches. Navarre has drawn particular admiration for pioneering certain administrative innovations.
entities.name: Efficient Bureaucracy

desc: Our people have always looked to the sea with awe and fear, well aware of both the rewards and dangers to be found in its briny embrace. Our brave forefathers founded communities that would live not only by the sea but from it, developing impressive skills on the water. Sailors from our shores are well known all across the Atlantic Coast.
entities.name: Fearless Seafarers

desc: Our people were active participants in the Reconquista, contributing to the Christian efforts to reclaim Iberia from Muslim rule. Despite reaching a stage where further territorial expansion became unattainable, Navarre still played a significant role in this Crusade, through military campaigns and alliances with neighboring Christian kingdoms
entities.name: Memories of the Reconquista

desc: For centuries, our society has traded not only with our neighbors, but with faraway lands. This has had the effect not only of making our merchants particularly skilled in the art of trade, but has disseminated innovations from many nations farther and wider than they would have been able to otherwise.
entities.name: Mercantile Expansion

desc: Over time, our neighbors have gained significant strength, posing an increasing threat to our nation's survival. To address this, we will establish a military department aimed at bolstering our forces with a higher number of soldiers without compromising on the quality of recruits.
entities.name: Navarrese Defense Force

desc: Our people are expert mariners, and all the world knows it. Our expertise will be an obvious advantage in maritime battles to come.
entities.name: People of the Sea

desc: The introduction of rifles to our armies has required new approaches to military training and discipline. Our commanders have developed innovative marching formations that have become famous as proof of our military competence and focus.
entities.name: Riflemen March

desc: ''Euskalerriaren Adiskideen Elkartea'', the Royal Basque Society of Friends of the Country, has been founded to encourage the development of Basque economy, culture, and science. It will benefit the country greatly in the coming years.
entities.name: Royal Basque Society

desc: The sea kissing our shores teems with resources waiting for those brave enough to grab them. For centuries, our coast has been full of ports and shipyards, tirelessly building vessels with which to slake our thirst for adventure and profit on the open seas.
entities.name: Expert Shipbuilders

desc: The traditions of shipbuilding, steelmaking, and ironworking have been common activities in our lands for centuries. But as new techniques develop, we must obviously update our processes correspondingly. Even the most ancient traditions must embrace modernity in order to remain valuable in the modern world.
entities.name: Shipyards and Ironworks

desc: With the professionalization of our army, the necessity of a training center for our recruits becomes apparent. We will form a corps of experienced soldiers to teach the fundamentals of war and to forge our recruits into the spearhead of our army.
entities.name: The National Military Academy

desc: Basque whaling traditions represent centuries of experience, and our specialists are often consulted by other nations looking to expand and improve their own whaling industries. We should capitalize on this expertise by establishing whaling enterprises throughout the Atlantic Ocean.
entities.name: Transatlantic Whaling

desc: With an extra boost to naval morale, our sailors will conquer the waves and rule the seas. Meanwhile, our colonists will be able to brave the darkest corners of the world, founding new settlements farther from home than ever before.
entities.name: Naval Ambitions

desc: A whole section of the coast has been enclosed and specialized for the construction and maintenance of our grand fleet. This small city of sailors, craftsmen, and engineers is capable of building entire navies by itself, making it one of the most important strategic centers of our country.
entities.name: Naval Base

desc: The natural evolution of defensive warfare has culminated in the development of intricate coastal defenses, ready to repel even the heaviest of hostile invasions.
entities.name: Naval Battery

desc: By promoting the navy as the ideal career choice for second and third sons of the aristocracy, we can create a professional corps of naval officers to oversee our gunnery crews.
entities.name: Naval Cadets

desc: Naval warfare has seen many changes in recent years, with ships and fleets both becoming larger and more specialized. As a result of this, different countries are starting to use a variety of tactics and doctrines, tailored to their strong points or their particular way of using their fleets.
entities.name: Naval Doctrines

desc: The confusion of combat can leave a warship unfit for action for a long time. A well-drilled crew will recover much faster than an ordinary one.
entities.name: Naval Drill

desc: Allows our naval veterans to devise new methods to improve our navy's efficiency in blockades.
entities.name: Naval Fighting Instruction

desc: The awesome sight of our glorious navy will make all adversaries tremble in fear!
entities.name: Naval Glory

desc: It is true that victory often comes to those who draw first blood. Exhaustive study and effective implementation of deployment tactics will permit us to mobilize quickly and take initiative in combat situations, helping us achieve that victory.
entities.name: Deployment Tactics

desc: The advancements made in the field of sailing in recent decades have increased the expertise and confidence of our sailors, allowing them to navigate with confidence in coastal waters.
entities.name: Medieval Sailing

desc: Our sailors are becoming accustomed to longer journeys, using a new set of techniques and instruments, such as dry compasses, to improve their mastery of navigation.
entities.name: Navigation Techniques

desc: The recent rise of long-range overseas commerce has accustomed our sailors to being at sea for long periods of time, making them resistant to the adverse effects of long journeys.
entities.name: Overseas Expeditions

desc: The global expansion of trade and commerce demands permanent naval forces to protect national interests. Maintaining an established, ever-present standing navy will allow ships to operate more effectively together as a fleet.
entities.name: Permanent Fleets

desc: Until the beginning of the 17th century, permanent navies were quite small, and even notable martitime powers mostly maintained only enough of a naval force to meet their immediate needs. Over time, however, many states have started moving in the direction of establishing larger professional navies. Unless we want to see our rivals overtake us in naval matters, we must strive to create a larger permanent navy with the proper administrative structures to support it. We should also ensure that a naval career can be a lifelong occupation for our officers.
entities.name: Naval Professionalization

desc: Everyone knows that a hole in a ship's hull will inevitably lead to its sinking. With better building techniques, we can build a hull with more tightly jointed planks, making the ships less prone to leakage and holes in the hull much easier to repair.
entities.name: Tighter Joints

desc: Similar to the Naval Supplies Guild, so does the Naval Supplies Manufactory focus on the production of Naval Supplies. Thanks to its increased dimensions, the output of available supplies for the ship construction is significantly higher.
entities.name: Naval Supplies Manufactory

desc: The steady increase in trading across the globe requires more Naval Supplies than ever before and dedicated mills are required to supply it.
entities.name: Naval Supplies Mill

desc: Naval Supplies play a vital role in the supply and upkeep of our maritime ambitions. With bigger production spaces we will be able to maintain our position and increase our output.
entities.name: Naval Supplies Workshop

desc: These acts represent the apex of mercantilism. Trade must be conducted with our ships and pass through our ports first, where we will collect customs duties and any other applicable taxes.
entities.name: The Navigation Acts

desc: In an era of global trade, our islands have become the indispensable waystations of the Mediterranean, providing fresh water, ship timber, and salted meats to long-haul vessels. By standardizing the port facilities across our twenty-odd islands, we ensure that any merchant ship must pay for the privilege of our hospitality. This logistics network makes us the undisputed masters of the Aegean's internal economy.
entities.name: Aegean Waystation Networks

desc: The scattered islands of the Aegean demand constant vigilance from their Latin rulers, who maintain fleets of light galleys to patrol against pirates, raiders, and rival Italian maritime powers. The dukes of Naxos and their vassals have developed a sophisticated system of island garrisons, signal fires, and swift courier vessels that allow them to respond rapidly to threats across the archipelago, while the wealth extracted from trade protection and harbor dues enables the construction of sturdy coastal fortresses that make the Cyclades one of the most secure regions of the Frankokratia, a maritime bulwark.
entities.name: Achipelagic Vigil

desc: Our nobility is unique in the Western world; they are knights who have traded the horse for the galley and the lance for the boarding pike. These 'Sea-Knights' roam the Eastern Mediterranean under the Ducal banner, enforcing a 'Latin Peace'. This aggressive stance keeps our sailors sharp and our rivals' trade in constant peril.
entities.name: The Naxian Sea-Knights

desc: Marco I Sanudo, a Venetian noble who participated in the Fourth Crusade, seized the Cyclades archipelago in 1207 and founded the Duchy of Naxos, creating a maritime feudal state whose lords ruled from fortified island citadels and drew income from trade, piracy suppression, and the fertile valleys of Naxos, Paros, and Santorini. By blending Venetian commercial instincts with Frankish feudal organization, the Sanudo dynasty has maintained a semi-independent duchy that serves as a vital link in the Latin trade network, protecting shipping lanes while extracting tolls and offering safe harbors to Crusader, Genoese, and Venetian vessels alike.
entities.name: Sanudo's Isles

desc: In an age of global exploration and precision, the Dukes of Naxos have established the premier center for Mediterranean cartography and maritime science. By employing the finest astronomers and clockmakers to map every reef, current, and wind pattern of the Cyclades, we have made our navigational charts the most sought-after tools in the world. This scientific mastery ensures that Naxiot captains can navigate the treacherous Aegean at night or in storm, granting our merchant and war fleets a decisive advantage in speed and safety over any foreign interloper.
entities.name: The Aegean Hydrographic Bureau

desc: As the demand for fine art rises, the demand for high-quality Parian marble has returned to levels not seen since the days of Augustus. By reopening the ancient quarries and employing modern engineering techniques, we have turned a geologic quirk into a fountain of wealth that funds our Aegean hegemony. The palaces of Rome and Paris are increasingly built with stone hewn from our sovereign islands.
entities.name: The Marble Trade of Paros

desc: Due to cold winds in the late autumn and heavy snows until the early spring, our people often suffer from severe famines and hunger. We must build reserves of food and look into how we can improve the lands under our control to counter future catastrophes.
entities.name: Fighting Famine

desc: We are originally a cadet branch of the Kai Genji; our founder was given a fief in Ōshū Province as a reward for loyal service to the Kamakura Shogunate. Over time, we have grown accustomed to this region with its harsh winters, and know how to utilize these conditions to our strategic and tactical advantage.
entities.name: Ōshū Genji

desc: Mutsu has ranches, from which horses were sent to Kyōto in ancient times. The tradition of horse farming continues until today, and is one we should cultivate, as it allows us to raise cavalry more easily than many of our neighbors.
entities.name: Northern Horses

desc: Our nation needs to undergo sweeping military reforms, modernizing its armed forces to meet the challenges of the changing battlefield. These reforms will bolster tactical capabilities, streamline command structures, and enhance training programs, positioning us as a formidable force in our region.
entities.name: Neapolitan Army Reforms

desc: Naples has witnessed a gradual industrialization process over the past decades. Key sectors such as textiles, shipbuilding, and ironworks have experienced significant growth, fueled by investments and technological advancements. This shift towards industrialization will play a significant role in transforming Naples into a major economic center.
entities.name: Neapolitan Industrialization

desc: The narrow channel separating our island from the mainland is the most strategic chokepoint in Central Greece, controlled by our massive swing-bridge and fortified towers. By taxing the flow of goods between Boeotia and the Aegean, we have transformed a geographic oddity into a permanent source of toll revenue. We hold the key to the movement of armies in the Balkans, and we charge a heavy price for its use.
entities.name: Bridgehead of the Euripus

desc: The triarchs of Negroponte divided the lordship of the long island among three families, yet managed to maintain a unified naval policy that dominates the narrow Euripos channel and extracts tolls from every vessel passing between the Aegean and the northern ports. Their galleys, crewed by a mixture of Frankish knights, Greek mariners, and Italian mercenaries, patrol the straits with ruthless efficiency, ensuring that Negroponte remains one of the wealthiest and most strategically vital outposts of the Frankokratia.
entities.name: The Negropontine Navarchy

desc: The unique, reversing tides of the Euripus Strait have been harnessed by our engineers to power a series of massive tidal mills. These machines provide consistent energy for milling grain, sawing ship-timber, and powering forge-bellows regardless of the wind. This technological advantage makes Euboea the most industrially advanced island in the Mediterranean, capable of out-producing its maritime rivals.
entities.name: The Eubean Tidal Mills

desc: Using the high-quality silica sands of our beaches and the soda ash from our coastal plants, we have established a glass-making industry that rivals Murano. Our mirrors and stained glass are exported to the great palaces of the Latin Empire and the West, bringing immense wealth to the island. This luxury industry provides the tax revenue needed to maintain our massive coastal walls in an age of gunpowder.
entities.name: The Glassworks of Chalkis

desc: The island of Euboea is divided among three ''Terzieri'', or Triarchs, creating a competitive yet unified defensive structure that prevents any single lord from becoming weak. This tripartite system ensures that if one fortress falls, the other two mobilize instantly, creating a redundant and resilient military administration. This internal rivalry keeps our garrisons at peak readiness, as no Triarch wishes to be outdone by his peers.
entities.name: The Three Fold-Defense

desc: To ensure the quality of our fleet, the three lords of the island have co-founded an academy for the training of naval officers and navigators. Students are taught the latest in astronomical navigation and maritime law, ensuring that every Euboean captain is a professional of the highest caliber. This focus on naval education keeps our fleet at the cutting edge of maritime warfare and exploration.
entities.name: The Triarchic Naval Academy

desc: Confucianism has a millenary history, and Neo-Confucianism has already existed in Japan for centuries. However, active state involvement and support of the faith will strengthen our authority.
entities.name: Neo-Confucianism

desc: In the mountainous frontier of southern Thessaly, the lords of Neopatras — first Brienne and later Aragonese — constructed and repeatedly strengthened one of the most formidable castle complexes in Frankish Greece, turning the ancient city into a virtually impregnable stronghold that withstood repeated sieges by their enemies. These towering walls, deep ditches, and cleverly situated outworks became a symbol of Latin tenacity, allowing a small but determined garrison to project influence deep into central Greece and delay the northward advance of hostile powers for generations.
entities.name: Neopatras Fortresses

desc: Neopatras needs to replace its hereditary 'Captain-Governors' with graduates of a dedicated Administrative Lyceum. Candidates are tested on their knowledge of our civil law and the latest techniques, ensuring that the nation's officials are as comfortable with a quill as they are with a sword. This shift from 'Birthright to Merit' has turned Neopatras into the most efficiently governed territory in Central Greece, capable of precise census-taking and rapid tax-levying.
entities.name: The Academy of Administration

desc: Using our connections to the Crown of Aragon and the merchants of Barcelona, Neopatras has become the primary entry point for Iberian goods into the Levant. We operate a ''Consulate of the Sea'' that provides legal protection and standardized weights for all Catalan and Spanish traders. This special relationship makes Neopatras the wealthiest outpost of the Western Mediterranean in the heart of Greece.
entities.name: The Consulate of the Sea

desc: The nation remains governed by the democratic-military traditions of the Catalan Company, where officers are elected and the spoils of war are shared. This egalitarian structure creates an army with incredibly high morale, as every soldier feels they have a personal stake in the survival of the state. While the rest of Europe moves toward absolutism, our 'Soldier's Republic' remains a fiercely loyal and cohesive fighting force.
entities.name: The Great Company's Code

desc: In the fertile Spercheios valley, the Dukes have established royal stables to breed a new strain of warhorse, crossing Catalan stallions with local Balkan mares. The resulting ''Neopatras Charger'' is famed for its endurance in mountainous terrain and its shock power in the charge. This cavalry advantage allows us to dominate the open plains of Thessaly and strike fear into our rivals.
entities.name: The Neopatras Horse-Breeding Program

desc: The realm has moved to centralize its scattered mountain population into 'New Towns' (Viles Noves in the Catalan language) modeled after the planned fortified villages of Catalonia. The governance of these towns is handed to a 'Consul of the Hearth', an official tasked with managing communal wood-fuel and grain storage for the harsh winters. By controlling the heat and the bread of the highlands, our rule effectively ends the age of independent mountain-warlords, replacing them with a streamlined, urbanized bureaucracy.
entities.name: The Ordinance of the Viles Noves

desc: For a long time, our land has been home to bustling towns and cities with a higher concentration of craftsmen than our neighbors. This focus has made us a highly productive nation.
entities.name: Netherlands Verlagssystem

desc: As the Low Countries are home to some of Europe's greatest port cities, it is only fitting that they should also boast some of Europe's greatest shipyards. Being able to employ skilled local craftsmen dramatically reduces the costs of acquiring new merchant fleets.
entities.name: Netherlands Shipbuilding

desc: Across lakes and valleys, our cities bind themselves through roads, markets, and shared purpose, strengthening our reach.
entities.name: Network of Cities

desc: The discovery of new lands has also led to an increased flow of trade. This has in turn caused a rise in the demand for coins, and although the noble metal currencies made of Gold and Silver remain the main values, other lesser metals like Copper and its alloys have seen their use and circulation increased.
entities.name: New Currency Demands

desc: Once every fifty-two years, the world is renewed by flame, uniting the people in faith and cosmic balance.
entities.name: New Fire Ceremonies

desc: The movement to push the colonial frontier further and further inland in the New World, by establishing everything from small trade stations to full settlements with large areas of cultivated land.
entities.name: New Frontiers

desc: The needs of our people have been adapting to the new markets that have opened to our traders, and we have been training our merchants in methods to maximize our earnings.
entities.name: New Trade Opportunities

desc: As the Florentine navigator Amerigo Vespucci says, the lands discovered by Columbus are not the Indies but, in fact, a whole New World unknown to our ancients and waiting to be mapped and claimed.
entities.name: New World

desc: The bountiful lands of the New World have provided many treasures to our country. One of the most important discoveries is that of the strange, exotic plants cultivated as food and spices by the natives of those lands. Growing those crops in our fields will provide our population with the dietary variety and novelty they crave.
entities.name: New World Crops

desc: The concept of announcements being announced or posted where the public may read them is certainly not a new one. However, as the Printing Press becomes more popular around the world, so does the demand for accessible information about politics, war, and the economy. The newspaper - a periodical publication describing current events - shall satisfy this demand.
entities.name: Newspapers

desc: Throughout our history, the ''Nghĩa Quân'' — 'righteous militias' — have risen in defense of our land during times of great peril. Composed of farmers, scholars, and local patriots, they stood against foreign invaders and internal tyranny alike. Though irregular in nature, their valor and devotion to the country have made them a formidable force when mobilized.
entities.name: The Nghĩa Quân

desc: In order to defend against the vicious barbarian onslaught, we must do more than simply repair the Great Wall. The Nine Garrisons are militarized garrison towns along the Wall that will not only help to defend the most important passes, but also improve the overall logistical situation on our northern border.
entities.name: Nine Garrisons of the Great Wall

desc: The tradition of the Five Noble Talents involves riding, archery, military command, loyalty, and discipline. These aspects of our martial society form the backbone of our proud culture.
entities.name: Niyamniyan

desc: The path to being liberated from Saṃsāra and achieving Nirvāṇa, the Noble Eightfold Path is the purest distillation of Buddhist practices. Dictating both one's mental state and physical actions, it determines proper comportment for any follower of Buddhism.
entities.name: Noble Eightfold Path

desc: Supporting cavalry requires an economic system that produces a large number of surplus horses. If we were to guarantee the privileges of our nobility, not only would they be much happier, but they would do much of the work to produce the much-needed horses. Our court fool described it as 'service guarantees serfs.'
entities.name: Noble Knights

desc: The choice of who leads our troops is a crucial one, and our nobles wish to ensure that preference is given to them when it comes to filling these roles. It will give them a chance to show their valor by giving the enemy cold steel, and we will allow them to do this.
entities.name: Noble Officers

desc: The various mercenary groups on this continent are often headed by lesser nobles. By befriending the aristocracy, we can use their network of contacts to seek out more — and larger — groups of mercenary soldiers.
entities.name: Noble Connections

desc: Founded to protect knightly interests within the Empire, the ''Gesellschaft mit dem Esel'' has entrenched itself in the lands surrounding Heidelberg. Their expertise in governance, as well as their ability to sponsor tourneys, will improve our cultural standing.
entities.name: Society with the Donkey

desc: The ''Hubertusorden'' will serve as a glorious reminder of our knights' combat prowess! Joining the order will be a reward for our loyal knights, and its members will display our glory for all to see.
entities.name: Order of Saint Hubert

desc: The ''Gesellschaft mit dem Fürspang'' is an order of knights formed to defend their interests and provide assistance to those who sponsor them. Providing them with extensive funds will grant us significantly more political prowess within our region and within the Holy Roman Empire.
entities.name: Fürspang Society

desc: The ''Klüppelgesellschaft'' has been founded by a group of knights concerned about the erosion of our power within the Holy Roman Empire. It would be wise of us to sponsor those willing to fight for our status.
entities.name: Bengler Society

desc: Founded in the woes of the Western Schism, the ''Löwenbund'' is sworn to protect our lands from heretical revolts. We should grant them our official sponsorship and incorporate them into our court to further our cause.
entities.name: Society with the Lion

desc: Our lands are at risk of invasion from hostile neighbors, who desire the riches of our valleys. Creating and funding an order of knights, ready to defend our lands, allows us to draw on greater forces if the need ever arises.
entities.name: Elefantenbund

desc: The position of the Nobility is not only reinforced by their privileges, but also by our laws.
entities.name: Rights of the Nobility

gate: is former or current nomadic steppe culture

desc: Our people are born in the saddle, free to roam the world without the need to put down roots.
entities.name: Nomadic Legacy

desc: Many of our people have lived their lives as nomads, as our custom has been to travel from one habitable place to the next. Even now, as everything changes and we build a city for our people, some retain their nomadic traditions, and continue to wander.
entities.name: Nomadic Tendencies

desc: Having our court officials pass their offices from father to son is a plague on our administrative system! It does nothing but cause apathy and rot to blight every branch of our authority. All offices should from now on be assigned to those best able to fulfill the required duties, regardless of their lineage.
entities.name: Non-Hereditary Offices

desc: The Norwegian land cannot provide our people with enough food to sustain themselves. We will look to the sea to feed our people instead. Fortunately, the waters of the North Sea provide us with plenty of fishing grounds.
entities.name: Bountiful Seas

desc: The ports of Norway have long been a desirable destination for merchants from all around Europe. It is time that we not only host foreign merchants in our ports, but benefit from the trades of northern Europe ourselves.
entities.name: Norwegian Merchants

desc: The Norwegian people have always chosen to traverse the country by boat, whenever it is convenient. This makes our people adept sailors, ready to man our navy whenever necessary.
entities.name: Seaborn Country

desc: The expansion of our fishing industry has also led to an expansion in shipbuilding. We have a ready pool of trained shipwrights at hand to expand our own production process.
entities.name: Military Shipbuilding

desc: Our state is governed by its own customary legal code, the Coutume de Normandie. By enshrining noble privilege, decentralized power, and property rights, this legal tradition ensures local stability while asserting our distinct identity.
entities.name: Norman Law

desc: Our people have long organized into warrior societies, brotherhoods bound by oaths, shared rituals, and a common duty to defend their kin. By formalizing these traditions into Warrior Lodges, we can train a new class of dedicated fighters whose skill and resolve will keep our communities strong long after European weapons arrive on our shores.
entities.name: Warrior Societies

desc: The people of Northern Germany have for a long time reaped the benefits of access to the Baltic Sea. While many of our southern neighbors must make do using rivers to transport goods, our traders have a long tradition of sailing the Baltic to make their fortunes, bringing enviable wealth back to our shores.
entities.name: Hanseatic Traders

desc: Novgorod is an important cultural center in Europe. Epic tales are told of our's literate and intellectual population, intricate religious art, and grand architecture, increasing the prestige of our flourishing city and indeed the whole nation.
entities.name: Northern Center of Arts

desc: In the early days of the Holy Roman Empire, the Brandenburg area was settled and governed by Slavic tribes, until the Emperor created the Northern March to subjugate and fortify the area. Over time, this Northern March evolved into Brandenburg, becoming one of the most important regions in the Holy Roman Empire.
entities.name: The Northern March

desc: Norway's rugged coastlines and maritime traditions have shaped a people skilled in seafaring, fishing, and navigation. The legacy of Norwegian fishermen and shipbuilders fuels our naval endeavors and bolsters the lifeblood of our coastal communities.
entities.name: Norwegian Maritime Heritage

desc: The ''Novgorod First Chronicle'' details the history of our country, from the days of the legendary Varangian chieftain Rurik up to the present. It is a cultural heirloom that is proudly handed down from one generation to another.
entities.name: Velikiy Novgorod First Chronicle

desc: Fur, the silken gold of Russia! While other states gain their wealth from trading in Gold and other rare metals, our source of income comes from the high-quality Fur the motherland provides us with.
entities.name: Novgorodian Fur Trade

desc: Gurkha are troops of Nepali origins (as their name are quite interchangeable) who are infamous for their unbreakable bravery and discipline in combat.
entities.name: Gurkha

desc: Our people have lived since time immemorial in the shadow of very mountains that sustain the Heavens. The high passes, the steep ridgelines, the deep-cut river valleys — these are not obstacles to us but the very fabric of our homeland. Even the air itself is different than that of the lowlands, and no army from the plains can expect to move through these lands as our soldiers do.
entities.name: Children of the Himalayas
