entities.name: Potato Production

desc: The growing demand for commercialized ceramics has led to the creation of economies of scale. The production of manufactured goods using a common, organized workflow, renders pottery-making no longer a craft profession.
entities.name: Pottery Manufactory

desc: The growth in the supply generated by manufactured ceramics has led to its ultimate logical consequence: the development of mass production, in which industrial workers are now responsible for producing the ceramics.
entities.name: Pottery Mill

desc: Pottery is a staple in all population, from simple storage vessels to ornamentation objects. Streamlining its production in specialized workshops will serve to satisfy the people's need for pottery.
entities.name: Pottery Workshop

desc: We have carved into the very face of Earth in order to gain access to food, affluence, and better circulation of goods. The invention of special gates, called 'Mitre Gates', will assist us in providing the necessities for our people to grow and prosper.
entities.name: Pound Lock Canals

desc: As the countries grew and states consolidated during the High Middle Ages, their ambitions also grew, leading to attempts at creating and recreating empires in their regions.
entities.name: Imperial Ambitions

desc: Although the old ideas about forging empires still linger in the minds of the rulers in this age, they have also begun to crystallize new ways of establishing their dominance over other countries and peoples.
entities.name: Supranational Ambitions

desc: The ability to project power beyond our borders is of vital importance to maintaining relevance on the regional stage. By studying the strategies of great powers past and present, we can elevate our nation's prestige everywhere and leverage that reputation to exert power.
entities.name: Regional Ambitions

desc: Our presence at the diplomatic tables always conveys an air of grandeur and prestige. Our voice and influence shall resonate with all those with whom we engage.
entities.name: Domineering External Influence

desc: As state power becomes increasingly centralized, rulers across the world have begun to envision themselves as absolute sovereigns over their respective territories. Like the sun that illuminates the entire world, they seek to be the sole source of authority, their will extending unchallenged across every corner of their domain.
entities.name: Absolutist Ambitions

desc: Consolidation of countries into bigger nations has resulted in the formation of major powers that dominate huge portions of their homelands, and have every intention of extending their power even further.
entities.name: Global Ambitions

desc: A prosperous country is the true sign of a strong ruler, but the people will only believe that a ruler is strong if they are depicted as such. To that effect, many rulers commission statues of themselves, often made out of stone or bronze, to project an image of strength and power to any who look upon their rendered visages. However, these displays of ego are not always effective, and sometimes only result in great amounts of materials being moved around.
entities.name: Impressive Statuary

desc: Preaching friars — members of Mendicant Orders like the Dominicans and Franciscans — have taken their ministry beyond the monastery walls to preach directly among the people. By supporting and praising them openly for these acts of devotion, we can strengthen religious conviction throughout the realm, even among the most remote peasants.
entities.name: Itinerant Preaching Friars

desc: Establish missionary expeditions that will ensure that our population worships the one true faith.
entities.name: Preaching Missions

desc: Our area is rich in precious stones, which are excellent for adding color, detail, and sparkle to artistic pieces and mundanities alike. Our craftsmen will immortalize themselves through these glittering jewels, and create great monuments to our culture.
entities.name: Precious Stone Carving

desc: The 'Toy Army' is organized into elite companies, forming the Imperial Guard which protects the interests of the monarchy. They are frequently involved in court ceremonies, parades, and other significant events, showcasing their importance beyond their military duties.
entities.name: Preobrazhensky Semyonovsky Imperial Guard

desc: Hesiod's Theogony recounts the origins and genealogy of the gods, revealing the birth of the divine order itself. Through its verses, symbols of authority such as the scepter and the voice of rule are presented as sacred responsibilities. The work reminds rulers that true authority must be exercised through wisdom, moderation, and reason.
entities.name: The Teachings of Theogony

desc: It is because of our history of being persecuted and oppressed that our Church became responsible for preserving our identity. It is in the bosom of the Church where our languages and traditions have been kept safe, and therefore we have unshakeable faith in this institution.
entities.name: Preserving National Identity

desc: Despite the importance of Greek and Latin in early Christianity, Miaphysitism has preserved its liturgy in more local vernaculars, like Coptic, Aramaic, and Armenian. Venerable languages in their own right, each Miaphysite branch preserves its own historical tongue.
entities.name: Preservation of Local Languages

desc: Life at sea is hard and unforgiving, and not everyone is keen on a naval career. By legalizing the impressment of sailors and other skilled seafarers, it will be easier to crew our ships, speeding up the process of commissioning ships as well.
entities.name: Press Gangs

desc: People from Europe have been looking for Prester John for centuries, and are convinced that our ruler has to be him, somehow, as we are fellow Christian worshippers. There is no reason to point out that they are wrong, however, as they are now happy to share their ideas with us.
entities.name: Prester John

desc: In Orthodoxy, monasticism and asceticism are highly valued and almost a requirement. Any bishop must be a monk first, and they must become a monk before being consecrated if they are not. As such, monasteries and monasticism centers have a big impact on our clerical life.
entities.name: Prestigious Monasticism

desc: Buddhism has developed into a myriad of schools, each one centered around one type of monastic community and declaring a preference for certain texts. However, some of these schools have gained recognition, while others have been relegated to obscurity. Associating with the more prestigious schools gives those people a bit of prestige as well.
entities.name: Prestigious Schools

desc: Our court will not be a place of idle luxury. Every ducat saved is a ducat for the army; every hour wasted is a march not made. We ask nothing of our soldiers that we do not first demand of ourselves.
entities.name: Preußische Tugenden

desc: Although Miaphysitism has many branches and independent leaders, we recognize Alexandria and its seat as our spiritual leader. However, this is a sign of respect for the Apostolic Throne and a way to honor it, rather than a bestowal of any special prerogatives.
entities.name: Primacy of Alexandria

desc: The natural evolution of our complex government dictates the adoption of new laws pertaining to our administration.
entities.name: Principle of Administration Law

desc: With the invention of the printing press, the spread of knowledge has never been easier. New techniques and advances will reach every corner of our nation and make it grow stronger and richer.
entities.name: Print Culture

desc: The introduction of new printing techniques allows printers to produce more Books than before.
entities.name: Printing Manufactory

desc: New techniques involving the usage of chemicals and more durable print plates allows the mass production of Books.
entities.name: Printing Mill

desc:
Establishing procedures to print, commercialize, and distribute religious texts are the necessary next steps towards increasing our piety and literacy!

Unlocks the Sponsor Printing of Religious Texts privilege.
entities.name: Religious Text Printing

desc: The popularization of printing techniques this century has resulted in the wider spread of knowledge, as well as easier exchange of information, by speeding up the duplication of important manuscripts.
entities.name: Printing Press

desc: Utilizing easily produced and replaceable parts the Printers Shop will reduce both our cost in labor and materials to produce and spread written documents among our population.
entities.name: Printers Shop

desc: Every private has a marshal's baton in his back. Well, perhaps not exactly, but for those who distinguish themselves in battle, promotion and rewards will follow. The troops know this and are inspired by it.
entities.name: Private to Marshal

desc: Waging war on enemy commerce is at the apex of naval warfare. We shall encourage the crustiest, saltiest seadogs we can hire to strike at the heart of the enemy's trade, which should help refill our own coffers quickly.
entities.name: Privateers

desc: The decree forbids foreign ships arriving in Sweden to bring goods from countries other than their own or their colonies.
entities.name: Produktplakatet

desc: The modernization of our armies is largely dependent upon the maintenance of our recruitment and organization centers. We must strive towards preserving a clear and robust military organization, cutting waste and redundancy.
entities.name: Professional Armies

desc: Burgundy is a feudal creation with various parts conjoined under different conditions, which has created strong local identities. By promoting a central assembly, we give a forum for these interests, promoting a smooth and uncontested rule.
entities.name: Promote the États Généraux

desc: Our religion is beset on all sides by enemies. We will have to defend our rights to our own confession against the Catholic oppressors.
entities.name: Shield of the Faith

desc: Some places are more naturally suited to serve as a harbor than others, but with the proper infrastructure those conditions can be improved anywhere.
entities.name: Protected Harbor

desc: We stand on the frontlines of Christendom, surrounded by unbelief. It is our sacred duty to shield the Holy City and strike fear into the hearts of heathens who would dare usurp it.

mods.label: Damage Done versus Heathens in Battle

entities.name: Protectors of Jerusalem

desc: Previously, the clerics shouldered a significant portion of the tax burden. While some of these structures have been dismantled in the wake of the Reformation, the capable common people are still around, and thus must help make up for that missing clerical revenue.
entities.name: Efficient Tax Collectors

desc: ''Whose realm, his religion.'' We will have to accept that other countries follow other faiths, and that this will sometimes be a crucial factor in diplomacy.
entities.name: Cuius Regio, Eius Religio

desc: Since the founding days of our faith, we have emphasized the inherent value of questioning established doctrines and beliefs. We should apply these same ethics to other fields of study.
entities.name: Protestant Innovations

desc: While we have seen the light of the true faith, many of our brethren suffer under the oppressive rule of misguided heathens. We should invite these people to settle in our lands, where they can process their faith without repercussions and, more importantly, contribute to our treasury.
entities.name: Welcome the Unwelcome

desc: The Reformation has given our artists the opportunity to explore new themes, finally freed from the obligatory glorification of God. Hiring more of these artists will reflect well on us, and give us the reputation of being a great patron of the arts.
entities.name: Protestant Art

desc: Educating the people is an important part of our religious duties. We should establish schools, closely tied to our normal worship services, to provide basic education to our flock.
entities.name: Sunday Schools

desc: The influence of Puritan and Pietist preachers on the Reformation is undeniable. Their emphasis on virtues like diligence and frugality will help us to foster an industrious and dedicated workforce.
entities.name: Diligent Workers

desc: Our provinces are not ruled autonomously, nor by any local nobles hungry for power. Instead, governors appointed by our central administration are the ones responsible for extending our authority into every settlement in our country.
entities.name: Provincial Governors

desc: The Prussian Grenadiers are elite troops of the Prussian Army. Their role as vanguards in sieges and assaults requires them to be fearless fighters, recruited from among the strongest men in our country.
entities.name: Prussian Grenadiers

desc: Life at sea is full of dangers, and thus the punishments need to be harsh. If wrongdoing is not thoroughly deterred, we will quickly run into trouble. Over time, a system of highly public punishments has evolved, and now the time has come to formalize those proceedings. This will greatly enhance discipline at sea.
entities.name: Public Punishments

desc: The Pukara is a building placed in hill or mountainous terrain, and serves both as weapon storage and as a defensive fortification. They incorporate the difficulty of the terrain into their design, making them comparatively cheaper and easier to construct and maintain than regular forts.
entities.name: Pukara

desc: The five great rivers — Indus, Jhelum, Chenab, Ravi, and Sutley — penetrate the lands of the Punjab area, granting the soil the blessing of unmatched fertility. Apart from allowing us to export food and cotton to our neighbors, this also allows our many cities to grow and encourages all sorts of specialized production. We must do our utmost to encourage the growth of agriculture and to defend our farmers from the bandits and brigands in the adjoining areas.
entities.name: Breadbasket of India

desc: Situated on the westernmost border of India, the Punjab has always been at the crossroads of economic and cultural exchange between India and Persia. The ancient Grand Trunk Road, which connects eastern India to the Farsi world, runs right through our lands before heading up into the Afghan mountain passes. These passes are, however, plagued by tribal raiders and bandits. We should encourage the traffic along this ancient and vibrant route and do everything in our power to look after the wellbeing of these traders by constructing caravanserais and policing these roads.
entities.name: Encourage Indo-Persian Trade

desc: Sikhism, a religion native to the Punjab, is spreading rapidly in our lands. Members of this faith come from all castes and backgrounds, and will defend their state regardless of their former professions.
entities.name: The Khalsa

desc: The Gurmukhī script is an ''abugida'' developed in the lands of Punjab, and is highly favored by our Sikh gurus. Our clergy is using this script in order to record Sikh texts.
entities.name: Gurmukhī Script

desc: The Punjab is a major center for textile production. Cloth from our weavers is specially made for markets all over Asia and Europe, and our weavers are among the most productive in India.
entities.name: Punjabi Textile Industry

desc: The ways of our forefathers were sound, and have served us well over the years. But in order for our armies to continue to triumph on the battlefields, we must create a more professional military. By studying the way other countries organize their armies and adapting their methods when prudent, we may create a more efficient Punjabi army while still retaining the unique qualities of our current military system.
entities.name: Reforming the Punjabi Army

desc: The administrative system of the Misl states of Punjab allows them to field impressive cavalry forces. In times of need, we may call upon these forces to fight a common enemy.
entities.name: Strength of the Misls

desc: Considered part of the Smṛti, the Purāṇa are texts with a variety of content. Cosmology, divine genealogies, astronomy, grammar, love stories... almost everything can be found within them. As such, even though they are not part of the Śruti, their influence on Hindu beliefs and society is strong, as they combine diverse local beliefs and traditions into the common narrative of the Vēdaḥ.
entities.name: Purāṇa

desc: By increasing the quantity of our boilers for the process of concentrating the Saltpeter and improving their reliability, we will be able to increase the production of gunpowder for our troops without the reliance on costly imports.
entities.name: Putrefaction Mill

desc: Saltpeter is a valuable chemical compound which finds its uses as a fertilizer, salt for meat processing and as key ingredient for gunpowder. The Putrefaction Works serves as an alternative way to gain Saltpeter for cases where mining operations are not available.
entities.name: Putrefaction Works

desc: Our ancestors constructed massive stone pyramids in the far-gone days of Teōtīhuacān, Tik'al, Copan, and Palenque. We have not forgotten the art of pyramid building, and can carry on this tradition.
entities.name: Pyramid Architecture

desc: The fortified complex of Qal'at al-Mashwār stands as both a military bastion and a symbol of dynastic authority. Having invested in its expansion, the defense of Tlemcen is strengthened while ensuring administrative control over the surrounding lands.
entities.name: Qal'at al-Mashwār

desc: The most crucial time for any army comes after battle. Win or lose, troops are most vulnerable when they are exhausted. We must ensure that our troops are highly trained and can recover easily from combat, lest our enemies take advantage of us in moments of weakness.
entities.name: Well-Trained Forces

desc: Allows us to join the nations set to explore the world outside their borders, or strive to be the first nation to circumnavigate the globe, by commencing a quest for the New World.
entities.name: Quest for the New World

desc: Although the 'Jesuit's Bark' has been effective in treating malaria in the past, its consumption as dried bark powder leaves much room for improvement. By isolating and extracting the actual healing component from the bark, we can substantially increase the effectiveness of the treatment.
entities.name: Quinine

desc: A system which uses knots on a string to store information, do accounting, and perform other informational tasks. Each knot represents a number from zero to nine. The knots can also be used to refer to logograms on the same string. The knots show which syllable in the logogram to use, and by combining more strings, sentences can be formed.
entities.name: Quipu

desc: Toulon's natural harbor offers the ideal staging ground for our naval ambitions. While Marseille thrives as our commercial jewel, Toulon shall be the armory of Provence, and the launching point of a future maritime power.
entities.name: Rade of Toulon

desc: Our shipyards have become famous for producing the ''argosy'', massive carracks capable of surviving the Atlantic and the Indian Oceans. By standardizing our shipbuilding techniques and securing high-quality oak from the Bosnian forests, we ensure that the Ragusan merchant marine is the most technologically advanced in the Adriatic. These vessels are designed for maximum cargo capacity and defensive firepower, allowing our merchants to dominate the spice and silk routes while flying the flag of Saint Blaise in every major port from London to Goa.
entities.name: The Arsenal Expansion

desc: To maintain our status as a center of refinement, we have established the ''Collegium Ragusinum'', a Jesuit-led institution of higher learning that attracts the sons of Balkan and Italian nobility. By producing a class of highly educated diplomats, scientists, and poets, we ensure that Ragusa's leadership is never outmatched in the courtrooms of Europe. This intellectual investment turns our small city into a center of culture, where the fusion of Latin logic and Slavic spirit produces the scholars who will define the cultural awakening of the entire Adriatic littoral.
entities.name: The Collegium Ragusinum

desc: Facing the recurring devastation of the Black Death, Ragusa has pioneered the world's first mandatory maritime quarantine system on the islands of Mrkan and Bobara. By isolating incoming crews and goods for forty days (quaranta), we protect our urban population while maintaining the functionality of our port when other Mediterranean hubs are paralyzed by plague. This scientific approach to public health ensures that the Republic remains a reliable and clean port of call, preserving our manpower and mercantile networks during even the most lethal periods of European history.
entities.name: The Lazzaretto System

desc: We have moved beyond mere shipping to the world of high finance by formalizing one of the first sophisticated systems of maritime insurance. By pooling the risks of our merchant families through the ''Monte di Pietà'', we allow our captains to undertake daring new voyages to the Americas and the Far East with minimal personal risk. This financial innovation ensures that Ragusan capital is always in motion, creating a self-sustaining cycle of wealth that keeps our city wealthy and relevant even as the traditional Mediterranean trade routes begin to fade in importance.
entities.name: The Ragusan Maritime Insurance Code

desc: As the wars between our neighbors intensify, we have declared our city a strictly neutral ''Porto Franco'' (Free Port). By refusing to host foreign warships while offering high-quality repairs and storage to all merchant vessels, we ensure that the conflict only serves to increase our profits. This 'Economic Non-Alignment' makes Ragusa the only safe harbor in a burning sea, allowing us to capture the trade routes that our rivals have abandoned in their pursuit of military glory.
entities.name: The Ragusan Porto Franco

desc: To ensure a stable environment for international investment, Ragusa has codified its laws into a comprehensive legal framework that defines property rights and maritime codes. By limiting the power of any single noble and establishing the ''Consilium Rogatorum'', we create a predictable mercantile environment that attracts the wealthiest traders of the Mediterranean. This legal clarity allows a small city-state to punch far above its weight, turning a rocky outcrop into a sanctuary of ''Libertas'' that no feudal lord can easily subvert or ignore.
entities.name: The Statute of 1272

desc: ] has been upgraded to a rail connection, massively increasing travel speed and logistics.
entities.name: Railroad

gate: is capital in south america or carribean

desc: The rainforests and mountains of our land are teeming with life. Apart from the spirits of the forests, jaguars, anacondas, tarantulas, and a myriad of other animals live among us, and for someone who knows them, they offer little direct danger. To an invading enemy, however, these lands might seem like a fortress and the wild animals as its defenders.
entities.name: Rainforests and Mountaintops

desc: Our corsair captains, the ''Ra'īs'', are more than just pirates. Truly, they are seasoned naval commanders, and their experience at sea feeds a deep well of maritime tradition that strengthens our navy's proud heritage.
entities.name: Ra'īs of the Navy

desc: The influence of our clan extends far beyond our own borders. We are able to draw from other Rajput groups from all over northern India when filling the ranks of our armies.
entities.name: Clan Loyalties

desc: Every soldier is trained for battle, but our people start combat training at a much younger age, granting them skills surpassing those of other green soldiers.
entities.name: Combat Training

desc: Sieges are what win wars. We must experiment with ways of creating bigger and better cannons to bring down the many forts of our enemies, both within India and outside it.
entities.name: Expanded Artillery Arm

desc: The rise of Delhi, and the invading Muslim warriors of the past, were wake-up calls. We must always be prepared for foreign invaders, and thus, we must hire the most skilled architects to design impregnable forts throughout our realm. The immensely long walls that will be needed to protect our land make this an ambitious project, but our determination to defend our people shall ensure that it is done.
entities.name: Fortress Architecture

desc: Many Rajput soldiers are experts in the use of personal firearms. We should put these hardened veterans to work training the next generation of soldiers, rather than risking the loss of their expertise in battle. All of our soldiers must be drilled in firearms tactics before they are expected to meet our enemies on the front line.
entities.name: Mandatory Firearm Drills

desc: The upbringing and traditions of Rajput warriors ensure a wide base for recruiting officers to lead our armies. In order to capitalize on this, we should formalize career opportunities and advancement paths to encourage these promising young fighters to serve as officers in our forces.
entities.name: Martial Ethos

desc: Wars are not only won through tactics and bravery, but also through weaponry. Our blacksmiths shall forge the finest martial weapons for our warriors to wield in defense of the Rajput people.
entities.name: Martial Smiths

desc: Like their masters, Rajput cavalry horses are meticulously trained to perform on the field of battle. It is said that a Marwari horse will only leave the battlefield under one of three conditions - victory, death, or when carrying a wounded master to safety. By taking good care of these divine beings, we will ensure the everlasting dominance of our horsemen on the battlefields of India.
entities.name: Marwari Horses

desc: There is almost no division between civil and military society among the Rajputs. Our nation is a host, defined by its people rather than by the land we control, and its people are warriors. We must ensure that military divisions properly meet our administrative needs as the host expands.
entities.name: Militaristic Society

desc: What purpose does victory serve if there is nothing to immortalize our achievements? Monuments, such as an awe-inspiring Tower of Victory, shall be erected, so future generations will know of our greatest battles and be appropriately inspired.
entities.name: Monumental Architecture

desc: Rajput painters already have an excellent reputation, but it could be even better. We must encourage our artists to develop their skills and add to the glory of our dynasty by creating a school of painting particular to our state.
entities.name: Rajput Painting School

desc: Rajput poet-musicians tell stories of our people's many battles against foreign invaders, and how our ancestors would rather die than admit themselves defeated. We must encourage this spirit of unity, and give our musicians reason to write new ballads of bravery in the face of death.
entities.name: Rajput Resistance

desc: Traditional clan structures are an excellent foundation for a modernized regimental system. Existing hierarchies based on kinship and unconditional loyalty can be easily translated into an organized and formal chain of command.
entities.name: Reorganized Rajput Regiments

desc: The Rajputs have spread themselves throughout northern India in their pursuit of glory. The ''Purbias'', elite Rajput soldiers who venture as mercenaries, are renowned for their combat ability, and as such spread our fearsome reputation.
entities.name: The Purbias

desc: Our realm has developed various methods for swiftly amassing troops, so no enemy can catch us unprepared. This edge has helped us stand tall, despite all odds being against us, and we are prepared for battle. United, we march forward, resolute in purpose and ready to defend our honor and homeland!
entities.name: Rallying the Troops

desc: A commemoration of the first revelation to Prophet Muḥammad, peace be upon him, the month of Ramaḍān is the holiest month in Islam. During this month, all Muslim faithful are expected to perform Ṣawm — fasting and abstinence — during the daylight hours, as well as prayer and reflection.
entities.name: Ramaḍān

desc: One of the two major Smṛti texts together with the Mahābhārata, the Rāmāyaṇa is an epic of ancient India. It narrates the life of Rāma, avatar of Viṣṇu, as a prince of the kingdom of Kosala. It emphasizes the importance of virtue in all aspects of one's life.
entities.name: Rāmāyaṇa

desc: Cattle breeding led to the ability to raise entire herds of horses, which in turn has made it possible to breed the best animals for travel, war, and many other tasks.
entities.name: Ranching

desc: The Rasulid dynasty brought unprecedented administrative order to our lands. With census records, tax systems, and a robust cabinet structure, they transformed Yemen into one of the most efficiently governed realms in the region.
entities.name: Rasulid Bureaucracy

desc: Ravenna has long been a prize worth fighting for, and the fields outside our walls have witnessed battles of extraordinary ferocity that have made our name synonymous with the hardest kind of fighting in Italy. We harden the walls of the city and steel the soldiery against the shock of pitched battle, drawing on the lessons that only ground stained this often can teach. This martial tradition forges an army that is difficult to break and a city that is difficult to take.
entities.name: The Battle of Ravenna

desc: The marshes and lagoons that surround our city are both our shield and our burden — they protect us from armies but flood our fields and breed disease. We commit to a systematic program of drainage and embankment, digging channels and raising dykes that push back the water and claim new agricultural land from the swamp. This transformation of the wetlands into productive territory feeds our growing population and expands the taxable estate of the state.
entities.name: The Ravenna Reclamations

desc: Our city is a living archive of a civilization that has vanished almost everywhere else — the gold-leaf apses, the intricate stonework, the iconographic traditions of the ''Byzantine'' world survive here in a concentration found nowhere else in the west. Artists and patrons who come to study these works carry their influence outward, raising the reputation of everything produced in our workshops. This custody of a unique heritage turns our past into a source of lasting cultural and commercial value.
entities.name: The Byzantine Legacy

desc: No city in the Western world preserves the art of the ''Mosaic'' as we do — our basilicas and mausoleums are clad in tesserae that glow with gold and deep blue, images that have survived centuries of war and neglect without losing their impact. These works attract scholars, pilgrims, and artists who come to study what the ancient world looked like before it was lost. This tradition of extraordinary craftsmanship deepens our cultural heritage and lends our state a prestige that no contemporary rival can easily replicate.
entities.name: The Mosaics of Ravenna

desc: After generations of stagnation, we invest in our city's renewal — clearing old districts, building new roads and market squares, and offering incentives to artisans and merchants who settle within our walls. The city that results is more open, more prosperous, and more capable of absorbing the growth that comes with a reforming state. This reinvestment in our urban fabric makes Ravenna a place people want to come to rather than one they are merely stuck in.
entities.name: The New Ravenna

desc: The vast coastal pine forests (the Pinedi) of the Adriatic coast are managed as strategic state assets. Our people have developed a culture of sylviculture and salt, harvesting timber for shipbuilding and managing the vast salt pans of Cervia. By reinforcing these traditions, our people will provide a non-agrarian source of wealth that is immune to crop failure, giving us the liquid capital necessary to face any challenges.
entities.name: The Pineda di Classe

desc: These are turbulent times, and not everyone is happy with who rules over them. By contacting these dissatisfied groups abroad, we may be able to turn them to our cause and persuade them to incite a revolt, which would be a devastating tool for destabilizing our enemies.
entities.name: Undercover Contacts

desc: The Sahara is not static. It can wax and wane depending on rainfall, and the habitable belt known as the Sahel, where we reside, can grow or shrink accordingly. A major drought could render much of our kingdom useless desert, an addition to the Sahara where no one reigns but death. However, in good years, we might reclaim some of the marginal lands from the Sahara and make it productive again.
entities.name: Reclamation of Land

desc: In our frequent clashes with fierce foreign corsairs, the thought has occurred to us that these scurvy dogs might have the right idea about looting and pillaging the coast, but they are preying on the wrong targets. Piracy may be a vile sin in peacetime, but in times of war, it is known as 'privateering,' and that is another thing altogether.
entities.name: Reconquista of the Sea

desc: War is a cruel mistress that leaves behind naught but wreckage and devastation. By concentrating our efforts on assisting our people as they return to ordinary life after so much horror, we can hasten recovery across the realm.
entities.name: Recovery Efforts

desc: For our country to create a formidable army, we must improve our recruitment efforts. With increased time and money spent on recruitment centers and activities, we will attract able soldiers with haste.
entities.name: Recruitment Offices

desc: The development of professional armies has increased our military capabilities. To sustain this, the state will need to improve its capacity for recruiting soldiers as well.
entities.name: Organized Recruitment

desc: With potential threats emerging from across a wider geographical expanse than ever before, we need to expand our military recruitment accordingly. By offering incentives to volunteers while also pressing criminals into service, we can rapidly mobilize forces to meet any danger.
entities.name: Extensive Recruitment

desc: Battles cannot be won with no soldiers on the field! Recruiting fighters is an absolute necessity. As time goes on, how we recruit soldiers may change, and our forces will adapt to it as needed.
entities.name: Recruitment Law

desc: The spice trade flowing through the Red Sea is a key source of our wealth, and we must seize full control of it. By threatening to burn down any Red Sea ports outside our authority that accept spice traders, we can capture the lion's share of this lucrative commerce. We may not win many friendships with our aggression, but we shall have gold enough to comfort us.
entities.name: Red Sea Trade

desc: Some may think that if we need more money, the only thing we need to do is mint more, but that is neither sustainable nor wise. By keeping strict control over our minting industry, we can keep our inflation in check, and possibly even reduce it.
entities.name: Strict Monetary Control

desc: Obsidian is an excellent material for making all kinds of tools and weapons. The hard, glasslike rock holds a sharp edge beautifully, making it an easy task to create blades, spearheads, or arrowheads which leave deadly wounds on any foe.
entities.name: Obsidian Weaponry

desc: We must accept the proposed reforms to our liturgical music. The diluted, soulless tunes currently in fashion can no longer be considered acceptable ways to express the glory of the divine.
entities.name: Reformed Church Music

desc: We are fortunate to be served by loyal and well-educated Farsi administrators, who have perfected the art of governance for generations. Sadly, however, a hereditary office is one that over time might stagnate and lack innovation. By reducing the number of inherited offices with each generation, we can make sure that we reward not only loyalty, but also ability. Able administrators must rise to high positions regardless of which family they come from.
entities.name: Reform the Dīwān

desc: We will issue royal charters to the guilds of the Morava Valley, and encourage the development of large-scale leather-working, weaving, and metal-finishing workshops along the river's transit points. By exempting these guilds from certain internal tolls in exchange for providing standardized equipment to the royal armies — such as saddlery for the cavalry and uniforms for the infantry — the state will create a self-sustaining domestic industry. This move will reduce the realm's dependence on expensive foreign imports from outside and create a prosperous, urban middle class that serves as a loyal counter-weight to the rural power of the nobility, significantly broadening the state's taxable economic base.
entities.name: The Morava Trade Guilds

desc: The feudal levy system has proven slow and unreliable in this new age of professional warfare. Inspired by the French model, we will replace our scattered vassal hosts with salaried companies, skilled officers, and integrated armies. A disciplined core of professional soldiers will form the backbone of a modern and adaptable army.
entities.name: Reform the Feudal Army

desc: Considered the ''de facto'' highest institution in our nation, the ''Grand Secretariat'' has served our rulers for centuries. Wielding immense influence over administrative affairs, this body of cabinet ministers must undergo a reform to further increase its effectiveness.
entities.name: Reform the Grand Secretariat

desc: The later Mamlūk troops are categorized by a renewed attention to detail and discipline. A series of military reforms are set in place, to restore the old standards and retrain our standing armies.
entities.name: Reformed Mamālīk

desc: The spiritual heart of the Bulgarian world will undergo a rigorous and profound transformation under the iron-willed guidance of our Patriarch. Recognizing that the survival of the nation depends upon the purity of its faith and the precision of its holy texts, the Patriarchate will initiate a sweeping linguistic and liturgical reform centered at the Holy Trinity Monastery of Tarnovo. By purging the Church Slavonic manuscripts of centuries of scribal errors and corrupt localisms, we will establish a new, standardized orthography that will become the gold standard for the entire Orthodox Slavic world, from the Danube to the Volga.
entities.name: Reformation of the Patriarchate

desc: Contracts that define suzerainty over another state cover many different aspects. One such is the domestic trade obligations of the subject to their overlord. As global trade becomes more and more prominent, the expansion of these obligations becomes increasingly important.
entities.name: Economic Overlords

desc: As we face new enemies, new military tactics have to be developed or learned. This invaluable knowledge will be taught in our ''Tēlpōchcalli''.
entities.name: Reformed Tēlpōchcalli

desc: The ''Posadnik'' is the highest administrative position in our towns and cities, and is a more significant role than that of a mayor. As their city grows, so do the responsibilities, influence, and number of Posadniks in the administration.
entities.name: Reforms of the Posadnichestvo

desc: Standing armies have become the new standard of warfare, which in itself brings its share of challenges. The Marshal of Lodging, a new position within our military, shall focus on overcoming these challenges by organizing the logistics of our ever-growing forces.
entities.name: Marshal of Lodgings

desc: Logistics are half the battle. As soldiers fight, their weaponry and armor will lose their durability, and possibly even break under the enemy onslaught. Establishing local supply depots, as well as employing other logistic methods, allows us to re-equip our soldiers in record time.
entities.name: Early Military Logistics

desc: Use of gunpowder weaponry has become increasingly prevalent among our fighting forces. However, gunpowder is a troublesome material to work with due to its vulnerability to weather and external impact. A specialized flask will protect our gunpowder from the elements, allowing us to supply our troops more easily.
entities.name: Powder Flask

desc: Professional armies are shifting the way warfare is conducted, as now it is based on permanent units that serve for long periods of time. Maintaining a regular flow of trained soldiers into those units is a challenge, but very much needed for their optimal operation.
entities.name: Permanent Field Training

desc: Modern standing armies are grander than any military force of the past. Tactics are executed by the tens of thousands, and the casualties pile up in unprecedented numbers. Our new military training techniques should offset the high death toll of modern warfare by readying hundreds of soldiers for battle at the same time.
entities.name: Mass Training

desc: The Regimental Camp is a more efficient way of increasing the [
] by replacing the Training Fields in any [Rural Location].
entities.name: Regimental Camp

desc: By organizing our armies into regiments tied to distinct geographical areas, we allow them to put down roots in local communities. Then, we need to raise additional battalions for these regiments, recruitment will be faster thanks to these regional ties.
entities.name: Regimental System

desc: We should record the history of our splendid rulers and their illustrious deeds in great chronicles, so that they may be passed down across the generations and always remembered.
entities.name: Regnal Chronicles

desc: Levies are by definition not the best-trained troops, but that does not mean that we have to send a bunch of untrained rabble to war. Assigning them proper instructors from our most proficient units will allow them to learn from the best, and a mandatory training period with them will make them ready — and eager — to fight.
entities.name: Designated Instruction

desc: By applying a strict regimen and routine to our operations, we will reduce any potential excess cost, and run a frugal and efficient court.
entities.name: Regulate Court Procedures

desc: A legislative body whose jurisdiction involves the maintenance and promotion of inflation-related laws as well as the local administration of our provinces.
entities.name: Regulation Bureau

desc: As they did not accept the Second Council of Ephesus, the Council of Chalcedon was called at the instance of Pope Leo I, who demanded the nullification of the Second Council of Ephesus. We reject this false council, and stand by the decisions made in the original one.
entities.name: Rejection of Chalcedon

desc: As the world around us shifts to accommodate the wider scope of a truly global theater, so too must our diplomatic efforts keep up with this ever-growing need for security against foreign threats.
entities.name: Threaded Politics

desc: Although our faith is shared across many communities, notable divergence exists in ritual, tradition, and local religious practice. Over time these variations develop organically, sometimes even within the same province. Much like language evolves into regional dialects, our religious customs gradually form distinct local expressions while remaining within the same sacred tradition.
entities.name: Religious Dialects

desc: Icons are the physical representation of our faith, sacred depictions of holy figures designed to inspire awe and devotion to those that contemplate them.
entities.name: Religious Icons

desc: Many different religions have influenced our people, from their traditional folk beliefs to Hinduism and Buddhism, both from India and China. Over time, our people have developed some degree of religious syncretism, mixing some beliefs with others and not fully disregarding any.
entities.name: Religious Melting Pot

desc: Interaction between beliefs sometimes results in synthesis rather than rejection. Foreign thoughts and practices should therefore not be seen as hostile threats, but opportunities to learn, and possibly incorporate valuable elements into our own traditions.
entities.name: Religious Syncretism

desc: Stability in our home regions is the key to our success elsewhere. Expanding outwards while fostering religious tolerance, we not only improve stability at home, but we also make our realm a haven for those fleeing persecution elsewhere.
entities.name: Religious Toleration

desc: The strength of our faith, and the impressive public displays of piety and worship we stage, are admired by other countries both near and far. This is a clear reflection of the prestige and glory of our realm.
entities.name: Religious Tradition

desc: There is only one religion that is true, and thus it is our duty to unite all the faithful under the sole guidance of God.
entities.name: Religious Unification

desc: Conquest and persecution have repeatedly forced our patriarchates to relocate after their seats have fallen under control of heathen conquerors. Though we now operate from new locations, the original seats remain spiritually revered in our tradition, albeit from a distance.
entities.name: Remote Patriarchates

desc: The waves of innovative thought and discoveries that permeate our realm must be harnessed and utilized if we are to remain at the forefront of technological innovation.
entities.name: Renaissance

desc: By establishing that only our ruler can grant city rights, we centralize control over urban development and give our administration a clear overview of the state of our country.
entities.name: Formal City Rights

desc: The Renaissance has spread far and wide, and as a result, our court is attracting dedicated artists and scholars, creating the most splendid works ever made.
entities.name: Renaissance Court

desc: This era of thought, arts, and science will bring forth new waves of discoveries and inventions, allowing us to optimize our adoption of foreign institutions.
entities.name: Scholarly Treatises

desc: The Veneranda ''Fabbrica del Duomo'' has maintained a permanent workforce of stonecutters, engineers, and master builders in continuous employ for generations, treating the Cathedral not as a project with an end but as an institution that trains craftsmen and refines technique for as long as the work demands. We have extended its remit and its funding, ensuring that the knowledge it preserves flows outward to every construction site in our territory. This institution turns Milan into a school of practical building, and the craftsmen it trains are sought across the whole of northern Italy.
entities.name: The Fabbrica del Duomo

desc: The Renaissance has brought with it greater interest in arts in all forms. It seems that nowadays no one is anybody if they do not have a piece of art adorning their homes! Sculptures are one of the most prolific forms of artistic expression, which has led to an increase in the number of quarries as demand for Stone has risen dramatically among the artistically inclined.
entities.name: Renaissance Sculptures

desc: In recent years, matters of culture, humanism, and natural philosophy have risen in prominence. This cultural influence extends not only to our own people, but also to states who have sworn allegiance to us, making our position as cultural overlords a valuable diplomatic tool.
entities.name: Cultural Overlords

desc: The notion of a noble oligarchy ruling over society is hardly new, having existed since at least Roman times. This system remains entrenched in the structure of many nations, and the idea is regaining popularity among those who matter...
entities.name: Renaissance Thought

desc: Accounting for dedicated areas for resource exploitation during the planning phase will allow our urban centers to produce more goods than before.

mods.label: Maximum RGO Size in Towns & Cities

entities.name: Renaissance City Planning

desc: Ships are undertaking longer voyages than ever before, made possible by new technical advances. This means more complex repairs are needed, but ports with adequate equipment and skilled craftsmen are not always available. Our sailors must be trained in the art of careening — deliberately beaching vessels to expose the parts that need cleaning or repair. This is the only way our fleets can maintain seaworthiness far from their home ports.
entities.name: Coastal Careening

desc: While the latest advances in naval craftsmanship are pushing the boundaries of sailing as we know it, we need any crewmen on said ships to know how to fully exploit these new capabilities. Only training permanent professional sailors will allow them to correctly perform the necessary tasks to maintain these cutting-edge new ships.

mods.label: Maximum Ship Strength to Repair at Sea

entities.name: Professional Crews

desc: This advanced form of careening is performed in deep coastal waters. Heavy cargo is shifted to one side of the ship to make it heel, allowing the crew to access the opposite side of the hull for repairs without needing to beach the vessel and wait for low tide as with regular careening.

mods.label: Maximum Ship Strength to Repair at Sea

entities.name: Parliamentary Heel

desc: Dissemination of power is a cornerstone belief of any healthy republic. Robust laws enforcing elections by lottery will ensure stability and reduce corruption.
entities.name: Republic Reform Traditions

desc: The heart of our republic, the Republican Assembly is an incredibly vital institution, allowing us to be governed by noble virtue and excellence.
entities.name: Republican Assembly

desc: Elections are the cornerstone of our republic, ensuring that there are reasonable limits on those in power while giving the people the ability to select rulers that best serve their interests.
entities.name: Election

desc: Elections are the foundational concept of our republic, and as such, the most important factor in determining the course of the Republic is deciding who is eligible vote in those elections.
entities.name: Republican Electorate Law

desc: Our Republic is founded on the principle that power should be in the hands of the people, not a single absolutist ruler. Yet as with any government, its laws and decisions must be respected and obeyed to maintain order, necessitating the creation of complex administrations in order to govern.
entities.name: Foundation of Republic

desc: As any government, the Republic must not only make decisions, but also act upon them. To do so, it needs a way of exercising its executive capabilities so that they reach even the furthest areas of the country.
entities.name: Republican Power

desc: Former religious properties seized by the state during our national conversion process can serve us now in new ways, such as centers for production or administration.
entities.name: Repurposed Monasteries

desc: We must pursue good relations with our fellow Christian faithful of all denomination, even if we consider some of their practices to be heresy.
entities.name: Universal Christianity

desc: Muslim traders endure the harshest of conditions during their expeditions. From crossing the scorching sands of the Sahara and Gobi Deserts, to braving the monsoon-plagued waters of the Indian Ocean, they have proved time and again that they will undergo any hardship in order to bring about successful trade.
entities.name: Resilient Traders

desc: Although it has spread widely throughout the world, Buddhism has also seen its fair share of persecution across the ages. Its temples and images may have been destroyed, its followers slaughtered or forced into hiding, but nonetheless its faithful have persevered.
entities.name: Resistance to Persecution

desc: Our Orthodox brethren have seen themselves at times under the yoke of foreign infidels. However, we have learned to endure such oppression, and even live in peace alongside these infidels.
entities.name: Resistance to the Infidels

desc:
After tumultuous wars, a new era dawns upon Saxony — the remarkable Saxon ''Rétablissement''. Amidst the ruins of our past, our nation will rise like a phoenix, rebuilding its shattered economy and charting a path toward prosperity. Driven by a blend of visionary state reforms and disciplined spending, our nation will emerge as a commercial hub.

With unparalleled administrative prowess and a strategic focus on economic growth, this resolute transformation will mark a pivotal moment in history, shaping the destiny of Saxony well into the future.
entities.name: Rétablissement

desc: We are the true heir of the Kievan Rus', and those lands must be reunited under our banner!
entities.name: Reuniting the Rus'

desc: Under the direct patronage of the Shishman Dynasty, the nation has undergone a spectacular cultural growth, positioning itself as a true ''Third Rome'' and the primary guardian of Orthodox high culture. By funding the reconstruction of the Patriarchal Cathedral and the royal palaces of Tsarevets, the state has gathered a new generation of master iconographers, hagiographers, and architects who blend traditional Byzantine aesthetics with a unique, emotive Bulgarian realism. This school of thought does not merely produce religious icons; it serves as a powerful instrument of imperial propaganda, codifying the Bulgarian recension of Church Slavonic and producing the Manasses Chronicle to legitimize the Tsar's claim to the Byzantine heritage.
entities.name: The Tarnovo Artistic Schools

desc:
The international diplomatic theater thrives on a balance of power between the nations. Wars of aggression are frowned upon and, if won, might lead to coalitions forming and uniting against the winner.
Through clever usage of diplomacy and interpretation, however, we can make our enemies appear as the aggressors against us, justifying our warmongering and gains from it in the eyes of the public.
entities.name: Justified Conflicts

desc: The fires of revolution are no trifling threat. If we wish to guarantee the loyalty of our subjects, we must suffocate any notion of uprising in its cradle by appointing trustworthy governors and removing any cause for unrest.
entities.name: Benign Overlords

desc: The great edifices and grand statues erected in the past still stand proudly. It is undeniable that the construction techniques used to design and erect them were sophisticated and well-developed. There is still much we can learn from studying them.
entities.name: Renaissance Building Methods

desc: Our country is nothing without its land and its people. Improving the infrastructure of our nation will benefit the common folk as much as it benefits us.
entities.name: Infrastructure Efforts

desc: If merchants and artisans can access the products they need locally, that would not only ease the burden of their work, but keep prices from being excessively high. To that effect, storehouses will serve as local distribution hubs to supply everyone's needs.
entities.name: Local Storehouses

desc: Having proper storehouses to hold the products required by local businesses is a must if we want those enterprises — to say nothing of the entire economy — to function smoothly.
entities.name: Improved Storehouses

desc: Recent developments in economic thought have shifted the focus from the mercantilist ideals of value lying in trade towards the notion that value lies in the production process itself. As a result, production has been steadily improving and increasing.
entities.name: Physiocracy

desc: The discovery of new minerals and the invention of new tools has resulted in more efficient resource gathering and production line acceleration.
entities.name: Advanced Extraction Techniques

desc: As we learn new and better methods of resource extraction, our production will skyrocket, making us richer in the process!
entities.name: Spinning Wheels

desc: Mills have been used since ancient times. However, we are now able to develop more modern and efficient wind and water mills, which in turn improve our production.
entities.name: Mills

desc: Steam as a means to power a machine has been understood since antiquity. However, its potential had never been fully realized until recently, when the latest advances in physics and mathematics allowed the creation of more sophisticated steam engines, which in turn can power more complex machines. This allows for increased productivity in all fields.
entities.name: Steam Engine

desc: We control the strategic mountain passes that cross the Alps. This tends to attract unwanted attention from other nations who want that same control. Out of this chaos, a specialized class of Rhaeto-Romance diplomats may emerge. Under our sponsorship, these multilingual negotiators will master the art of playing major powers against each other to maintain local autonomy. This culture of high-stakes mediation will ensure that even when foreign armies occupy the valleys, the legal and social sovereignty of the communes remains intact through meticulously drafted treaties.
entities.name: Alpine Diplomacy

desc: More than ever, the Rhaeto-Romance people need to utilize epic songs (Chanzuns) and oral poetry to preserve their distinct language and history. This creates a culture of 'Linguistic Defiance', where their Latin-based speech is used to foster an identity that is neither German nor Italian. This cultural pride ensures the valleys remain unified against external administrative overhauls.
entities.name: The Chanzun

desc: Under our guidance, the Rhaeto-Romance warriors will become world-renowned for their mastery of the halberd and the pike in broken terrain. Specialized in ambushing heavy cavalry in narrow gorges, these soldiers can turn their valleys into lethal traps. This military culture is so effective that Rhaeto-Romance mercenaries are highly sought after, bringing wealth and modern tactical knowledge back to their home mountains.
entities.name: Mountain Warriors

desc: Our intellectuals have begun the formal revival of our languages, for too long considered 'inferior' to other Latin tongues. Under our guidance, the scholars will codify dialects into literary standards and publish national histories. This will create a solid basis for our language, ensuring that the Rhaeto-Romance people are integrated into modern states as an equal and respected nation.
entities.name: The National Revival

desc: The Rhaeto-Romance people have for a long time used the ''Tobià'' — a specialized wooden barn designed for long-term storage in high-altitude climates. These structures are often built with defensive features to protect the community's food supply. This culture of autarky ensures our people's survival during long winter blockades, as the population can retreat into the high valleys and subsist on stored reserves.
entities.name: The Tobià

desc: The harsh environment in the Rhaetian and Dolomite Alps necessitated the development of the ''Vicinanza'' (Neighborhood). This is a system wherein the residents of a valley hold forests and high pastures in collective ownership. This culture of 'Mountain Democracy' prevents feudal lords from monopolizing the vital resources of the peaks, fostering a fierce localism that makes the Rhaeto-Romance valleys autonomous cells within larger empires.
entities.name: The Vicinanza

desc: Our lands are rich with fertile soil and abundant resources from the prairies to the dense forests, ready to be transformed by our hardy men and women. We will use every tool at our disposal to wisely manage the land we have been gifted, and thereby bring prosperity to every household.
entities.name: Rich Lands

desc: Asia is famous around the world for its riches. From the bountiful cities of Persia and India, to the highly-sought luxury items produced in China, to the almost mythical Spice Islands in Indonesia, the luxurious goods coming from Asia are highly prized worldwide.
entities.name: Riches of Asia

desc: Distant lands have brought to us many resources, but not only the lands themselves are rich. Coasts and seas are also plentiful, and the knowledge we have gained from foreign pearl divers allows ours to be more successful in their catches.
entities.name: Riches of Foreign Coasts

desc: As long as our merchants control the trade through the lands of Transoxiana and Samarkand, the trade of the Silk Road shall flow unhindered and the wealth of our dynasty will continue to grow.
entities.name: Control of the Silk Road

desc: Our administration is centered around the premise that the most talented people should be assigned to appropriate posts. As such, the ruler should be the most gifted member of the realm, as befits someone who leads an entire country. In the unfortunate case that the ruler might be lacking, we will need people skilled at 'embellishing' the truth to communicate the ruler's extraordinary competence, be it through imposing statues, astonishing paintings, or exalting verses.
entities.name: Right to Rule

desc: At the forefront of current revolutionary thought is the radical notion of equality for all. Philosophers from around the world have collaborated to create a document entitled the 'Declaration of the Rights of Man and of the Citizen', proclaiming that these rights are universal and should be enforced by law. It is likely that this will be ample fuel for popularizing the concepts of freedom and democracy, and we would do well not to lag behind other nations.
entities.name: Rights of Man

desc: History proves that the most extraordinary individuals are the ones who rise to prominence and achieve great things. Time and again, empires have been forged or destroyed by the hand of a single ruler, and such achievements are to be respected and admired.
entities.name: Rise of Great Individuals

desc: In the Church of the Holy Sepulchre, the ancient Latin rites are once more performed in full splendor. These solemn rituals, honoring the death and resurrection of Christ, reinforce our divine mandate to rule this land and spread the teachings of our faith.
entities.name: Rites of the Holy Sepulchre

desc: Many cultures in this region consider ritual sacrifice and bloodletting by the ruler as a way of paying homage to the gods. Maintaining this tradition pleases the gods and affirms our right to rule through divine tribute.
entities.name: Ritual Bloodletting

gate: is capital in south america or carribean

desc: The bounty of our great rivers and seas has always fed our people. Let us embrace the river trade, and do what we can to protect the many merchants that travel along the coast to the mouth of the mighty river, so that we may never lack for the fine goods they bring us.
entities.name: River Trade

desc: We have issued the first printed collection of laws in our nation, the ''Carte Românească de Învățătură''. This monumental work seeks to unify the legal practices of our realm and align them with broader European jurisprudence. By codifying Byzantine canon law into the vernacular and standardizing punishments, we have curbed the arbitrary power of the local boyars and bound the metropolitan courts to the throne, making our state a model of Eastern Orthodox legalism where the Prince's edicts carry the weight of both throne and altar.
entities.name: Carte Românească de Învățătură

desc: The publication of the first complete Bible in the Romanian language has fundamentally shifted our cultural identity from the liturgical Church Slavonic to the living vernacular. This monumental work acts as a linguistic unifier, standardizing the dialects of Wallachia, Moldavia, and Transylvania into a single literary tongue. By making the sacred texts accessible to the common man, we have laid the foundation for a unified national consciousness that transcends the political borders of the three separate principalities.
entities.name: The Bible of Bucharest

desc: Inspired by the glory of Constantinople, the Romanian princes have bound themselves to be the primary patrons of Mount Athos and the Orthodox East. By positioning ourselves as heirs to the Byzantine cultural legacy, we attract scholars and artists from across the Balkans. Romania is now 'more Byzantium than Byzantium', the faith capital of the Orthodox world.
entities.name: The Byzantine Heirs

desc: As enemy tides recede, the Latin-speaking people of the Carpathians recognize their shared Roman heritage. By formalizing the oral histories and legal traditions of the 'Vlachs', we create a unified cultural identity that transcends the fragmented ''Knezates'' and Voivodeships. This ''Romanitas'' provides the ideological glue needed to bind the mountain clans into a cohesive state.
entities.name: The Descendants of Trajan

desc: By securing the establishment of the Metropolises in our lands, we achieve spiritual and political independence from foreign ecclesiastical influence. This religious autonomy allows the Romanian crown to use the Church as an administrative arm, ensuring the loyalty of the boyars through divine sanction. The Church becomes the primary sponsor of Romanian literacy and law.
entities.name: The Foundation of the Metropolises

desc: Our nation has seen the rise of the ''Panduri'', a highly motivated irregular infantry force drawn from among our free peasantry and petty gentry. These soldiers specialize in guerrilla warfare and rapid movement through the Danubian marshes, proving that a native, ideologically driven force could challenge both enemy and Boyar retinues. The Pandur tradition will become the blueprint for the first professional and modern native Romanian national army.
entities.name: The Pandur Militias

desc: The importance of trade and commerce is becoming more and more relevant, and so is the establishment of more complex road networks to facilitate and increase the movement of people and goods.
entities.name: Road Network

desc: We have constructed rudimentary road networks, but those are quickly showing us why we need to advance our transportation systems. By expanding our road network, we will be able to circulate goods within our territory more easily.
entities.name: Basic Roads

desc: The transportation of goods, troops, and people is vital to our nation's survival. By developing a basic road network, we will be able to at least connect our people and assist them in their daily endeavors.
entities.name: Road Building

desc: The Roman road system is the envy of the world. It binds our empire together, speeding merchants, messengers, and soldiers alike, with all paths converging in the Eternal City.
entities.name: All Roads Lead to Rome

desc: The people must be kept happy and sated, for discontent breeds revolt. By putting grain on their tables and providing diverting activities such as games and public festivals, we shall win their loyalty and strengthen the state through their patriotism.
entities.name: Panem et Circenses

desc: Citizenship is the lifeblood of Rome, binding peoples of every province into a single political body. Extending these rights ensures integration and the promise of advancement for all who serve the empire.
entities.name: Roman Citizenship

desc: Rome's destiny knows no bounds. From the Pillars of Hercules to the edges of the earth, we will expand our dominion without end, bringing civilization wherever the Imperial Eagle soars.
entities.name: Imperium Sine Fine

desc: Our jurists shall compile and refine our laws into a comprehensive body, drawing on the wisdom of Justinian and the Republic alike. In doing so, we will assure justice for all Roman citizens.
entities.name: Novus Corpus Juris Civilis

desc: Peace under Rome does not mean the absence of war, but the triumph of order. Through enforcing our laws and building extensive road systems, as well as the might of our armies, we will bring stability and prosperity to every corner of the Empire.
entities.name: Pax Romana

desc: Our more remote provinces cannot effectively be ruled from Rome only. By placing competent governors in the outlying regions, we will guarantee that our laws are followed and taxes paid promptly in even the most distant lands of the empire.
entities.name: Provincial Governors

desc: The Legions were once the pride of Rome, feared and respected across the world. To restore them is to also revive the discipline, organization, and indomitable spirit that our great empire is built upon.
entities.name: Restore the Legions

desc: Rome was as much a center of culture as it was an Empire of conquest. By sponsoring poets, scholars, and architects, we will rekindle the creative flame that once illuminated the ancient world.
entities.name: Revival of Arts and Culture

desc: From aqueducts to amphitheaters, Roman engineering leaves behind monuments that endure for centuries. Our mastery of stone and arch will show the entire world that Rome's greatness is eternal.
entities.name: Roman Architecture

desc: The Senate and the people of Rome are the eternal foundations of our state. By invoking this ancient authority, we remind all that Rome rules not merely by force of arms, but by the will of its citizens and its institutions.
entities.name: S.P.Q.R.

desc: A triumph is more than a mere procession. Indeed, it is the living memory of conquest, paraded through the streets of our greatest cities. Such ceremonies inspire loyalty, awe, fear, and ambition in equal measure.
entities.name: Roman Triumphs

desc: Romagna has preserved a unique legal artifact of the Byzantine Exarchate of Ravenna. Unlike the Lombard-influenced north, Romagnol culture has retained a deeper layer of Roman-Byzantine administrative law. This has fostered a differentiated culture, where even the smallest towns claim ancient imperial privileges. This administrative complexity makes the region a nightmare for large empires to centralize efficiently, as every valley is protected by its own Roman web of exemptions and local statutes.
entities.name: Al Téri dl'Esarchét

desc: The state and local communes will unite to undertake the radical modernization of the ancient Via Romea coastal road. By building new stone bridges and drainage systems, we will reconnect the Romagnol coast to the Venetian and Papal markets. This plan will turn the coastal towns from isolated fishing villages into significant trade hubs, facilitating the movement of Romagnol agricultural products and providing the strategic mobility necessary for any future war that threatens our soil.
entities.name: La Strêda Rumêgna

desc: Romagnol towns, caught between the Papal States and Venice, have become laboratories for defensive architecture. The region has pioneered the use of the ''Roca'' (''Rocca'' in standard Italian: the Fortress), a fortress with rounded towers that deflect fire from primitive cannons. These fortifications mean that every village is a tactical strongpoint. They will force invaders into a slow, attritional style of warfare, allowing the small Romagnol states to punch far above their weight in Mediterranean power politics.
entities.name: Mura Malatestiani

desc: Following the trends of the late Baroque, every major Romagnol town will establish an ''Académia'' focused on improving agricultural yields. These local scientific societies will study the drainage of the ''Vâli'' (marshes) and the selection of disease-resistant vines. These agronomy projects will turn the region into an experimental farm, leading to a surplus of crops that will fuel the regional manufactories and provide the state with high-value trade goods for the Adriatic markets.
entities.name: Agricultural Academies

desc: The Romagnol hills are dedicated to the cultivation of the Sangiovese grape. This is not just agriculture; it is a 'Warrior's Wine', robust and hearty. The state will formalize wine-making protocols to ensure a high-calorie, durable product for the infantry. This will also provide a reliable high-value trade good that integrates the rugged Apennine peasants into the urban market, ensuring rural loyalty through economic prosperity.
entities.name: Sangiovese Viticulture

desc: Romagna will become a center for broadside printing — cheap, popular pamphlets in the local dialect. This will create a public narrative, where news, prophecies, and folk songs are disseminated to even the rural population. This literacy-based mobilization will ensure that the state can communicate its decrees rapidly and effectively, fostering a highly informed and politically active populace.
entities.name: The Stampa d'Popul

desc: Our clergy must adopt the official Roman Catechism as their guide for instruction. This text will improve priestly education and ensure only consistent, orthodox teachings are transmitted to the populace.
entities.name: Roman Catechism

desc: The righteousness of the Roman Catholic faith and its doctrines must remain unquestioned, in order to entrench its authority in the minds of our people.
entities.name: Roman Orthodoxy

desc: The transition from tribal knezes to the centralized office of the Voivode signals the maturation of Romanian political culture into a sophisticated medieval system. This ''Dux'' or military leader model is adapted from both Slavic and Byzantine influences but is uniquely Romanian in its execution, blending elective monarchy with dynastic continuity. It will provide the community with a clear military hierarchy capable of negotiating with the neighboring crowns as sovereign equals.
entities.name: The Foundation of the Voivodeship Tradition

desc: The Letter of Neacșu of Câmpulung represents the earliest surviving document in the Romanian language. This shift from Slavonic to the vernacular in private and administrative correspondence signals a growing national self-awareness among the elites and merchants. It provides the foundation for a unified Romanian literary culture that will eventually bridge our lands.
entities.name: The Letter of Neacșu

desc: We have modernized our central administration by expanding the role of the Postelnic (Great Chamberlain) to oversee a professionalized corps of diplomatic and financial scribes. By adopting Western-style chancery practices and keeping rigorous records of state revenues and foreign treaties, we have moved beyond simple feudal governance. This bureaucratic efficiency allows the Voivode to squeeze every ducat out of the Danubian trade while maintaining a complex network of spies in our enemies' capitals.
entities.name: The Postelnic Bureaucracy

desc: Due to the influence of our wealthiest families, our lands are undergoing a cultural blossoming known as the Brâncovenesc style, which we must support. This period of high culture will lead to the construction of grand palaces and the patronage of humanist scholars who will emphasize the Roman origins of the Romanian people. This intellectual movement will solidify our identity as the 'Latin island' in a sea of Slavic and Magyar influences, boosting our diplomatic standing in Western Europe.
entities.name: The Romanian Renaissance

desc: This intellectual movement born in Transylvania has successfully combined Enlightenment rationalism with a fierce national pride, proving the Latin origins of our people through rigorous cultural and linguistic studies. By creating the first modern Romanian grammar and history books, we have provided the ideological fuel for a true nationalistic spirit. The school has convinced the Romanian people across all provinces that they are a single, Western-descended nation destined for sovereignty, effectively ending the era of medieval provincialism.
entities.name: The Școala Ardeleană

desc: Our people have inhabited the highlands for generations, enduring extreme conditions that have made us resilient and strong. This gives us a significant advantage over our enemies whenever we engage in conflict.
entities.name: The Roof of Africa

desc: The basic plow in use in Europe has been unchanged since Roman times. Now, thanks to an improved design, the same plow can be made much lighter, reducing the strain on draft animals and thereby getting more work out of them.
entities.name: Rotherham Plough

desc: Trade with the Far East is essential to maintaining our way of life. However, the land route is slow and costly. If we could find a route over the seas, it would open up many business opportunities for our merchants.
entities.name: Route to the Indies

desc: The pinnacle of the state, the Royal Court is the center of the monarchs power and splendor.
entities.name: Royal Court

desc: The Royal Mamluks are the elite core of the Mamluk army, serving as the Sultan's personal guard. Handpicked and rigorously trained, they are renowned for their loyalty, exceptional combat skills, and unwavering dedication.
entities.name: The Royal Mamluks

desc: Beginning around 1495, the Tudor monarchy invested heavily in not just ships, but extensive infrastructure to maintain and otherwise support them. This for many marked the official founding of the Royal Navy.
entities.name: A Royal Navy

desc: If Scotland is to continue its independent existence, we must secure stable sources of income. By tightening our control over the obligations owed to us by royal estates and feudal properties, we can increase our rightfully received taxes. Through these methods, we can ensure the Crown has sufficient funds to enact their will without relying on other sources of money.
entities.name: Assert the Royal Revenue

desc: It is unavoidable that ships deteriorate while sailing. The beating of the waves and the bite of saltwater accumulate over time, damaging both the hull and ropes no matter how well-constructed the vessel. To alleviate this, sailors are used to performing regular maintenance on their ships to keep them in prime condition, and when more significant damage is received, even being able to keep it afloat until they reach a safe harbor.

mods.label: Maximum Ship Strength to Repair at Sea

entities.name: Makeshift Repairs

desc: Our city produced Cesare Beccaria, whose treatise on crimes and punishments has become the most-read legal text in Europe, arguing that laws should deter crime through certainty rather than cruelty. By reforming our criminal code along these lines — replacing torture and arbitrary sentencing with proportional penalties and open courts — we create a legal system that the urban population sees as fair rather than predatory. This makes our cities easier to govern and more appealing to merchants and investors who know their disputes will be resolved by law rather than by bribes.
entities.name: Beccaria's Treatise

desc: Any settlement, no matter how small, will thrive as long as the land is rich and there are people willing to work it. Even the smallest village can become prosperous and bustling with activity over time.
entities.name: Developing Settlements

desc: We must tame the far reaches of our country in order to expand our economic capabilities. Not only will we provide more space for our people, but we can optimize their contributions to our country.
entities.name: Clearing Terrain

desc: Superior firepower is what determines who wins the sieges of today as well as the pitched battles of tomorrow. We must build a state-of-the-art artillery yard in the heart of our country, to ensure our armies are never without cannons nor ammunition.
entities.name: Russian Artillery Yard

desc: The East Slavic are vast and diverse in their culture. To unify them like the rulers of old once did, we should promote our shared history and forge an unbreakable cultural bond between the different groups.
entities.name: East Slavic Traditions
