desc: The East Slavic people have occupied and ruled these lands for centuries. It is only natural that a East Slavic ruler should govern their own people. The more East Slavic we present ourselves to be, the easier the people will accept our leadership.
entities.name: Common Legitimacy

desc: The Mongol invasions of the past left a strong determination within the East Slavic to resist foreign rule. We can utilize their zeal to reinforce our troops.
entities.name: East Slavic Recruitment

desc: By establishing local schools, we will ensure that our population is well-educated at all levels of society.
entities.name: Education for All Ruthenian People

desc: Much of Ruthenia is rural, empty land. While our great cities like Kyiv serve many important purposes, we cannot neglect the remote lands or small villages that provide us with crucial supplies of food and raw materials.
entities.name: Ruthenian Villages

desc: In the past, we bowed to foreign influences, and were obliged to adapt to their customs to ensure friendly relations. But times have changed, and now we must affirm our own customs, or risk falling into the sphere of foreign influences again.
entities.name: A Ruthenian State

desc: As part of Ahiṃsā, it is prohibited to slaughter cattle. They instead are respected and venerated as maternal figures, and are symbols of selfless provision and sacrifice. Having been worshiped since the time of the Vēdaḥ, they still command enormous respect and attention.
entities.name: Sacred Cattle

desc: Heading into the unknown is always scary, but nowadays, there are few places that are truly undiscovered. While many places around the world have still not been fully explored, they are nonetheless known to us, and we have the knowledge and experience to reach them. With the wealth of knowledge our explorers have collected over their many journeys, we can confidently venture into uncharted territory.
entities.name: Lessons of Exploration

desc: The Gold mined within our territory is of superior quality, and an excellent tool with which to further spread our influence over trade routes with foreign ports.
entities.name: Saharan Gold Trade

desc: From the oases of Ghadames to the caravans of the Sahel, our merchants secure and collect revenue from the trans-Saharan routes that connect us to the riches of the interior. Gold, Salt, and Slaves flow northward under our protection and oversight.
entities.name: Saharan Trade

desc: A new and revolutionary smelting process, enriching silver-containing copper with lead, will allow us to increase the productivity of our mining operations.
entities.name: Saiger Process

desc: Improved processing and work methods will allow our Silver and Lead mines to prosper.
entities.name: Refined Saiger Process

desc: Robert Blake has written several sets of rules and regulations that resulted in sweeping naval reforms. These include new tactics for blockades and landings, as well as adoption of the single line ahead battle formation.
entities.name: Blake's Sailing and Fighting Instructions

desc: For the last century, the Sakya school has held temporal authority over Tibet, acting as spiritual and political stewards under Mongol patronage. Their dominance ushered in an age of centralized governance and scholastic consolidation. Though their rule has waned, their legacy continues to shape our approach to authority and order.
entities.name: Sakya Hegemony

desc: The highland villages of our marquisate have long sustained themselves through skilled craftsmanship, producing goods of quality that find their way into the markets of the plains below. The knowledge of our artisans is passed within families and guilds, ensuring that each generation inherits the ''Alpine Craft Traditions'' intact. This industry sustains the prosperity of our communities and earns our highland towns a reputation for quality that outlasts any political upheaval.
entities.name: The Alpine Crafts

desc: The mountain passes that cross through our lands connect the plains of Italy with the highlands beyond, and we have learned to profit from every traveler and merchant who must pass our gates. Control of the ''Alpine Routes'' gives us a leverage that no army alone can provide, and we use it to sustain friendships on both sides of the mountains. This geography is our greatest inheritance.
entities.name: The Alpine Passages

desc: Our soldiers have been forged in the hard school of mountain warfare, where endurance and discipline matter more than numbers and where every man knows the value of his comrades. The ''Highland Regiments'' of our marquisate have built a reputation for steadiness that makes them sought after even when our state is not at war. This tradition of arms is the shield behind which our people have always stood.
entities.name: The Alpine Regiments

desc: We have fortified the natural strongpoints of our mountains with walls and towers that make our land a nightmare for any invader who seeks to hold it by force. Every valley approach leads to a defended pass, and every pass to a ''Hilltop Citadel'' that must be taken before any advance can continue. Any army that enters our lands uninvited will find the mountains themselves arrayed against them.
entities.name: The Alpine Strongholds

desc: The trails and roads that thread through our mountains are known to us as no outsider can know them, and this knowledge shapes how we move and supply our armies. Our soldiers march along paths that would leave foreign troops exhausted and disoriented, arriving fresh where others would arrive worn. This intimate mastery of the ''Alpine Terrain'' is a form of strength no fortress can replace.
entities.name: The Mountain Routes

desc: Our court has fostered a distinctive literary tradition that weaves together the languages and voices of both sides of the mountains, producing chronicles and verse of surprising richness. The ''Occitan and Italian tongues'' mingle in our writings as they do among our people, creating something that belongs to neither tradition entirely. This chronicle of who we are preserves our identity in letters that outlast stone.
entities.name: The Saluzzo Chronicles

desc: The rulership of women is not always respected — nor even permitted. As such, it is not uncommon for governments to pass laws directly barring women from inheritance, rejecting them in favor of their male siblings or cousins.
entities.name: Salic Law

desc: The Salt monopoly was once our most important revenue source, but previous Emperors abolished it to encourage free trade. It is time to return the Salt trade to state control.
entities.name: Restore the Salt Monopoly

desc: With the increasing demand for gunpowder by our forces, a reliable production of artificial Saltpeter is a necessity.
entities.name: Saltpeter Workshop

desc: Sāmanta — ''neighbor'' — is a term denoting vassals and tributary chiefs alike. It is a feudal system that has for centuries acted as one of the pillars of our society. While this arrangement is currently losing prominence, it remains a foundation of our political structure.
entities.name: Sāmanta Feudalism

desc: Settlements are investing in improved sanitation measures, such as waste disposal and clean water systems. This will reduce the spread of disease, and improve the overall health of the population. The development of modern sanitation practices will make it possible for people to live in closer proximity without succumbing to disease.
entities.name: Sanitation

desc: We have been told that the Sankoré Mosque's school is the greatest center for learning in the entirety of Africa. Who could be surprised if this were true, given how many wise men from distant Arabia and the Maghreb are here right now, arguing the finer points of philosophy and religion?
entities.name: Sankoré Madrasah

desc: Hinduism has spread much farther than its origins in India, and many other cultures and countries have adopted Sanskrit concepts and titles to refer to their own identity. As such, the concepts of Hinduism have seamlessly permeated and blended into foreign beliefs.
entities.name: Sanskritization

desc: The Hall of Three Rarities is our most splendid repository of rare, valuable objects and works of art. Through the generous patronage of our ruler, it has flowered into a venue for academic discussions, lectures, and even cultural events, promoting intellectual exchange and scholarly pursuits.
entities.name: Sānxītáng

desc: The mountain lords of Salona, perched around the ancient site of Delphi and controlling the strategic passes into central Greece, maintain a fierce independence through a combination of rugged terrain, stout fortifications, and a martial tradition that draws fighting men from across the Frankokratia. Even as larger states collapse, the lords of Salona repeatedly defy their enemies, turning their highland fief into a safe refuge of Latin knighthood in Greece and a persistent irritant to every power that seeks to dominate the region between the Corinthian Gulf and the Spercheios valley.
entities.name: Salona's Stance

desc: The soil of Salona is a miserly host, offering little food besides mountain herbs to those who dwell in the shadow of the peaks. Life in this jagged landscape has bred a peasantry and knightly class alike who are famously indifferent to hunger and hardship. Our soldiers require half the rations of a Frankish man-at-arms, possessing a lean, wolf-like endurance that allows them to out-march and out-climb any adversary. In the high passes of Phocis, the belly is light, but the resolve is as unyielding as the mountain itself.
entities.name: The Asceticism of the Crissaean Crags

desc: The 'Wolf-Pacts' have reached their logical conclusion: the Hegemony is the recognized 'Alpha' of the Eastern Mediterranean. We no longer justify aggression. We simply exercise our natural mandate to 'police' the Levant. This projection of power ensures that the Greek seas remain a private lake for the merchants of Salona.
entities.name: The Legacy of the Alpha Protector

desc: In the shifting power dynamics, Salona has moved beyond simple feudal oaths to a predatory legal doctrine known as the 'Wolf-Pacts'. By legally defining our neighbors as 'client-prey' that require Salona's 'alpha' protection to survive, we create a permanent diplomatic justification for intervention and annexation. This predatory diplomacy allows us to absorb smaller lordships and border-fiefs under the guise of 'Defensive Consolidation', ensuring that the Latin presence in the Balkans is led by a single, sharp-toothed power rather than a scattered, vulnerable pack.
entities.name: The Parnassian Wolf-Pacts

desc: Deep within the rugged mountains of our lordship lie veins of metals that have been forgotten since the days of the Delphic Oracle. By bringing in Saxon mining experts and applying Western smelting technology, we have turned the ''Mount of the Muses'' into a center of heavy industry. The wealth extracted from these mines allows the Lords of Salona to maintain a court that rivals the Dukes of Athens in elegance and power.
entities.name: The Parnassus Mines

desc: Wheeled transport is pretty much impossible in most of our domain; thus, we have established a state-run Chancery to nationalize the logistics of the mountains. This allows us to move supply trains at a pace that leaves conventional imperial armies starving in the crags.
entities.name: The Phocian Mule-Chancery

desc: The Sāqiyah is a mechanical device designed to ease the transportation of water to higher elevations. Also known as the ''Persian wheel'', ''tablia'', ''rehat'', and ''tympanum'', the wheel is crucial in the irrigation systems in areas with little to no flowing water.
entities.name: Sāqiyah

desc: A generation of administrators has concluded that our potential has been constrained by outdated laws, uneven taxation, and a literacy gap that leaves too many of our subjects unable to participate in the life of the state. We commit to systematically reforming these institutions — codifying the tax rolls, expanding education, and replacing exemptions with a clearer and fairer legal framework. This administrative modernization increases our revenues and prepares our population for the demands of a transforming world.
entities.name: The Enlightened Reforms

desc: Our foot soldiers have earned a reputation across the battlefields of the age for a tenacity that makes them exceptionally costly to break — they hold ground that others would abandon and press attacks that others would not dare. We formalize this tradition by organizing our infantry into disciplined formations trained in pike and shot, building on the fighting qualities that have always distinguished our men. This military culture produces an army of exceptional morale that serves as the backbone of any campaign we undertake.
entities.name: The Sardinian Infantry

desc: The Sardinian interior, particularly the plains of the Campidano, has developed a world-class horse culture. The ''Sartiglia'' and other equestrian tournaments are not mere games, but displays of extreme horsemanship and military readiness. This culture will provide the state with elite light cavalry units (the ''Cavalleggeris de Sardigna'') who are famous for their speed and ability to navigate the treacherous karst terrain, making them the premier scouts for our armies.
entities.name: The Cavalcadòres

desc: Our island was once divided into four self-governing judgedoms — the ''Giudicati'' — each with its own court, its own laws, and its own traditions of governance built entirely from within. Though that era has passed, the habits of independent administration it instilled run deep in our institutions and our people. This tradition of sovereign self-governance gives our state a legitimacy that is felt by every subject rather than merely proclaimed from above.
entities.name: The Giudicati

desc: Our parliament, the ''Stamenti'', is one of the oldest representative assemblies in the Mediterranean world, dividing legislative counsel among the church, the military nobility, and the royal towns in three distinct chambers. This structure gives every major constituency a recognized voice in how the island is governed, channeling disputes into procedure rather than conflict. This culture of structured representation keeps our merchant and burgher classes invested in the stability of the state.
entities.name: The Stamenti

desc: The foundation of a university in our capital brings the institutions of learning that have long been enjoyed on the mainland to the people of our island. Lawyers, physicians, and administrators trained here no longer need to seek their education abroad, and the talent they represent stays in our service rather than enriching distant courts. This commitment to education raises the literacy and capability of our governing class and prepares our island for the demands of a more complex world.
entities.name: The University of Cagliari

desc: Sardinian culture remains anchored in the ''Ademprivio'' — the right of the people to use feudal lands for grazing, wood-cutting, and water. Despite attempts to privatize land, the Sardinian peasants have maintained their culture of 'Sacred Commons'. This prevents the total impoverishment of the rural classes, and ensures a high level of internal stability, as we recognize that the stability of our lands rests on the shared prosperity of these pastoral communities.
entities.name: The Ademprivio

desc: In the cities and towns, a distinct class of Sardinian artisans and silver-smiths is emerging, blending foreign aesthetics with indigenous motifs. These guilds are fiercely protective of their liberties, often coming into conflict with foreign merchant monopolies. This creates a vibrant urban culture that is both Mediterranean in outlook and Sardinian in soul, providing the state with a literate and skilled middle class that can manage the complexities of maritime trade.
entities.name: The Artizanu

desc: The central mountains (the Barbagia) have remained a 'Land of Barbarians' to every Mediterranean invader for centuries. The culture here is defined by the ''S'Ard'' (Sardinian) identity — a fierce, isolated pastoralism that rejects any form of external taxation or conscription. This has created a cultural redoubt where the ancient Nuragic spirit of independence is preserved. An invading state can master the coastal cities, but the heart of the island will remain a forbidden zone, ensuring the survival of our customs through pure geographical and social defiance.
entities.name: The Barbagia

desc: As a modern national consciousness begins to emerge, our culture is shifting from feudal loyalty to a new 'Patriotism of the Kingdom'. This is expressed through a boom in Sardinian literature and political pamphlets that demand a 'Sardinia for the Sardinians'. This cultural movement provides the state with a new, modernized administrative class that seeks to reform our ancient feudal laws into a modern sovereign constitution.
entities.name: The Hymnu Sardu

desc: With the discovery of new lead and zinc veins, our traditional pastoral culture is beginning to merge with the industrial era. We will establish the first modern mines and foundries, staffed by Sardinian workers who bring their traditional 'Guild Discipline' to the contemporary age. This mining culture will provide us with the raw materials needed for modern warfare and infrastructure, turning the island into the industrial battery of our rising state.
entities.name: The Industrial Transition

desc: To combat the pirate threat, our people will construct a chain of coastal towers. This will give rise to the 'Coastal Vigil', where entire families will move from the shore to the hills while maintaining a permanent rotation of watchers. This culture of 'Horizon Scanning' will turn the entire island population into a strategic state asset, ensuring that the Mediterranean's most vital sea-lanes are constantly monitored by a populace that views defense as a daily ritual.
entities.name: The Turres Costeras

desc: Nestled in the high Alps, We are a mountain people before we anything. Their therrain and the passes crossing them are our inheritance, our livelihood, and the mountains themselves are our protectors. Generations of living inside the Alps have given our people an unmatched understanding of their heights and geography.
entities.name: Savoyard Alpine Identity

desc: The passage over the Alps is troublesome at the best of times, and can be outright impossible with carriages or a larger entourage. By maintaining good pathways, shelters, and waystations, we will be able to dominate the difficult terrain and ensure a steady exchange of merchants throughout our territory.
entities.name: Control Over the Passes

desc: We have embraced the teachings of the Waldensian movement and are dedicated to protecting this faith from the vicious Catholic Church, which seeks to eradicate its ideas.
entities.name: A Light in the Darkness

desc: Our lands have long suffered under the heretical preaching of the Waldensians. By the force of our will and with the support of the divine, we have been able to contain their influence, and we shall continue to defend the one true faith from these dangerous ideas.
entities.name: Stand against Heresy

desc: Savoy has been ruled by a stable line of dynastic counts ever since its creation. By ensuring the unity of our ruling family and maintaining a strong connection to local representatives, we keep our land from being fractured.
entities.name: A Unified House

desc: Many people in our realm leave the alpine valleys they were born into to settle in the urban areas on either side of the mountain range. This depopulation leaves the small villages of lesser valleys in a precarious, politically unstable position. We must ensure that the valley lands are sufficiently populated and can be adequately maintained.
entities.name: Populate Alpine Valleys

desc: Due to our precarious location between greater powers, we must rely on our diplomatic skills for survival. By maintaining diplomatic relations even with our most dangerous foes, we will be able to shift our alliances to ensure the endurance of our country.
entities.name: Savoyard Diplomacy

desc: Our realm is in the possession of a most holy artifact, a piece of cloth that bears the face of Jesus of Nazareth. Naturally, it has attracted numerous pilgrims, all clamoring to see and venerate this extraordinary relic. This constant stream of pilgrimage brings a great deal of wealth into our territory — which is all very much to our advantage.
entities.name: Holy Shroud Pilgrimage

desc: Dresden and Leipzig, among other locales, have gained international recognition for being centers of Saxon Baroque culture. Magnificent architecture, like the Dresdner Hof, epitomize the grandeur of Saxony, while Johann Sebastian Bach's work has transformed Leipzig into a city of music and thriving highbrow culture. The region boasts unique expressions of culture, including handicrafts from the Ore Mountains and culinary traditions like the ''Dresdner Christstollen''.
entities.name: Saxon Baroque

desc: The Saxon Court is a pillar of Electoral Saxony's government, alongside civil and military administration. Court regulations define the responsibilities and daily routines of officials, while the court itself is composed of both nobles and peasants serving the ruling family in governance and administration. Traditionally, each adult member of the ruling family maintained their own household court, but we will now create a single, permanent court in our capital, attracting the finest minds in the realm.
entities.name: The Saxon Court

desc: The ''Defensioner'' are veteran troops from the rough lands on the Bohemian border. Tasked with securing the passes in the Ore Mountains, these units will serve us well in battles on rough terrain.
entities.name: Saxon Defensioner

desc: Saxony's successful early industrialization is evident, with a highly developed industrial sector compared to other regions. The manufactory system, producing mainly for export, has flourished and will make Saxony a leading state in Germany's industrialization process. The emergence of smaller commercial landscapes and trade will be instrumental in promoting the region's economic growth and connections to other markets in Europe.
entities.name: Saxon Industrialization

desc: Ōshū Province is our second home and where our clan originated. We must make use of our ties to Ōshū to procure some of the strong war horses native to that region.
entities.name: Ōshū Ties

desc: We have been made ''Shugo'' of multiple provinces. Administering all this land will make us rich from revenue generated by our fertile rice paddies and the workshops of the region's most skilled artisans.
entities.name: Multiple Shugo

desc: We have talented, but ambitious vassals in our clan. They are a frequent cause of familial friction, and we would be wise to rein them in. Then again, close supervision and lavish, yet strategic rewards could turn these powerful families into the greatest assets of our rule.
entities.name: Shiba Retainers

desc: Though the Kalmar Union dissolved in conflict, it established a precedent for shared Nordic sovereignty. Drawing upon this legacy, we reaffirm our authority and remind our subjects that unity brings strength, not subjugation.
entities.name: Legacy of the Kalmar Union

desc: Control over the Øresund grants us the right to impose the Sound Toll on all foreign ships passing through the Danish straits. This ancient privilege turns geographic advantage into tangible wealth, strengthening our dominance over northern trade.
entities.name: The Sound Toll

desc: The union of Denmark, Norway, Sweden, and Finland under one crown has turned the North from a battleground of competing kings into a centralized power. With unified administration and increased cooperation among the estates, we can assert stronger control over the realm.
entities.name: Unified Scandinavia

desc: Verona's amphitheater is one of the finest surviving Roman monuments in Italy, and we have made it the stage for the greatest public ''Spettacoli'' in the north — bullfights, pageants, and civic competitions that draw crowds from Venice and the ''Terraferma'' for days at a time. No other city can offer this scale of spectacle inside ancient Roman stone, and the tradition has become inseparable from how Verona understands itself, a republic that still performs its identity before thousands of witnesses in a space built two thousand years ago. This reputation for public magnificence spreads our name across northern Italy and draws visitors whose spending and whose letters home do more for our standing than any envoy we could send.
entities.name: Spettacoli dell'Arena

desc: ] as a mining community (bergslag), granting it collective rights over local ore extraction, its own court, and freedom from military conscription. The Commoners of the mines hold a stronger legal standing than in ordinary towns.
entities.name: Bergslagsprivilegier

desc: ] has been granted exclusive rights over nearby fishing grounds and the trade in dried and salted fish. Norwegian coastal towns organized around these privileges supplied Fish across Northern Europe.
entities.name: Fiskeriprivilegier

desc: ] has been granted rights to harvest and export Tar and Naval Supplies from Crown forests. These forest industries are the backbone of Baltic shipbuilding supply chains.
entities.name: Tjärprivilegier

desc: ] has been granted formal assembly rights (tingsrätt), giving its inhabitants a recognized legal forum for governance and justice. Royal authority is curtailed in exchange for a more orderly and loyal population.
entities.name: Tingsrätt

desc: Shortcomings due to overconfidence and arrogance can lead to great failures and defeats. Defeat is a teacher, if we are willing to learn. We will purge our army of its complacency, noble birth alone will no longer open the officer ranks, and every soldier must understand not just his orders, but the purpose behind them.
entities.name: Scharnhorst Reforms

desc: Based on Aristotelian logic and the writings of the early Christian Fathers, scholasticism aims to spread knowledge by emphasizing religious dogmatic beliefs and traditions.
entities.name: Classic Scholasticism

desc: The Catechetical School of Alexandria, allegedly founded by the Apostle Mark himself, is the oldest school of catechism in the world. There, biblical and theological studies have been taught since the start of Christianity itself. Although the school itself was destroyed when the Bishop of Rome was declared to be above the Patriarch of Alexandria, its tradition has endured.
entities.name: School of Alexandria

desc: Islam tradition has always emphasized the pursuit of knowledge and education. From schools of jurisprudence and theology to the great libraries and institutions of learning established by various rulers, Muslim scholarship has earned admiration throughout the Muslim world and well beyond.
entities.name: Schools of Thought

desc: Things happen for a reason. By understanding the explanation behind everything, we can learn what to expect when similar situations arise.
entities.name: Scientific Experimentation

desc: Recent improvements in the sciences of geography and cartography have allowed for more accurate depictions of land masses and natural features, both in terms of their relative sizes and their exact positions.
entities.name: Cartographic Mapping

desc: Recent developments in mathematics, physics, astronomy, biology and chemistry have not only challenged, but completely changed our view of the world around us. Society is progressing at a greater speed than ever before, and more scientific breakthroughs are made every day.
entities.name: Scientific Revolution

desc: For centuries, we relied on diplomacy and contact with foreign powers on the continent to ensure our independence. It is time to formalize this practice, and secure the endurance of our bonds for centuries to come.
entities.name: Reliable Alliance

desc: Having sent our brightest scholars to be educated in foreign universities for many years, it is time to improve our domestic education, and provide a place here in Scotland where the greatest minds of our nation can learn and grow. Our people should strive to acquire valuable knowledge and skills in their home country rather than wasting their money on expensive travel and their time on foreign institutions.
entities.name: Scottish Universities

desc: Rapid advancements in philosophy, political economy, and medicine have led to a plethora of accomplishments by our fellow countrymen that will propel Scotland to the forefront of global innovation. This period of Scottish Enlightenment can be a very powerful tool for us on the world stage.
entities.name: Scottish Enlightenment

desc: The clans of the Highlands have always moved and fought differently from lowland armies. Raised among the glens, lochs, and steep braes of the north, our clansmen are naturally comfortable engaging in terrain that would exhaust and disorient outsiders. This intimate knowledge of the local landscape is passed down from father to son, and no foreign conqueror has ever truly mastered it.
entities.name: Highland Tradition

desc: Recruiting regiments from the people who live in the Scottish Highlands can be a crucial measure for our military efforts.
entities.name: Establish Highlander Regiments

desc: Now that our ties to England have been strengthened, we shall incorporate some of their military tactics, refining our units into fearsome forces.
entities.name: English-Scottish Longbowmen

desc: Since the start of our war against English tyranny, we have preserved our independence through the valiant efforts of the courageous Scottish people. The memory of brave men like William Wallace will motivate our armies to defend and protect Scottish independence for all time!
entities.name: Scottish Courage

desc: Our rivers and coastlines are rich in salmon. With careful attention and strict legislation, we will be able to harness this resource and shape our local economy towards export of this highly sought-after fish.
entities.name: Scottish Salmon Conservation

desc: War can be a long and tiring affair. If we are to defend our independence, we need to be prepared to endure hard times. Luckily, our people are as tenacious as the land they call their home, and resist foreign invaders to their last breaths.
entities.name: Tenacious Land

desc: Our country is situated at the far edge of Western Europe and is sparse in resources. If we are to thrive economically, we need to invest and expand our trade connections to further regions. The North Sea can connect us to rich markets and business opportunities, provided we learn to harness its potential.
entities.name: North Sea Trade Connections

desc: While distilleries have existed in Scotland for a long time, we should ensure these industries are finally put under the purview of the state. This supervision will allow us to establish ourselves at the forefront of liquor production, and expand our exports industry.
entities.name: Scotch Whisky

desc: The famed Turkish privateer Hayreddin Barbarossa fought many legendary encounters against the Knights, but he was hardly the only corsair we have encountered. Turkish raiding and looting of all of Southern Europe, tolerated by the Barbary states and funded by the Turks, must end. The Knights will do their job protecting innocent sailors at any cost.
entities.name: Scourge of the Corsairs

desc: A specialized center where scribes meticulously copy manuscripts, the Scriptorium produces a variety of texts of religious, legal or even literary nature, in an effort to preserve and disseminate knowledge.
entities.name: Scriptorium

desc: Allows us to focus heavily on military advancements, and thereby increase our Naval Tradition.
entities.name: Seahawks

desc: In troubled times, we must learn to endure life, and life is synonymous with nature. The change of seasons necessitates a change in our lifestyles; villages must be adaptable and mobile.
entities.name: Seasonal Economy

desc: The Russian people need firm religious guidance. We have historically cooperated well with the Church, and expanding this relationship would benefit us all. If we can move the seat of the Metropolitan Bishop to Moscow, we will be able to strengthen the bonds between our faith and our state.
entities.name: Seat of the Metropolitan Bishop

desc: The Second Council of Ephesus, convened in 449 at the instance of Pope Dioscorus of Alexandria, was a legitimate Christian council despite its denunciation by the Catholic and Orthodox Churches. At this council, the formula of Cyril of Alexandria — which states that Christ is a single incarnate nature, both human and divine — was officially accepted.
entities.name: Second Council of Ephesus

desc: We will need to revive and refine the philosophical movement of medieval scholasticism.
entities.name: Second Classic Scholasticism

desc: The monarch has always had a secretary responsible for their royal correspondence. This position eventually evolved into that of the Secretary of State, a powerful minister who not only transmits royal decrees, but also has a high level of administrative authority.
entities.name: Secretaries of State

desc: Our ports across the Mediterranean Sea are some of the most affluent in the entire region. Merchants from every corner of the known world travel to Alexandria and Cairo to deal in spices, Silk, and precious stones. The creation of a merchant navy to facilitate and protect our maritime avenues would therefore be a wise idea.
entities.name: Secure Mediterranean Ports

desc: To embrace the future, we must remember what we learned from Persia and the Great Seljuks, and build a state that can unite disparate peoples and beliefs into a greater whole.
entities.name: Seljuk Heritage

desc: We are surrounded by enemies on all sides, making a strong military an absolute necessity. Fortunately, we are not weak people. From the irregular Ġuzāt and the Akıncılar raiders to the Sipâhi of the Ottomans, the world has come to fear and respect our military might. Let us build an army worthy of an empire, inspired by our glorious traditions and history, honing our might through the ages.
entities.name: Seljuk Roots

desc: By the right of the Salic Law, only men are allowed to inherit the throne. This practice leads to a succession crisis in cases where the male bloodline dies out, and the monarchy gets thrown into chaos. In order to avoid such disturbances, the rights of women shall be expanded to include eligibility to rule the nation, should no suitable male heir exist.
entities.name: Semi-Salic Law

desc: New lands mean new opportunities — and new resources to exploit. By encouraging our population to settle abroad and take advantage of these abundant resources, we will reap enormous benefits.
entities.name: New Lands of Plenty

desc: A whole new world lies open before us, and that means our people are dreaming about what their lives could be in these distant lands. We should encourage these thoughts, embellishing stories of gold and glory to be found in the unexplored territories, so that our people will be eager to settle these new lands for us.
entities.name: New Lands of Opportunity

desc: Having been practiced all over South East Asia for a long time since its adaptation from the ancient Chinese ''Cùjū'', and also known as ''Sepak Raga'', ''Takraw'', ''Chinlone'', or ''Sipa'' depending on the country, ''Sepak Takraw'' is not just a game. Although the objective is to kick a ball between players and keep it in the air, it is also a way to have regular physical exercise, and thus played not only for entertainment but as military training for the army.
entities.name: Sepak Takraw

desc:
An incendiary, anonymous treatise on political theory has emerged. Despite efforts to suppress the text, it is spreading quickly across the world. It analyzes the nature of various forms of government, be they monarchies, despotisms, or democracies, and argues for a strict separation of the executive, legislative, and judiciary branches.

This separation would protect the people and limit monarchical, which is understandably a very popular prospect for many of our subjects. Despite the unfortunate implications for the ruler's authority, these ideas may well benefit our nation greatly.
entities.name: Separation of Powers

desc: Our Old Testament is encoded in Greek, using the version known as the Septuagint, which is a translation from Hebrew done in the 3rd century BC. It was written by seventy-two isolated translators, who all came up with the exact same translations independently. It is thus definitely divinely inspired, and the direct word of God.
entities.name: Septuagint

desc: Drawing from the hard-won experience of our veteran units of the previous decades, we have established a permanent, professional standing National Militia. This force represents a decisive move away from the disorganized peasant levy, utilizing rigorous Western drill, uniform equipment, and a modernized chain of command while retaining the fierce, high-morale fighting style of our Balkan predecessors. This ensures that our independence is not a fragile diplomatic gift, but is instead backed by a credible, modern military machine that can defend our borders against any encroaching imperial power.
entities.name: Serbian National Militia

desc: The Serbian peasantry has led its own cultural-economic revolution by adopting agrarian techniques learned from the West. This has turned the dense forests of Šumadija into a highly productive agricultural heartland. This surplus of food does not just feed the people; it fuels a demographic explosion. A well-fed Serbian population is a growing and ambitious one, providing a massive pool of young, healthy recruits for the army and a robust internal market that makes Serbia the dominant economic engine of the Central Balkans.
entities.name: The Šumadija Agrarian Revolution

desc: In an era of conflict, the Serbian people turns to the pen to preserve what the sword can not. The ''Resava School'' of orthography will standardize the Serbian-Slavonic language, creating a cultural 'republic of letters'. This obsession with linguistic purity and the preservation of chronicles will ensure that Serbian history is never lost to the fog of war. It creates a highly literate elite who acts as the memory of the nation, keeping the records of our dynasties alive in every monastery scriptorium from the Danube to the Adriatic.
entities.name: The Transcribers of Resava

desc: We will encourage ''Viteštvo'', a unique Serbian chivalric code, that will blend the heavy-armored traditions of the West with the stoic warrior-ethos of the East. This culture of knighthood will not be restricted to the highest nobility but trickle down into the lower classes of free soldiers. It will emphasize personal bravery, loyalty to the True Faith, and a specialized mastery of both the lance and the saber. This military culture will produce a population that is naturally predisposed to warfare, viewing military service as the highest form of social and spiritual achievement.
entities.name: Viteštvo

desc: Inspired by other nations of the Enlightenment, our national heroes, such as Dositej Obradović, have sought to elevate our vernacular language and literature. Touched by the dearth of secular works accessible to the common folk, Dositej Obradović has taken the lead in bridging the gap between written and spoken Shtokavian. By diligently crafting grammar books and dictionaries, authoring new tomes, and translating foreign works, our nation is fostering a literary revival thanks to the work of these visionaries.
entities.name: Serbian Enlightenment

desc: The deliberate invitation of ''Sasi'' miners from Upper Saxony and the Harz Mountains has fundamentally transformed our primitive surface pits into sophisticated industrial engines. By granting these Germanic experts their own autonomous courts, the right to follow their own mining codes, and religious freedom, we have successfully unlocked the vast, deep-seated silver and gold veins of Brskovo and Novo Brdo. This influx of technical expertise provide us with the immense quantities of hard bullion necessary to hire the finest Western mercenaries, build monumental stone endowments, and mint the high-quality silver ''Matapan'' imitations that have come to dominate Balkan trade and Mediterranean commerce.
entities.name: The Saxon Mining Privileges

desc: The Serbian people have mastered the art of 'mobile identity'. This is characterized by the ability to move entire communities to new lands without losing cultural cohesion. This cultural mobility ensures that the 'Serbian Hearth' is not a fixed geographic point, but a portable and indestructible social contract; wherever the Serbian community strikes its staff, the old laws and the traditions of the ''Slava'' are immediately re-established. This resilience makes the Serbian culture functionally impossible to decapitate, as the nation can abandon scorched valleys only to reappear as a fully formed, military society on a new frontier, waiting for the opportune moment to strike back at the heart of their ancestral lands.
entities.name: Seobe

desc: Serbian people have developed a 'living history' through epic poetry. The ''Guslar'' — a wandering bard — is the primary guardian of the national soul. The ''Guslar'' recites thousands of verses accompanied by the ''gusle''. These songs preserve genealogies, legal precedents, and moral imperatives. Serbian culture ensures that even the most illiterate shepherd has an understanding of ancestral rights and a shared identity. Every village gathering becomes a session of historical indoctrination.
entities.name: Serbian Epic Poetry

desc: The cultural foundation of the Serbian people is defined by Saint Sava. By blending Byzantine spirituality with local Slavic customs and a fierce commitment to the Serbian language in liturgy, Sava created a national church that is inseparable from the people's identity. This cultural anchor resurfaces again among our people and ensures that all Serbians, whether nobles or peasants, view themselves as part of a distinct, sacred community that remains unified even when political borders shift or collapse, providing an internal stability that resists foreign cultural assimilation.
entities.name: The Icon of Saint Sava

desc: The Serbian elite and commoners alike are bound by the tradition of the ''Zadužbina'' — the 'endowment for the soul'. This cultural drive to build stone churches and monasteries creates a permanent, physical landscape of Serbian presence across the Balkans. These buildings serve as more than religious centers; they are repositories of history, art, and literacy that define the Serbian 'living space'. This architectural obsession ensures that the Serbian culture is physically anchored to the land, providing a sense of permanence and historical continuity that inspires the people to defend their 'holy ground' at any cost.
entities.name: Zadužbina

desc: Held after the harvest, the ''Sérén Taun'' festival is an annual thanksgiving ceremony celebrating agricultural abundance. Marked by rituals, offerings, and music, it strengthens the communal bonds of our ''kampung-kampung'' and reminds all of the sacred balance between people, rice, and nature.
entities.name: Sérén Taun

desc: Being a foot soldier in the army is not exactly a dream career, what with the poor food, low pay, and virtually nonexistent medical services. Therefore, recruitment attempts are often a fruitless affair. If we were to tie our peasantry to the land, however, we would always know exactly where to find recruits.
entities.name: Serfs

desc: Being a cog in this heavenly machine is a great honor; our people find deep purpose in serving God's will. This belief that we collectively serve divine purpose makes the heart of our people beat with thunderous acclaim.
entities.name: Servants of God

desc: We are surrounded by weakly defended territories ripe for the taking! Let us send out some adventurous courtiers to enforce our authority in these unclaimed lands.
entities.name: Call of the Frontier

desc: Across the scattered isles of our homeland lie countless shores awaiting our touch. By strengthening our presence among these islands, we secure the wealth of our people: new trade posts, new harvests, and new communities bound by the waves that unite us.
entities.name: Settle the Islands

desc: The unification of the Jurchen tribes is but the first step in our ambitious rise to power. Soon, our name will strike fear and awe across the entire continent.
entities.name: Shadow of Ambition

desc: To manage the vast tide of merchants arriving at our ports, we appoint a Shāhbandar as the authority to oversee customs, resolve disputes, and organize the foreign quarters. This office brings order to our bustling entrepôt and will strengthen our role as the crossroads of the seas.
entities.name: The Shāhbandar System

desc: United in the teachings of the Great Law of Peace, our people maintain a strong sense of brotherhood and unity, despite their disparate tribal background.
entities.name: Shared Brotherhood

desc: Innovation can come in many forms and if we want to stay ahead of rival tribes, we will need to explore every advantage we can get.
entities.name: Shared Knowledge

desc: The world has become smaller, and we have encountered a plethora of new peoples and undiscovered territory. Along with these discoveries, we have also come into contact with many new products and ways of utilizing them. Even the most specialized goods, like Alum, can be used in other ways in other places.
entities.name: Shared Products and Procedures

desc: The Holy Law that the Prophet followed when ruling Madīna should be the unshakable foundation of the laws we use to run our society. By reforming our criminal code to reflect the teachings of the Prophet, we will bring harmony and justice to our people.
entities.name: Sharī'ah

desc: It is an unfortunate fact that ships tend to be damaged during battle, and equally unfortunate that the damage can rarely be repaired at sea. To alleviate this problem, we will create a system of sheltered ports along our coastline where our ships can patch themselves up.
entities.name: Sheltered Ports

desc: Since Buddhism came to Japan, its teachings have coexisted with the worship of local ''Kami''. This has led to them both blending into a single combined set of beliefs, albeit with distinct ritualistic practices.
entities.name: Shinbutsu-Shūgō

desc: The seas hold many adventures, much wealth, and commercial — as well as expansionist — opportunities.
entities.name: Shipbuilding

desc: The development of the wet dock, or floating dock, will allow our shipwrights to construct ships much faster than before.
entities.name: Wet Dock

desc: New building techniques for our ships will help us produce them faster.
entities.name: Improved Shipbuilding

desc: Ships are expensive to build and maintain. By imposing a ship's penny — a small tax levied on trade or port activities — we can ensure our fleet remains strong without draining our treasury.
entities.name: Ship's Penny

desc: The Shipyard expands the capabilities of our port to new heights, increasing the number of vessels that can be serviced and built while also augmenting the amenities for the crew of those ships.
entities.name: Shipyard

desc: Our ancestral founder came from Širâz, son of the 'Amīr of Persia, which makes our right to rule undeniable.
entities.name: Shirazi's Legacy

desc: As a prominent samurai family from Northern Kyūshū, we have bravely fought against both Mongol invasions. Should the need arise, we will once again rise to defend both Kyūshū and the realm at large from outside invaders.
entities.name: Defender of Japan

desc: Thanks to our presence in Tsushima, we have a wealth of experience in negotiating with Korea. This way, we have always been able to keep a channel open to the outside world, even during times when official relations were forbidden.
entities.name: Diplomacy Through Tsushima

desc: As the name of our clan shows, we come from the appointed vice minister of the Dazaifu in Chikuzen province. This institution has since antiquity been the diplomatic and military center of the region, and we traditionally govern Northern Kyūshū as representative of the Emperor.
entities.name: Vice-Minister of Dazaifu

desc: Allows us to make use of more refined trading practices, giving our merchants the upper hand over our competitors.
entities.name: Shrewd Commerce

desc: The most revered and prestigious amongst all those who inhabit the Muslim world, there are not many who can proclaim themselves descendants of the Great Prophet. We, of course, are among these blessed few.
entities.name: Shurfā' Status

desc: It is not uncommon for our greatest poems to dedicate lines of text to list and honor our war elephants individually. Let us show our enemies why!
entities.name: Advanced Elephant Warfare

desc: A decentralized system may cause us to lose control over our more distant provinces. If we are to be the true unifying realm for the Thai people, our provinces must be unified as well.
entities.name: Consolidation of the State

desc: As our Lord Buddha said, we shall not accept something because it is often said, but we need to experience it ourselves. Education is the basis of knowledge, and if we want to excel at technology, we need to excel at education first.
entities.name: Education Reforms

desc: We have extensive political experience. The birth of our country was something achieved not only with the power of our military, after all. Surely our diplomatic reputation will prove to be a source of our influence on the world stage.
entities.name: Experienced Ambassadors

desc: There are many parts of our country with very low population. We should improve conditions in these regions to ensure that no part of our country is seen as lackluster, and all of it shines equally.
entities.name: Rise to Equal Heights

desc: Second only to Heaven — that is what a ruler should be. Honored and worshipped, our leaders rule over the Earth as the Gods rule over Heaven.
entities.name: Royal Absolutism

desc: We are undoubtedly the leaders of all Thai people. Our troops are proud to serve as defenders of our culture and identity itself, and they fight fiercely for the privilege.
entities.name: Thai Unity

desc: The distant wastes of Siberia call to us. We must clear a path to its frozen heart, and let our Cossacks go forth and claim land for the Russian people.
entities.name: Siberian Frontier

desc: Emperor Frederick II, the Hohenstaufen King of Sicily, drafted a legal code for Sicily known as the Constitutions of Melfi, or ''Liber Augustalis''. Still in use centuries later, it represents a solid foundation for the governance of our state, regulating public law, judicial procedure, and feudal, private, and penal law.
entities.name: Constitutions of Melfi

desc: To maximize agricultural output and tax revenue, the state granted ''Licenses to Populate'' to the nobility. This will allow lords to build brand-new towns in the desolate interior of the island, attracting peasants with promises of land and lower taxes. This internal colonization effort will transform the Sicilian landscape, turning wild hinterlands into a patchwork of profitable agricultural communities.
entities.name: Licentia Populandi

desc: Constant raids from Barbary pirates and Ottoman ships have forced Sicily to maintain a vigilant coastal defense. Its galleys and forts became critical for protecting southern Europe.
entities.name: Naval Vigilance

desc: Our island trembles often, causing many buildings to collapse. In order to replace these old structures, the state will orchestrate one of the most ambitious rebuilding programs in human history. Rather than simply repairing old ruins, the government will redesign entire cities using the theatrical, earthquake-resistant ''Sicilian Baroque'' style. This will demonstrate the state's incredible ability to mobilize labor and capital in the face of total disaster.
entities.name: Sicilian Baroque

desc: Though distant from the great salons of Paris or Wien, Sicily has fostered its own Enlightenment. Intellectuals challenged feudal privileges, promoted science, and advocated legal reforms, building a tradition of critical inquiry that navigated the tensions between faith and reason. These ideas laid the groundwork for modernity in the shadow of monarchy and tradition.
entities.name: Sicilian Enlightenment

desc: As time passes, our institutions become obsolete or just inefficient. Reforms are necessary if we want our nation to prosper and thrive. Our best minds will work hard to ensure that no waste happens, and that our processes are as efficient as possible.
entities.name: Sicilian Reforms

desc: In the time of Frederick II, Silk was Sicily's major export. Although our Silk industry has declined in the intervening centuries, Sicily's productions having been outstripped by that of the northern Italian states, there is no reason why it should not rise again. By investing in our Silk production, we can see our weavers and craftsmen flourish anew.
entities.name: Sicilian Silk

desc: Founded by King Alfonso V of Aragon, the University of Catania was the oldest in Sicily and one of the few southern institutions granted full ''Studium Generale'' status. Unique for its royal charter and blend of scholastic and legal education, it produced jurists, theologians, and scientists who served both Church and Crown in a culturally diverse region.
entities.name: Studium Generale

desc: We will create this specialized court to manage the royal properties and the ''Secretias'' (customs offices). By professionalizing the collection of export duties on silk, tuna, and grain, the state will significantly reduce corruption and 'leakage' to local barons. This administrative rigor will turn our lands into the most reliable revenue stream for the Crown, funding our wars across Italy and the Mediterranean.
entities.name: The Court of the Royal Patrimony

desc: Thanks to foreign investors, Sicilian wine will be transformed from a local peasant drink into a fortified luxury good that can survive long sea voyages. The culture of the 'Vineyard Estate' (the ''Baglio'') will be the new symbol of Sicilian wealth and sophistication. It links the island's ancient agricultural traditions to the modern, industrial world of global commerce.
entities.name: The Marsala Wine Industry

desc: The religious identity of Sicily has for a long time been tied to powerful female patron saints, who are believed to protect cities from plague and lava. The massive, theatrical processions (like the ''Festino of Palermo'') associated with their worship serve as a release valve for social tension, and as a display of communal unity. These rituals are the heartbeat of Sicilian public life, reinforcing social cohesion.
entities.name: The Cult of the Santuzze

desc: This institution looked after the welfare of ordinary enlisted seamen in the Navy. It brought about a series of reforms that greatly improved the health of sailors on duty.
entities.name: The Sick and Hurt Board

desc: The art of painting has flourished in Italy since the beginning of the Renaissance, but no artists can match the elegance of those trained in Siena, where the ''Studium Senese'' — one of the oldest universities in Europe — ensures that painters and scholars alike are nurtured by the same tradition of civic patronage. Sienese art is otherworldly and refined, with a heavy focus on the miracles performed by Biblical figures and Saints. This unity of learning and artistry defines the Sienese school, securing its reputation for centuries to come.
entities.name: Sienese School of Painting

desc: Even as the grand ambitions of the Sienese republic gave way to foreign pressure and Tuscan consolidation, the citizens of Siena maintained a fierce pride in their distinct identity — their dialect, their art, their tradition of communal self-governance — that made the city difficult to absorb without provocation. Those who sought to antagonize or diminish Siena found its people stubborn in their resistance, bound together by centuries of shared memory and an insistence that Sienese life meant something worth defending. This deep-rooted civic spirit discourages aggression against us and sustains the prosperity that flows from a population genuinely invested in the wellbeing of the city they call home.
entities.name: Sienese Civic Pride

desc: The Nine Priors of our republic — drawn exclusively from the merchant guilds of Siena and barred to the high nobility whose factional rivalries brought every previous government to ruin — have shaped the city's governance with an administrative diligence that our more aristocratic neighbors cannot match. Their terms are brief and their accountability public, making sustained corruption harder to conceal and factional manipulation harder to dress in the language of civic virtue. This tradition of merchant governance gives our institutions a practical competence and a legitimacy grounded in commerce and consent rather than an accident of birth.
entities.name: The Council of Priori

desc: Our magistrates have established the ''Monte dei Paschi'' — a public lending institution secured against the revenues of the Maremma pastures — to provide affordable credit to merchants and the poor alike and to give Siena a stable foundation for commerce in an era of expanding trade. This innovation in public finance became a model of banking stability that outlasted empires, sustaining our commercial life through crises that bankrupted more reckless rivals. This institution accelerates the adoption of new economic practices across our lands while generating the steady fiscal revenue that a city of ambition requires.
entities.name: Monte dei Paschi

desc: Caterina di Giacomo di Benincasa — mystic, theologian, and doctor of the faith — remains the most celebrated soul that Siena has ever produced, and in the age of religious upheaval that followed the great disputes of the era her memory became a rallying point for a confident, devotional faith that answered challenge with piety rather than polemic. Sienese scholars and preachers placed themselves at the forefront of this spiritual renewal, drawing on the saint's writings to argue that reform must begin in the heart before it reaches the law. This legacy of sanctity and conviction deepens the faith of our people and draws together communities that might otherwise fracture under the pressures of religious conflict.
entities.name: Santa Caterina's Legacy

desc: Twice each year the contrade of Siena compete in the ''Palio'' — a bareback horse race around the Piazza del Campo that is as much a civic ritual as a contest, binding the neighborhoods of the city in a shared drama of rivalry, identity, and fierce communal pride. The elaborate pageantry of the event draws visitors from across Italy and broadcasts Sienese cultural vitality to all who witness it, reinforcing our reputation as a city that has not forgotten how to celebrate itself. This enduring tradition amplifies our influence across the region and wins us the admiration of courts that see in Siena a living testament to the power of civic culture.
entities.name: The Palio of Siena

desc: Artillery has become so central to modern warfare that specialized officers trained in gunnery techniques and tactical deployment are now essential on the battlefield.
entities.name: Artillery Officers

desc: The most important aspect of veneration is the faithful be reminded of great works, miracles, and figures through their natural sense. As such, our churches are adorned with vibrant images and colors, ringing with music and sweetly scented with our holy incense, so that the presence of Christ on Earth can be immediately felt by all inside.
entities.name: Icon Veneration

desc: Be it the land route crossing the Gobi Desert and Persia, or its ocean counterpart through the Indian Ocean and Indonesia, the lands of Asia have been for centuries traversed by merchants seeking profit on the famous Silk Road.
entities.name: Silk Road

desc: It is undeniable the effect that the Silk Road has had on the spread of Buddhism. Whether via land or sea, trade has allowed Buddhism to spread far from its origins in India.
entities.name: Silk Road Transmission

desc: By turning most obligations towards the central government - from poll taxes to the labor obligations of the peasants or the tributes of local officials - into a single silver payment, the amount of which is based on the population and cultivated land in each prefecture, tax collection will become easier and our income will increase.
entities.name: Silver Standard

desc: We must ensure that our captains meet the highest standards of seamanship and nautical knowledge, ensuring that they will be able to use every advantage in all situations.
entities.name: Skilled Captains

desc: From the time of our ancestors, horsemen have been the agents of our conquests. The thunder of their hooves ringing across the grasslands of the Sahel spread fear in our enemies, and have brought us many victories.
entities.name: Cavalry Raids

desc: By encouraging the spread of literacy and scholarship among men and women alike, we can advance our society and further our hold over our lands. The family of our rulers must have a special place in these efforts, serving as an ideal to emulate.
entities.name: Learned Scholars

desc: For too long the people of Western Africa have labored under rulers that, while professing to be righteous, indulged in syncretism. No more! Our flag shall always fly above that of worldly kingdoms!
entities.name: Expansion of Sokoto

desc: Our lands are home to many people of different cultures and languages. We must emphasize our faith as the unifying force, joining all people under one banner.
entities.name: Unification in Faith

desc: The Fulbe people are distinguished warriors, serving as leaders in all corners of Western Africa. We should establish ourselves as a permanent employer for their most capable commanders.
entities.name: Recruit Fulbe Commanders

desc: Everyone who is ready to serve under our righteous leaders must be welcome, regardless of their heritage.
entities.name: Recruit the Faithful

desc: Instead of displaying the worldly pomp of our rule, our court should focus on spiritual matters. By inviting learned religious figures to teach in our capital, we can show our true commitment to our faith.
entities.name: Most Religious Court

desc: An agricultural technique that involves strategically cutting and burning the vegetation to obtain a nutrient-rich layer of ash that fertilizes underlying soil, making it excellent land for planting crops. We have learned that the land becomes stronger after this method, as a bone becomes stronger after being broken.
entities.name: Slash and Burn Agriculture

desc: Properly managing bonded labor within our realm is imperative to the continued affluence of our people.
entities.name: Slave Center

desc: Our country has a long tradition of raiding the coastlines for slaves, money, and all the other necessary things in life.
entities.name: Coastal Raiding

desc: Slaves are the cornerstone of our economy. Attacking and raiding our neighbors to capture their population and enslave them is therefore the lifeblood of our country.
entities.name: Slave Raiding Wars

desc: To ensure a loyal corps of well-trained standing troops, we will employ disciplined slave soldiers from within our society.
entities.name: Slave Soldiers

desc: The flow of workers to and from our colonies is a lucrative and sensitive affair. As such, we must invest in our legislative attempts to refine it.
entities.name: Slave Trade Act

desc: Razing and the destruction of cities are part of warfare. In the past, our warriors would go on a rampage, destroying and looting every item they could find, and killing those who stood in their way. While it strengthened their morale, their actions were far from economical. With this new approach, we can ensure to at least enslave those capable of work instead of blindly beheading them for the skull throne.
entities.name: Slavery Before Death

desc: These are a new type of watermills developed for slitting bars of Iron into rods. This allows for more efficient development of Iron tools and machinery, as it allows casters to use rods that more appropriate for their needs compared to bigger bars, wasting less byproduct in the forging process.
entities.name: Slitting Mills

desc: The discovery of massive iron ore deposits and the rapid advancement of steam technology have led to the birth of the first modern industrial zones in the Hron and Váh river valleys. The state must heavily subsidize the creation of iron-works and textile factories to reduce our dependency on foreign imports. This drive for industrial sovereignty will transform the traditional agricultural landscape into a manufacturing powerhouse, providing us with the tools to compete with the other powers. The concentration of labor in these new industrial hubs will begin to shift the social dynamics of the region, creating an urban working class that will become a new political force in the century to follow.
entities.name: The Hron Valley Industries

desc: Recognizing the immense strategic and financial value of the northern territories, King Charles Robert of Anjou bypassed the unruly local barons by granting special 'Royal Free Town' status to the primary mining centers, such as Banská Štiavnica and Kremnica. These settlements were removed from the jurisdiction of local lords and placed directly under the ''Tavernicus'' (the royal treasurer), creating a direct financial link between the mountain mines and the throne. This legal framework has fostered a loyal, urbanized tax base and a German-Slavic merchant class that has operated independently of feudal land-rights. This administrative shift has ensured that our nation has a reliable source of liquid capital, funding the central government's efforts to stabilize the realm and professionalize the royal bureaucracy.
entities.name: The Law of the Seven Towns

desc: Our mountains are full of ore, so the state will formalize the central management of the 'Seven Towns' through the ''Bergkammer'' (Mining Chamber) in Banská Štiavnica. By appointing a royal ''Berghauptmann'' (Mining Captain), the government will seize direct control over the extraction and smelting of silver and gold, stripping local feudal lords of their ancient mineral rights. This professionalization of the industry will allow for the implementation of advanced drainage technologies and deeper shaft mining, ensuring a constant flow of bullion to the royal mints. This financial engine will provide us with the liquid capital necessary to fulfill our needs, making the Slovak Ore Mountains indispensable to us.
entities.name: The Mining Captancy

desc: Faced with threats from all sides, we will establish a formalized military border along the Danube and the Carpathian foothills. We will empower the ''Zeman'' — the lower, land-owning Slavic nobility — to act as a permanent, hereditary frontier guard. These warriors live in ''Curias'' (fortified manor houses) and are exempt from certain taxes in exchange for their constant readiness to mobilize. This will create a resilient social class of warrior-farmers who are intimately familiar with the local terrain, providing the state with a cost-effective and highly motivated defensive screen that will be able to absorb the shock of foreign invasions before they reach the heart of the realm.
entities.name: The Slovak Castle System

desc: For decades, the cultural figure of the ''Zbojník'' (Highland Outlaw), epitomized by Juraj Jánošík, has become a military ideal in the minds of our people. This is the 'Culture of the Forest', where young men flee into the mountains to wage a guerrilla war against feudal oppression. While we have viewed them as bandits, the populace sees them as defenders. This cultural archetype has fostered a partisan mindset in the Slovak psyche: a distrust of central authority and a mastery of the scorched earth and mountain ambush tactics that can serve us well if we manage to nationalize it.
entities.name: Social Banditry

desc: We are at the height of the Humanist movement, meaning that we have a great opportunity to found a university in Bratislava (Academia Istropolitana) to become a magnet for the brightest minds of our era, including scholars from Italy, Poland, and the German states. The curriculum will emphasize the new sciences of astronomy, mathematics, and Roman law, modernizing the state's diplomatic and legal apparatus. This intellectual boom will ensure that the ruling elite are educated in the latest European political philosophies, allowing the state to navigate the complex international relations of the Renaissance with professional skill. The university will also serve as a center for astronomical research, placing the Slovak lands at the forefront of the scientific revolution that is beginning to sweep across the continent.
entities.name: The Universitas Istropolitana

desc: A unique architectural culture is emerging, wherein the sophisticated stone-working of the Germans meets the ancient Slavic tradition of heavy timber construction. This results in 'Articular Wooden Churches'. Culturally, this represents an 'Architecture of Resistance' — buildings that can be constructed rapidly in the mountains, but are designed with hidden defensive features, like reinforced oak shutters and elevated entrances. This cultural aesthetic is born from a need for beauty in a state of permanent distrust, creating a landscape of cultural supremacy. By learning from this lesson, we can capitalize on these techniques for the glory of our nation.
entities.name: Highland Architecture

desc: A new generation of Romantic intellectuals is shifting the linguistic base to the Central Slovak dialects, creating a version of the language that is becoming the standard. This is not merely a literary shift but a radical political movement, as they are using poetry, folk songs, and journalism to elevate our identity. This Romantic fervor will turn every cultural production into a call for national greatness, unifying the peasantry and the burgeoning middle class in a shared vision of national pride.
entities.name: Slovak Romanticism

desc: The city of Trnava has become the intellectual and spiritual sanctuary of Slovakia. This has led to a dramatic boom in High Baroque architecture, with the city's skyline filled with grand churches and academic halls. The printing of Slavic-language books is flourishing here, making Trnava the primary engine of intellectual resistance against heretics and heathens. By strengthening this cultural concentration, we will ensure that the Slavic population remains deeply anchored in a sophisticated, literate, and religiously unified identity during a period of extreme existential threat.
entities.name: The Slovak Rome

desc: The deep-mining culture of the Slovak Ore Mountains has produced the most skilled subterranean engineers in Europe. The state has begun drafting these Slovak Miners (''Banskí Chlapi'') into specialized 'Sapper and Miner' regiments. Their cultural familiarity with black powder, tunneling, and structural bracing in the dark will make them terrifyingly effective in siege warfare. They can collapse enemy bastions from below or build fortified trenches in half the time of standard laborers. This 'Miner-Soldier' identity will turn the Slovak workforce into a strategic military asset, making the capture of Slovak mining towns a high priority for any empire seeking to master the art of 17th-century siegecraft.
entities.name: The Slovak Sappers

desc: The local Slavic vernacular — distinct from Czech or Polish — has begun to appear with increasing frequency in official town records and legal documents, most notably in the Žilina Book. This development may signal the birth of a formal Slovak administrative language if we support it, allowing the local government to communicate more effectively with the peasantry and the lower nobility without relying solely on Latin or German. By codifying local speech into a written administrative format, the state will improve the efficiency of its judicial system and strengthen the bond between the common people and the government. This early linguistic standardization will provide a sense of 'National Agency', making the state more resilient to foreign administrative overhauls.
entities.name: The Slovensky Vernacular

desc: Following the devastation of the Mongol invasions, the state encouraged the arrival of ''Zipser'' German settlers to rebuild the shattered economy. Unlike many other colonial movements, these settlers integrated deeply with the local Slavic population, resulting in a unique cultural and legal syncretism known as the 'Saxon Law'. This blending of traditions created a multilingual and highly skilled urban middle class that combined Slavic agricultural resilience with German technical expertise in mining and metallurgy. This atmosphere of shared knowledge fostered a culture of innovation, where the exchange of ideas between different linguistic groups accelerated the spread of new technologies and administrative practices, making the Slovak towns some of the most progressive in the region.
entities.name: Urban Syncretism

desc: The soul of our people has found its voice through the printing presses. Primož Trubar has published the ''Catechismus and Abecedarium'', the first books ever printed in the Slovenian language. This is far more than a religious act; it is a political earthquake that standardizes our various dialects into a single literary tongue. By giving the common folk the tools of literacy in their own language, we have forged a unified national consciousness that transcends the borders of old feudal duchies. This intellectual awakening accelerates the adoption of modern administrative institutions and allows the light of new ideas to spread rapidly from the pulpit to the plow.
entities.name: The Catechismus and Abecedarium

desc: The ancient ritual of installing the Dukes of Carinthia in the Slovenian language symbolizes a unique contractual relationship between the ruler and the ruled. This custom reinforces the idea of a free peasantry with specific legal rights, preventing the total disenfranchisement of the rural population. This social contract fosters a stable and productive agricultural base across our domains.
entities.name: The Duke's Chair Tradition

desc: Drawing upon the ancient traditions of the Freising Fragments, the Slovenian peasantry and local clergy have maintained a distinct linguistic identity, which has survived within the ecclesiastical structures of the Holy Roman Empire. This early vernacular tradition serves as a silent but resilient cultural anchor that distinguishes the ''Windisch'' speakers from their Germanic and Italian neighbors.
entities.name: The Freising Fragments

desc: Following the lead of Janez Vajkard Valvasor, we have undertaken a monumental effort to map the geography, history, and customs of our lands. This scientific survey provides the state with an unparalleled understanding of its resources and people, allowing for more efficient taxation and the rapid application of technological innovations.
entities.name: The Glory of Carniola

desc: As a border nation, we have always been in a dangerous position against our enemies, so our people have developed the ''Tabor'' — fortified church enclosures where villagers can retreat with their livestock and valuables. This decentralized defense system turns every village into a minor fortress, forcing any invader into a grueling war of attrition they cannot win.
entities.name: The Tabor Defense System

desc: Baron Sigmund Zois, a wealthy mineralogist and patron of the arts, has started organizing a circle of intellectuals who spearheaded the Slovenian National Awakening (Preporod). This group promotes the use of Slovenian in high culture, science, and politics, effectively transforming a 'peasant tongue' into a language of modern statehood.
entities.name: The Zois Circle

desc: We are not just one part of the Kingdom of Georgia, as a long time ago we received royal recognition and, with it, the title of Atabeg. This title had previously been granted only to the Armenian vassals, and therefore its conveyance is a sign of distinction and of the respect that the Georgian monarch has for us.
entities.name: Atabegs of Samtskhe

desc: Our country has always served as a bridge between the Christian and Muslim worlds. As such, people of both faiths within our borders have become accustomed to interacting with each other.
entities.name: Bridge Between Worlds

desc: Our mountainous terrain has acted as a shield against foreign invaders many times. Because of this, we learned to build strong fortresses and to always be prepared for defensive warfare. This legacy of strength and readiness is one we must strive at all costs to uphold — the fortresses of Samtskhe must be perpetually well maintained, manned, and supplied, as foreign invaders are not a possibility but a certainty.
entities.name: Fortresses of Samtskhe

desc: The Caucasus have been shaped by nomadic emperors since time immemorial, but the lush pastures of Samtskhe have convinced many tribesmen to settle. We must not let this affect the stability of our kingdom, but instead make arrangements with these settling tribes so that they contribute to our military ambitions in exchange for the lands they claim.
entities.name: Frontier Warriors

desc: Samtskhe has often been obligated to bow to foreign rulers, be they Muslim or Christian; Georgian, Turkic, or Iranian. To build an enduring state that survives as an independent entity and can stand against covetous outsiders, we must establish independent institutions: issuing our own coinage, creating our own laws, and patronizing our own theologians and writers.
entities.name: Independent Ambitions

desc: Despite its humble origins, the Jaqeli dynasty has been able to establish many successful relationships, forging strong ties to the rulers of surrounding states. As such, we have a positive reputation in the diplomatic sphere.
entities.name: Jaqeli Dynasty

desc: While still a part of Georgia, Samtskhe operates with substantial independence. This privileged position requires constant diplomatic awareness and a policy of active diplomacy, ensuring that we always have a direct channel to those in power. We do all this while actively engaging in our internal politics, meddling with the succession and forging dynastic alliances as best benefits us. The survival of our relatively small state depends on upholding these diplomatic traditions. Let it never be said that we have done too little or acted without sufficient wisdom!
entities.name: Proactive Diplomacy

desc: Our position at the crossroads of Georgia, Anatolia, Armenia, and Āzarbāijān also means that a great number of traders seek to cross our lands. However, the constant threat of being raided by nomadic tribesmen means that some have come to doubt the safety of traveling on our roads. We must properly defend all roads and merchant inns in our nation so that trade revenue can flow into our state treasury unhindered.
