entities.name: Protect the Trade Routes

desc: The lands of Samtskhe are home to places both sacred and revered among the Georgian people. The cave monastery of Vardzia, the ancient church of Atskuri with its miraculous icon of the Virgin Mary, and the Monastery of Ancha with its Anchiskhati icon, are some of the most significant holy places in our realm. By protecting and curating the Samtskhe church, setting it apart as distinct from that of Georgia, we ensure that our people stand united even in the face of adversity.
entities.name: A Sacred Land

desc: By opposing mercantilism and restricting the state's influence in economic matters, we shall support a free market that will increase our overall production efficiency.
entities.name: Smithian Economics

desc: For centuries, Smolensk has been a land carved up by outsiders — Lithuanian dukes, Polish kings, and Muscovite princes. To survive, we clung to what united us: our faith and our fortitude. If we are ever to rise again, we must cast off divisions and rally around the sacred idea that, above all, there is only Smolensk.
entities.name: Smolenskian Resolve

desc: Having an administration composed of the most talented and suitable individuals in our realm helps our country run smoothly and our authority to flow uninterrupted, regardless of any circumstances in which we may find ourselves.
entities.name: Smooth Administration

desc: Meaning 'that which is remembered', Smṛti texts are inspired by or originated from the Vēdaḥ, and thus are considered less authoritative than the Śruti due to being derived from them. However, unlike the Śruti, the Smṛti texts have attributed authorship and are transmitted through manuscripts.
entities.name: Smṛti

desc: Thanks to frequent early contact with Western countries, we have learned a lot about foreign technology and other innovations. Using this knowledge, we can carry out reforms in economy, industry, and education that will help gain an edge over other clans.
entities.name: Early Westernization

desc: We have always traditionally held the title of ''Shugo'' of Satsuma; its name has become synonymous with our clan. Our warriors are proud of this, and therefore always ready to defend our territory.
entities.name: Satsuma Shugo

desc: Even when surrounded and outnumbered, our soldiers will keep marching forward until they reach the other side of the enemy lines. The charge of our troops will be legendary!
entities.name: Shimazu Charge

desc: The Westerners who first landed on Tanegashima brought with them new and interesting weapons. These arquebuses are becoming an increasingly common sight all over Japan, but nowhere have they been available for as long as here.
entities.name: Tanegashima Teppō

desc: ''Tsurinobuse'', 'lure and ambush', is our most effective tactic. This strategy enables us to beat enemies when we are vastly outnumbered, which is of course a very valuable skill. We must make this a central tactic of our armies, and give the dull-witted commanders of rival clans a little surprise.
entities.name: Tsurinobuse

desc: Originally, all soldiers in the Kèlè-Bolo levies are ''horon'', or 'freemen', but the latest developments in Mali have forced the inclusion of ''jonow'', 'slaves', to serve in the army as fighters instead of weapon-bearers. These slave warriors would thereafter be known as 'Sofa', protecting fortifications as part of garrison forces.
entities.name: Sofa Levies

desc: Most states are countries that have an army. Prussia, on the other hand, is an army that has a country! The many Kings of Prussia were soldiers as much as monarchs; each concluded their reign not only by reforming the state but also leaving a lasting impact on the army.
entities.name: The Soldier-King of Prussia

desc: Our lands are sparsely populated, for the most part, and surrounded by enemies. The necessity for more robust defenses has prompted us to hire soldiers from foreign lands, who will fight under our banner for a price.
entities.name: Soldiers of Fortune

desc: Our rulers' forefathers are descended from the monarchs of Aksum; from the bloodlines of King Solomon and the Queen of Sheba. We have deposed the Zagwe monarchs in order to legitimize our rule and firmly establish the kingdom being restored to its rightful dynasty.
entities.name: Solomon Dynastic Claim

desc: The Karamanids trace their ancestry to the Salur, one of the major Oghuz tribes. Known for both their leadership and valor, the Salur legacy shapes our state's identity and our claim to represent the Turkmen of Anatolia.
entities.name: Sons of the Salur Tribe

desc: Our privateer ships fly the flag of Hachiman, spreading terror wherever they go. No one would dare attack a fleet protected by the god of war himself!
entities.name: Bahan Ship

desc: Lying between Asia and the islands of Japan, our homeland of Tsushima and its surrounding waters are where countries clash and fight hard. May our own fleets be strong, so that we can not only defend our country, but also expand it!
entities.name: Fight for Tsushima

desc: While we appreciate lawful and peaceful trade, we also need to be prepared for tense military situations. Fortunately, the local tradition of piracy could help us solve certain combat-related issues.
entities.name: Wakō Tradition

desc: While foreign nations pride themselves on being at the forefront of knowledge and development, some of their recent 'inventions' have been known in Asia for centuries. From the technological prowess of China to the ancient literature of India, there is nothing for the East to envy from the West.
entities.name: Source of Knowledge

desc: China is home to immeasurable wealth, prestige, and knowledge. Under the rule of a weak dynasty, it falls upon our shoulders to seize power and return the prosperity and splendor of these lands.
entities.name: Southern Campaigns

desc: We have not made our navy a priority, and as a result, we have fallen behind our competitors in terms of naval quality and performance. A reform is in order, which will re-elevate us to our rightful position of maritime supremacy.
entities.name: Spanish Naval Reforms

desc: Religious laxity has become widespread among our people, turning us away from God. We will sign treaties with our religious leaders to encourage a stronger bond between them and our government, and return to being a devout nation.
entities.name: Revival of Ecclesiastical Discipline

desc: Based in the University of Salamanca, the School's interests lie in fields as diverse as theology, economics, and political philosophy. As one of the leading schools of thought in the Catholic world, its entrenched presence in Spain ensures that our nation always remains at the forefront of intellectual affairs.
entities.name: School of Salamanca

desc: Our realm bustles with cultural and artistic achievements of all kinds. Should we channel that creativity to the proper places, feeding it when needed through wealthy benefactors, we will start a truly Golden Century of Spanish art.
entities.name: Siglo de Oro

desc: Radical new ideas have permeated the minds of Spain's leading figures, inspiring them to develop ambitious plans that will make us stand out among all the other nations of the world.
entities.name: Spanish Enlightenment

desc: New lands across the ocean are waiting for us to claim them. We will divide this territory and have each section ruled by representatives of our government, who will establish orderly settlements. The aim there is for our people to find these new lands an attractive destination, and will settle there and secure our presence.
entities.name: Spanish Viceroyalties

desc: The Spanish Square evolved organically from the Pike and Shot formation. At its core was a traditional pike square, and at each corner, it had a group of arquebusiers. This way, they maintained the staying power of the traditional pike square and enhanced it with the firepower of the arquebus.
entities.name: Spanish Square

desc: Cardinal Albornoz built the ''Rocca Albornoziana'' not as a gesture but as a declaration — a fortress of such impregnability that every petty lord between Rome and Perugia understood that central power had returned in earnest, and that Spoleto stood as its most fortified instrument in central Italy. We have inherited both the structure and the institutional role it embodies, maintaining our city as the most orderly and disciplined administrative center in the region through every upheaval of the age. This combination of military solidity and civic order keeps our population unified, our burgher class literate in their civic duties, and our walls resistant to the storms of revolt and rebellion that trouble less well-governed territories.
entities.name: Cardinal's Bulwark

desc: We are the inheritors of the great ''Duchy of Spoleto'', the Lombard dominion that once stretched from Umbria to the edges of the Mezzogiorno, and where other communes forgot their martial origins we kept the garrison tradition alive in every hilltop tower and every lord's keep across our lands. The memory of that broad territorial authority shapes how our nobility thinks about defense and how our peasants think about obligation, producing a social compact organized around the protection of altitude and stone. This legacy of distributed fortification and soldierly culture gives our armies a discipline and our territory a resilience that no city-state built from trade alone can match.
entities.name: Duchy of Spoleto

desc: We invited Filippo Lippi to paint the apse of our cathedral, and what he gave us was the ''Stories of the Virgin'' — one of the most luminous and tender fresco cycles of the fifteenth century, left unfinished only by his death in Spoleto itself, where he was buried with honors in the church he had transformed. His tomb in our cathedral turned a patronage arrangement into a permanent pilgrimage point for the cultivated and curious across all of Italy. This artistic legacy deepens our intellectual reputation and draws the learned visitors whose presence sharpens the quality of inquiry throughout our city.
entities.name: Lippi Frescoes

desc: The ancient ''Ponte delle Torri'' — part Roman aqueduct, part fortified bridge — strides across the Tessino gorge on ten great piers, giving us control of the main Apennine passage between Umbria and the Marche. Merchants who wish to cross the mountains must cross our bridge, and we have never been reluctant to collect what that privilege is worth in tolls, intelligence, and deference. This structure makes our territory a natural chokepoint, pulling trade inward and making any would-be aggressor calculate the cost of that crossing before they march.
entities.name: Ponte delle Torri

desc: The mulberry groves of our valley have fed silkworms that supplied the finest weavers in the Papal States for centuries, and the resulting ''Spoletine silk'' reached the altars of Rome and the wardrobes of courts as far as France and the Habsburgs. Our merchants built a prosperous burgher class on the back of this trade — one with enough surplus to educate its children and enough political sense to keep the guild networks running through every succession of papal governors. This luxury craft tradition fills our treasury from foreign demand and sustains the middling commercial class whose stability is the surest foundation of our peace.
entities.name: Spoletine Silk

desc: The broad agricultural valley cradled between our hills has been the material foundation of our prosperity since antiquity, and we have spent the revolutionary era improving it — drainage canals, systematic crop rotation, and the redistribution of marginal land into productive holdings that sustain our laboring population through the economic shocks that less prepared states cannot absorb. The ''Vale of Spoleto'' now feeds our city, supplies our markets with surplus, and generates the agricultural capital that any serious industrial ambition requires as its foundation. This inherited fertility, carefully tended and rationally improved, turns every season into a buffer against the disruptions that ruin neighbors who have spent their resources on less durable investments.
entities.name: Vale of Spoleto

desc: Our region is home to some of the most impressive madrasas and mosques in the entire Muslim world. With their meticulous attention to detail and abundant talent, our artisans shine with unmatched prowess.
entities.name: Splendor of Anatolia

desc: As the various empires and institutions that make up our world continue to expand, we shall need to maintain and perhaps increase espionage if we wish to stay one step ahead of our rivals.
entities.name: Expand Global Spy Networks

desc: By hiring trustworthy individuals as informants and strategically positioning them in situations where clandestine information is shared, we can improve our capability to gather information about our enemies and their activities.
entities.name: Improved Spy Organization

desc: If we want to gather intelligence on our enemies, we must improve our skill in cracking and devising secret codes. We shall lull our enemies into a false sense of security by sending what appear to be only ordinary communications, which shall actually contain hidden, encoded information. A pity our enemies will not be clever enough to understand it!
entities.name: Advanced Cryptography

desc: Espionage has been a valuable tool for empires since ancient times. Spycraft allows us to become better informed about both internal and external threats, and to monitor the activities of potentially dangerous states and actors. The Mongols were masters of this art, using espionage to prepare for and secure the success of their military campaigns.
entities.name: Spy Networks

desc: As new ideas and political systems raise their heads around the world, there must logically also arise those who protest the status quo. We will need to allocate resources to support these dissenting voices in our rival nations in order to extract valuable information and contribute to their destabilizing effects.
entities.name: Contact with Dissidents

desc: By combining the Iberian Caravel and the Carrack, a new ship has been born: fast, strong, and exactly what we need help us dominate the seas.
entities.name: Square-Rigged Caravels

desc: Meaning 'that which is heard', Śruti are the holiest and most ancient texts of Hinduism. They are considered to be a divine revelation and thus not attributed to human authorship, although some deny their divine origin while still accepting their authority.
entities.name: Śruti

desc: With artillery's growing importance on the battlefield, the number of firearms kept increasing. But because each gun was made separately, it also required great effort to resupply. In 1544, in an effort to mitigate this, Emperor Charles V declared that there would be only five calibers of guns, while King Henry II of France set the standard of calibers at six.
entities.name: Caliber Standardization

desc: As wealth is created, more and more mints appear. While we have lived with many different currencies for years, official standards have to be set in order to avoid fraud caused by using lesser quantities of precious metals, or by rasping the edges of those coins.
entities.name: Standardized Coins

desc: A pike is a remarkably simple weapon to make, but to get the full benefit from their use, the entire formation must be wielding weapons of similar length and blade.
entities.name: Standardized Pikes

desc: Other nations raise armies when war arrives and dismiss them when it ends. We cannot afford that luxury. Our army will be permanent, always trained, always ready, and the storehouses to sustain it will never run dry.
entities.name: Standing Army

desc: Unlike its predecessor, the medieval Castle, the Star Fort is a very flat fortification composed of many triangular bastions at its corners and an additional ditch. This allows the defenders to counter enemy Artillery while still being able to keep climbing infantry at bay.
entities.name: Star Fort

desc: Taxing our population is only feasible as long as we know who lives where and what local customs and laws apply to each person. We must establish a comprehensive administration to properly manage our realm.
entities.name: State Administration

desc: Despite our focus on country-wide affairs, we must not neglect our local state legislators and bailiffs.
entities.name: Local Infrastructure

desc: The nature of a theocracy is held in its proximity to the divine. To achieve this closeness, many actions of our government are carried out by the clergy, combining religious ritual with the bureaucratic duties of administrators.
entities.name: State of Clerics

desc: As with a man, a nation's reputation is everything, and the establishment of an official propaganda service will ensure our good name is not smeared by the lies of our enemies.
entities.name: State Propaganda

desc: Warriors and nobles rise through valor and service, ensuring authority belongs to those who have truly earned it.
entities.name: Status by Merit

desc: Known as the General Charter of Jewish Liberties, this legislation contains articles that allow all Jews in our realm the freedom to worship, trade, and travel. The statute also attempts to reduce the number of blood libel accusations against Jews propagated by the Catholic Church.
entities.name: Statute of Kalisz

desc: A series of loosely consolidated laws and statutes form the legal backbone of our governance. These statutes blend Roman jurisprudence with local customs and Angevin tradition, allowing us to manage a patchwork of regions as one cohesive domain: a true composite monarchy, where the parts are diverse, but the crown is indivisible.
entities.name: Statutes of Aix

desc: Statutes of Lithuania are a set of three different legal reforms which aggregate, unify, and update the laws of the realm. Known for harsh punishments and the introduction of the death penalty, these statutes are in line with many contemporary Western penal codes. Each crime is supposed to be punished the same regardless of the class of the person committing it, but in practice, the peasants were often at a disadvantage compared to how members of other estates were treated.
entities.name: Statutes of Lithuania

desc: An increase in the reliability of our furnaces and production process made it possible to produce Steel on an economically beneficial scale.
entities.name: Steel Mill

desc: As time progresses, so does our understanding of our culture and identity. We no longer have to fear neighboring tribes; we have tamed the wilderness and have become its master. Now it is time to embrace who we are as a people.
entities.name: Tribal Cultural Identity

desc: The time has come to discard our old ways and embrace a position in the larger world. No longer seen as a mere tribe, we shall officially become a country, one that represents and defends our people and the way we live.
entities.name: Tribal Modernization

desc: The religious values of our tribe dictate not only how we live, but how we treat those who do not share our beliefs and traditions, both within and outside of our territory.
entities.name: Tribal Religious Values

desc: The steppes are a peculiar and treacherous place to live. When you enter the Endless Sea of Grass, your horse stops being an animal or piece of property, and truly becomes a part of you. Just as your body cannot survive without a heart or a liver, in the steppes it certainly will not survive without a horse. But the good news is that those who find themselves in that situation will find countless interesting ways to perish...
entities.name: Steppe Riders

desc: Our raiding parties move as fast as the wind, hitting and running almost before anyone is aware of our presence. Looting the settlements we attack is in itself lucrative, but any prisoners we capture can be sold for a high price as well.
entities.name: Steppe Slave Raiding

desc: The ancient tradition of playing the stickball game has been part of our culture for ages. Used for ritual purposes or to settle disputes, hundreds of warriors gather in a field with wooden sticks and a single ball, which must be directed towards a marked goal. This practice not only brings our people together, but keeps our warriors in prime condition.
entities.name: Stickball Game

desc: Regardless of the hostile clans around us, we have always presented ourselves as a reasonable third party for other clans to attach themselves to for protection against invaders. This tradition of eastern coalitions will serve us well, as long as we make sure that the clans who rely on us never have to worry about protection.
entities.name: Eastern Coalitions

desc: We are one of the oldest Minamoto lines in the Kantō region, and have fought for our clan's glory in eastern Japan since before Minamoto no Yoritomo founded the Kamakura Shogunate. Our position as ''Shugo'' of Hitachi is therefore never in question.
entities.name: Hitachi Genji

desc: Kashima Shrine is one of three most important shrines in the Kantō region. This shrine is dedicated to Takemikazuchi-no-O-no-Kami, who is the god of thunder and swords, and also the patron god of Sumō wrestling. Our custodianship of this shrine strengthens the resolve of our armies.
entities.name: Kashima Shrine

desc: An important meeting place of brokers, merchants and investors, the Stock Exchange greatly facilitates business and the flow of shares in joint-stock companies.
entities.name: Stock Exchange

desc: For centuries, we have used wood to build our towns and defenses, but we will now  systematically upgrade our infrastructure by replacing more vulnerable wooden structures with stronger ones. We have inherited wooden towns, but we shall leave them fortified with stone and brick.
entities.name: Stone and Brick

desc: Before the Malian Empire came to dominate Western Africa, the city of Gao was the capital of an empire in its own right. Although there are barely any written records of the Gao Empire, its legacy lives on in our oral traditions, inspiring all who want to achieve greatness one day.
entities.name: Stories of the Gao Empire

desc: The Boyar class is in many ways the foundation of Russia, but just as we need to strengthen the Boyars, we also need to control them. We must protect seats for the Boyars in the Duma, but also to make sure that they are dependent on us to further their influence.
entities.name: Strength of the Boyars

desc: Our patriarchates have always been well organized and structured, each with its own attributions and delimitations. This allows for a better-functioning Church, which leads to a better-functioning state.
entities.name: Structured Patriarchates

desc: Religious and philosophical traditions, particularly those of Hinduism and Confucianism, have historically influenced social organization in parts of Asia, emphasizing proscribed role fulfillments within social hierarchies. The rigidity of living within these systems is offset by the relative ease with which social order is maintained.
entities.name: Structured Society

desc: Members of our royal dynasties are accustomed to journeys abroad. They have spent much of their upbringing as students of illustrious courts far away from home, in the pursuit of a thorough education in matters of statesmanship.
entities.name: Students of Foreign Courts

desc: Strangers have made contact with our people. Their unfamiliar ships and weapons instill awe and fear. Understanding their methods may be the key to survival.
entities.name: Study the European Colonizers

desc: The great empires of Europe and the East have made groundbreaking advances in the use of gunpowder and its military applications. To study their ways and make the according improvements to our own armaments would greatly strengthen our own military.
entities.name: Foreign Gunpowder

desc: It is not a shame that others know what we do not, but it is never to our benefit if we do nothing to remedy that ignorance. By actively studying and learning from the discoveries of others, we can better improve our own knowledge of the world.
entities.name: Shared Knowledge

desc: Privateers are always in the line of fire. If we wish to utilize their full potential, we must ensure they are not sunk after the first round of cannon fire! Making sure they only sail on the sturdiest vessels will be beneficial to us in the long run — and to the privateers themselves, of course, as they will live longer.
entities.name: Sturdy Privateers

desc: The financial responsibilities our subjects have towards us are clearly defined. However, tightening these contracts will ensure timely payments and lead to a healthier treasury.
entities.name: Firmer Financial Control

desc: The world around us is undergoing tremendous change in all sectors. We can capitalize on this instability by formalizing tributary arrangements with subject nations in exchange for supporting them. Sovereign protection, it turns out, has a price.
entities.name: Paid Sovereignty

desc: Although having many countries serving us can be beneficial, only by gathering their different titles under our own will we be able to best utilize their resources. In the end, it is clear that a ruler with only one title will pale in comparison to us, with our splendid array of impressive-sounding titles.
entities.name: Consolidation of Titles

desc: We tolerate no dissent or revolt. Absolute loyalty is demanded from all subjects, whether they are part of the core citizenry or a conquered group.
entities.name: Absolute Loyalty

desc: Granting our subject nations some autonomy over local governance keeps them from revolting while ensuring they continue to provide tribute to the realm.
entities.name: Subject Nations

desc: From the days of total conquest to the vast expanses of Genghis Khān's great Empire, our people descend from generations of earthshakers. Our people are the ones destined to author history.
entities.name: Successors of Genghis Khān

desc: The grasslands, savannas, and deserts of Western Africa provide few resources suitable for construction projects, so we have made the best of what we can get. The usage of mudbricks and adobe plaster reduces the cost of buildings significantly while also giving them a distinct style that is pleasing to the eye.
entities.name: Sudano-Sahelian Architecture

desc: Although the Thai script is already common to all Thai people, it should not be forgotten that it was in our country and under our guidance that it was developed. As such, Thai script is not only a unifying force for our culture, but also proof of our individuality and distinctiveness.
entities.name: Akson Sukhothai

desc: We are called the first independent Thai kingdom, as we were the first ones to rebel against Khmer authority and establish ourselves as free from their influence. As such, all Thai people look at us in admiration.
entities.name: Birthplace of a Culture

desc: It was not so long ago that we saw ourselves under the Khmer authority, but we have since gained our freedom, and have taken our rightful place as an independent power. We have earned the admiration of our peers, and their respect.
entities.name: Breaker of Chains

desc: Our armies have a long history of victory in combat. As a result, a position in our military is seen as a post of honor and prestige, and there are many willing to serve.
entities.name: Military History

desc: Most of the history of the early Sukhothai kingdom comes from inscriptions on the Ram Khamhaeng Stele, commissioned by the great king to give a record of his glorious reign. The Ram Khamhaeng Stele is a sacred piece of heritage and one that surely proves our place in history.
entities.name: Ram Khamhaeng Stele

desc: Ceramics have been created by the Thai people since antiquity, influenced by Chinese ceramics but always retaining their own distinct style. However, the ceramics produced in our country are most valued, and they are often traded at great distances overseas.
entities.name: Sukhothai Ceramics

desc: Many have tried in the past to stop our progress and expansion, but all have failed in the face of our army. It has proved to be an unstoppable force, one that readily crushes any obstacles in our way.
entities.name: Unstoppable Army

desc: We are known for our many gorgeous temples, such as the Wat Si Sawai, one of the oldest in Sukhothai. Built under the Khmer authority as a Hindu temple, its ensuing repurposing has turned it into a symbol of our identity. The faith of our people is strong.
entities.name: Wat Si Sawai

desc: Derived from an ancient agricultural ritual, in which dances served as prayers for a good harvest, the practice of Sumō has escaped the confines of the court and is now a popular practice among the commoners. It also serves as a form of combat training.
entities.name: Sumō

desc: Through devotion and ritual, we keep the sun's journey alive, easing the hearts and strengthening the spirit of our people. The preservation of equilibrium, and even the world, rests upon our shoulders.
entities.name: The Sun Must Rise

desc: Consisting of the traditions and practices attributed to Muḥammad, peace be upon him, the Sunnah dictates how every Muslim faithful should behave, and is also what gives Sunnism its name. Although the different schools of jurisprudence may vary on the details, they all have their basis in the Sunnah.
entities.name: Sunnah

desc: The use of massed firepower to disrupt the enemy before delivering a coup de grâce is one of our army's strengths, and we will make sure that our leaders know this.
entities.name: Superior Firepower

desc: Enables us to transform our navy into a supreme naval force with top-class vessels and highly skilled captains and crew.
entities.name: Superior Seamanship

desc: Building ships that are slightly faster than those of our opponents, even if the amount of this extra speed is so negligible that it is of no military significance, can still fill our crews with confidence and make our enemy wary of taking us on in an even fight.
entities.name: Superior Ship Design

desc: No army can survive without supplies. Establishing permanent supply depots dedicated to providing for our fighting forces allows for a continuous feeding of the supply lines, keeping our armies always in peak condition.
entities.name: Supply Depots

desc: The development and deployment of standing armies have increased the demands for weaponry, uniforms, and other military supplies, which should be stored in close proximity to our soldiers.
entities.name: Army Depots

desc: Generalized deployment of artillery for battlefields and sieges has created a high demand for the ammunition and gunpowder to fuel them, increasing the importance of storage depots.
entities.name: Ammunition Depots

desc: Armies can now penetrate deeper into enemy territory and sustain themselves there for longer periods, making it necessary to build and maintain forward depots closer to them while being linked to rear supply lines.

mods.label: Max Level of Trade Company Headquarters

entities.name: Forward Depots

desc: The operation of multiple armies on longer campaigns has put extra stress on our supply systems, making bigger, rapidly constructed depots even more important to sustain them.
entities.name: Campaign Depots

desc: The development of professional armies has changed the way war is waged. Logistics are now essential, and supply lines are absolutely necessary to keep armies fed and supplied with ammunition.
entities.name: Supply Lines

desc: While on campaign, attrition is our most formidable foe, and the key to defending our men against it is a well-planned and efficiently run logistic network capable of providing ample support and supplies.
entities.name: Supply Trains

desc: Supervising the law of our country, the Supreme Court is the central institution to dictate and enforce our law.
entities.name: Supreme Court

desc: If we are to defend ourselves against our aggressive Polish and East Slavic foes, we must project strength! Establishing the title of ''Supreme Duke of Lithuania'' will decisively assert our authority, especially against the growing power of our nobility and others who seek to violate our sovereignty.
entities.name: 'Supremus Dux Lithuaniae'

desc: Barber-surgeons are developing more sophisticated techniques for treating injuries and illnesses, and the invention of new surgical instruments makes procedures safer and more effective. As a result, patients are surviving injuries and illnesses that would have been fatal just a few years ago.
entities.name: Surgery

desc: A type of sacred text in both Dharmic and Buddhist religions, they vary in format and content. Regardless, they are always considered to be valid sources of knowledge, and proper study of them is required if one is to develop their spirit.
entities.name: Sūtra

desc: Suwa Taisha at Lake Suwa is one of the oldest shrines in Japan, and highly adored throughout the country. Its most important festival, ''Onbashira-matsuri'', proves the bravery of our people as they carry the sacred logs from the mountain to the shrine.
entities.name: Suwa Taisha

desc: By investing in large-scale hydraulic engineering projects to drain the vast marshlands of the riverine areas, we unlock thousands of acres of new, fertile farmland. These reclaimed lands will be soon settled, increasing the population density and tax base of the province while eliminating the vectors for disease. This transformation of the landscape not only strengthens our economy but also creates a more navigable and defensible terrain, removing the natural barriers that once hindered our own internal communications.
entities.name: Swamp Drainage Projects

desc: The fertile silt between the Sava and Drava is our greatest asset. By granting tax-free plots in exchange for clearing the heavy riverine brush, we are turning the flooded plains into the primary grain basin of the North. This agricultural intensification provides the logistics needed to support a massive standing army, ensuring the Kingdom can feed its defenders even during the most grueling winter blockades.
entities.name: The Alluvial Land Grants

desc: We have formalized the ''Marturina'' (marten-pelt tax, also known as ''Kunovina''), a unique and ancient Slavonian tribute system that provides the Ban with a high-value, portable liquid asset. By standardizing the value of these pelts against the Royal Mark, we have created a stable currency for the region that is highly resistant to inflation. This fiscal reliability allows the Banate to maintain a professional guard and build extensive wooden and stone river-fortifications along the vulnerable Drava crossings without burdening the peasantry with excessive grain taxes.
entities.name: The Marturina Tax System

desc: Slavonian Oak is now the most sought-after timber in the Mediterranean for its iron-like resistance to water rot. By establishing a royal monopoly on the export of mature oak to the Venetian shipyards, we have secured a strategic economic lever over the maritime republics. This trade does not just fill our coffers; it ensures that the very foundations of Venice's palaces and the hulls of their galleys are physically composed of Croatian soil, giving us a unique diplomatic influence over the 'Queen of the Adriatic'.
entities.name: The Oak Staple Rights

desc: Our infantry units are reorganized into elite grenadier regiments that are renowned across the continent for their physical stature, rigorous discipline, and unwavering bravery under fire. These specialized shock troops are trained to lead the charge into the heaviest enemy fire, using their grenades and bayonets to break the lines of even the most formidable opponents. The presence of these 'Slavonian Giants' on the battlefield serves as a powerful psychological weapon, boosting the morale of our own troops while striking terror into the hearts of those who face them.
entities.name: The Slavonian Grenadier Regiments

desc: Our people are governed under the scrutiny of the Slavonian ''Sabor''. This legislative independence allows the Slavonian nobility to address the specific needs of the inter-river plains, such as drainage projects and the regulation of grain markets. By having a dedicated assembly, the Banate can react quickly to regional crises and negotiate directly for tax exemptions, ensuring that Slavonia's agricultural wealth is used primarily for Slavonia's own defense and improvement.
entities.name: The Slavonian Sabor

desc: Many have accused our people of stinginess, and laughed at our good sense of economic caution. Fortunately, we cannot hear their mockery over the sound of all these ducats jingling in our purse.
entities.name: Frugal Finances

desc: Swabia is home to many wealthy cities, which are desirable targets for foreign ambition. To better protect our nation, we should come together in times of war and fight united against foreign incursions.

mods.label: Possible Burghers in Towns and Cities

entities.name: League of Cities

desc: Absolutism is the theory that one person should be in charge, that this person is the monarch, and that said monarch shall run the government unfettered by the Privy Council.
entities.name: Swedish Absolutism

desc: The abundance of copper in Sweden, primarily from the Stora Kopparberget mine in Falun, has prompted the country to use it as the main metal for minting a new national currency, the ''daler''. This is issued as a large money plate, called ''plåtmynt'', which can weigh up to 20 kilograms. Some argue that this might not be very practical and that the volume of money in circulation could exceed copper reserves, but they seem narrow-minded.
entities.name: Swedish Copper Coins

desc: Swedish peasants have always made significant contributions to our country; the differences between a noble and a free farmer have never been big.
entities.name: Free Farmers

desc: From the disciplined Carolean ranks to the strong freeholding peasantry, Sweden's military prowess is an essential pillar of Scandinavia. By integrating Swedish institutions and recruitment systems, we reinforce the manpower and strength of our empire.
entities.name: Swedish Military Roots

desc: The ''Kungliga Postverket'', or Royal Postal Agency, was created to improve state administration and communication across the expanse of Sweden. It establishes a reliable network of couriers and waystations, and has become crucial for our military coordination, diplomacy, and governance.
entities.name: Kungliga Postverket

desc: While other armies may be content to wildly fire inaccurate volleys at their enemies, we shall march at them in disciplined ranks, deliver a single volley at close range, and then feed them cold steel.
entities.name: Swedish Steel

desc: Forming our marching troops into a ''Svinfylking'' and charging is enough force to shatter any opponent! Mounted troops are not superior; other than being ridden to the battle itself, horses have no place on the battlefield.
entities.name: Always Attack

desc: The great mountains of the Alps are not mere obstacles to us, they are our home. Their great passes — the Gotthard, the Simplon, the Grimsel — are our streets. Generations of pilgrims, merchants, and armies marching through these treacherous heights have made our people intimately familiar with every route, shelter, and shortcut in them. No foreign army will move through our mountains as swiftly as we do.
entities.name: Masters of the Alpine Passes

desc: We do not need to construct a unique identity for our country, since our people readily rally around the banners of their cantons and the ideals of our confederacy. But by funding our most enlightened scholars of our time, we will be able to shape a new age for the Swiss people, and solidify the unique traits of our ''Eidgenossenschaft''. This Helvetism forms the foundation of our Enlightenment.
entities.name: Swiss Enlightenment

desc: We are a sanctuary, not only for persecuted people from other countries, but also for their wealth. In large vaults, hidden away behind strong walls and protected by our most trustworthy soldiers, we will be the best place for every citizen of the poor, war-torn countries of the world to stash their valuables.
entities.name: Swiss Banking

desc: Some fools think that clockwork is for timekeeping alone, but when one witnesses the power of rotating gears, it is obvious that clockwork can do just about anything one wants it to do. Maybe the Creator of the Universe Himself wound up existence like a clock and let the gears spin on their own, ticking away the centuries. Be that as it may, Swiss clockmakers are the greatest masters of the art — barring God Himself, of course.
entities.name: Masters of Clockwork

desc: We have forged an eternal alliance with our friends in the neighboring Cantons. Had it not been for this treaty, we would have surely succumbed to the Habsburg invaders and fallen under the rule of foreign tyrants yet again. These alliances will ensure our survival for centuries to come.
entities.name: Eternal Alliance of the Forest Cantons

desc: When we defended our freedom in the Battle of Morgarten, we had a very important advantage over the cursed Habsburg invaders: the halberd, a simple yet lethal weapon that can repel any foe with ease. Training our troops to use halberds with skill will give us an advantage against our foes, even if they have superior numbers.
entities.name: Legacy of Morgarten

desc: Our troops are widely recognized as exceptional combatants. Fortunately for us, we are not permanently in need of their services, which allows us to rent them out to foreign powers, earning extra revenue and providing them with valuable combat experience.
entities.name: Swiss Mercenaries

desc: Let us recite the vow of this new union: We shall be one nation of brothers, and no trouble or danger shall separate us. No foreign tyrant shall ever rule over our realm!
entities.name: The Oath of Rütli

desc: Past conflicts have shown that repelling invaders is not our only concern. The valleys of our cantons are devastated with each battle; careful steps must be taken to bring prosperity back to our land.
entities.name: A Tormented Realm

desc: Some of our countrymen elect to travel into foreign lands and earn their keep as mercenaries for foreign rulers. Once these return to their home, these men are veteran soldiers and some of the best fighters of Europe. We should form regiments from these veterans and employ them in our own armies.
entities.name: The Reisläufer

desc: While others exile religious minorities and disruptive figures, we will gladly offer them a home. In Switzerland, they will be able to establish a new life for themselves, and as a result will be inclined to praise our rule.
entities.name: Haven for Refugees

desc:
Why must we kill each other over obscure issues of transubstantiation and predestination, when we could spend that energy turning our mountain home into a realm united once more?

For that reason, every Canton of Switzerland will have the ultimate jurisdiction over religious matters in their region. While this will not eliminate all religious strife in our country, it will at least ensure that no matter what someone believes, our people will be able to find a place where they are not persecuted.
entities.name: Swiss Tolerance

desc: Jerusalem is the holiest city in Christendom, the very place of Christ's Passion and Resurrection. By asserting Catholic supremacy over these sacred grounds, we become the spiritual beacon of the Latin world and a pillar of the true faith.
entities.name: Symbol of Catholicism

desc: Direct rule comes at the cost of extensive investment in subjugating and pacifying rival groups. By instead installing a loyal official to rule locally and demanding they pay an annual tribute, we eliminate threats from any rival Āltepētl while filling our treasury at the same time.
entities.name: Tributary System

desc: By establishing the 'Knight's School' to train noble youth in military science and their patriotic duty, we will forge generations of capable, dedicated military and civil personnel.
entities.name: Szkoła Rycerska

desc: The abolishment of the Mestnichestvo was the first step toward creating a more meritocratic state bureaucracy. The Table of Ranks further codified this principle, making military advancement conditional on performance rather than noble birth.
entities.name: The Table of Ranks

desc: Just as we staff our administration with talented officials, we need to ensure our commercial infrastructure is managed by skilled professionals. Having only the brightest minds overseeing our trade operations will keep products moving and revenues flowing without interruption.
entities.name: Talented Traders

desc: The Berber-speaking people of the interior are a vital part of our society. By recognizing their cultural identity and fostering literacy, we expand our ability to govern diverse regions without losing cohesion or a firm hold on power.
entities.name: Tamazight

desc: The Tambo is a supply depot of the Incas. The purpose of the Tambo varies significantly depending on the size of the structure. Smaller tambos serve as road stops for passing travelers while larger ones can even serve as an office for the province's administration.
entities.name: Tambo

desc: Although most people would qualify the steppes as inhospitable and even worthless land, our Cossacks have adapted to the harsh environment, and are able not only to survive but to thrive in the wilderness. Thanks to their expertise, we are able to exploit those lands and benefit from them.
entities.name: Tamed Steppes

desc: This new variety of chess, invented by our great eponymous founder, improves upon previous versions. Using it will help our generals to improve their strategic and tactical skills.
entities.name: Tamerlane Chess

desc: Advancements in chemistry make the process of tanning animal hides significantly shorter and produce higher quality Leather
entities.name: Tanning Manufactory

desc: With the use of new chemicals and more efficient production methods, our Leather production will be unrivaled.
entities.name: Tannery Mill

desc: The production of Leather has refined and allows for a wider scope of produced hide materials and increased output.
entities.name: Tanning Workshop

desc: For centuries, our spiritual influence in China has formed the bedrock of our diplomatic relations. Imperial patronage, tribute exchanges, and sacred rituals like ''Tányuè'' secure both respect and material gain.
entities.name: Tányuè Guānxì

desc: The Tax Assessor enforces the will of the ruler to collect the proper amount of taxation.
entities.name: Tax Assessor

desc: Operating a civilized society implies the maintenance of a central authority, and that authority must be supported through some form of currency. By extracting taxes from our subjects and citizens, we will be more productive and better able to achieve great things for our people.
entities.name: Taxation

gate: is capital in south america or carribean

desc: Though adventurers from far-off lands dream of finding secret gold on mountain trails high in the Andes, to us the yellow metal has more artistic and sacred importance than simple economic value.
entities.name: Tears of the Sun

desc: Having our court members serve a position for life carries the inherent risk of them amassing undue power and influence. They also tend to dedicate less effort to their tasks, due to being given excessive responsibilities. To avoid this messiness, we can establish a system of temporary assignments. That way, officials are assigned to the positions they are best qualified for, but can be reassigned with ease should they grow too complacent in their roles.
entities.name: Temporary Appointments

requires.label: March to the Sound of Guns

desc: The Ten Great Campaigns are aimed at expanding our influence both inside and outside our borders. To achieve that, we will draft a huge army to crush any resistance that we might find in our way. We shall choke the life out of any rebellion before it has the chance to raise its head, and our glory will be eternal.
entities.name: Ten Grand Campaigns

desc: ''Tercio'' infantry were developed principally by the brilliant general Gonzalo Fernández de Córdoba, called ''El Gran Capitán'', during the Italian Wars. It is a mixed infantry formation of pikemen and musketeers. Because of this combined-arms approach, the formation simultaneously utilizes both the rigidity of its heavy infantry and the long-range firepower of its musketeers, making it an ideal defensive and offensive formation.
entities.name: Tercios

gate: is capital in south america or carribean

desc: To take maximum advantage of the limited space in our highlands, we have developed terrace farming, a series of step-like platform fields on the sides of the mountains, as well as better irrigation techniques.
entities.name: Terrace Farming

desc: The Terraces are sloped areas for the purpose of effective farming in the complex terrain of the Andes. Constructed on different height levels, the terraces can provide prime soil for many different crops in a close area.
entities.name: Terraces

desc: All powers of the state are consolidated in our order. Every action taken and every decision made goes through the hierarchy of the Teutonic Order first before it gets executed. Of course, this bureaucracy is not in everyone's favor, but it ensures the absolute power of the ''Hochmeister''.
entities.name: Absolute Order

desc: Our grand order was forged in the flames and blood of the Third Crusade during the siege of Acre in 1191. While we originally nursed the sick and feeble, the order has transformed into a militarized group of knights of unbreakable devotion and discipline.
entities.name: Crusader Discipline

desc: Grant autonomy to the local governors of our border regions, and reform their holdings into marches. These special zones will pay fewer taxes to the state in return for an obligation to maintain the highest combat readiness during times of war as well as peace. This should provide us with substantial military flexibility at little cost.
entities.name: Expanded Marches

desc: Contemporary battles in Europe have proven that the age of infantry is about to begin. It is now time to develop new tactics, adopt use of the pike, and reform our medieval concept of auxiliary infantry into the main fighting force of our future armies.
entities.name: Infantry Tactics

desc: Reserve all state offices only for those who follow our religion. Heretics and heathens are no longer welcome in our realm.
entities.name: One State, One Religion

desc: It has become clear to us that we can no longer rely on foreign volunteers to fill up our army ranks, no matter how experienced and valuable they might be. Instead, we will develop a system that would allow us to levy our subjects, both German and non-German folk alike.
entities.name: Peasant Recruitment

desc: We shall grant further rights and privileges to our Prussian bishops, ensuring their loyalty in all matters.
entities.name: Prussian Bishops

desc: The German knights, and veterans of the Crusades and other wars are simply not numerous enough to remain the base of our armies. We must reorganize the army to incorporate domestic levies, regiments capable of replacing the knights on the battlefield.
entities.name: Reformed Order Army

desc: There is no greater symbol of power and military prowess than the heavy cavalry. While for many states the cavalry is made of nobles, every Teutonic Knight is also a member of our heavy cavalry, and undergoes the strict training of a crusader.
entities.name: Teutonic Heavy Cavalry

desc: We will put an end to the loose religious autonomy local bishops hold within our realm. All religious matters, from taxation to converting the populace, will be state matters from now on.
entities.name: Teutonic Religious Authority

desc: The knights who carved this land from the wilderness left something behind, a tradition of service, discipline, and arms as a way of life. Our noble houses carry that tradition still. They do not merely own the land; they are sworn to defend it.
entities.name: Teutonic Legacy

desc: Powered by Waterwheels, a Textile Mill can mass-produce Cloth at rapid speed.
entities.name: Textile Mill

desc: What is the point of winning wars if no songs are sung about our victories? Our court shall be a haven for poets, and our history shall be their source of inspiration.
entities.name: Royal Poets

desc: War elephants have been used in Indochina for generations, both for cavalry and as personal mounts for the kings, who would then engage in elephant duels with the opposing side's leader.
entities.name: War Elephants

desc: The Adige runs from the Alps through the center of our city and down to the Adriatic, carrying grain, timber, and finished goods along a route that has been profitable since Roman times. We invest in improving the river landings, clearing the shallower stretches, and negotiating passage rights with the communes downstream, turning a natural advantage into a managed commercial system. This continuous river trade fills our markets with goods from the mountains and gives our city a steady prosperity that rivals cannot easily cut off.
entities.name: The Adige

desc: The great banking fairs of ''Piacenza'' have made Genoese financiers the indispensable creditors of the Spanish crown and the arbiters of European capital flows for generations. The immense wealth that passes through our hands finds its way into the palaces and villas of our merchant nobility, who have built the most far-reaching commercial network in the Mediterranean world. This supremacy over European finance makes our merchant network more efficient than any rival's, and the trade it channels through Genoa fills our treasury with returns drawn from every major commercial circuit in Europe.
entities.name: The Age of the Genoese

desc: We are the only nation to house the sacred Ark of the Covenant after it was secretly taken by Menelik I with divine assistance thousands of years ago. It is hidden away from public view, lest someone attempt to steal our sacred national treasure. Replicas of the Ark are placed in every single one of our churches as a reminder that our rule is blessed by God.
entities.name: The Ark of the Covenant

desc: Parallel to other institutes within our administration, this branch of our government is in charge of preventing corruption. The censors are tasked with keeping palatial intrigues and malfeasance in check, often seen as the eyes and ears of the Emperor.
entities.name: The Censorate

desc: A new philosophical concept called constitutionalism has been developed, wherein the government accepts legal limits to its power through established law rather than ruling by arbitrary decree. While some may find this idea intriguing, it is obviously not popular with monarchs...
entities.name: The Constitution

desc: Known for their slender and elongated hull design, the Kilwan Dhow is famous for being the backbone of our maritime trade that connects our ports to faraway lands. The ship itself is a manifestation of our mastery of shipwright, as our workers utilize palm trees for a sturdy body as well as locally-grown cotton for the sails.
entities.name: Kilwan Dhow

desc: The Eight Banner System is the core of our society and military. Through hereditary membership and grants of land and income, the Banners are granted elite status, and for good reason — from the conquest of our neighbors to future campaigns, our dominance depends on their might.
entities.name: The Eight Banners

desc: Our legislative body must remain distinct from any outside influences, in an effort to preserve our cultural identity and independence. Inspired by Anglo-Norman fiscal institutions, our parliamentary procedures will surely bolster crown revenue and improve administrative oversight.
entities.name: The Exchequer

desc: The ongoing trade deficit between Europe and China has caused a shortage of silver bullion not only in Europe, but all over the world. Switching from silver to gold coinage will allow new coins to enter circulation and encourage trade to flow in ever greater amounts.
entities.name: The Gold Standard

desc: Like Mansa Mūsā of Mali once did, our rulers can travel to Mecca on pilgrimage, fulfilling the fifth pillar of Islam and bearing gold as a symbol of our wealth and power. Like the Malian pilgrims of old, the world will gasp in wonder at the wealth and grandeur of Songhai.
entities.name: The Ḥajj

desc: Following our new system of contributions, we can underwrite a bank for members to use. Backed by the resources of the League, a letter of credit from the bank will be as good as cash. This, as well as other financial instruments, will give our merchants an edge over those in other countries.
entities.name: The Hansa Bank

desc: The Kilwan Zambuc is a smaller variation of the Kilwan Dhow, and it is primarily used for local trade, transportation of goods and pottery between the various city-states across the Swahili Coast, as well as serving as trustworthy faring vessels for short distances.
entities.name: Kilwan Zambuc

desc: The death of Genghis Khān created a power vacuum that led to people who should have known better vying to replace him. However, through strategic marriages, we have consolidated our claim to descent from the Great Khān himself, and the warriors of the steppes will declare their loyalty to us accordingly.
entities.name: The Mantle of the Great Khān

desc: The Mestnichestvo is an ancient system that assigns positions of state to people based on the antiquity of their lineage and the seniority they hold within their families. The most tangible demonstration of this system involved the seating order of Boyars at the Tsar's table, which reflects their individual rank and precedence.
entities.name: Mestnichestvo

desc: Our veteran sergeants are some of the most despicable and corrupt men imaginable, but that does not mean they are useless. Rather than leave them to be beggars on our streets when their service ends, we can put these old dogs to work. We shall make them into drill sergeants and quartermasters so that their unique skills can be put to use.
entities.name: The Old and Infirm

desc: The old structure of the Church formulated by Emperor Justinian is still in full effect in Orthodoxy. Although the patriarch of Rome believes himself to be above all else, for the ''authentic'' Church, the cities of Constantinople, Alexandria, Antioch, and Jerusalem remain far more important.
entities.name: The Pentarchy

desc: We are proud to be the home of so many of the most renowned philosophers of these enlightened times. These thinkers produce a constant stream of groundbreaking ideas, which are stimulating advances in all fields, from the most trifling to the most vital.
entities.name: The Philosophes

desc: Through incredible savvy and political maneuvering within the complex imperial administrative systems of our neighbors, we have successfully negotiated the restoration of our national Patriarchate. This diplomatic victory grants us spiritual and legal jurisdiction over all Serbian populations stretching from the Adriatic coast to the middle Danube, effectively allowing the Church to act as a 'Guardian of all Serbs'. It enables the maintenance of a shadow administration that collects tithes, manages local education, and keeps the flame of our traditions alive among a population that remains unified by a single, powerful faith.
entities.name: The Rebirth of the Patriarchate

desc: The red-haired barbarians from Europe may be uncivilized and ill-mannered, but they do know how to make artillery and firearms of good quality. Importing and duplicating their weapons will give our army a significant advantage against all invaders.
entities.name: The Red Cannon

desc: Contact with foreigners from other continents has given us interesting new ideas about our gods. The ''Quetzalcōātl'' prophecy unveils a reality beyond myth — a glimpse of truth. ''Quetzalcōātl'', 'the Feathered Serpent', will soon return and herald a transformative era, vanquishing darkness for enlightenment. Symbolizing cosmic fusion, he will bridge matter and spirit, restoring balance and elevating human consciousness.
entities.name: The Return of Quetzalcōātl

desc: As time goes on, and the Crusades start to fade from the memory of our people, the importance of having the Pope's ear increases. We ingratiate ourselves until we are the closest confidantes to the Supreme Pontiff. Naturally, our devotion to his service will benefit us enormously — and why not enjoy our hard-won privileges?

facets.branch: The Right Hand of the Pope

entities.name: The Right Hand of the Pope

desc: Caravans have been trading between the Sahel and the Mediterranean for ages, the benefits from this trade greatly outweighing the perils of crossing the burning sands of the Sahara.
entities.name: The Sahel Trade

desc: Every member of our confederation contributes valuable resources to our cause. Our decentralized approach to governing this alliance of states serves a greater purpose, so we cannot break into civil war when disagreements arise between towns, cities, or our cantons.
entities.name: Principles of the Confederation

desc: A staple beverage of our society, Tea has come to dominate social gatherings, becoming the choice drink of many. This will undoubtedly lead to not only new varieties being cultivated, but a production boom as well.
entities.name: The Tea Trade

desc: We have expanded the ancient religious fair into a massive international trade expo that links the Balkan hinterland with the Mediterranean maritime routes. By granting safe passage to merchants, Thessalonica has become the premier marketplace for fur, grain, and Western textiles. This economic vitality allows the King to bypass the local nobility by funding his administration through sales taxes and customs duties.
entities.name: The Fair of Saint Demetrios

desc: Restored as a bulwark in Macedonia, the Kingdom has revived its heritage by inviting Lombard and northern Italian military engineers to modernize its defenses. These ''Lombard Guards'' serve as the professional core of the army, utilizing advanced pike-and-shot formations to hold the Vardar valley against the encroaching enemy armies. Their presence ensures that our nation remains a bastion of Western military theory in the heart of the Balkans.
entities.name: The Lombard Guard

desc: Our hunters have tapped into the vast wilderness of the northern mountains, establishing a lucrative trade in high-quality pelts for the luxury markets of Italy and France. By regulating the trapping seasons and protecting the trade routes to the Danube, we have secured a consistent source of 'furry gold' for the royal treasury. This industry funds the modernization of our northern fortifications against the rising power of the northern principalities.
entities.name: The Macedonian Fur Trade

desc: Boniface of Montferrat, crowned King of Thessalonica in 1204, established a northern Latin kingdom that controlled the vital Via Egnatia and much of Macedonia, creating a wealthy and strategically important realm whose capital became a glittering center of Frankish court life, Italian commerce, and Orthodox–Catholic coexistence under Latin domination. Although repeatedly threatened by surrounding enemies, the kingdom's barons maintained a proud martial tradition and a flourishing economy based on grain, wine, and transit trade, ensuring that Thessalonica remained one of the brightest jewels in the Frankokratia.
entities.name: The Thessalonican Crown

desc: Thessalonica has founded a royal university dedicated to the study of a diverse array of matters, blending Italian theory with local Balkan experience. This institution produces the finest students in the Frankokratia, capable of marvels. Our graduates are in high demand across the Latin world, making the Kingdom the intellectual center of innovation.
entities.name: The University of Thessalonica

desc: The King has commissioned the total resurfacing and fortification of the ancient Via Egnatia, the vital artery connecting the Adriatic to the Bosporus. By establishing permanent garrisons along this road, we have eliminated banditry and drastically reduced the travel time for both merchants and armies. This logistical masterpiece cements Thessalonica as the indispensable bridge between the Latin Empire and the Western European powers.
entities.name: The Via Egnatia Restoration

desc: Domesticated for centuries, the yak is the backbone of Tibetan pastoral life. It provides meat, milk, wool, transport, and fuel — even its dried dung is a vital source of fuel on the treeless plateau. In times of need or celebration, yak butter fills our lamps and cups.
entities.name: The Yak

desc: How old does a boy have to be before he is a man? How old must he be before he can die for his country? Some rulers are squeamish; We, on the other hand, are an equal opportunity butcher.
entities.name: The Young can Serve

desc: A building used by artists to perform plays, concerts and other theatrical works.
entities.name: Theater

desc: While monarchies and republics may be content to simply exist in the world, a Holy State requires a deeper, more spiritual calling. This Divine Cause shall guide our hand towards a glorious destiny.
entities.name: Divine Cause

desc: Religion is the pillar of our entire society, and as such, the nature of our faith plays a role in all facets of our culture. No major decisions can be made without carefully considering the religious perspective of taking these actions.
entities.name: Nature of our Faith

desc: The Virgin Mary is a key figure in our beliefs, as she fulfilled the Old Covenant by carrying within her the New Covenant in the figure of Christ. As such, being the bearer of Christ God-incarnate, she was literally the Mother of God, and has a place of prominence above all other saints.
entities.name: Theotokos

desc: Where our horde has passed, the grass will never grow again; the land will no longer feed our enemies. Day and night will pass, and the ground will stay silent, no crops to be collected. Some hungers you cannot escape.
entities.name: There Shall Be No Grass

desc: We have moved away from loose clan associations toward a semi-professional core of infantry based in our central urban axis. This modernization allows us to respond to threats with a speed and discipline that traditional tribal levies cannot match.
entities.name: A Centralized Levy System

desc: We assert a prestigious, albeit disputed, descent from the French Royalty, granting our diplomats a unique standing in the courts of Europe. This perceived noble pedigree allows us to negotiate as peers with the Italian city-states and the Papacy, securing alliances that would be denied to common Balkan warlords.
entities.name: French Blood Claims

desc: We have funded the construction of grand cathedrals and fortifications, blending Gothic and Byzantine styles to showcase our wealth and piety. This architectural splendor serves to legitimize our rule in the eyes of the Church and our subjects, turning our cities into symbols of permanence.
entities.name: Mecenas of the Arts

desc: Our name has become synonymous with the state itself, allowing us to integrate various ethnic groups under a single banner. By promoting the most talented individuals regardless of their origins, we have created a meritocratic bureaucracy that outshines our feudal rivals.
entities.name: Princeps Albaniae

desc: Our house has risen to preeminence by masterfully navigating the clashes among the clans, positioning the Thopia family as the arbiters of Albanian sovereignty. By weaving together a complex web of alliances, we will secure the first true ''Princeps Albaniae'' title recognized by both the East and the West. With the lion of our crest flying over the ramparts of the coast, we have established a professionalized administrative core that outpaces the primitive feudalism of our rivals, ensuring our house remains the apex predator of the Adriatic shore.
entities.name: The Lion of Thopia

desc: We have expanded our commercial influence by offering state protection to all merchant vessels flying the Thopia banner. This naval security has turned our ports into the preferred hubs for Levant trade, siphoning wealth away from the decaying ports of our rivals.
entities.name: The Thopia Merchant Marine

desc: The Three Jewels, or Three Refuges, are the three supports in which a follower of Buddhism takes refuge. These refuges are the ''Buddha'', the enlightened one; the ''Dharma'', the teachings of the Buddha; and the ''Saṃgha'', the monastic community that preserves the Dharma.
entities.name: Three Jewels

desc: Our land is plentiful, with many crops, but the method of cultivating maize, beans, and squash together is one of our greatest agricultural achievements. Grown together, these crops have a better output than they do when planted separately.
entities.name: Three Sisters Agriculture

gate: any international organizations member of international organization has policy
any international organizations member of international organization has policy

desc: The Three Teachings are a philosophy originating from China which combines the teachings of Confucianism, Daoism and Buddhism into a harmonious, singular teaching. Confucianism represents the ideology of the law while Daoism is the worldview of the radical intellectuals. These two opposite ends of the philosophical spectrum would then be connected with the philosophies of Buddhism.
entities.name: Three Teachings

desc: Although our faithful have been persecuted by heretics for centuries, our beliefs have persevered. No matter how many times they bring us down, we will rise again!
entities.name: Thriving Under Persecution

desc: To combat the lawlessness of the borderlands and the rise of banditry, the Thessalian state institutionalized the ''Armatoloi'', a system where local leaders are given official military jurisdiction over specific districts. This administrative layer bridges the gap between the central Despot and the rural peasantry, creating a disciplined paramilitary class responsible for collecting taxes and maintaining internal security. By turning former outlaws into state-sanctioned peacekeepers, the despotate will achieve a level of domestic stability that will allow for renewed economic growth and a more centralized form of governance.
entities.name: Armatole Administration

desc: As the Balkans face increasing instability, the Despots of Thessaly patronize the construction of monastic complexes atop the inaccessible sandstone pillars of Meteora. These 'monasteries in the sky' serve a dual purpose: They function as spiritual beacons for the Orthodox faith and as high-altitude treasuries where the state's wealth and holy relics can be protected from marauding mercenaries. By centralizing the spiritual authority of the region in such defensible positions, the Despotate ensures that the local identity remains anchored in Orthodoxy even when the central government is under duress.
entities.name: Meteora Sanctuaries

desc: Survival in Northern Greece requires a departure from traditional Byzantine field tactics in favor of a sophisticated system of partisan warfare. The Thessalian military doctrine will evolve to focus on ''Klephthic'' tactics, utilizing the deep ravines and dense forests of the Pindus mountains to bleed enemy supply lines dry through constant harassment. This cultural shift toward guerilla resistance meant that any occupying force will face a landscape where every shepherd is a scout and every mountain path a potential ambush site, making the conquest of Thessaly a logistical nightmare for foreign empires.
entities.name: Raiders of the Pindus

desc: In the chaos following the Fourth Crusade, the rulers of Thessaly turned to the semi-nomadic Vlach populations of ''Great Wallachia'' to bolster their depleted ranks. By granting these fierce herdsmen autonomy and grazing rights in exchange for military service, the Despotate secured a loyal caste of light infantry and skirmishers who thrived in the rugged Pindus range. These soldiers, known for their mobility and devastating shock tactics, became the primary deterrent against Latin knights and Epirote rivals alike, turning the mountain passes into lethal bottlenecks for any invading force.
entities.name: The Wallachian Scutari

desc: The transformation of the Thessalian plains into a modernized agricultural breadbasket will be completed through the establishment of the Thessalian Grain Exchange. Moving away from medieval sharecropping, the state will encourage the use of the most modern techniques, while the Exchange will standardize prices and quality for the international market. This economic centralization will allow Thessaly to leverage its food surplus as a diplomatic tool, supplying the hungry armies of Europe during conflicts in exchange for political concessions and modern technology. The wealth generated by these exports will fund infrastructure that will link the mountain mines directly to the coastal ports, creating a truly integrated national economy.
entities.name: The Thessalian Grain Exchange

desc: The vast, fertile plains surrounding Larisa and Trikala offer a unique geographical advantage in a region dominated by mountains: the capacity for large-scale horse-rearing. Drawing upon the ancient legacy of the Thessalian cavalry, the Despots have established state-run stud farms to produce hardy, swift mounts capable of carrying armored riders across diverse terrains. This investment will transform the Despotate's military, allowing it to field a professional cavalry corps that could compete with enemy knights, providing the state with a decisive offensive tool on the open field.
entities.name: Thessalian Horse-Breeding

desc: Our monastic institutions have long served as centers of learning, debate, and spiritual discipline. Through rigorous training and a structured approach to education, our clerics maintain a high standard of intellectual and moral integrity. These foundations will support wise governance and cultural flourishing across our enlightened realm.
entities.name: Monastic Education System

desc: Years of negotiations with the Holy Father have resulted in our embracing Catholicism, with the blessing of our Polish neighbors and the Pope himself, during a turbulent and unique Christianization process. After our struggle to seek our spiritual identity subsided, it is clear that we have become a beacon of Catholicism, a shield against the heathens and heretics that threaten our society.
entities.name: Holy See Ties

desc: By offering Timar land grants to Sipâhi cavalrymen, they can use this new state-sponsored wealth to supply themselves and their retinue. This allows us to field more formidable cavalry forces.
entities.name: Timariots

desc: The architecture of Persia has been the envy of the known world for centuries. We must promote a new form of architecture, one that surpasses anything seen before, so that we may claim our birthright as the master of this art.
entities.name: Timurid Architecture

desc: As the great Genghis Khān dominated the steppes with the power of his cavalry, so will we triumph through our incomparable horses. Bred for the most rigorous combat, and mounted by the best-trained soldiers in the world, our cavalry will instill fear in the hearts of our enemies.
entities.name: Timurid Cavalry

desc: Ever since the initial Timurid expansion, our realm has attracted the greatest artisans and wise men of the age. Through our continued patronage of art, science, and literature, we have made the cities of Herāt and Samarkand the brightest jewels in the world.
entities.name: Timurid Renaissance

desc: 'Swift like the wind, gentle like the forest, aggressive like fire, immovable like a mountain.' The words of the great war master Sun Tzu shall be permanently etched into our family's history, and shall serve as our motto.
entities.name: Fūrinkazan

desc: We are descendants of the Genji of Kai, and have been traditionally appointed as its ''Shugo''. As such, we are intrinsically associated with it, and the famous horses from the province are already synonymous with our cavalry.
entities.name: Kai Shugo

desc: Traditional forms of martial arts have been practiced in our family for generations. Among them, there is particular emphasis on horse riding and mounted archery, making our mounted troops much more effective soldiers than those from other clans.
entities.name: Takeda-Ryū

desc: Strong leaders are better at safeguarding their domains than any number of imposing castles. Our generals must train hard, and earn the right to be called the 'Tiger of Kai'.
entities.name: Tiger of Kai

desc: Having been its Shugo for generations, our emblem is already synonymous with Mino. All who live there will fight under our banner.
entities.name: Bellflower Banner

desc: In our home province, the three big rivers of Kiso, Nagara, and Ibi often cause serious flooding in our rice fields. We should control this overflow, and use it to increase the yield in all provinces under our rule.
entities.name: Flood Control

desc: As the head of the Genji in Mino and its appointed ''Shugo'', we have led other local samurai for generations. Our domain occupies an advantageous position from which to control the neighboring regions.
entities.name: Genji of Mino

desc: We will create a system of provinces for the city-states that are integrated into our realm in an effort to centralize our power.
entities.name: Tlahtohcāyōtl

desc: Throughout our turbulent history, we never wavered in the face of conflict and insurmountable odds. We need to weaponize this determination, and use it to instill a sense of fervor into our people that will inspire them to fight harder than ever.
entities.name: Hardened by War

desc: The lands of southern India have long endured the incursions of foreign invaders and upstart warlords looking to establish their own domains. We must use the grand history of our ancient dynasty to lay claim to this land, as only we can bring stability and peace back to our rightful territory.
entities.name: Imperial Pandyan Legacy

desc: Our ancestors ruled the lands of Tamil Nadu for centuries. In these times when we are dominated by foreign invaders, we should rely on our ancient connections to this land to justify our rule.
entities.name: Ancient Roots

desc: Our people have developed an outstanding skill for diving for and harvesting pearls along our coasts. While this has clear economic benefits, the natural affinity our people have for water makes them excellent and easily-trained sailors, granting us an edge against our seafaring foes.
entities.name: Pearl-Diving Expertise

desc: Our troubled history records both victories and crushing defeats. If we want to endure and dominate as a significant power once more, we must develop a thorough understanding of how to best utilize our native terrain to delay and stall hostile armies until we can mount a direct resistance.
entities.name: Expert Resistance

desc: Taught to our soldiers for use in combat, it is an unarmed martial art featuring punches, grappling, and ground-fighting techniques. Proficiency in this art allows our troops to remain deadly in battle even if they lose their weapons.
entities.name: Toi Muay
