By implementing a sophisticated system of tariffs and warehouse laws, the state will be able to fill its coffers without placing a heavy burden on its own agricultural population. This trade-heavy economy will allow Vidin to modernize its infrastructure, building paved roads and stone bridges that connect the Danube to the interior of the Balkan Peninsula.
entities.name: Vidin's Custom Houses

desc: The numerous invaders of our Hindu people have shown time and time again the same weakness: the tendency to fight amongst themselves. We must be ready at all times to exploit this to our own ends.
entities.name: Adroit Diplomacy

desc: For the City of Victory to be worthy of its name, we must have an army that can bring about these namesake triumphs. We will ensure our troops are well-trained and take great pride in their service.
entities.name: An Army for the City of Victory

desc: Horses from Arabia are far superior to our local breeds. We will use our trade connections to ensure that we have a steady supply for our military.
entities.name: Arabian Horses

desc: We must resist the Muslim invasion on all fronts. The musical traditions of the Northern States are already showing signs of foreign influence. This is blasphemy, because we all know that music is a divine art form that originated with the Devas and Devis themselves. We will show the Hindu people that we are committed to defending this holy art form.
entities.name: Carnatic Music

desc: Vijayanagar — the 'City of Victory' — is the heart of our state, and will one day become the heart of the entire Hindu. Let it shine as a beacon of culture and tradition even as it fends off the Muslim invaders!
entities.name: City of Victory

desc: The cultural diversity of India is one of our defining traits. By allowing our various settlements to rule by their own customs, we will assure their loyalty and integration into our society.
entities.name: Cultural Integration

desc: As our state grows, so do our administrative burdens on the government and the risk of revolt. To counteract this, we shall establish a system of decentralized rule, where settlements can manage their own minor issues, only seeking intervention from the central court for severe matters.
entities.name: Decentralized Rule

desc: The military application of gunpowder is not yet widespread, but it has the potential to mold the future of warfare. We must explore the utility and benefits of gunpowder.
entities.name: First Indian Artillery

desc: Harsh punishments — including being put to death — are how we uphold law and order in this society. By establishing and strictly enforcing a harsh penal code, we ensure criminals fear the consequences of their actions, creating stability through the certainty of punishment.
entities.name: Harsh Penal Code

desc: India has been subject to Muslim threats for far too long. Heathen empires claim their rule from Delhi in the north, yet their beliefs and government are in direct opposition to what our people want. No, a new seat of power must be established — and Vijayanagar shall be the new Throne of India!
entities.name: Indian Throne

desc: Our territory is situated on one of the key trade routes from East to West. We must ensure that our ports are safe and secure so that visiting captains will land there... giving us the opportunity to tax them.
entities.name: Promotion of Trade

desc: ''Dharma'' is a major pillar of our religious and social values. Our state can only be just and virtuous if our rulers themselves embody and live in accord with dharma.
entities.name: Rule According to Dharma

desc: Our society is built on agriculture in the rather arid Karnakassala area. The ''bunds'', also called ''anecut'', provide our cities and fields alike with much-needed fresh water.
entities.name: The Bunds

desc: The ancient seasonal routes that shepherds use to move their flocks between highland summer pastures and lowland winter grazing — the ''drailles'' — are among the most carefully maintained paths in the region, crossing passes and valleys in patterns refined over centuries. The communities along them have developed systems of collective grazing rights, waypoint shelters, and dispute arbitration that turn transhumance from a seasonal risk into a reliable cycle of production. This managed seasonality of the pastoral economy gives our highlands a food-producing capacity that purely sedentary agriculture cannot match.
entities.name: The Drailles

desc: The alpine flora of our region provides us with an extraordinary pharmacopoeia — gentian, arnica, valerian, and dozens of others — and the communities here have developed traditions of herbal preparation and botanical knowledge that keep these isolated valley populations healthier than their lowland counterparts. This is the result not of folk magic but systematic observation, transmitted from generation to generation in the form of practical recipes and the accumulated memory of what had worked and what had not. These ''Herbes des Alpes'' give our healers tools that the physicians of great cities, dependent on imported remedies, cannot easily replicate.
entities.name: Herbes des Alpes

desc: The mountain terrain has bred a tradition of light, mobile foot soldiers who could fight in conditions that make cavalry and heavy armor useless — men who need no road, no level ground, and no supply line longer than their own backs can carry. The valleys of our culture produce soldiers accustomed to cold, altitude, and sudden ambush, capable of holding narrow passes against forces many times their number. This tradition of alpine warfare gives our armies a quality in difficult terrain that opponents trained on the open lowland battlefield are consistently unprepared for.
entities.name: Alpine Infantry

desc: Rousseau's idealization of mountain simplicity, followed by the poets and painters of the Romantic movement, transformed the Alps from a barrier to be crossed into a destination to be sought. Our valleys, peaks, and ancient communities became mirrors for everything that educated Europe felt it had lost, drawing visitors, naturalists, and artists in numbers that the passes had never seen for any other reason. This reputation for embodying a kind of unspoiled authenticity gives our culture an influence far beyond what our political weight could command — people come to us to understand themselves, and they carry home memories that outlast any treaty.
entities.name: Alpine Nature

desc: Mont Cenis, the Col de Montgenèvre, the Col de Larche — the great transalpine routes connecting the Mediterranean world to northern Europe all pass through our territory, making even modest lords the indispensable gatekeepers of international movement. Merchants, armies, papal legates, and pilgrims all pay to cross our ground, and the traffic that passes through our hands gives us information, contacts, and leverage that purely inland powers could never accumulate. This position as the crossroads of transalpine exchange makes our diplomacy unusually well-informed and our merchants unusually well-connected.
entities.name: The Alpine Passes

desc: The isolation of our mountain communities has forced them to develop functional self-governance long before larger states thought to organize them — village councils managing collective pastures, local courts arbitrating disputes, and elected officers coordinating the resources that kept valley communities alive through the winter. These institutions run on knowledge of local conditions that no governor sent from outside could replicate, and they have accumulated over generations a tradition of deliberation and record-keeping that gives our communities an administrative depth disproportionate to their size. This ''Conseilh de Valat'' tradition makes our governance unusually competent and our subjects unusually engaged in the management of their own affairs.
entities.name: Valley Councils

desc: Across the Carpathian basin, the ''Voievod'' stands as both sovereign ruler in Wallachia and Moldavia and as a high crown office in Transylvania and the Hungarian kingdom. The office binds the ruler to a powerful nobility through ancient custom and elective right.
entities.name: Voievodate

desc: The ''Voivode'' is a military leader with regional administrative authority, defending territory and maintaining order. A voivode can be useful in overcoming the challenges posed by the limited means of communication available, as they have the authority to make crucial decisions without waiting for approval.
entities.name: Voivode

desc: Among the South Slavs, the ''Vojvoda'' serves as a high military commander, leading the nobles into battle and administering frontier lands. The title is preserved through generations of war, carried by princely warlords and resistance leaders alike.
entities.name: Vojvodstvo

desc: During the Hussite Wars, our armies relied on wagon forts called ''Wagenburg'' to win battles against superior forces. While we may not always deploy wagons, the principle remains: infantry sharpshooters fighting from prepared defensive positions become our standard doctrine.
entities.name: Wagenburg

desc: There is almost no place in Asia that has not felt the influence of the Mongol conquests. After the fall of the once-great empire forged by Genghis Khān, the land is finally recovering from being trampled by his horses.
entities.name: Wake of the Mongol Horde

desc: Under the reformists in our nation, we have taken the radical step of legally abolishing serfdom, before many of our neighbors. By transforming the peasantry from 'chattel' into 'taxable subjects', we have centralized the state's fiscal power and broken the absolute control of the rural boyars. This social revolution provides the Voivode with a more direct relationship with the people, creating a more mobile and economically active population capable of supporting a modernizing central administration.
entities.name: The Abolition of Serfdom

desc: Under the patronage of high officials, we have established the Princely Academy of Saint Sabbas, bringing Italian and Greek professors to our capital. This investment in high education has created a generation of 'Philosopher-Diplomats' who are as comfortable discussing Latin rhetoric as they are negotiating secret treaties with our neighbors. By turning our capital into an intellectual beacon, we have ensured that our administrative elite remains the most sophisticated in the Balkans, capable of outmaneuvering anyone at every turn.
entities.name: The Diplomat Schools

desc: We will introduce a culture of brutal psychological warfare and absolute law and order in Wallachia. By purging the corrupt boyars and imposing strict legal codes, we will consolidate princely power and transform the military into a centralized force loyal only to the Voivode. This ruthless reputation will serve as a primary deterrent for the forces of our enemies.
entities.name: The Order of the Dragon Influence

desc: In 1330, Basarab I defeated the Hungarian King Charles Robert, securing Wallachian independence through superior mountain tactics. This victory proved that a smaller, localized force could utilize the treacherous Carpathian passes to dismantle imperial armies, setting a military precedent for the next five centuries. Our troops are now experts in hit-and-run warfare and utilize the terrain to bleed invaders long before they reach the Danubian plains.
entities.name: The Battle of Posada Legacy

desc: According to historical tradition, Radu Negru crossed the Carpathians from Transylvania to found the Principality of Wallachia, and similar stories have been told about the foundation of other Principalities. This 'founding descent' or ''Descălecatul'' represents the migration of Romanian elites and the establishment of the first sovereign Țara Românească (Romanian Land), independent of foreign hegemonies. This event marks the birth of a distinct Romanian statehood, separate from the surrounding empires, but deeply rooted in Orthodox and Latin heritage.
entities.name: The Descent of the Vlachs

desc: A mix of white and purple beads made from different kinds of shells, wampum are used for many purposes, such as recording treaties and oral histories, facilitating diplomacy, and functioning as a system of exchange in trade. Wampum appears wherever our people tread.
entities.name: Wampum

desc: Communities of learned scholars of many faiths live in our lands, offering religious instruction to all who will listen.
entities.name: Wandering Scholars

desc: A network of frontier settlements linked together by immense bonfires, which can be seen from a huge distance when lit, will allow us to quickly alert multiple settlements at once to threats, and therefore respond far faster.
entities.name: War Bonfires

desc: The War College serves as a place where veteran officers educate and train the coming generation of generals, ensuring the superiority of our army.
entities.name: War College

desc: The nature of war is strongly influenced by which actors are involved. Those with superior capabilities can wage war for longer periods, and thus inter-state wars are becoming increasingly more common.

mods.label: War with No Casus Belli Cost

entities.name: Recurrent Warfare

desc: The power of the state is directly tied to its military capacity. The more populous a country is, the grander its army can become. We must take an aggressive approach toward annexing as much land as possible in peace treaties to seize the advantage over our neighbors.
entities.name: Aggressive Demands

desc: Victory on the battlefield is the result of more than just good execution of battle plans and war strategies — it is a divine intervention in our favor. Therefore, our right to conquer and annex new territories for which we have spilled blood is an extension of the divine will that champions our supremacy.
entities.name: Divine Right to Conquer

desc: Wars are always ugly affairs that bring suffering to both sides. Emphasizing this fact, and appealing to our opposition's reason and logic, will surely give us a significant advantage when negotiating the inevitable border changes.
entities.name: Arguments of Reason

desc: The ''warachikuy'' is a holy ceremony where young men are tested in their skills, valor, and wits, as well as their physical abilities like racing, marksmanship, combat, and durability for extended lengths of sleep deprivation. Those who pass these tests with excellence are promoted to the rank of officers for our ever-growing army.
entities.name: Warachikuy

desc: Our ties with the Warka have given us great knowledge in hunting and gathering food. Through these practices, we ensure our people stay fed, even during long winters.
entities.name: Warka Ties

desc: Over two remarkable centuries of warfare, Lithuanian warlord dukes transformed a loose federation of tribes into a unified warrior state. They mounted fierce resistance against the aggression of Catholic holy orders, while simultaneously conquering vast territories in the East. These legendary achievements continue to inspire our military leaders today.
entities.name: Warlord Dukes

desc: Our society is remarkably dynamic, offering commoners, also known as ''mācēhualtin'', the path to become ''pīpiltin'', or noble, by exceptional military service through the ''tlahuiztli'' honor dress rank system. This unique opportunity for upward mobility grants our people a distinct advantage over those in neighboring societies.
entities.name: Warrior Societies

desc: We may not be the largest tribe in terms of sheer number, but our tribal nature gives us something that others lack: unity! Our warriors fight as brothers and stand together on the field of battle. So long as we maintain this tradition, we cannot lose!
entities.name: Warriors Unity

desc: We will need to be wary of forces trying to convert our people, or seduce them back to our previous faith. By publicly declaring these preachers to be malicious and hostile, we can prepare our people for these interactions and more easily reinforce religious orthodoxy.
entities.name: Defense Against Heretics

desc: We do not build, we do not trade. We take what we need... and sometimes more. Our warriors have kept an attentive watch upon foreign merchants and their passage, and we now know the safest paths for transporting our goods.
entities.name: Watchers of the Silk Road

desc: The water frame is a spinning frame used in the textile industry to produce cotton thread. This innovation will contribute to the establishment of large textile factories powered by water wheels.
entities.name: Water Frame

desc: The fertile soils, forests, and mines of Ānāhuac yield immense riches, sustaining our growth and imperial ambitions. Properly utilizing these resources will bolster our affluence.
entities.name: Wealth of Mesoamerica

desc: Military importance has increased much more in recent years. As such, better and new methods of producing armament for our soldiers are needed, and entire factories dedicated for such purpose are being established.
entities.name: Weapon Factory

desc: An association of craftsmen responsible for the production of various weapons, guilds such as this are a pillar for state defense, supplying the common soldier with arms tailored to specific martial needs and volume.
entities.name: Weaponsmith

desc: Various weapons such as swords, pikes, and bows make up the core Weaponry of every army. Using various materials, the Weaponry Manufactory creates melee and simple ranged weapons of all types.
entities.name: Weapon Manufactory

desc: The ever-increasing demand of weapons both for our armies and our hunting operations requires us to increase the capabilities of the Weaponry production.
entities.name: Weapon Workshop

desc: Many would-be conquerors eye our lands with covetous intent. If we are to defend our territory, we must set up a garrison system, aimed at rapidly responding to hostile invasions. Through the recruitment of local troops, our defensive prowess will be supplemented through supplies and more efficient logistics.
entities.name: Wèi Suǒ

desc: Trade between sub-Saharan Africa and North Africa has been part of our identity for centuries. The journey across the vast desert, even with the many years of accumulated experience, is always taxing and dangerous. The key to securing trade in this region is the Caravan Stop, a place where merchants and their caravans can rest and refresh themselves on their way through the desert.
entities.name: Saharan Caravan Stop

desc: Even before our Empire existed, the great Wagadou, the Ghana Empire that preceded us, sold Slaves across the desert to the Arabs. We have followed suit all these years, supplying the Arab world with a vast number of Slaves. Now the Europeans clamor for even more Slaves to work their holdings in the so-called New World. We have had little report, but the amount of Slaves they demand is truly stunning, and they keep coming back, sometimes even raiding our shores and abducting our subjects. The time has come to impose order on this trade and restrict the Europeans to select commercial ports where they will purchase, not steal, Slaves.
entities.name: West African Slave Trade

desc: Northern Germany is home to many Catholic strongholds, such as the Bishoprics in Münster and Paderborn. Monastic life and associated regional religious traditions have a generally positive effect on the literacy and education of our clergy, as there are plenty of opportunities for them to further educate themselves. This access to learning also helps the Holy Mother Church by creating an intellectual flock well-suited to priestly duties.
entities.name: Land of Monasteries

desc: Whales, porpoises, walruses, seals... everything the sea gives us, we hunt.
entities.name: Whale Hunters

desc: Viennese Classicism is a transformative force in music. Our best composers' works shall revolutionize Western musical tradition through bold, trend-setting innovation of symphonic, operatic, and chamber arrangements.
entities.name: Wiener Klassik

desc: Windmills come in various shape and sizes, as well as diverse sails structure and mechanisms, but they all serve to harness the power of wind to crush grain. As a result, the nutritious value of crops can be greatly improved, and transformed into a wider range of prepared foods.
entities.name: Windmill

desc: The ever-growing demand for refined fermented drinks has led to the creation of vast production centers where tradition meets industry. Ancient methods of wines are scaled up to serve bustling cities and far-reaching trade networks, ensuring no cup is left empty.
entities.name: Winery Manufactory

desc: The hussars were originally light cavalry troops used for scouting, but with the decline of the old feudal army, we have switched over to professional regiments, the core of which shall be made up of these heavier, armored hussars. The fear of these winged warriors shall make our enemies tremble in the night like children!
entities.name: Winged Hussars

desc: In the Polish Crown, the ''Wojewoda'' is a powerful magnate appointed by the king to administer a voivodeship and lead its regional sejmik. Holders of this dignity sit on the royal council and command significant influence over provincial affairs, often outshining the king's own reach in their lands.
entities.name: Województwo

desc: The 'Compute Army' was based around an annual budget calculated and approved by the Sejm. The idea behind this was to provide the Commonwealth with a stable standing army for defense.
entities.name: Wojsko Komputowe

desc: The production of elegant illustrations, artworks, and books using this printing method has captivated our people's attention, and our master printers constantly strive to perfect their techniques. Woodblock printing has become part of our culture and, with recent improvements to and expansion of our literary production, will further elevate our prestige.
entities.name: Woodblock Printing

desc:
Keen minds preserve knowledge
Known from ages past
Sung in the sundown
Sagas are our inheritance
Encouraged by the establishment
Each country will have its own
entities.name: Write New Sagas

desc: What is a society but the sum of its legacy? A written alphabet, therefore, is but the first step towards immortalizing our culture, as well as the foundation of building an educated, well-functioning society.
entities.name: Written Alphabet

desc: Xuánzàng, a Chinese Buddhist monk who lived during the Táng dynasty in the 7th century, embarked on a seventeen-year overland trip to India in order to visit it centers of learning and to gather a great number of Buddhism texts. Among other places he visited Nālandā, where he learned from the best masters, and on his return to China he brought with him more than a thousand documents, which made a great contribution to Eastern Buddhism. His trip and his records served as basis for the tale of ''Journey to the West'', in which a monk is tasked by the Buddha to travel to India in search of some holy texts. accompanied among others by the Monkey King, Sūn Wùkōng.
entities.name: Xuánzàng Travels

desc: In order to ensure that messengers could travel fast enough to keep up with Mongol armies, Genghis Khān instituted a system of relay stations or ''yams'', which were set up every 30-60 km to provide food, shelter and spare horses for Mongol army messengers. This allowed messages to travel as fast as a horse can gallop, with fatigue no longer slowing the speed a messenger could travel. By these means, our empire was able to overcome the logistical problems caused by the vast scale of the Pax Mongolica - at least temporarily.
entities.name: Yams of the Great Khān

desc: From the Tihāmah coast to the Ḥarāz mountains, our realm is home to countless fiercely independent tribes. While they have long resisted centralized authority, they are also our strength. By uniting them under a single cause, we can better utilize them as a workforce.
entities.name: Unite the Yemeni Tribes

desc: We are descendants of the Nitta clan, ancient rivals of the Ashikaga family. To some this is proof of the depths of our loyalty, while to others this makes us a natural enemy. We must cleverly utilize our lineage as a diplomatic weapon.
entities.name: Descendants of the Nitta

desc: Our homeland is mountainous and isolated. Fortunately, this also means that any potential conquerors would find our territory almost impossible to reach! Let us build our defenses so that they complement the natural protective strength of our geography — any invader will bitterly regret the day they turned their greedy eyes to our possessions.
entities.name: Isolated Heartland

desc: Let us forge a great western army to unite the squabbling states of Japan. Skillful generals, well-trained soldiers, and ironclad bravery will easily force the Easterners to their knees!
entities.name: The Western Army

desc: As many of the other clans squabble within themselves over who is the rightful heir to whom, they turn to us to mediate their disputes. Doing so puts us in a unique position of power and trust, making it easy for us to make new allies and contacts — and to destabilize our rivals.
entities.name: Succession Dispute Mediation

desc: A prominent Hindu school and philosophy, Yoga is a set of practices both physical and spiritual, with the purpose of controlling the mind and body. Performed for millennia, it has almost become synonymous with the path of enlightenment.
entities.name: Yoga

desc: Tax evasion is a timeless problem that even plagued our ancestors, but we may have found a solution: By compiling registers for districts and provinces, we will keep better track of the taxes owed to the central government by every plot. This taxation is largely determined based on the grain yield of every plot that undergoes survey.
entities.name: Yúlín Túcè

desc: Typically consisting of four acts, this brilliant display of dance and music is a colorful expression of the artistic heights that our society has achieved.
entities.name: Zájù

desc: One of the Five Pillars of Islam, Al-Zakāh is a form of almsgiving considered a religious obligation for any Muslim faithful. Giving money to help the needy is a mandatory charity for everyone that can afford it, and it is considered a tax.
entities.name: Al-Zakāh Wājib

desc: We are uniquely positioned at the confluence of wealth coming from China, India, and Europe. This not only benefits us financially, but it gives us great influence in the diplomatic game between Empires and foreign powers...
entities.name: Diplomacy Through Trade

desc: The dawn of a new age in seafaring has given us new opportunities to seek sustenance for our people. Whereas once we would only trade with the interior of Africa to procure crucial supplies of Sturdy Grains, Livestock, and Rice, we can now access new ports where food may be cheaper and more readily available.
entities.name: Food Imports

desc: Our abundant reserve of Gold from many sources across East Africa is the cornerstone of our economy. We must take full advantage of our reserves, and use our wealth to support and disseminate a strong currency. This will help us develop as a trading hub.
entities.name: Gold Trade of Africa

desc: Our superior ship technology allows us to sail further and for longer than any of our competitors, giving us a significant edge in any seafaring activity.
entities.name: Latitude Staves

desc: Originally a term to describe the inhabitants of inner Africa, particularly those of Bantu origin, these folk make up a substantial portion of our demographics. While they have many liberties and responsibilities, they are taxed accordingly in order to preserve these privileges. Their peaceful, relatively autonomous  place within our legal framework has led to the organic development of linguistic phenomena and new cultural traditions.
entities.name: Zanj Taxation

desc: In order to withstand the constant threat of Tatar raids, our ancestors have built a line of tightly positioned and well-defended forts. As our state grows larger, we should keep expanding this 'Abatis Line' to ensure our people are always protected from foreign attacks.
entities.name: Zasechnaya Cherta

desc: The highlands of Yemen have long been home to the Zaydī imamate, a center of learning and piety. Rooted in Islamic jurisprudence, theology, and rationalism, our scholars have ensured the rule of law and the moral integrity of our governance for centuries.
entities.name: Zaydī Scholarly Traditions

desc: Our people are descendants of the Zenata, a tribe best known for its vital wool production and skill at shepherding great herds of rams.
entities.name: Zenata Roots

desc: One of the most vital branches of the ''Three Departments and Six Ministries'', the central secretariat is responsible for the drafting and codification of many Imperial reforms and decrees.
entities.name: Zhōngshū Shěng

desc: Western travelers have named our land 'Ophir', and the riches of our gold mines and the Zambezi trade have made many visitors envious of us over the centuries. Let us leverage our control over these riches, and build permanent trade posts which can grow into sprawling cities.
entities.name: Controlling the Riches

requires.label: March to the Sound of Guns

desc: Adapting to the ever-changing tactics of war is no easy task. Against potentially superior enemies, we should rely on our own mobility over everything else. If we are able to pin our foes into a melee fight and send a regiment to flank and encircle their troops, we will be able to inflict devastating casualties.
entities.name: Cow-Horn Formations

desc: Discipline, preparation, and training are the factors that win battles. With this in mind, our commanders have successfully pioneered elaborate new tactics and organizational improvements. Let us make good use of these innovations by dividing our warriors into regiments and having them train regularly with their bows, assegais, daggers, and axes. Practice will also allow them to fight in formation without fear, defeating many more numerous enemies.
entities.name: Regular Training

desc: Traditionally, all of our administrators, even on the local level, have been direct relatives of our ruler. As our empire has grown and matured, however, it is time we show deference to the local knowledge of our subjects, and allow them to select their own administrators.
entities.name: Provincial Administrators

desc: Our lands are home to many skilled warriors. Among them are the Rozwi, disciplined fighters who stand ready to defend our people against any who would dare try to take our rightful lands from us.
entities.name: Empowering the Rozwi

desc: Beyond our borders lie vast expanses of land, studded with resources and herding grounds waiting eagerly to be claimed by our people. We must encourage settlement in these territories, and establish new towns.
entities.name: New Grounds for Resources

desc: Herding animals requires some skill, and is crucial for our survival. If we want to stabilize and expand our rule, we should expand our herding and grazing grounds as well.
entities.name: Experienced Herders

desc: With the arrival of new traders in the Zambezi area, the need has arisen to assert our authority. Anyone who wishes to trade here, and carry our precious Gold and Ivory to other shores, must first be approved by our ruler and pay a tax in order to be granted access. Should payments lapse, all foreign merchandise will be confiscated by our state.
entities.name: Mercantile Fees

desc: Our subordinate chiefs must prove their loyalty to us and the gods by traveling to the capital once a year, and using our flames to rekindle their own local fire. Once a year has passed, our army will extinguish their fire, and they will have to make a new journey.
entities.name: Rekindling the Royal Fires

desc: Our ruler is not only our leader in the temporal sense, but is also expected to speak on our behalf before the spirits of the dead. Prior to any campaign or harvest, he will communicate our respect and needs to the spirits of our ancestors through ceremonies or dances. Without a diligent ruler to maintain the royal graves and keep in close contact with our dead, things might go awry very quickly.
entities.name: Spokesman Before the Dead

desc: The astonishing stone buildings of Zimbabwe impress many visitors to our great country. Continuing our architectural traditions will allow us to expand our great cities of stone, which shall stand tall for centuries.
entities.name: Builders of Zimbabwe

desc: The land provides us with plenty of goods that foreign merchants have a keen interest in, but our abundant reserves of Gold shine brighter than any other. While such riches are a blessing, the state must tightly regulate all trade and ownership of Gold in order to help prevent the destructive effects of human greed and skullduggery from affecting  our bottom line.
entities.name: Gold Trade Restrictions

desc: The ''Gola Brda'' (Naked Hills) of the karst offer absolutely no cover for a traditional invading army, but they provide infinite hideouts and ambush points for our nimble warriors. We have developed a sophisticated tactical doctrine of 'Night-Raiding', where our clansmen descend silently from the peaks under the total cover of darkness to butcher enemy camps, spike their cannons, and vanish back into the mist before the first light of dawn. This psychological warfare ensures that any occupying force in the lowlands is driven to the brink of madness by constant fear and physical exhaustion, making our territory a nightmare they eventually choose to abandon, while adapting our armies to any hostile territory.
entities.name: Guerillas of the Scrub

desc: Our identity is forged at the violent meeting point of the high limestone mountain and the salt of the sea. By maintaining firm control over the strategic coastal towns of the coast, the lords of Zeta act as the indispensable maritime gateway for the entire Serbian interior, controlling the flow of salt, silk, and silver. We utilize the considerable wealth generated from Mediterranean trade and customs duties to fund our independent-minded mountain clans and build massive stone fortifications that guard the shoreline. This ensures that Zeta remains a maritime power in its own right, projecting influence far beyond the rugged cliffs of the hinterland.
entities.name: Maritime Fiefdoms of the Adriatic

desc: To finally transition from a loose tribal federation to a modern, centralized state, we have introduced a rigorous and uncompromising new legal code that strictly suppresses the destructive tradition of blood feuds and centralizes the power of the ''Vladika''. By replacing ancient tribal law with a uniform system of state justice and taxation, we unify the competing clans into a single, cohesive national body. This reform turns the disparate and often chaotic energy of the mountains into a focused, disciplined national force capable of reclaiming our ancestral coastlines and expanding our borders with the efficiency of a modern European power.
entities.name: The Code of the Black Mountain

desc: We have mastered the lucrative and dangerous art of the international mercenary contract. By providing elite Zetan mountain infantry and veteran sailors to the italians for their various overseas wars, we secure access to modern Western armaments, gunpowder, and a powerful naval ally in the Adriatic. This connection ensures that our realm's independence is protected by powerful friends, while we simultaneously maintain and sharpen our ancient warrior traditions at home. It provides us with a professional military edge that few other Balkan states can hope to match.
entities.name: The Italian Condottieri

desc: The coast may be temporarily lost to the shifting sands of imperial power, but the karst mountains remain our eternal and impregnable fortress. Our monastery-stronghold of Cetinje, nestled high in the Lovćen mountains where the air is thin and the slopes are steep, is the core of our nation. This city embodies a long-term national strategy of 'Mountain Isolation', where we deliberately trade the wealth and vulnerability of the ports for the absolute security of the high peaks. By entrenching ourselves in the rock, we effectively make the Zetan state impossible for any imperial power to fully annex or govern.
entities.name: The Retreat to the Karst

desc: As the secular noble dynasties fade under the pressure of continuous war, the Prince-Bishops (Vladikas) of Cetinje have taken up the heavy mantle of national leadership. This unique ''Theocratic Monarchy'' unites spiritual authority and temporal power in a single, celibate office, effectively preventing the dangerous fragmentation of our lands among rival feudal heirs. It turns the struggle for mountain independence into a perpetual holy war that every clan member is religiously bound to fight. The ''Vladika'' is not just a ruler; he is the living symbol of our resistance, ensuring that the cross and the sword are never separated in the defense of the ''Black Mountain''.
entities.name: The Vladika Sovereignty
